rules.default_dial_reason: Default to trained appraisal revealing magical presence and, with a harder check, properties; a world can restrict or broaden such mundane detection to define how readily magic can be recognized.

rules.statement: In bargaining, a seller’s asking price above 150% of an item’s actual value ends negotiations before they start, and the seller’s minimum acceptable price is 75% of the asking price. The buyer’s undercut is 2%, plus 1% for each point their Bluff check beats the seller’s Sense Motive check, to a minimum of 0%.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Bargaining — Steps 1 and 3 (pf1-rules#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded negotiation shaped by appraisal and deception; a world can change the price limits or undercut to represent its markets and buyer relationships.

rules.statement: A successful combat feint with Bluff denies the target its Dexterity bonus to AC against the feinter’s next attack; it takes a standard action, and its DC is 10 plus the target’s base attack bonus and Wisdom modifier, or 10 plus its Sense Motive bonus if that is higher.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Bluff — Feint in Combat (pf1-rules#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a brief opening created by deception and spent on the next attack; a world can change the opening’s duration or cost to model how combatants read one another.

rules.statement: At 20 Bluff ranks, a character can use a full-round action to make a suggestion to a creature within 30 feet; the target can resist with a Will save against DC 15 plus the user’s Charisma modifier. The effect lasts at most 1 hour, and a successful save prevents another attempt for 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Bluff Unchained — 20 Ranks (pf1-rules#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived compelled course of action resisted by a saving throw; a world can change its duration or resistance to set the strength of extraordinary persuasion.

rules.statement: A successful Climb check lets a character move across a steep surface at one-quarter speed; climbing faster allows half speed but imposes a −5 penalty. Failing by 5 or more causes a fall, and taking damage while climbing requires another check or the climber falls.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Climb — Check; Accelerated Climbing (pf1-rules#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to slow, risky vertical movement; a world can make climbs faster or safer, with reduced danger or effort as the tradeoff.

rules.statement: Diplomacy can improve a creature’s attitude by one step on success, plus another step per 5 points by which the check exceeds its DC, to a maximum improvement of two steps. A failed check by 5 or more worsens attitude by one step; changes usually last 1d4 hours, and the target can be influenced only once per 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Diplomacy — Influence Attitude (pf1-rules#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited, temporary change in disposition; a world can extend its duration or allow repeated influence, at the cost of making persuasion more consequential.

rules.statement: A character with at least 5 Climb ranks keeps their Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing. At 10 ranks they gain a 10-foot climb speed on surfaces of DC 20 or lower; at 15 ranks that speed becomes their base speed there and 10 feet on harder surfaces; at 20 ranks it becomes their base speed on all surfaces, with a +8 check bonus if both hands are free.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Climb Unchained (pf1-rules#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to skill-ranked mobility with surface limits; a world can grant climb speed more broadly, trading rarity and progression for easier traversal.

rules.statement: A character with at least 5 Disable Device ranks can shorten the time to disarm a trap or open a lock by one step per −5 check penalty. At 10 ranks they can try to disarm magic traps at −10 without trapfinding; at 15 ranks they can use an immediate check against a trap attack or save DC to halve damage, or avoid it entirely by exceeding the DC by 10.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Disable Device Unchained (pf1-rules#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to traps that can be bypassed or mitigated with time and skill; a world can make them harder to interact with, at the cost of greater danger to intruders.

rules.statement: A disguise takes 1d3 × 10 minutes to create, and observers’ Perception checks oppose its quality; suspicious observers check when they encounter the disguised character and every hour afterward. With 5, 10, 15, and 20 ranks, creation time falls to 1d3 minutes, 1d3 rounds, a full-round action, and a standard action, respectively.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Disguise — Check; Disguise Unchained (pf1-rules#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to disguises that require preparation and can be detected; a world can make them instantaneous or harder to see through, reducing preparation cost or detection risk.

rules.statement: Escape Artist can free a character from a grapple with a standard action against the grappler’s CMD, or from a net or certain restraining effects with a full-round action against DC 20; a snare spell uses DC 23. With 10 ranks, the character can attempt to escape any entangling effect as a standard action against its save DC + 10.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Escape Artist — Common Uses; Escape Artist Unchained (pf1-rules#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to restraints that take time and skill to escape; a world can make escape quicker or harder, trading tension for player agency.

rules.statement: In bargaining, the buyer’s final offer is based on the item’s estimated value or asking price, reduced by an undercut percentage of 2% plus 1% for each point their Bluff check beats the seller’s Sense Motive check. An asking price above 150% of actual value ends bargaining before it begins.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Diplomacy — Bargaining (pf1-rules#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to bounded negotiation with prices shaped by estimates and deception; a world can widen the bargaining range, at the cost of greater price volatility.

rules.statement: A magic trap usually has a Disable Device DC of 25 + the spell’s level, and only characters with trapfinding can disarm it under the basic rule. With 10 Disable Device ranks, a character can attempt the task at a −10 penalty even without trapfinding.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Disable Device — Magic Traps; Disable Device Unchained (pf1-rules#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to magic traps requiring special expertise; a world can let skilled specialists bypass that restriction, at the cost of a severe check penalty.

rules.statement: At 15 Escape Artist ranks, a standard-action check against the effect’s save DC + 20 suppresses slow or paralysis for 1 round, plus 1 round for each 5 points the result exceeds the DC; the attempt counts as purely mental even while paralyzed. At 20 ranks, escape from entangled, grappled, or pinned conditions becomes an immediate action at DC 10 above the effect’s DC or attacker’s CMB, and suppression can instead take a standard, move, or immediate action by increasing its DC by 10, 15, or 20 respectively.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Escape Artist, 15 and 20 Ranks (opening passage) (pf1-rules#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary suppression and action-speed tradeoffs; a world can change the DC surcharges or suppression duration, reflecting how difficult it is to exert mental control over immobilization.

rules.statement: Flying normally requires a natural ability to fly or glide, or a reliable daily magical means of flight; the Fly skill itself does not grant flight. Without a check, a flyer can remain aloft by moving more than half speed, turn up to 45 degrees at a cost of 5 feet of movement, ascend at half speed on a 45-degree angle, or descend at any angle at normal speed; other maneuvers use the listed DCs, and a winged flyer failing a check by 5 or more falls.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Fly > Special Requirement; Fly > Check; Table: Flying Maneuver DCs (pf1-rules#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to flight ability as a prerequisite and checks only for departures from routine movement; a world can make ordinary flight more or less demanding, reflecting local flight conditions.

rules.statement: When winged flight is hit by damage, a DC 10 Fly check prevents a 10-foot loss of altitude; a collision with an object at least the flyer’s size requires an immediate DC 25 check to avoid a fall. A flyer that is falling can use a DC 10 check to negate falling damage, except when the fall followed a failed Fly check or collision.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Fly > Common Uses (pf1-rules#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to checks that avert a fall or its damage in specified cases; a world can alter the check thresholds or exclusions, reflecting how fragile or forgiving flight is.

rules.statement: Winds impose Fly penalties from –2 in strong winds to –16 in tornado conditions. At each round airborne, creatures of a checked size or smaller need a DC 20 check to move; creatures of a blown-away size or smaller need a DC 25 check or are pushed 2d6×10 feet and take 2d6 nonlethal damage, and must still pass the movement check.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Fly > Modifiers > High Wind Speeds; Table: Wind Effects on Flying (pf1-rules#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to wind as an environmental field that penalizes and can displace flyers; a world can adjust thresholds, penalties, or displacement to represent its prevailing hazards.

rules.statement: At Fly ranks 5, 10, 15, and 20, successful checks unlock progressively sharper or faster maneuvers: a DC 20 turn without movement loss; a DC 30 full-speed angled ascent and reduced collision-fall distance; a DC 30 tighter turns and treatment as one size larger for wind; and a DC 35 full-speed vertical ascent and treatment as two sizes larger for wind. These benefits require skill unlock access rather than ranks alone if the optional system is not universal.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Fly Unchained (pf1-rules#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to rank-gated maneuver improvements only for characters eligible for skill unlocks; a world can grant unlocks broadly or restrict them, trading power access against specialized training.

rules.statement: Teaching a specific animal trick takes one week of work and a successful check against its listed DC; Intelligence 1 animals can know at most three tricks and Intelligence 2 animals at most six. A successful command makes an animal perform a known trick on its next action, while a wounded animal raises the handling or pushing DC by 2.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Handle Animal > Teach an Animal a Trick; Handle an Animal; Push an Animal (pf1-rules#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to learned-command control bounded by intelligence and training time; a world can change trick capacity or training duration, reflecting animal cognition and the trainer’s expertise.

rules.statement: A flying animal trained in Bombard can drop a carried item on a designated point or opponent using its base attack bonus, but cannot throw it and must fly directly over the target. A companion trained in Cocoon can wrap an object or helpless or willing Huge-or-smaller creature in webbing; escape takes a full-round Escape Artist or combat maneuver check against 20 + the companion’s CMD, or a DC 25 Strength check to break it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Handle Animal > Common Tricks > Bombard; Cocoon (pf1-rules#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to trained creature tricks with prerequisites and physical limitations; a world can vary what creatures can learn or the binding’s strength, reflecting their anatomy and training.

rules.statement: An animal taught Mark Territory spends 1 hour marking up to half a square mile; after 24 hours, 25% of qualifying low-intelligence wild-animal encounters in that area are avoided. Markings must be renewed weekly and carry a 10% weekly chance of attracting a powerful predator seeking the territory.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Handle Animal > Common Tricks > Mark Territory (pf1-rules#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a maintained territorial effect that deters some encounters but risks attracting a challenger; a world can change coverage, deterrence, or upkeep, reflecting local ecology.

rules.statement: At 15 Handle Animal ranks, a trainer can teach an animal to understand their speech with a week of effort and a successful DC 30 check; its actions remain limited by Intelligence. At 20 ranks, a DC 30 check makes the trainer’s speech understandable to any animal for 24 hours, or DC 40 for magical beasts or vermin.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Handle Animal Unchained (pf1-rules#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to short-term comprehension without increasing intelligence; a world can adjust duration or broaden eligible creatures, reflecting how strongly speech crosses species boundaries.

rules.statement: A dying character with negative hit points who continues to lose hit points can be stabilized with a first-aid check; this stops the loss without restoring hit points and also stops hit-point loss from bleeding. The task takes a standard action, and another attempt is allowed if the target remains alive.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Heal — Provide First Aid (pf1-rules#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to stopping ongoing loss but not restoring health; a setting can change retry access, with survival hinging on whether the patient is still alive.

rules.statement: Successful long-term care doubles a patient’s natural recovery: per level, the patient regains 2 hit points or ability-score points after 8 hours of rest, or 4 after a full day of complete rest. One healer can tend up to six patients for 8 hours, but cannot treat themself; the work counts as light activity.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Heal — Provide Long-Term Care (pf1-rules#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to doubling recovery under sustained care; a world can lower the patient limit or require scarce supplies, making coordinated healing costly.

rules.statement: Treating deadly wounds takes 1 hour and uses two healer’s-kit uses; for each missing use, the check takes a –2 penalty. The patient regains 1 hit point per level, plus a positive Wisdom modifier if the check beats the DC by at least 5; this treatment can benefit a creature only once per day and only within 24 hours of injury.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Heal — Treat Deadly Wounds (pf1-rules#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to level-scaled recovery gated by kit supplies and a once-daily limit; a world can make medical materials rarer, increasing the cost of emergency treatment.

rules.statement: For each saving throw against a disease or poison, a healer can check whether care grants the patient a +4 competence bonus on that save. Disease care takes 10 minutes; poison care takes a standard action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Heal — Treat Disease; Treat Poison (pf1-rules#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary +4 defensive modifier on each relevant save; a world can require longer treatment, trading time for protection from afflictions.

rules.statement: A successful check to torture a victim for 1 hour inflicts nonlethal or lethal damage, chosen by the torturer, equal to the victim’s level or Hit Dice. For NPCs, each hour also calls for a Will save against that hour’s check result, with a cumulative –1 morale penalty per hour of continued torture; success does not compel truthful answers.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): New Uses for Old Skills — Torture (pf1-rules#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to escalating pressure and damage without guaranteeing truthful disclosure; a world can impose stronger social or moral consequences, making coercion dangerous beyond the victim’s injuries.

rules.statement: A successful 2-hour deep-hurting session inflicts 1 point of chosen ability damage at DC 20, or ability drain instead if the check reaches DC 30. It otherwise follows the standard torture rules.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): New Uses for Old Skills — Deep Hurting (pf1-rules#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a costly, slow attack on an ability score; a world can raise the threshold for permanent drain, reflecting how difficult lasting injury is to cause.

rules.statement: Each day that a torturer succeeds at eroding a victim’s will, the victim takes a cumulative –1 morale penalty on Will saves for the following day. A day without successful erosion clears all accumulated penalties.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): New Uses for Old Skills — Erode Willpower (pf1-rules#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary cumulative penalty that clears after a day of respite; a world can make recovery require longer care, increasing the harm of captivity.

rules.statement: Successful coercion makes a target act friendly for 1d6 hours, plus 1 hour for every 5 points the check exceeds the DC. Repeating successful coercion at least once a week for 1d6 weeks without a failed Intimidate check extends the effect to 2d8 days; the target’s real attitude remains hostile and its help is grudging.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Intimidate — Coerce Opponent (pf1-rules#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to overt, temporary compliance that does not change true loyalty; a world can lengthen the required campaign of weekly coercion, demanding sustained effort and risk.

rules.statement: A successful demoralization check makes a target shaken for 1 round, plus 1 round per 5 points by which the result exceeds the DC. Repeated uses only extend the duration, and each retry before an hour passes raises the DC by 5; the target must be within 30 feet and able to see and hear the intimidator.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Intimidate — Demoralize Opponent (pf1-rules#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to short-lived fear with a rising retry threshold; a world can extend the penalty or limit repeated attempts, making intimidation less reliable as a sustained tactic.

rules.statement: Hearing a sound with a Perception result at least 20 above its DC reveals the exact space it came from. If its source is still unseen, it retains total concealment against attacks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Pinpoint Sound (pf1-rules#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: a 20-point margin pinpoints sound but does not remove concealment; a world can change the margin or concealment because hearing identifies location, not visible form.

rules.statement: A creature with at least 10 Perform ranks can attempt a DC 25 Perform check when casting an emotion- or language-dependent spell to raise its save DC by 1. At 15 ranks, it can instead attempt a DC 30 check to raise caster level by 1; it cannot use both benefits on the same casting.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Perform Unchained (pf1-rules#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: skilled performance can improve one spell parameter at a time; a world can tune the check or bonus because the added force takes trained effort.

rules.statement: A mount urged onward gains 10 feet of speed for 1 round on a successful DC 15 Ride check, but takes 1d3 damage; this can be done each round until it becomes fatigued after rounds equal to its Constitution score. A fatigued mount cannot be urged this way.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Ride — Common Uses: Spur Mount (pf1-rules#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: a short burst of speed costs the mount health and eventually causes fatigue; a world can change the speed, damage, or threshold because exertion wears down the animal.

rules.statement: At 5 Ride ranks, a mount gains +2 on Fortitude saves or Constitution checks to avoid fatigue or exhaustion, with the bonus increasing by 1 per 5 additional Ride ranks. At 10 ranks, urging a mount adds 20 feet of speed and grants +2 Reflex and dodge AC for the round; at 20 ranks these bonuses become 30 feet and +4.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Ride Unchained (pf1-rules#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: greater riding expertise improves a bonded mount's endurance and burst movement; a world can adjust rank thresholds or bonuses to set how exceptional the partnership is.

rules.statement: With 10 Sense Motive ranks, after 1 minute of conversation a character can try to read a creature’s surface thoughts as with detect thoughts, taking a –20 penalty and opposing the creature’s Bluff check. At 15 ranks the attempt takes 1 round, and at 20 ranks it takes a standard action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Sense Motive Unchained (pf1-rules#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: thought reading is possible but slow and heavily penalized; a world can change time or penalty because penetrating another mind requires focused attention.

rules.statement: With 15 Sense Motive ranks, when attacked a character may use an immediate action to oppose the attacker’s attack roll with a Sense Motive check; success grants +2 insight AC against that opponent for 1 minute. At 20 ranks, a successful check also negates the triggering attack.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Sense Motive Unchained (pf1-rules#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: reading an attacker's cues offers brief, foe-specific defense; a world can change the bonus, duration, or whether the first attack is stopped because anticipation depends on reading the opponent.

rules.statement: To conceal a small object on the body, oppose observers’ Perception checks with Sleight of Hand; a person frisking the character gets +4 on the search. A dagger gives the concealer +2, and an exceptionally small item or heavy, baggy clothing gives +4 or +2 respectively.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Sleight of Hand — Hide Object (pf1-rules#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: hiding is opposed by observation and a frisk favors the searcher; a world can vary modifiers because item size and clothing affect concealment.

rules.statement: A Sleight of Hand check is normally a standard action; doing it as a move action imposes –20. With 10 ranks the move-action penalty is –10; with 15 ranks it can be done as a swift action at –20; with 20 ranks a move action has no penalty and a swift action has –10.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Sleight of Hand Unchained (pf1-rules#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: speed trades away accuracy, while training reduces that tradeoff; a world can tune penalties or action speed because subtle handwork takes time.

rules.statement: In bargaining, the buyer's undercut is 2% plus 1% for each point their Bluff exceeds the seller’s Sense Motive result, with a minimum of 0%. If the seller asks more than 150% of actual value, the buyer refuses to bargain; the seller’s minimum acceptable price is 75% of the asking price.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Sense Motive — Bargaining: Steps 1–3 (pf1-rules#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: bargaining constrains price through valuation and opposed deception; a world can adjust the percentages because local markets and trust shape willingness to negotiate.

rules.statement: To identify an item’s properties using detect magic or identify, examine it for 3 rounds; you can try only once per day, and further attempts that day give the same result. At 5 Spellcraft ranks the task takes a full round, and at 10 ranks it can be done without detect magic at +10 DC.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Spellcraft — Determine Properties of Magic Item; Spellcraft Unchained (pf1-rules#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring examination and limiting repeated identification; a world can reduce the time or waive the spell requirement as expertise improves, with greater difficulty represented by the higher DC.

rules.statement: A creature using Stealth is unnoticed by observers who fail to beat its check and is treated as having total concealment; it can move at up to half speed without penalty, but attacking, running, or charging ends Stealth. A successful sniper can make one ranged attack and attempt Stealth again at –20.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Stealth — Hide; Sniping (pf1-rules#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to concealment requiring cover or distraction and ending on an attack; a world can make stealth easier or harder through visibility, movement speed, and environmental cover.

rules.statement: Following tracks requires a Survival check for each mile and again when the trail becomes difficult; the tracker moves at half speed, or can move at normal speed with –5 or up to twice speed with –20. A failed search can be retried after 1 hour outdoors or 10 minutes indoors.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Survival — Follow Tracks (pf1-rules#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to tracking through physical traces at reduced speed; a world can make trails persist or vanish faster by changing terrain and weather modifiers.

rules.statement: Survival can provide food and water for one other person per 2 check points above DC 10, or one person per 4 points above DC 20 in remote desert. A successful DC 15 check can predict weather 24 hours ahead, with each 5 points above 15 adding another day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Survival — Survive in the Wilderness; Finding Water (pf1-rules#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to survival checks supplying limited necessities and near-term forecasts; a world can raise the difficulty or reduce yield where resources are scarce.

rules.statement: While in water, a creature checks Swim each round; success permits movement at half speed as a full-round action or quarter speed as a move action. Failing by 5 or more sends it underwater, where breath is limited to twice its Constitution score in rounds before escalating checks risk drowning.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Swim — Swim (pf1-rules#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to round-by-round movement with drowning risk; a world can turn the dial through water conditions and breath duration.

rules.statement: Use Magic Device can let a user activate an item as if meeting a class, race, alignment, spell-list, or ability-score requirement; a check is generally needed each activation, or hourly when emulating an ongoing quality. Blind activation failure by 10 or more causes a mishap, which can deal 2d6 damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Use Magic Device — Read Spell/Activate Magic Item (pf1-rules#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing item use through a check while risking failure or mishap; a world can narrow which requirements can be imitated or increase the cost of failure.

rules.statement: A potion can hold a known spell of 3rd level or lower that targets creatures or objects; the drinker becomes its target, but personal-range spells are excluded. Creation takes 2 hours for a base price up to 250 gp, otherwise 1 day per 1,000 gp, and costs materials worth half the base price; the spell must be prepared and expended.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Brew Potion — Benefit; Editor’s Note (pf1-rules#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to storing a limited spell effect in a consumable drink at half-price materials and spell expenditure; a world can change eligible spell levels or the resource cost.

rules.statement: Creating a construct takes 1 day per 1,000 gp of market price and materials worth half its base price plus the full cost of its body. A newly made construct has average hit points for its Hit Dice.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Craft Construct — Benefit (pf1-rules#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring time, materials, and a body to animate a construct; a world can turn the cost and creation time while preserving the need for a crafted vessel.

rules.statement: A homunculus’s blood donor becomes its master, even if another person sculpts or animates it. Improvements can be built into its creation or added to an existing homunculus surgically; each additional 1,000 gp of abilities raises the creation Craft DC by 1, and surgery requires a successful Heal check at that DC.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Craft Construct — Homunculi; Improving Homunculi (pf1-rules#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to linking a homunculus to its blood donor and requiring reagents plus skilled work for upgrades; a world can change the strength of the bond or the price and difficulty of modification.

rules.statement: Creating a construct requires the Craft Construct feat and any mandatory caster-level prerequisites; each unmet optional spell or other bypassable requirement raises the crafting DC by 5, while missing a required caster level cannot be offset. Prepared spell slots used for requirements are expended on each day of work.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Crafting Constructs Requirements (pf1-rules#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Require the listed training and spell resources; a world can permit more exceptions, at the cost of making construct-making more accessible.

rules.statement: The full listed creation cost must be paid before work begins. Normally, work takes 1 day per 1,000 gp of market price, in uninterrupted 8-hour blocks; choosing before work to raise the DC by 5 halves the required hours, while dangerous conditions halve progress again.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Cost; Time; Accelerated Work; Dangerous Conditions (pf1-rules#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the listed price and time as the default; a world can make materials harder to obtain or allow faster work, changing the financial and risk costs.

rules.statement: Only one item can be under active construction at a time: starting another makes all materials and progress on the earlier project unusable. Work can otherwise pause between completed work blocks without losing progress.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Intermittent Creation; Simultaneous Creation (pf1-rules#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Keep projects exclusive but pausable; a world could allow concurrent projects, reducing the time-management constraint.

rules.statement: The creator makes the construct’s skill check only after completing the work. Failure by less than 5 wastes the time and materials; failure by 5 or more may, at GM discretion, produce a dangerous result such as an explosion or an uncontrolled construct.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Skill Check; Failure (pf1-rules#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the stated failure bands, with catastrophic outcomes optional; a world can make failed creation safer or more dangerous.

rules.statement: A completed construct recognizes its creator and obeys that creator’s commands. It begins with full hit points equal to the average for its Hit Dice; for an intelligent construct, the creator fixes its feats and skill ranks at creation.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): The Finished Construct (pf1-rules#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Give the maker default command authority; a world can remove or contest that loyalty, making control less reliable.

rules.statement: A golem manual supplies the relevant creation information and spells, counts as the Craft Construct feat for making that kind of golem, gives a caster-level increase for that purpose and a +5 crafting-check bonus, and waives the non-body portion of the normal cost. The user still provides the body and spends the normal construction time.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Other Methods: Golem Manuals (pf1-rules#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Let a manual replace much of the creator’s training and expense, but retain the body and time costs; a world can make manuals rarer or less complete.

rules.statement: A construct can gain modifications by paying their listed costs and meeting their requirements; basic changes improve movement, senses, or resistances within the stated caps, while spell-like abilities are limited by the construct’s Hit Dice in total spell levels.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Modifying Constructs: Basic Modifications (pf1-rules#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Permit only the listed bounded upgrades; a world can raise the costs or loosen caps to change how customizable constructs are.

rules.statement: A fleshcraft elixir grants one graft’s effect for its stated duration, takes effect the round after drinking, and requires a Fortitude save. Failure grants only the graft’s penalty, and failing by 5 or more also deals 1d6 Constitution damage; a creature cannot benefit from multiple graft effects at once this way.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Fleshwarper: Fleshcraft Elixirs (pf1-rules#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the listed save, delay, and drawback as the default; a world can make elixirs safer or harsher by changing their risks.

rules.statement: A construct shelter takes 10 minutes to form, conceals occupants from outside view while allowing them to see out, and lets the construct admit or eject creatures according to its creator’s orders. Entry can be forced by a Strength check or by damaging the shelter for one-quarter of the construct’s total hit points.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Complex Modifications: Construct Shelter (pf1-rules#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the size-based capacity and entry rules as written; a world can make shelters easier to breach or less protective.

rules.statement: A ring crafter with caster level 7 or higher spends 1 day and raw materials worth half the ring’s base price per 1,000 gp of base price. The crafter can repair a ring they could create for half the usual time and half the usual raw-material cost.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Forge Ring (Item Creation) (pf1-rules#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: allow creation and repair of eligible rings at the stated time and material costs; a setting can restrict access to trained casters because magical ringcraft requires specialized ability.

rules.statement: A creature-part ornament can grant a morale bonus to one chosen statistic against creatures of the source creature’s type: the bonus is the source’s CR divided by 4, rounded down, minimum 1, and rises by 1 against the exact same variety. It lasts 1 day, plus 1 day for each 5 by which the crafting check exceeds its DC; a gifted ornament instead uses CR divided by 6, rounded down, minimum 0, and lasts 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Grisly Ornament (Item Creation) (pf1-rules#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: ornaments provide temporary, narrowly targeted bonuses; a world can change their duration or strength because trophies draw their efficacy from the creature they came from.

rules.statement: Growing a plant creature takes 2 weeks per Hit Die and costs at least 1,000 gp per Hit Die in nutrients. After a successful nature check to form its body, a 24-hour awakening ritual has a 50% success chance; failure leaves the body dormant for 3 months before another attempt, which costs another 1,000 gp and again has a 50% chance.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Grow Plant Creature — Growing Plant Creatures (pf1-rules#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: plant bodies require time, costly materials, skill, and a nearby spirit; a world can raise the awakening chance to 75% or 100% at fitting, unspoiled sites because such places attract nature spirits.

rules.statement: A successfully awakened plant creature is not compelled to obey its maker, though it commonly treats the maker as an ally. Plant-type creatures cultivating another of their own kind gain +5 on the nature check, take half the growth time, spend 25% less on materials, and add 5% to the awakening chance per Hit Die when they perform that ritual.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Grow Plant Creature — Growing Plant Creatures (pf1-rules#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: new creatures act freely, with plant cultivators receiving practical advantages; a world can make the spirit’s relationship to its maker more binding at the cost of autonomy.

rules.statement: An infused ingested poison can carry a known spell of 3rd level or lower that targets one or more creatures and takes less than 1 minute to cast. The creator chooses the spell’s normal options, sets a caster level high enough for the spell but no higher than their own, and whoever ingests the poison becomes the spell’s target.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Infuse Poison (Item Creation) (pf1-rules#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the poison delivers its stored spell to the ingester; a world can narrow eligible spells or impose extra preparation costs because the magic is bound to a consumable dose.

rules.statement: A magical tattoo occupies a permitted body slot but does not interfere with a worn magic item in that slot, and only one magical tattoo can occupy each slot. It can be destroyed by erase if the bearer fails a Will save and the caster succeeds at a caster-level check, or by physical damage of at least 2 points per tattoo caster level in a full-round attempt against a willing or helpless bearer.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Inscribe Magical Tattoo (Item Creation) (pf1-rules#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: tattoos bind magic to the body without displacing worn items, but remain removable by powerful magic or damaging force; a world can make them harder to remove because they are embedded in living flesh.

rules.statement: A haunt or eligible creature’s residue must begin to be harvested within 10 minutes of its destruction. At least 1 minute of work halts further degradation for 24 hours; each hour of successful work yields 50 gp of components, up to 50 gp per CR, while a failure by 5 or more spoils the source.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Haunt Scavenger (Item Creation) (pf1-rules#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: timely, risky extraction yields materials scaled to the source’s CR; a world can shorten the harvesting window because ectoplasmic remains quickly decay.

rules.statement: An ornament integrated into a wondrous item grants no ongoing benefit, but can be activated once per day as a free action to grant its full benefits for 1 minute. Integrating or replacing one takes 8 hours and costs 100 gp per CR of the source creature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e skills, environment, afflictions, crafting (d20pfsrd): Monstrous Crafter (Item Creation) (pf1-rules#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: an integrated trophy produces a brief daily effect at a CR-based crafting cost; a world can change the activation frequency or duration because the ornament’s power is stored in the item.

rules.statement: A sustained remote force can move objects weighing up to 25 pounds per caster level, to a maximum of 375 pounds, at up to 20 feet per round; it lasts up to 1 round per caster level and ends if concentration stops or the target exceeds range. The same effect can instead make one combat maneuver per round, or spend its energy in one round to throw up to one target per caster level (maximum 15) within the same total weight limit.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Telekinesis (pf1-spells#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to concentration-bound, caster-level scaling; a world can raise or lower weight and range limits because sustained control demands attention.

rules.statement: A held electrical charge can be returned in a melee touch, dealing half the largest electrical damage the caster took while the spell was active; a successful hit discharges it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Body Capacitance (pf1-spells#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to storing the strongest single incoming charge and releasing it once; a world can change the fraction retained because energy is conserved imperfectly.

rules.statement: A ward lasts 1 minute per level and grants +2 AC and saves against evil sources. It permits an immediate second save with +2 against qualifying existing mental control, suppresses it on success, blocks new control and evil summoned creatures’ bodily contact, but attacking or forcing the barrier against a blocked creature ends that contact protection.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Protection from Evil (pf1-spells#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a moving, source-specific barrier with a 1-minute-per-level duration; a world can broaden the protected categories because stronger wards affect more threats.

rules.statement: A lock-opening effect attempts a caster-level check against the lock’s quality DC, adding 10; success opens up to two closures, while an arcane lock is only suspended for 10 minutes. The area limit is 10 square feet per level, and the mass version affects one closure per level within 30 feet of another.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Knock (pf1-spells#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a check-based release with a two-closure cap; a world can increase the cap because complex barriers resist being undone.

rules.statement: A blood-fueled component effect costs 1d6 hit points and supplies one component for another spell cast in the same round. A component worth over 1 gp also costs 1 Strength damage, plus 1 more per full 500 gp of value; unused created material reverts to blood at round’s end, and it cannot create magic items.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Blood Money (pf1-spells#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary components paid for with bodily injury and escalating Strength loss; a world can alter the value threshold because costly matter requires greater sacrifice.

rules.statement: A transformed alchemical item is destroyed if used before the effect ends; a transformed firearm instead returns to its original type when the duration expires. The transformation lasts 1 minute per level and cannot affect magic items.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Alchemical Tinkering (pf1-spells#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary same-or-lower-cost substitutions with destruction risk for consumed goods; a world can change the allowed substitutions because matter resists lasting alteration.

rules.statement: An animated rope can act only within 1 foot of itself and must be thrown near its intended target; it can entangle a creature that fails a Reflex save. Commands take a move action, are limited to one per round, and the animation lasts 1 round per level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Animate Rope (pf1-spells#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-range animated tool requiring repeated commands; a world can extend reach or command frequency because autonomous tools need more upkeep.

rules.statement: An enlarging effect raises a humanoid one size category, multiplies its weight by 8, and gives +2 Strength and −2 Dexterity, with −1 to attacks and AC; worn and carried gear enlarges too, but items leaving the creature revert immediately. Multiple magical size increases do not stack.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Enlarge Person (pf1-spells#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one size step with fixed attribute tradeoffs and nonstacking; a world can permit greater growth because larger bodies strain available space and control.

rules.statement: Erase can remove magical or ordinary writing from a scroll or up to two pages. Ordinary writing is automatically removed by touch if nobody else holds it; otherwise removal succeeds 90% of the time. Magical writing must be touched and requires a caster-level check against DC 15, with a natural 1 failing; failure against explosive runes, a warding glyph, or a sepia sigil activates it instead.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Erase (pf1-spells#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing removal of writing but require touch and a check for magical marks; a failed attempt can trigger dangerous inscriptions.

rules.statement: Excavation moves up to one 5-foot cube of dirt, dust, or sand instantaneously, but cannot tunnel or affect solid rock or earth creatures. A pit may make a Medium or smaller creature fall prone unless it saves; an optional grit cloud grants concealment in the affected and adjacent squares for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Expeditious Excavation (pf1-spells#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limited earth-moving that cannot bore through rock; a world may broaden materials or volume, at the cost of larger terrain changes.

rules.statement: Feather Fall slows eligible free-falling targets to 60 feet per round and prevents landing damage while active, lasting until landing or 1 round per caster level. It affects up to one Medium-or-smaller target per caster level within 20 feet; larger targets count as multiple targets, and normal falling resumes when the effect expires.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Feather Fall (pf1-spells#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to slowing free falls and negating impact only while the effect lasts; a world can change the fall rate or target capacity, balancing safety against spell reach.

rules.statement: A caster can intensify Keif Vigor once per round, increasing its Strength bonus by 2 for that round per chosen increase, up to +10 at caster level 15. Each increase costs 1d6 nonlethal damage and removes an extra round of duration; the target becomes fatigued when the spell ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Keif Vigor (pf1-spells#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to trading bodily harm and remaining duration for stronger temporary power; a world can raise the ceiling or change the injury cost.

rules.statement: A magic weapon grants +1 to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute per caster level, but does not enhance natural weapons and its attack bonus does not stack with a masterwork weapon’s +1. The greater version grants +1 per four caster levels, up to +5, lasts 1 hour per level, and can affect one weapon or 50 grouped projectiles; a projectile loses the effect after use.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Magic Weapon (pf1-spells#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary bonus bound to the selected weapon or grouped ammunition; a world can increase the bonus or duration, with projectile effects consumed on use.

rules.statement: Mirror Strike stores a single melee attack to use before the end of the caster’s next turn, comparing its roll against two opponents in reach. A hit on both deals half damage to each; a hit on only one deals full damage to that target, and the stored effect expires unused at the deadline.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mirror Strike (pf1-spells#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to splitting one imminent attack across two nearby targets with divided damage when both are hit; a world can extend its window or target reach, reducing the timing pressure.

rules.statement: Lucky Number lasts 24 hours or until discharged, but the passage gives no description of its operative effect. The accompanying Path of Numbers describes eight basic energies and 64 possible pairings as templates for events across the multiverse.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Lucky Number — The Path of Numbers (pf1-spells#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to treating eight energies and their 64 pairings as a cosmological classification, not a guaranteed way to predict outcomes; a world could make the templates operational at a cost of simplifying fate.

rules.statement: Reinforce Armaments lasts 10 minutes per caster level. A fragile weapon or armor suit temporarily loses that quality; ordinary equipment becomes masterwork and has twice its usual hardness, while masterwork or magical equipment only gains doubled hardness.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Reinforce Armaments (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary reinforcement of one touched item; a world could extend it to multiple objects by splitting the duration, with less time available per object.

rules.statement: Communal Reinforce Armaments divides its duration into 10-minute periods among the touched weapons or armor suits. Each object receives the same temporary reinforcement as the single-target version.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Reinforce Armaments, Communal (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sharing a fixed duration among selected objects; a world could limit the number of objects to preserve the full duration on each.

rules.statement: Snapdragon Fireworks lasts 1 round per caster level and permits one move-action launch each round. A burst in a selected 5-foot square deals 1d4 fire damage; a Reflex save halves the damage and negates the 1-round dazzled effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Snapdragon Fireworks (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to repeated, limited bursts in chosen squares; a world could make the display harmless, trading its damage for spectacle.

rules.statement: Spirit Share lasts 1 round per caster level. During that time, a standard action and touch deliver one dose of a potable liquid in the caster’s possession to a willing creature; poisons and liquids primarily harmful when drunk are excluded.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spirit Share (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transferring a single safe dose by touch; a world could permit harmful liquids, at the cost of removing the willingness safeguard.

rules.statement: Sundering Shards lasts 1 hour per caster level or until used. After its weapon destroys an item with a successful sunder maneuver, the spell discharges: the item’s bearer takes 1d6 damage, and each adjacent creature other than the weapon’s wielder must save or also take 1d6 damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Sundering Shards (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to storing one triggered burst in a weapon; a world could let it persist through multiple sunderings, but each use would consume some of the stored force.

rules.statement: A target of Touch of Gracelessness takes a Dexterity penalty of 1d6 plus 1 per two caster levels, to a maximum of 1d6+5, for 1 round per caster level; Dexterity cannot fall below 1. A successful Fortitude save halves that penalty and prevents the prone and flight-maneuverability effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Touch of Gracelessness (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, save-reducible impairment; a world could make the movement consequences milder, reducing the spell’s disabling impact.

rules.statement: Transfer Tattoo moves one magic tattoo between creatures immediately. An unwilling creature can resist with a Fortitude save; if it succeeds, the transfer fails and the caster is staggered for 1 round. A tattoo can be taken from a body dead for no longer than 1 hour per caster level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Transfer Tattoo (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transferring a tattoo with consent or a successful resistance check; a world could forbid transfer from the dead, avoiding the use of corpses as sources.

rules.statement: Tripvine animates a 10-foot rope or vine to attack creatures in a designated 10-foot-square area for 10 minutes per caster level. Its combat maneuver bonus is caster level +2; a creature aware of it gains +4 defense against its trip attempt.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Tripvine (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an animated object that attacks within a bounded area; a world could require ongoing upkeep or limit its attacks to a single target.

rules.statement: Darkness lowers illumination by one step within 20 feet of the touched object for 1 minute per caster level. It does nothing where the area is already dark, does not stack with itself, and only a higher-level magical light can raise illumination; equal- or lower-level light effects can be countered or dispelled.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Darkness (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a radius-limited dimming field with level-based interaction; a world could make it force darkness, but that would also make it harder to counter.

rules.statement: Accelerate Poison immediately starts a poison’s delayed effects. For poison without an onset delay, it doubles the frequency of saves and damage while halving the duration; it does not change the cure condition.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Accelerate Poison (pf1-spells#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to accelerating the existing poison rather than changing its cure; a world could also accelerate recovery, reducing the danger of the faster onset.

rules.statement: A blood-affecting effect can target only creatures with blood; a failed save causes 1 fire damage each round, while orc-subtyped targets instead gain +2 morale Strength and take no fire damage. Its mythic version deals 1d3 damage per round to failing non-orcs and gives orcs fire resistance 5; spending two mythic-power uses lets allies count as orcs for the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Passage opening (Boiling Blood; heading not shown) (pf1-spells#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to blood-bearing targets and the listed orc exception; a world can broaden eligible targets, at the cost of changing who is harmed or empowered.

rules.statement: Brittle Portal reduces the hardness of each nonmagical surface in its 5-foot-radius area by 2 per caster level for 1 round per level; the caster centers the area on a flat surface.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Brittle Portal (pf1-spells#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a localized, temporary reduction in surface durability; a world can increase the radius or duration, making more structures vulnerable.

rules.statement: Buoyancy makes affected creatures and objects float on water at least 1 foot deep, but a creature trying to stay submerged must make a DC 20 Swim check each round. The effect ends if its target spends at least 1 round on dry land.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Buoyancy (pf1-spells#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to buoyancy ending after a round on dry land; a world can change that environmental end condition, affecting how long the altered state persists.

rules.statement: Carry Companion turns a helpful animal or magical beast into an inert stone figurine, including its carried and worn items; placing it on the ground, touching it, and speaking a command restores it. Damage to the figurine carries over to the creature, and a creature that is not at least helpful will not accept the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Carry Companion (pf1-spells#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to willing or helpful companions and restoration by a command; a world can alter the attitude threshold or release method, with the companion’s safety at stake.

rules.statement: Codespeak lets its recipients speak, read, and write a shared language for 10 minutes per caster level; outsiders hear babble, and the writing becomes unreadable when the spell expires. The same recipients can read it again if the same caster repeats the spell, while a codebreaker can decipher it one page at a time with DC 30 Linguistics checks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Codespeak (pf1-spells#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary language shared only by recipients; a world can make the writing persist or change who can decipher it, affecting secrecy and access to records.

rules.statement: An eldritch conduit marks a creature that fails its save; before the effect ends, the caster may use that creature as the origin of a cone, cylinder, line, or sphere spell, ending the conduit. The creature must be within the spell’s range when used; the greater version can mark multiple creatures, and using one conduit ends only that creature’s effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Eldritch Conduit (pf1-spells#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one area spell routed through a marked, in-range target, consuming that mark; a world can allow repeated uses or more spell shapes, increasing tactical reach.

rules.statement: Hidden Knowledge transfers up to 50 words from the caster’s mind onto a runic tattoo, masking the resulting memory gap until the chosen duration ends, which may be up to 1 day per level. Dispel magic destroys the knowledge completely rather than returning it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Hidden Knowledge (pf1-spells#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary storage on the caster’s skin with permanent loss if dispelled; a world can change the storage medium or recovery risk, trading secrecy for memory security.

rules.statement: Full Pouch copies an eligible alchemical consumable as it is drawn, placing the second, slightly lower-quality copy in the caster’s hand. The copied item otherwise works like the original, and its saving-throw DC is whichever is higher: the original’s or the spell’s.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Full Pouch (pf1-spells#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to making one diminished copy of an eligible alchemical item; a world can widen eligible items or remove the quality reduction, increasing the value created.

rules.statement: A repair effect restores 1d6 damage per caster level, to 5d6, and can restore a destroyed magic item’s properties only if the caster level is at least twice the item’s. A stronger version restores 1d6 plus 1 per caster level, to 10d6+10, and needs caster level equal to the item’s; neither version repairs charged or single-use items.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Make Whole (pf1-spells#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to repairing physical damage and eligible item properties; a world can tighten the caster-level threshold because restoring enchantments is difficult.

rules.statement: A blood mark on a weapon must strike a creature within 1 minute or expire unused. Once it marks a struck target, the caster can spend a move action to learn that target’s direction and rough distance; the effect persists until dispelled or removed by curse-removal magic.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mark of Blood (pf1-spells#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to lasting tracking of the marked victim; a world can make it easier to remove because the caster invests life essence in the mark.

rules.statement: A mirror opens a space for up to eight Medium creatures for 1 hour per level. Covering the mirror disables entry, while breaking it or moving it more than 5 feet ends the spell and expels occupants, who become nauseated for 1d6 rounds; only one creature can pass through at a time.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mirror Hideaway (pf1-spells#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a hidden, bounded refuge with one-at-a-time access; a world can make its anchor more fragile because the mirror sustains the portal.

rules.statement: A rune placed on another creature costs paint worth 25 gp, lasts 24 hours, and cannot be stacked with another rune of this spell on the same bearer. The bearer activates its chosen benefit under that rune’s specified conditions; unused markings and benefits fade when the time runs out.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Rune of Rule (pf1-spells#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one conditional stored benefit per bearer; a world can increase the material cost or shorten the window because the rune is specially prepared.

rules.statement: A full simulacrum has half the original’s levels or Hit Dice and remains under its maker’s command, but cannot grow stronger. It melts away when destroyed; repairing it takes at least 24 hours, a magical laboratory, and 100 gp per hit point. A lesser version lasts 1 hour per level, has no magical abilities, and is not controlled by its maker.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Simulacrum (pf1-spells#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited, obedient duplicate that cannot advance; a world can raise repair costs because maintaining a replica requires rare resources.

rules.statement: Turning a fire source into fireworks extinguishes it and blinds creatures with line of sight within 120 feet for 1d4+1 rounds unless they resist. The smoke option makes sight ineffective in or through the cloud and can penalize Strength and Dexterity by 4; those penalties last 1d4+1 rounds after leaving or after the cloud dissipates.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Pyrotechnics (pf1-spells#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, source-dependent area effect; a world can increase its duration or radius at the cost of requiring a fire source.

rules.statement: The hidden space created by the rope effect holds up to eight creatures and the rope supports up to 16,000 pounds; excess weight can pull it free. Occupants are beyond ordinary spell reach, and everything inside falls out when the spell ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Rope Trick (pf1-spells#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited extradimensional refuge tethered to a rope; a world can lower its weight or occupant capacity because the rope is the space’s only anchor.

rules.statement: A size-transfer spell reduces a larger humanoid target by one size category and enlarges the caster by one category. If the spell ends for either one, both return to normal size.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Steal Size (pf1-spells#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to paired size changes that end together; a world can make the effect easier to disrupt because both bodies share its magic.

rules.statement: When this spell’s rune is activated, its particular benefit applies only under its listed trigger: examples include a +5 bonus to a qualifying roll, a second save after failing against poison or disease, or a one-round improvement to defense or spell effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Rune of Rule (pf1-spells#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one narrowly triggered benefit per rune; a world can strengthen a benefit only by adding stricter activation conditions.

rules.statement: A spell can assemble one disassembled siege engine using up to one fewer worker per 2 caster levels. Knowledge (engineering) removes one more worker if the caster has any ranks in it, plus one for every 5 ranks; if these reductions do not cover all required workers, the spell fails.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Siege engine assembly (heading absent; description before Section 15) (pf1-spells#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring a miniature focus worth 10 gp and enough caster-level and engineering reductions to cover the workers; a world can relax the worker requirement, trading away the need for skilled labor.

rules.statement: A power that creates an area effect can apply one shared combat maneuver check to each creature in its area each round; the check uses caster level as its base attack bonus and the effect’s stated bonuses. The check can recur for the spell’s duration, and creatures entering the area are also affected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Black Tentacles (pf1-spells#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed area and a shared recurring check for the listed duration; a world can alter the area or repetition rate, changing how many targets the effect can constrain.

rules.statement: Haste lasts 1 round per level, grants one extra attack during a full attack, and increases movement modes by 30 feet up to twice normal speed. Its extra attack does not stack with similar effects, it does not grant an extra action, and multiple haste effects do not stack; haste counters and dispels slow.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Haste (pf1-spells#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated capped speed increase and nonstacking extra attack; a world can raise the cap or allow stacking, making repeated enhancements more powerful.

rules.statement: Slow lasts 1 round per level, makes affected creatures staggered so they can take either a move or standard action but not both, and halves their speed. Multiple slow effects do not stack; slow counters and dispels haste.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Slow (pf1-spells#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the action restriction and half-speed effect for the stated duration; a world can soften or intensify the restriction, changing how much agency the target loses.

rules.statement: A field can randomly assign one of two opposing effects at the start of each affected creature’s turn: time shudder gives each creature in its 30-foot-radius area a 50% chance of haste and otherwise slows it, for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Time Shudder (pf1-spells#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an equal 50/50 chance of either effect each turn; a world can weight the outcomes, making the field more reliably beneficial or harmful.

rules.statement: Visualization spells can hold a chosen enhancement for up to 24 hours, then be expended as an immediate action for a single stronger effect, after which the spell ends. The body version requires 1 hour and incense worth 200 gp; its Constitution choice raises maximum and current hit points by Hit Dice, while its other choices grant associated bonuses.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Visualization of The Body (pf1-spells#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stored benefit that can be cashed in once, ending the spell; a world can change the preparation cost or immediate payoff, trading reliability for a larger burst.

rules.statement: The mind visualization spell takes 1 hour and incense worth 200 gp, lasts up to 24 hours, and grants a +5 bonus to checks associated with one chosen mental ability. It can instead be expended as an immediate action for a temporary ability tied to that choice, ending the spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Visualization of The Mind (pf1-spells#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one chosen mental specialty and a single expendable enhancement; a world can change the duration or payoff, trading advance preparation for a short-lived advantage.

rules.statement: A maintained wall of loose natural ground provides total cover, but requires concentration and can last no more than 1 round per 2 caster levels. When it reaches 0 hit points or concentration stops, it explodes, damaging adjacent creatures; a successful Reflex save halves the damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Blast Barrier (pf1-spells#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fragile, concentration-maintained barrier whose collapse is dangerous; a world can make it sturdier or less explosive, trading cover duration against the hazard of release.

rules.statement: Blood Scent lets a target detect and pinpoint injured creatures by smell for 1 minute per level; creatures below half health or taking bleed damage count as strong scents. Orcs and creatures under rage gain +2 to attack and damage against creatures they smell, or +4 against strong scents.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Blood Scent (pf1-spells#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default the scent effect to detect injured creatures within the spell’s range; worlds can adjust what counts as injured, with stronger scents exposing more severely wounded targets.

rules.statement: A Blood Sentinel lasts 10 minutes per level, acts as a familiar but grants neither Alertness nor its animal type’s special ability, and cannot be created if the caster already has a familiar or sentinel. If it is slain, the caster takes 2 points of Intelligence drain and its body becomes a statue.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Blood Sentinel (pf1-spells#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one bonded sentinel or familiar at a time; a world can change the bond limit, while destruction costs the caster Intelligence.

rules.statement: Blot makes recognizable writing and symbols on surfaces within a 10-foot-radius burst illegible for 24 hours. Magical writing can be dispelled by the effect, while artifacts and unique surfaces are unaffected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Blot (pf1-spells#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default the effect to ordinary marked surfaces within the burst; a world can decide what counts as a unique surface, protecting rare inscriptions.

rules.statement: Burrow grants movement through sand, loose soil, or gravel at 15 feet per round, reduced to 10 feet in medium or heavy armor or load, and through stone at 5 feet; the target cannot run or charge. Loose material closes 1 round after passage, and the target must hold its breath underground; the mythic augmented form can make an open tunnel that closes when the spell ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Burrow (pf1-spells#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default the spell to temporary underground movement without breathing; worlds can allow lasting tunnels at the cost of two mythic-power uses.

rules.statement: Fractions of Heal and Harm redirects 25% of the damage from the next instantaneous area-damage spell of 3rd level or lower into healing for the caster, leaving the spell to deal 75% damage. The follow-up must be cast before the end of the caster’s next turn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Fractions of Heal and Harm (pf1-spells#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transferring one quarter of eligible damage into healing; worlds can alter the fraction, but the healing is paid for by reducing the spell’s damage.

rules.statement: Enter Image allows the caster to sense around depictions of their likeness within range, with Perception checks 10 harder than normal, or place their consciousness in one image. While inhabiting an image the caster’s body is helpless, the image can only make limited movements and speech, and the caster may return as an immediate action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Enter Image (pf1-spells#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to remote perception through images and limited animation in one at a time; worlds can broaden the permitted actions, balanced by leaving the caster’s body helpless.

rules.statement: Erode Defenses removes 1 point of a target’s damage reduction and natural armor after a failed save, with further cumulative losses each round until a save succeeds or the spell ends. All penalties already accrued remain until the spell expires, then both defenses return to normal; only one such spell can affect a target at once.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Erode Defenses (pf1-spells#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to cumulative defense loss while saves fail; worlds can change the recovery timing, with the standard rule restoring defenses at expiration.

rules.statement: A target in gaseous form gains damage reduction 10/magic, immunity to poison, sneak attacks, and critical hits, and can fly 10 feet and pass through small openings. It cannot attack, cast most spells, manipulate objects, or enter liquids; the form lasts 2 minutes per level, and the mythic version can expand to obscure vision.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Gaseous Form (pf1-spells#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default the transformation to mist-like passage with restricted interaction; worlds can permit additional actions, trading away the substantial limits on attacks and object use.

rules.statement: Fly grants flight at 60 feet per round, reduced to 40 feet for medium or heavy armor or load, for 1 minute per level; ascending halves speed and descending doubles it. If the effect ends while airborne, the subject descends 60 feet per round for 1d6 rounds before falling; dispelling produces this descent, but negation by an antimagic field does not.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Fly (pf1-spells#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sustained flight with a controlled descent when the effect ends; worlds can change the grace period, while abrupt negation remains dangerous.

rules.statement: A trap must be known and precisely located before it can receive this spell’s improvement. It can hold only one improvement from the spell at a time; recasting replaces the existing improvement rather than adding a second.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Opening fragment before Section 15: Copyright Notice (pf1-spells#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one replaceable upgrade per trap; a world can permit multiple upgrades at the cost of weakening this limit, while requiring precise knowledge prevents blind modification.

rules.statement: Lightning Conductor absorbs electricity damage up to a capacity of 18 points, with capacity increasing by 6 for every 2 caster levels beyond 5th, to 60 at 19th level. Once at least 6 points are stored, all stored energy can be discharged; each 6 points adds 1d6 electricity damage, but leftover points are wasted and the charge dissipates at the end of the turn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Lightning Conductor (pf1-spells#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a capped reserve that converts incoming damage into a brief attack; a world can raise the cap or let charges last longer, but should price this in stronger retaliation or storage risk.

rules.statement: Keen Edge doubles a piercing or slashing weapon’s threat range for 10 minutes per level, but it cannot affect natural weapons. Threat-range increases do not stack, and an enhanced arrow or bolt loses the effect after one use whether it hits or misses.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Keen Edge (pf1-spells#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one non-stacking weapon enhancement with single-use ammunition; a world can allow repeated enhancement, but the increased chance of critical hits raises combat power.
