rules.statement: A creature changed by Iron Spine takes 1d6 piercing damage and is sickened for 1 round whenever it moves, for up to 1 round per caster level; it may avoid this by remaining still. Creatures with cold-iron damage reduction are nauseated instead, and creatures without a skeleton or hard carapace are unaffected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Iron Spine (pf1-spells#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to movement-triggered harm that can be avoided by stopping; a world can broaden eligible targets, but the bodily structure required to host the effect limits who suffers it.

rules.statement: Shifting Sand creates a 20-foot spread that erases tracks and makes movement difficult for 1 round per level. Creatures entering or starting their turn there save or become entangled until their next turn; moving while entangled calls for another save or they fall prone, while the caster can move the area up to 10 feet as a move action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shifting Sand (pf1-spells#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived moving hazard with recurring saves; a world can widen or lengthen it, but the caster’s control and the danger of the terrain should constrain its use.

rules.statement: Secret Page permanently changes a touched page of up to 3 square feet to look like different writing; a special spoken word reveals and restores the original text, and speaking it twice removes the effect. Ordinary language-reading magic does not expose the contents, while true seeing detects hidden material but needs language-reading magic to decipher it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Secret Page (pf1-spells#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to concealed text with a word-based reveal and limited magical detection; a world can make it harder or easier to uncover, balancing secrecy against access to the key.

rules.statement: Shaper’s Touch lets the caster reshape a whole unattended, nonmagical object of hardness 19 or less while concentrating, for at most 1 round per level. It reshapes up to 1 cubic foot per round at hardness 9 or less, or 1/4 cubic foot per round at hardness 10 or more; the result lasts 24 hours, and an object too large to finish within the spell’s duration is unaffected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shaper’s Touch (pf1-spells#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary reshaping with a hardness and work-rate ceiling; a world can allow partial or permanent changes, but should charge extra time or materials for lasting alteration.

rules.statement: Shrink Item reduces a nonmagical object within the limit of 2 cubic feet per caster level to one-sixteenth size in each dimension, or about one four-thousandth of its volume and mass, for 1 day per level. Tossing it onto a solid surface or using the caster’s command word restores it and ends the spell; permanent versions can be shrunk and expanded repeatedly only by the original caster.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shrink Item (pf1-spells#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to substantial temporary size reduction with caster-controlled restoration; a world can permit anyone to restore it, but limiting who can operate permanent versions protects stored objects.

rules.statement: Touch Injection places one held elixir, extract, poison, or potion into a body compartment for up to 1 hour per level, letting the caster deliver it by touch. A successful touch applies it immediately and grants its usual save; a miss preserves it, while poison risks exposure on casting at 5% without poison-use training and on a natural 1 during injection.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Touch Injection (pf1-spells#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to carrying and delivering one substance through the body with a poison exposure risk; a world can remove that risk, but should require training or another cost.

rules.statement: A spell that changes a creature’s body can grant the assumed form’s listed movement modes, senses, attacks, defenses, and vulnerabilities. The available form sizes and benefits depend on the spell’s tier; the effect lasts for its stated duration unless ended early.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Undead Anatomy; Elemental Body; Fey Form (pf1-spells#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to granting only abilities explicitly listed for the chosen form and tier; a world could broaden that list, at the cost of more powerful and less predictable transformations.

rules.statement: Some transformations also make the subject register as a different creature type or count as that type for only specified effects. These changes do not automatically make the subject susceptible to every effect that targets that creature type.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Undead Anatomy (pf1-spells#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to changing detection and interaction only where specified; a world could make type changes universal, at the cost of additional vulnerabilities.

rules.statement: A spell can temporarily change a weapon’s physical properties so it bypasses one selected defense type: bludgeoning, cold iron, piercing, silver, or slashing. It affects one weapon or up to 50 projectiles together, without changing the weapon’s damage type, hardness, or hit points.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Versatile Weapon (pf1-spells#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one selected property per casting and preserve the weapon’s other statistics; a world could permit multiple properties, at the cost of broader armor-piercing power.

rules.statement: When a spell affects multiple touched creatures, its total duration may be divided evenly among them. Water breathing, for example, lasts 2 hours per caster level in total, split among all creatures touched; it allows breathing in water without preventing breathing air.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Water Breathing (pf1-spells#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to dividing a fixed duration pool among all targets; a world could give every target the full duration, at the cost of multiplying the spell’s total benefit.

rules.statement: A spell may absorb a cloud-like effect of up to one 10-foot cube per caster level, removing it from the area; magical clouds require a caster-level check against DC 11 plus the effect’s caster level. The caster can contain it for up to 1 round per level while holding their breath, then release it as a breath weapon; failing to release it before the spell ends subjects the caster to its effects and automatically fails the saving throw.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Absorbing Inhalation (pf1-spells#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary containment with the original effect’s rules and a deadline; a world could allow indefinite storage, at the cost of removing the failure risk and enabling stockpiling.

rules.statement: An occupied destination for dimension door causes 1d6 damage to each traveler and redirects them to a random suitable space within 100 feet. If none is open, each takes another 2d6 and is redirected within 1,000 feet; if no space is open there, each takes another 4d6 and the spell fails. The caster cannot act again until their next turn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dimension Door (pf1-spells#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to accurate arrival when the target space is free and escalating displacement and damage when blocked; a world could make blocked travel harmless, at the cost of reducing the danger of careless teleportation.

rules.statement: A confusion effect determines a subject’s behavior by a d% roll each round: 01–25 acts normally, 26–50 babbles, 51–75 damages itself for 1d8 plus Strength modifier using a held item, and 76–100 attacks the nearest creature. An attacked subject retaliates on its next turn if still affected; the effect normally lasts 1 round per level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Confusion (pf1-spells#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fresh behavior roll each affected turn, with the printed chances; a world could make the behavior more controllable, at the cost of weakening the loss-of-control effect.

rules.statement: A curse set on a creature that sleeps triggers 1 hour after its next sleep begins, dealing 1d6 fire damage per 2 caster levels to a maximum of 8d6 and then 2d6 fire damage each round until death or quenching. Only one such curse can affect a creature at once, and the initial damage wakes a sleeping target.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Curse of Burning Sleep (pf1-spells#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single pending curse that triggers on the stated sleep condition; a world could let curses stack, at the cost of potentially lethal accumulated damage.

rules.statement: Firefall consumes one nonmagical fire source, extinguishing up to a 20-foot cube of it; a larger fire is only partly put out. A fire-subtype creature used as the source instead takes 1 damage per caster level, while magical fires are not extinguished.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Firefall (pf1-spells#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring a nearby fire as the consumed source; a world could let the caster supply equivalent fuel instead, at the cost of weaker or costlier output.

rules.statement: Effects that alter a target’s body can have lasting and selectively limited consequences: Ignoble Form lasts 24 hours, while Irregular Size is permanent and weakens one chosen limb set. A second spell may replace a graft, but only one Temporary Graft can be active at once.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Ignoble Form; Irregular Size; Temporary Graft (pf1-spells#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transformations respecting each spell’s stated duration and capacity; a world could permit stacking or easier reversal, with the cost of greater instability or resource use.

rules.statement: Liquefy turns a qualifying object into a pool of liquid for 1 round per caster level, disabling its magical or alchemical properties during that time. If an outside effect disperses or dilutes it, the object saves or becomes broken; a broken object that fails is destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Liquefy (pf1-spells#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to preserving the item’s identity and ongoing timed effects while suppressing its properties; a world could make liquid objects more vulnerable, risking damage or destruction.

rules.statement: Resilient Reservoir redirects 1 point of each qualifying melee or touch-spell hit into a pool capped at caster level, up to 20. Before the spell ends, the caster can spend pool points to boost a roll by the same amount; falling below 0 hit points instead releases the remaining pool as a 15-foot-radius blast.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Resilient Reservoir (pf1-spells#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a capped pool that trades incoming damage reduction for later benefit; a world could raise the cap or permit more releases, at the cost of greater stored-energy danger.

rules.statement: Shadowy Haven creates a hidden extradimensional space holding up to 10 creatures, but its entrance is open only in dim light and admits or releases one creature at a time. When the spell ends, occupants are ejected; if the entrance is shut at expiration, there is a 50% chance they instead emerge on the Shadow Plane 1d10 miles away.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadowy Haven (pf1-spells#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to access being governed by the local light condition and capacity; a world could remove the light restriction, but should charge another risk or cost for safe access.

rules.statement: Tailwind lets a linked group hustle without fatigue and gives flying targets 20 feet of free movement each round in the chosen direction. Targets must stay within 120 feet of one another; direction can be changed once per hour, and the effect does not work underwater.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Tailwind (pf1-spells#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to maintaining the group-distance boundary and limited redirection; a world could widen the group’s range, at the cost of reduced duration or control.

rules.statement: Temporary Graft requires a body part from a creature of the caster’s size and lasts 1 minute per caster level. Only one graft can function at once; attaching another immediately ends the earlier graft and drops that part.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Temporary Graft (pf1-spells#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one graft slot and a matching-size source; a world could allow multiple grafts, with compatibility or upkeep costs.

rules.statement: A spell may transform ammunition fired by a siege engine into one chosen energy type for 10 minutes per caster level without changing its base damage. The selected type can add a distinct secondary effect, such as area splash, entangling ice, stagger, ignition, or deafness.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Energy Siege Shot (pf1-spells#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to choosing one energy type at casting and applying it only to the targeted engine’s ammunition; a world could allow switching types, at the cost of extra time or components.

rules.statement: Fabrication changes nonliving material into a product of the same material, affecting up to 10 cubic feet per caster level, or 1 cubic foot per level for minerals. It takes 1 round per 10 cubic feet, consumes raw material worth the resulting item’s crafting materials, and may require a Craft check for fine work; it cannot create creatures or magic items.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Fabricate (pf1-spells#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to same-material conversion with a volume ceiling; worlds can vary the volume and craftsmanship check, paid for with the source material.

rules.statement: A mobile wind barrier can protect up to one Medium creature per level, with larger creatures counting as 4, 8, 16, or 32 Medium creatures by size. It lasts 1 minute per level, deflects incoming arrows and bolts without obstructing the protected creatures’ own shots, and fails inside a stronger wind or weather effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Fickle Winds (pf1-spells#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a moving, duration-limited defensive field; worlds can change its capacity or duration, while stronger weather overrides it.

rules.statement: A curse reduces worn armor or shield hardness, armor bonus, and enhancement bonus by 1 initially and by another 1 per hour of wear. Once removed, those values recover by 1 every 2 hours; hardness reaching 0 creates a 20% chance of becoming broken when struck, and enhancement reaching 0 suppresses the item’s other special abilities.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Flexile Curse (pf1-spells#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to gradual deterioration with timed recovery after removal; a world can increase the degradation rate, at the cost of making the curse less recoverable.

rules.statement: A spell can convert normal rock into mud in an area of up to two 10-foot cubes per level, with mud no deeper than 10 feet; the change persists until dispelled or reversed, though exposure eventually dries it into dirt. The reverse conversion permanently turns normal mud or quicksand into soft stone, and creatures in the mud can attempt a Reflex save to escape before it hardens.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Transmute Rock to Mud; Transmute Mud to Rock (pf1-spells#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to persistent, reversible material conversion; worlds can change affected volume or reversal conditions, with the terrain’s hazards as the cost.

rules.statement: A passage through wood, plaster, or stone lasts 1 hour per level and is 5 feet wide by 8 feet high; its depth is 10 feet, plus 5 feet per three caster levels above 9th, capped at 25 feet. When it ends, occupants are ejected through the nearest exit, or the far exit if dispelled or dismissed and one exists.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Passwall (pf1-spells#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, bounded tunnel that ejects occupants on closure; worlds can vary depth or duration, while unsuitable materials remain impassable.

rules.statement: A cloth up to 10 feet square can hold objects piled within a 10-foot cube as a two-dimensional embroidered image for 1 day per level. The owner can restore the contents as a full-round action, consuming the cloth; destroying or significantly damaging it loses the stored objects, and unique objects such as artifacts cannot be stored this way.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Treasure Stitching (pf1-spells#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to storage in a mundane cloth with a finite duration and a destructive failure risk; worlds can change capacity or retrieval conditions, balanced by the cloth’s vulnerability.

rules.statement: A transformation of a dog lasts 1 hour per level and can affect one dog for every 3 caster levels, to a maximum of five at level 15. At the end, the transformed dogs dissolve into gore and bones; a dog that trusts the caster takes a –4 penalty on its save, and transformed dogs can be commanded like summoned creatures.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Vile Dog Transformation (pf1-spells#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary creature transformation with lethal expiration; worlds can change the number or command rules, while trust makes resistance harder.

rules.statement: A wielder can make attacks with a temporarily flattened melee weapon as touch attacks that ignore armor, although force effects still protect against them. Bludgeoning weapons deal half damage and count as slashing, and the effect ends if the weapon leaves the caster’s hand.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dimensional Blade (pf1-spells#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a hand-bound weapon alteration that bypasses ordinary armor; worlds can change which defenses it ignores, while dropping the weapon ends the benefit.

rules.statement: A ray deals 2d6 damage per caster level, to a maximum of 40d6, and disintegrates a creature reduced to 0 or fewer hit points. A successful Fortitude save reduces the damage to 5d6; against nonliving matter it can destroy up to a 10-foot cube, including force-built objects but not protective magical effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Disintegrate (pf1-spells#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-target destructive ray with a save that reduces damage; worlds can vary its damage ceiling or what materials it affects, while magical barriers can remain immune.

rules.statement: A spell can transform a suitable melee weapon into a glaive, replacing its normal magical properties for the spell’s duration. The glaive begins at +1, improves to +2 at caster level 15 and +3 at 19, gains spell storing at level 14, and switches from flaming to flaming burst at level 17; artifacts are unaffected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Passage 12, weapon-transformation description before Enemy Hammer (pf1-spells#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary replacement of the target’s properties; a world could allow stacking or artifact effects, at the cost of weaker limits on magical-item modification.

rules.statement: Enemy Hammer binds one chosen creature as a movable weapon for up to 1 round per caster level. Each standard action can hurl it at a creature or object within 30 feet, using an attack bonus of caster level plus the higher of Intelligence or Charisma; both creatures take size-based damage, and the spell ends if its captive dies.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Enemy Hammer (pf1-spells#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one fixed target and a save to resist each hurl; a world could permit retargeting or repeated attacks, increasing the cost in control and danger.

rules.statement: Ether Step moves its caster to the Ethereal Plane after an attack or effect has targeted them but before its result is known, lasting until the caster’s next turn. On returning, the caster’s next turn permits only move or free actions.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Ether Step (pf1-spells#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a brief defensive crossing with a restricted return turn; a world could lengthen the crossing, at the cost of more exposure to planar hazards.

rules.statement: Harm deals 10 damage per caster level, up to 150, or half on a successful save, but cannot lower a living target below 1 hit point. Against undead it instead functions as healing.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Harm (pf1-spells#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to capped damage with a minimum surviving hit point; a world could permit lethal damage, making the effect more decisive and dangerous.

rules.statement: Flesh to Stone turns a flesh creature and its carried gear into an inert, mindless statue; damage to the statue carries over if it is restored. The target is not dead, and only flesh creatures are affected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Flesh to Stone (pf1-spells#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to persistent petrification that preserves the subject’s life; a world could make the change reversible only by rare means, raising the cost of failure.

rules.statement: Impart Mind gives a permanent, nonintelligent magic item temporary Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma of 10, the caster’s alignment, speech, and senses to 60 feet for 1 hour per caster level. It grants randomly determined powers, ends with reversion, and cannot affect intelligent, charged, or one-use items.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Impart Mind (pf1-spells#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary personality with no special caster control; a world could make the awakening permanent, at the cost of creating an independent will.

rules.statement: Tar Pool changes a 20-foot-radius area into hot tar for 1 round per caster level. Creatures there initially take 1d6 fire damage per 2 caster levels (maximum 10d6) and may become entangled; entering or starting a turn there deals 2d6 damage and calls for another save, while the area costs extra movement and impedes Acrobatics.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Tar Pool (pf1-spells#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary hazardous area that can entangle and damage; a world could make the tar persist, increasing the environmental and cleanup cost.

rules.statement: Transformation improves Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution by +4, grants +4 natural armor, +5 Fortitude saves, weapon proficiency, and a base attack bonus equal to character level for 1 round per level. While changed, the subject cannot cast spells or use spell-activation or spell-completion items.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Transformation (pf1-spells#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a combat form that trades away spell use; a world could remove that restriction, weakening the transformation’s defining cost.

rules.statement: Awakening a construct requires a Spellcraft check against DC 15 plus its current Hit Dice; if its master is present, the check is opposed. The construct gains Intelligence determined by 3d6 and Charisma increased by 2d6, becomes free-willed, and loses prior control links; the process cannot affect a construct that already has Intelligence.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Opening passage (before Control Construct) (pf1-spells#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a difficult check and a freely choosing result; a world can adjust the DC or ability gains, with the risk of failure or losing control of a useful construct.

rules.statement: A controller can take over one construct at close range while concentrating, but must pass a Spellcraft check each round at DC 10 plus the construct’s Hit Dice. If its existing controller contests the takeover, both make opposed checks each round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Control Construct (pf1-spells#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to control that requires continuing concentration and a recurring check; a world can make control more durable or contested, at the cost of ongoing attention and possible loss each round.

rules.statement: A weather alteration affects a 2-mile-radius area for 4d12 hours, takes 10 minutes to cast and another 10 minutes to appear, and can be revised with a standard action, with each new pattern taking 10 minutes to manifest. The season limits available weather; a druid doubles duration and area radius, while mythic casting changes timing and can spend two mythic-power uses to ignore seasonal limits.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Control Weather (pf1-spells#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to seasonal options, slow manifestation, and a broad but bounded area; a world can widen choices or speed the change, at the cost of greater power expenditure.

rules.statement: An ethereal traveler can move through solid things and in any direction, but moves at half speed and cannot attack material creatures; perception of the Material Plane is limited to 60 feet. If the effect ends inside a solid object, the traveler is shifted to open space and takes 1d6 damage per 5 feet moved.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Ethereal Jaunt (pf1-spells#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary access to an overlapping plane with limited interaction and a hazardous return; a world can relax those limits, but risks making barriers and travel trivial.

rules.statement: A creature marked by the fire rune gains immunity to damage from the caster’s fire spells and adds 1d6 fire damage to weapon hits. It may instead fire a ray dealing 6d6 fire damage at a target within 30 feet; doing so ends the spell’s effects on that creature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Firebrand (pf1-spells#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a choice between sustained weapon enhancement and a one-use burst; a world can increase either benefit, with the tradeoff of consuming the mark or inviting stronger attacks.

rules.statement: A transformation into living ice or iron removes ordinary bodily functions and grants listed immunities, but prevents drinking and using potions. Iron form also halves speed, increases weight tenfold, and makes the subject vulnerable to special attacks that affect iron golems.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Ice Body; Iron Body (pf1-spells#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to strong resistances paired with functional restrictions and material-specific weaknesses; a world can soften the drawbacks, at the cost of weakening the forms’ distinctive limits.

rules.statement: A weather-control effect cannot create contradictory conditions at once and changes only general tendencies, not precise events such as where lightning strikes. Its area weather can be made calm and can remove existing atmospheric phenomena.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Control Weather (pf1-spells#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to broad environmental steering rather than precise targeting; a world can permit finer control, with the risk that weather becomes a direct and reliable weapon.

rules.statement: A target held in temporal stasis does not age, its bodily functions nearly stop, and it cannot be harmed until the magic is removed. The effect is permanent unless ended by suitable magic.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Temporal Stasis (pf1-spells#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to indefinite suspension that requires a specific removal method; a world can add a time limit or more ways to end it, reducing the danger of permanent imprisonment.

rules.statement: Time stop gives the caster 1d4+1 rounds of apparent time to act while other creatures remain at normal speed. The caster cannot target or harm those creatures or their carried items, is undetectable during the spell, and cannot enter an antimagic field.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Time Stop (pf1-spells#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short private action window; a world can widen or narrow the apparent-time duration because others remain protected from direct attacks.

rules.statement: A mythic version can include up to half the caster’s tier in nearby creatures, who share the same apparent-time rounds and can interact with one another. Spending three mythic-power uses can extend the apparent duration to 1 hour per level, but provides no benefit from rest or sleep.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Time Stop — Mythic (pf1-spells#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a small shared group and brief duration; a world can buy a longer window with scarce mythic power, without gaining rest.

rules.statement: Transmute blood to acid deals 1d6 acid damage per 2 caster levels, up to 12d6, each round while concentration continues, for at most 1 round per 5 caster levels. The target is staggered and sickened; a successful Fortitude save each round halves damage and prevents staggering for that round, and damage reducing it to 0 hit points dissolves it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Transmute Blood to Acid (pf1-spells#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to ongoing damage requiring concentration; a world can increase the maximum exposure, at the cost of sustained attention and a save each round.

rules.statement: Transmute golem takes 8 hours, requires a willing golem and powdered metals worth 150% of the difference in creation costs, and cannot produce a type with a CR above the caster’s level. The old golem becomes the new type with its new abilities and statistics, but keeps damage and conditions already suffered.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Transmute Golem (pf1-spells#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a costly, lengthy conversion with consent and a power ceiling; a world can change the material surcharge or time because transformation consumes resources.

rules.statement: World wave travels in a fixed direction at eight times the caster’s base land speed. Its tsunami form is 30 feet high, lasts 1 round per level, and deals 6d6 damage on contact; its swell form is 5 feet high, lasts 1 hour per level, and deals 1d6 damage. Natural-world things and creatures ride unharmed, while other contact is damaging; the spell can collapse after 1d6 rounds if an unincorporable obstacle fills at least half its crest.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): World Wave (pf1-spells#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a forward-moving terrain wave with a gentle or destructive setting; a world can redefine what counts as natural, with damage or collapse determined by terrain and category.

rules.statement: Ghost sound creates a chosen sound that may rise, recede, approach, or stay fixed, at a volume of up to four ordinary people per caster level, capped at 40. Listeners can disbelieve it with a Will save, and its basic sound character cannot be changed after casting.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Ghost Sound (pf1-spells#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded, fixed-character audio illusion; a world can raise the volume cap, while the sound remains vulnerable to disbelief.

rules.statement: Vacuous vessel makes a container of no more than 1 cubic foot per caster level seem and feel empty to observers who fail a Will save. Stored contents remain, but casting the spell on another container or adding an item to the container immediately ends the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Vacuous Vessel (pf1-spells#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to hiding contents without moving them; a world can enlarge the container limit, while changing the container or adding contents breaks the concealment.

rules.statement: Cloak of secrets creates a 5-foot-radius speech-filtering bubble: outsiders hear a false conversation, and the bubble disguises lip movements and blocks language-dependent effects from reaching creatures outside. It also obscures spell verbal components; outsiders take –5 on checks to identify spells by other means, while a listener spending at least 1 round can try a DC 15 Sense Motive check to notice the conversation is incoherent.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Cloak of Secrets (pf1-spells#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a small privacy field that filters speech; a world can alter its radius or detection difficulty, trading coverage for the risk of scrutiny.

rules.statement: A visual illusion can be disbelieved after interaction or careful scrutiny, but casual viewing may not provide a chance; certain physical inconsistencies can expose it automatically. Some illusions cannot depict a state beyond their limits, such as making a corpse seem alive or a completely destroyed object whole.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Quintessence (preceding Shadow Trap) (pf1-spells#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing scrutiny-based disbelief, with automatic exposure when the illusion is physically contradicted; a world could make illusions harder or easier to inspect, trading realism for deception.

rules.statement: Shadow Trap holds a creature entangled within 5 feet of where it began, for 1 round per level; on each turn it can spend a full-round action to try a new save to end the hold. It fails against creatures that cast no shadow and ends if the creature is wholly in darkness without illumination.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadow Trap (pf1-spells#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a location-bound restraint with repeat escape attempts; a world could tighten the leash or alter how light breaks it, at the cost of making illumination tactically decisive.

rules.statement: Shadow Weapon creates a quasi-real proficient melee weapon for 1 minute per level, but it ends if it leaves the caster’s possession. A struck creature can disbelieve on its first hit: if it succeeds, attacks deal only 1 damage; the weapon always deals only 1 damage to objects, and its enhancement improves at caster levels 5 and 10.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadow Weapon (pf1-spells#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary weapon whose effectiveness depends on the target accepting its reality; a world could make shadow-made gear more potent, at the cost of stronger resistance or a possession tether.

rules.statement: Invisibility hides a creature or a touched object of no more than 100 pounds per level, including a creature’s carried gear, for 1 minute per level. Dropped items and carried parts extending more than 10 feet show, and the effect ends when the subject attacks a creature; the greater version lasts 1 round per level and does not end on attacking.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Invisibility (pf1-spells#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to concealment that breaks on direct aggression, with greater magic removing that weakness; a world could permit attacks without revealing the subject, at the cost of making invisibility much harder to counter.

rules.statement: Mass Invisibility affects any number of creatures within 180 feet of one another; attacking breaks the effect for the group, and a creature moving more than 180 feet from its nearest companion loses it. The spell lasts 1 minute per level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Invisibility, Mass (pf1-spells#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to shared concealment with an attack and distance limit; a world could loosen the spacing or make attacks individual rather than group-breaking, at the cost of weakening team coordination constraints.

rules.statement: Scrying creates a sensor that can observe a creature at any distance for 1 minute per level, with a Will save whose modifier depends on the observer’s familiarity and physical connection; being on another plane grants the subject +5. A successful subject save prevents another attempt for 24 hours, and the sensor follows movement up to 150 feet per round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Scrying (pf1-spells#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to remote observation resisted by knowledge and connection; a world could make scrying easier or harder across planes, balancing surveillance against privacy and the value of personal links.

rules.statement: Magic Mouth stores a message of at most 25 words on a creature or object and speaks it when a specified visual or audible condition occurs; the trigger range is 15 feet per caster level. It cannot identify hidden traits such as alignment or class, and the message remains until discharged.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Magic Mouth (pf1-spells#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent, trigger-activated message limited to visible and audible cues; a world could let it recognize deeper properties, at the cost of more powerful and less spoofable surveillance.

rules.statement: Mirror Image creates 1d4 doubles plus one per 3 caster levels, to a maximum of 8. Attack rolls may hit an image instead of the caster, destroying that image on a hit; area effects and effects not requiring attack rolls bypass the doubles.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mirror Image (pf1-spells#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to decoy images that absorb attack-roll hits but not other effects; a world could let illusions absorb broader threats, at the cost of making the defense less selectively counterable.

rules.statement: Searching shadows make a Perception check each round on touched squares with a bonus equal to caster level plus the higher of the caster’s Intelligence or Charisma modifiers. The caster can move the 10-foot-radius search area up to 30 feet or change its criteria while concentrating; after locating a target, the shadows can hinder or entangle a creature, attempt to disarm or steal a carried object, or move an unattended nonmagical object weighing up to 5 pounds.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Searching Shadows (pf1-spells#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited, concentration-driven search and seizure; a world can widen its reach, but risks making remote detection and restraint too easy.

rules.statement: A secret sign can carry an invisible mark or message of up to 25 words, no larger than 6 inches across, and lasts 1 day per caster level. The caster chooses one sensory criterion that lets designated creatures within 30 feet see it; at caster level 10 or higher, it can be made permanent on an object for 5,000 gp in diamond dust.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Secret Sign (pf1-spells#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a hidden message gated by one observable criterion; a world can make signs permanent, at the listed costly material expense.

rules.statement: A shadow tether lets its target move up to 5 feet from its current square freely. Moving farther requires a bull rush check against a caster-set difficulty, with a –1 penalty per 5 feet of separation; failure stops the move, failure by 10 or more pulls the target 5 feet back and knocks it prone, and success by 10 or more ends the spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadow Anchor (pf1-spells#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a tether that resists escape but can be broken; a world can strengthen the anchor, at the cost of allowing less movement.

rules.statement: A silent table muffles sounds and sonic effects originating in its 5-foot-diameter area for listeners outside it: hearing or understanding them is 20 points harder, and their saving throw DCs decrease by 2. It does not affect incoming sounds or hearing checks made inside the area, and lasts 1 minute per caster level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Silent Table (pf1-spells#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a small sound-screening field with a measurable tradeoff in sonic potency; a world can enlarge it, at the cost of broader silence.

rules.statement: An invisibility sphere hides creatures within 10 feet of its recipient when cast, and its center moves with that recipient. Those already affected can see one another; leaving the area reveals a creature, entering later does not hide it, and an affected non-recipient’s attack reveals only that attacker while the recipient’s attack ends the spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Invisibility Sphere (pf1-spells#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a mobile, one-time concealment zone with clear entry and attack limits; a world can permit new entrants, at the cost of stronger group concealment.

rules.statement: An illusory script is readable only by people chosen when it is written. An unauthorized reader who fails a save is subject to a suggestion lasting 30 minutes; a successful save causes only mild disorientation, and dispelling the script removes both the writing and hidden message.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Illusory Script (pf1-spells#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a readable-by-permission message with a short mental deterrent; a world can make the suggestion stronger, at the cost of greater intrusion into the reader’s mind.

rules.statement: Phantasmal affliction makes a target believe it suffers a chosen curse, poison, or wasting disease, with the corresponding penalties or ability damage occurring as specified by that form. Ordinary cures and immunities do not end the imagined condition; dispelling or a placebo effect can, and Constitution damage cannot kill the target.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Phantasmal Affliction (pf1-spells#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to belief-driven symptoms that remain real as effects despite being imaginary; a world can let ordinary medicine work, at the cost of weakening the mind’s power over the body.

rules.statement: Shadow enchantment produces a quasi-real version of a psychic, sorcerer, or wizard enchantment of 2nd level or lower. A creature that disbelieves still gets the simulated spell’s normal defenses, but its special or damaging effect is reduced to one-fifth or has only a 20% chance to occur, as applicable.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadow Enchantment (pf1-spells#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an imitation that can be resisted and loses most of its force when disbelieved; a world can increase its reliability, at the cost of blurring the line between illusion and original magic.

rules.statement: Minor creation produces an unattended, nonmagical object made from nonliving plant material, limited to 1 cubic foot per caster level and lasting 1 hour per level; complex objects require a suitable Craft check, and using the result as a spell component makes the spell fail.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Minor Creation (pf1-spells#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary plant-matter objects capped by caster level; a world can relax complexity or volume limits, at the cost of making manufactured goods easier to obtain.

rules.statement: Major creation also permits mineral materials, with duration determined by material: vegetable matter lasts 2 hours per level, stone, crystal, and base metals 1 hour, precious metals 20 minutes, gems 10 minutes, and rare metals 1 round; it cannot create cold iron.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Major Creation (pf1-spells#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to shorter duration for rarer or more durable substances and exclude cold iron; a world can alter the material schedule, with consequences for resource scarcity.

rules.statement: Shadow conjuration can reproduce sorcerer or wizard summoning or creation spells of 3rd level or lower, with effects at 20% strength against creatures that disbelieve it; those who believe are affected at full strength. Greater shadow conjuration raises the copied spell limit to 6th level and the nonbeliever effectiveness to 60%.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadow Conjuration (pf1-spells#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to quasi-real effects that scale by belief and the listed 20%/60% tiers; a world can change the tiers or copied spell families, at the cost of making illusion-based powers more or less reliable.

rules.statement: A created mindscape draws the caster and one target out of real-world action, and the caster must define a feasible exit when creating it. Leaving by the caster ends the spell and releases the target; dropping below 0 hit points inside returns that creature to its body, and if this happens to the caster the spell ends for everyone.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Create Mindscape (pf1-spells#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded mental environment with a required escape route and bodily vulnerability; a world can make exits easier or harder, changing the danger and captivity of mind travel.

rules.statement: A veiled mindscape lets a creature try to disbelieve after first interacting with its surroundings; success reveals that it is in a mindscape and how to leave, but does not release it. An overt mindscape reveals the exit method automatically.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Create Mindscape (pf1-spells#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to knowledge of an exit without automatic escape after disbelief; a world can make the environment more or less transparent, changing how difficult escape is.

rules.statement: A shadowform target takes only one-fifth of the normal damage from an attack that its attacker fails to disbelieve, and applicable non-damage effects are reduced to one-fifth strength or a 20% chance; an attacker who succeeds attacks normally for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadowform (pf1-spells#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to 20% incoming effects when the attacker accepts the shadow illusion, with a successful disbelief granting a 1-round bypass; a world can adjust the reduction or bypass duration, changing the value of the defense.

rules.statement: Quieting weapons silence their normal weapon sounds; the first creature struck must save or be limited to whisper-level noise for the spell’s duration. Whether it succeeds or fails, that creature cannot be affected again by the same casting.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Quieting Weapons (pf1-spells#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to silencing weapon noise and allowing one save per struck creature; a world can alter the volume limit or repeat exposure, affecting stealth and communication.

rules.statement: A phantasmal web traps affected targets in a mental imitation of a web: they are treated as if in a web spell and save each turn against nausea, but cannot destroy the imagined web or escape it by movement or teleportation. The effect provides concealment, not cover, and does not visibly affect observers.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Phantasmal Web (pf1-spells#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to mental restraint that cannot be removed through physical destruction or travel, but that provides concealment rather than cover; a world can change which escape methods work, changing the spell’s control.

rules.statement: A rainbow pattern can fascinate no more than 24 Hit Dice at once, affecting creatures with the fewest Hit Dice first; its caster can move the pattern’s origin up to 30 feet each round, drawing fascinated creatures along. Blocking their view ends the effect for those creatures.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Rainbow Pattern (pf1-spells#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 24-HD cap, low-HD priority, and 30-foot movement each round; a world can adjust capacity or movement, changing how many creatures can be controlled and led.

rules.statement: A shadow evocation can imitate a sorcerer or wizard evocation spell of 4th level or lower; a greater version can imitate one of 7th level or lower. A creature that disbelieves takes one-fifth damage or receives only 20% of a non-damaging special effect from the lesser version; the greater version deals three-fifths damage to disbelievers.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadow Evocation / Shadow Evocation, Greater — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to partial effectiveness against a target who recognizes the illusion; a world can turn the fractions up or down, with shadow-derived magic as the reason.

rules.statement: Shadow transmutation can imitate specified transformation spells, including polymorph. A creature that interacts with the transformed subject can disbelieve; against such a creature, the shadow form’s damage is one-fifth normal and its non-damaging special abilities work only 20% of the time. The greater version imitates greater polymorph and uses 60% instead.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadow Transmutation — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a shadow form that functions normally until recognized; a world can change its reliability after recognition, reflecting the illusion’s partial reality.

rules.statement: A target of baleful shadow transmutation that fails its first Will save believes it is the selected animal or humanoid and loses specified abilities while taking on the form’s mental scores and abilities. It retries a Will save when first targeted and every 24 hours; a successful retry ends the spell. On its first failed retry, a failed Fortitude save makes the polymorph permanent, and further polymorph effects then fail.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Baleful Shadow Transmutation — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to daily opportunities to reject the imposed identity; a world can alter the recovery interval or permanence threshold, with the danger of lasting transformation as the cost.

rules.statement: Psychic asylum lets its caster spend up to 15 minutes in a mental landscape while no time passes for the body. It can provide perfect recall of material encountered within one week per caster level, allow preparation of one spell, and pause the duration of effects on the body; mind-affecting effects continue to run.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Psychic Asylum — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a brief private mental refuge with selective effects continuing to elapse; a world can change the duration or what pauses, balancing preparation and respite against ongoing mental effects.

rules.statement: A creature affected by night terrors gains no healing or spell preparation from sleep, becomes fatigued after one poor night (or exhausted if already fatigued), and takes 1d4 Wisdom damage each restless night. It can attempt one new save per day to end the spell; if sanity rules apply, the nightly damage is 1d8 sanity damage instead.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Night Terrors — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one escape attempt per day and accumulating harm each night; a world can change the daily damage or duration, with lost rest and worsening condition as the cost.

rules.statement: Shadow walk requires dim light and can transport the caster and up to one touched creature per caster level along a shadow route at 50 miles per hour. The route obscures terrain and endpoint accuracy; arrival displaces travelers by 1d10 × 100 feet, or 1d10 × 1,000 feet if that would place them in a solid object. A further collision sends them to the nearest empty space and fatigues them; travel between bordering planes takes 1d4 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadow Walk — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to fast but imprecise shadow travel with a fatigue risk on forced relocation; a world can tune speed or displacement, making uncertain arrival the price of rapid passage.

rules.statement: In scintillating pattern, creatures are affected in order from fewest Hit Dice upward, using a total budget equal to caster level and capped at 20 Hit Dice. Those with 6 or fewer Hit Dice suffer unconsciousness, then stun, then confusion, each for 1d4 rounds; 7–12 Hit Dice suffer stun then confusion for 1d4 rounds each; 13 or more suffer confusion for 1d4 rounds. Sightless creatures are unaffected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Scintillating Pattern — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a capped Hit Dice budget applied to the weakest eligible targets first; a world can change the cap or severity bands, with limited capacity governing the effect.

rules.statement: Dream council permits a number of dream messages equal to caster level, each containing up to 25 words or one vague image; sending a message takes 1 round, and the spell ends when the messages run out. If a sleeping recipient can cast dream or dream council, it may spend one of the caster’s messages to enter the caster’s dreamscape; the group can interact there for 10 minutes per message remaining.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dream Council — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a finite message pool that also sets dreamscape time; a world can change message count or time per message, making communication and shared dreaming compete for a limited resource.

rules.statement: Detect magic reveals aura information in stages: presence in the first round, number and strongest power in the second, and strength, location, and possible school identification in the third. Lingering dim auras last 1d6 rounds, 1d6 minutes, 1d6 × 10 minutes, or 1d6 days according to original aura strength; specified barriers block detection.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Detect Magic — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to increasingly detailed sensing over three rounds, with stronger magic leaving longer traces; a world can alter the delay or persistence, trading time and access for information.

rules.statement: Magical writing can be deciphered without normally activating its magic; a cursed or trapped scroll may activate when read. After reading a particular inscription once with the spell, the reader can read it later without the spell, at 250 words per minute.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Read magic (opening passage) (pf1-spells#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to safe, persistent comprehension of already-read writing; a world can make cursed or trapped inscriptions dangerous, at the cost of risking their effects.

rules.statement: A humanoid with 4 or fewer Hit Dice affected by daze takes no actions for 1 round; creatures with 5 or more Hit Dice are unaffected. After being affected, a creature is immune to this spell for 1 minute.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Daze (pf1-spells#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a brief action lock with a strict strength threshold; a world can widen the target range, at the cost of making the effect more powerful.

rules.statement: Only one nonpermanent dancing lights or light spell from the same caster can be active at a time; casting another replaces the earlier one. Permanently maintained versions do not count toward this limit.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dancing Lights; Light (pf1-spells#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one active instance of each spell; a world can permit more instances, with the cost of requiring a permanent effect to bypass the limit.

rules.statement: Light counters or dispels a darkness spell of equal or lower spell level. It does not brighten an area that is already normally or brightly lit.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Light (pf1-spells#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to matching-level light overcoming darkness; a world can change the relative strength of opposing magic, with the cost that stronger darkness resists.

rules.statement: A spell may last for a stated duration, end when discharged, or end when its stated triggering action occurs; effects such as alarm remain in place for their duration and react to specified entrants. These durations and triggers vary by spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Abjuring Step; Alarm (pf1-spells#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the spell’s stated duration and trigger; a world can prolong or alter the trigger, with the cost of making the ward or protection harder to maintain.

rules.statement: Shield other gives its target half of hit-point damage and transfers the other half to the caster; it does not divide non-hit-point harms. The spell ends if the two subjects move out of range, and damage already transferred stays transferred.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shield Other (pf1-spells#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to splitting hit-point damage evenly while the pair stays in range; a world can change the share, at the cost of the caster bearing the transferred harm.

rules.statement: A creature’s carried equipment becomes waterproof while it remains in that creature’s possession; an item loses the protection when dropped or discarded, and picking it up again does not restore it. Combustible mundane materials still require air to ignite.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Passage 20, opening text (pf1-spells#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: protect carried gear; turn the dial by limiting protection to continuous possession; the in-world cost is losing the effect as soon as an item is let go.

rules.statement: Wave Shield lasts 1 round or until it reduces damage from one physical or fire attack, providing damage reduction and fire resistance each equal to half the caster level, minimum 1, against that attack.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wave Shield (pf1-spells#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: one attack receives both defenses; turn the dial by changing the scaling or eligible attack types; the in-world cost is the shield ending after that attack.

rules.statement: A creature’s equipment is protected from cold along with it, and it can withstand environmental cold down to –50°F without Fortitude saves; this does not prevent cold damage or other cold-weather hazards. The caster may also turn its feathers white for 24 hours, granting +4 to Stealth checks to hide in ice and snow.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Winter Feathers (pf1-spells#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: grant environmental cold comfort and optionally snowy camouflage; turn the dial by changing the temperature limit or bonus; cold damage and unrelated hazards remain costs the protection cannot erase.

rules.statement: Abundant Ammunition replaces, at the start of each round, nonmagical ammunition taken from a targeted container during the preceding round; the replacement vanishes if removed from the container. It lasts 1 minute per caster level, and projectile-enhancing spells cast on the container can affect conjured ammunition.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Abundant Ammunition (pf1-spells#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: replenish ordinary ammunition once per round; turn the dial by changing duration or eligible ammunition; the in-world limit excludes special materials, alchemical attributes, and nonmagical treatments.

rules.statement: An arcane pocket holds up to 10 pounds per caster level in extradimensional space while weighing 3 pounds regardless of its contents; overflow spills out. It becomes nonmagical and spills its contents if it leaves its caster’s possession or another such pocket is created.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Arcane Pocket (pf1-spells#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: provide compact storage with a level-based capacity; turn the dial by changing capacity or the possession condition; the pocket’s contents are lost from storage when the caster relinquishes it.

rules.statement: Burning Sands creates a 20-foot-radius area for 1 round per caster level, making its ground difficult terrain; creatures in contact with it take 1d4 fire damage at the end of their turns. The sand vanishes when the spell ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Burning Sands (pf1-spells#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: create a temporary hazard that damages creatures remaining in the area; turn the dial by adjusting radius, duration, or damage; the hazard leaves no lasting terrain change.

rules.statement: Fumblestep gives one creature a –1 penalty on Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks for up to 1 minute per caster level; once during that time, the caster may use a standard action to attempt a trip against it using caster level and its highest mental ability modifier instead of the usual attack bonus and Strength modifier.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Fumblestep (pf1-spells#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: impose a minor ongoing penalty and hold one remote trip in reserve; turn the dial by changing the duration or trip capability; the caster must spend an action and keep the target in range to trigger it.

rules.statement: An arcane pocket can be used to conceal its contents with a +1 bonus on Sleight of Hand checks; a sticky glue or grease coating can make objects harder or easier to handle, and affects surfaces as described by each spell. Glue or grease on a surface makes it difficult terrain for the spell’s duration.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Arcane Pocket; Glue Seal; Grease (pf1-spells#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: allow local surface and object alterations with spell-specific limits; turn the dial by changing their DCs or durations; handling an affected object may require repeated saves or checks.

rules.statement: A summoned creature appears at a chosen location and acts immediately on the caster’s turn, attacking enemies unless the caster can communicate instructions. It cannot summon another creature, use teleportation or planar travel, or appear where the environment cannot sustain it; some listed creatures receive an alignment-based template, and the spell’s type follows the creature’s subtype or the caster’s alignment as specified.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Summon Monster spells (pf1-spells#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived controllable creature limited by its list and surroundings; a world can expand choices or travel powers, at the cost of stronger summoning rules.

rules.statement: Summon Monster II can call one creature from its 2nd-level list or 1d3 of the same kind from its 1st-level list. Higher versions allow one creature from their own list, 1d3 of the same kind from the immediately lower list, or—starting with Summon Monster III—1d4+1 of the same kind from a lower list.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Summon Monster II–IX (pf1-spells#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a level-based menu that trades creature strength for numbers; a world can change list size or quantity, with more bodies increasing tactical reach.

rules.statement: An unseen servant can perform one simple commanded task at a time and repeat it while its controller stays within range. It has Strength 2, can lift 20 pounds or drag 100, cannot attack or use skills requiring training or a DC above 10, and dissipates after 6 points of area damage or if sent beyond range.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Unseen Servant (pf1-spells#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a weak, noncombat helper with strict task and range limits; a world can grant it greater capability by increasing its creation cost or upkeep.

rules.statement: Detect Undead reveals presence in the first round, count and strongest aura in the second, and individual strengths and locations in the third. A good caster is stunned for 1 round and the spell ends if the strongest aura is overwhelming and its creature has at least twice the caster’s character level; destroyed undead leave dim auras for 1d6 rounds, minutes, ten-minute periods, or days according to their original strength band.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Detect Undead (pf1-spells#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to progressively detailed sensing that takes time and can expose the caster to a powerful undead presence; a world can alter detection depth or the risk of sensing.

rules.statement: Aphasia prevents a target from understanding or using language, including for communication, command words, and verbal spell components. The target can retry its save at the end of each turn; tongues counters it and makes a creature immune.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Aphasia (pf1-spells#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary language lock with repeated chances to break free; a world can broaden or narrow the blocked forms of communication, at the cost of stronger countermeasures.

rules.statement: A charmed person regards the caster favorably but is not controlled like a puppet. Persuading it to do something outside its usual behavior requires an opposed Charisma check, with no retries; it will not follow suicidal or plainly harmful orders, and threats from the caster or apparent allies end the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Charm person (opening fragment) (pf1-spells#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to favorable regard rather than direct control; a world can make persuasion stricter or looser, with trust and perceived danger explaining the limit.

rules.statement: Mass charm affects humanoids within 30 feet of one another, up to a total of twice the caster’s level in Hit Dice. The caster selects targets in sequence until that limit is reached; a single target ignores the Hit Die limit, and the effect lasts 1 hour per level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Charm Person, Mass (pf1-spells#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a shared Hit Die budget and fixed duration; a world can change the target cap or duration, balanced by the reach of group influence.

rules.statement: The thought-loop spell makes a target repeat the types and order of actions it took on its first turn on its next turn, against the same targets, for a total duration of 2 rounds. If an action cannot be repeated, the target becomes confused; a target already affected cannot be targeted again by this spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Deja Vu (pf1-spells#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one-turn behavioral repetition; a world can extend the loop, with the risk of confusion when circumstances obstruct repetition.

rules.statement: A hypnotized creature treats the caster as two steps friendlier and can receive one brief, reasonable request if communication is possible. Greater hypnotism lasts 10 minutes per level, affects 2 Hit Dice per caster level, and permits up to five requests per target, which may be longer and more complex but must remain reasonable.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Hypnotism; Hypnotism, Greater (pf1-spells#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to short-lived attention and bounded requests; a world can increase duration or request complexity, limited by reasonableness and the target’s resistance.

rules.statement: A memorized page is recalled with perfect visual detail, but a creature can retain no more such pages than its Intelligence modifier, with a minimum capacity of one. Remembering magical writing does not transfer its magic, though the text can be copied for ordinary study.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Memorize Page (pf1-spells#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to accurate recall with an Intelligence-based slot limit; a world can raise capacity, while magical knowledge remains nontransferable.

rules.statement: The target forgets events from the spell’s casting back to the start of its previous turn. This may enable a renewed attempt at a social or opposed skill check, but only regarding that target.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Memory Lapse (pf1-spells#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to erasing only a brief, personal interval; a world can widen the erased span, with greater risk of disrupting more memories.

rules.statement: The dancing darkness spell creates up to four moving spheres, each lowering illumination by one step within a 20-foot radius, or one vaguely humanoid dim shape. The effect can move up to 100 feet per round and ends if it exceeds the spell’s range.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dancing Darkness (pf1-spells#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited, mobile darkness effect; a world can increase its reach or movement, bounded by the caster’s range.

rules.statement: A floating disk lasts 1 hour per level and carries 100 pounds per caster level, or 2 gallons of liquid. It follows at up to the caster’s normal speed, stays within range and 3 feet of a supporting surface, and vanishes if those limits or its duration are exceeded, dropping its load.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Floating Disk (pf1-spells#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a load-bearing force platform with strict range and altitude limits; a world can increase capacity or mobility, at the risk of a dropped load.

rules.statement: An energy-absorption ward lasts 10 minutes per level or until it has absorbed 12 damage per caster level, to a maximum of 120; a separate resistance ward instead subtracts 10 damage per hit, rising to 20 at level 7 and 30 at level 11. These two protections overlap rather than add, and the absorption ward is used up first.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Protection from Energy; Resist Energy (pf1-spells#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to finite absorption plus non-stacking resistance; a world can raise or lower the thresholds, with the tradeoff being how long protection lasts.

rules.statement: A ward against ranged weapons reduces damage by 10 per attack and ends after preventing damage equal to 10 per caster level, maximum 100; an energy-absorption ward similarly ends after reaching its stated damage capacity. Communal versions divide the available duration into 1-hour or 10-minute portions, respectively, and end separately for each recipient when that recipient’s capacity is spent.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Protection from Arrows; Protection from Energy; Resist Energy (pf1-spells#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to per-recipient finite protection; a world can alter capacity or shared duration, at the cost of changing how many people the resource can protect.

rules.statement: Within a 50-foot-radius zone, each summoning effect has an additional failure chance of 5% per caster level, capped at 75%; this stacks with an existing failure chance. The ward lasts 1 minute per level and does not hinder summoning an eidolon.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Anti-Summoning Shield (pf1-spells#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded anti-summoning field with a level-scaled failure chance; a world can widen the zone or increase the cap, making summoning more unreliable there.

rules.statement: A magical lock permanently secures a touched door, chest, or portal up to 30 square feet per caster level. It adds 10 to an existing lock’s opening DC, creates a lock with DC 20 if needed, adds 10 to the break-in DC, and is suppressed for 10 minutes by a knock spell without being removed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Arcane Lock (pf1-spells#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to lasting magical security that can be bypassed or temporarily suppressed; a world can change the bypass rules, trading convenience for stronger protection.

rules.statement: A ward against divination forces the opposing caster to beat a caster-level-check DC of 11 plus the warding caster’s level, or 15 plus that level if protecting oneself or one’s own possession. The ordinary ward lasts 1 hour per level; its lesser form lasts 1 minute per level and only blocks divinations aimed at an area, not ones aimed directly at the subject or its possessions.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Nondetection; Lesser Nondetection (pf1-spells#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a caster-level contest and a narrower, shorter lesser ward; a world can adjust the DC or the lesser ward’s scope, trading secrecy against detectability.

rules.statement: An object warded against energy absorbs 12 damage per caster level, up to 120, and then ends; a ranged-weapon ward absorbs 10 damage per caster level, up to 100, before ending. A communal casting assigns duration in 10-minute or 1-hour portions and tracks exhaustion separately for each recipient.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Protection from Energy; Protection from Arrows (pf1-spells#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to protection that consumes a limited reserve; a world can set a larger reserve or divide it among more recipients, at the cost of weaker or shorter individual protection.

rules.statement: A charm-and-compulsion suppressor can either grant a +4 morale bonus on saves for 10 minutes or suppress existing and newly successful charm and compulsion effects while the caster concentrates, for up to 1 round per level. When concentration ends, suppressed effects resume with their remaining duration.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Suppress Charms and Compulsions (pf1-spells#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a choice between brief resistance and concentration-dependent suppression; a world can lengthen suppression, at the cost of requiring sustained attention.

rules.statement: A food- or drink-borne spirit takes hold when the item is consumed; a failed Fortitude save allows it to embed in the user. Once per day, the caster can remotely cause sickness for 1d4 rounds plus 1 round per 2 caster levels (maximum 5 extra rounds), or remotely use a hex or a qualifying mind-affecting or necromantic spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Skin Tag (pf1-spells#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a consumed carrier that establishes a remotely triggered, daily effect; a world can remove the daily limit or broaden the effects, at the cost of a more invasive persistent link.

rules.statement: Ablative Sphere starts with improved cover, with hardness 5 and 3 hit points per inch of thickness; thickness is 1 inch per caster level. After losing one-third of its hit points it gives ordinary cover, after two-thirds it gives partial cover, and at 0 hit points it is destroyed; damage beyond the sphere’s remaining hit points affects the protected character.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Ablative Sphere (pf1-spells#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a finite, degrading protective barrier; a world can change its durability or cover stages, balancing greater safety against the barrier’s limited hit points.

rules.statement: Acid Arrow deals 2d4 acid damage on a hit and continues dealing 2d4 each round while the acid remains, unless neutralized. It lasts 1 round plus 1 additional round per 3 caster levels, up to 6 additional rounds at level 18.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Acid Arrow (pf1-spells#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a lasting damage effect that can be ended by neutralization; a world can alter its duration or damage, trading persistent harm for counterplay.

rules.statement: An Aggressive Thundercloud moves up to 20 feet with perfect maneuverability when directed as a move action; striking a creature stops it for the round and deals 3d6 electricity damage, negated by a successful Reflex save. It lasts 1 round per level, gives concealment within it, and disperses beyond range.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Aggressive Thundercloud (pf1-spells#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a directed, short-lived area effect; a world can change its speed or damage, with the caster’s actions and limited duration constraining its use.

rules.statement: Aqueous Orb moves up to 30 feet per round when directed as a move action. A creature it strikes takes 2d6 nonlethal damage on a failed Reflex save; a Large or smaller creature that fails a second save is engulfed, takes 2d6 nonlethal damage each round, and can retry a Reflex save each round to escape.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Aqueous Orb (pf1-spells#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a moving area that can capture a limited number of creatures and permit repeated escape attempts; a world can adjust capacity or escape difficulty, trading control for the risk of trapping allies.
