rules.statement: A creature affected by Aversion that fails its save must avoid a chosen object or place, which may be no larger than a 50-foot cube, and cannot come within 60 feet of it. If it must violate the aversion, it is nauseated while doing so; a successful save instead causes sickness within 60 feet without compulsion.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Aversion (pf1-spells#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a mental avoidance rule with a danger exception and a temporary penalty for violating it; a world can change the forbidden area or penalty, balancing compulsion against survival.

rules.statement: Apport Object can send a held nonliving object weighing at most 1 pound and occupying at most 1 cubic foot to a location within 25 feet plus 5 feet per 2 levels, without needing line of sight. Alternatively, a prepared object can be called to the caster within that distance as a swift action, even from an unwilling holder; either use fails if the destination excludes magic.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Apport Object (pf1-spells#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to short-range transport with tight size limits and a prepared recall option; a world can expand range or payload, with magical barriers remaining a countermeasure.

rules.statement: Arcane Disruption lasts 1 round per level and requires its target to succeed at a concentration check with DC 10 + half its caster level to use covered arcane abilities, spell-like abilities, or specified class features. It does not affect free, swift, or immediate actions or mythic abilities; other concentration checks for arcane casting take a penalty equal to half the target’s caster level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Arcane Disruption (pf1-spells#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary interference effect with a defined check and exclusions; a world can broaden the affected abilities, increasing disruption at the cost of narrower counterplay.

rules.statement: An Aura of Distraction imposes a –5 penalty on concentration checks for creatures that fail a Will save when entering its 20-foot-radius area. The penalty ends when they leave; a creature that succeeds is immune to that casting, and the caster is unaffected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Aura of Distraction (pf1-spells#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a save-based area penalty that ends on leaving; a world can change the radius or penalty, trading broader disruption for easier escape.

rules.statement: A creature gains a cumulative +2 Strength bonus and takes a cumulative −1 AC penalty for every 5 damage it suffers, up to +10 Strength and −5 AC. Both changes end when the effect expires or the creature falls unconscious.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Passage opening (unnamed spell) (pf1-spells#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: damage increases both strength and vulnerability; a world can change the damage interval or cap because pain is fueling the response.

rules.statement: A borrowed spell can be learned by consuming 1 pint of blood from a spellcaster who died within the previous 24 hours; the chosen spell must be on the learner’s spell list. The knowledge lasts 24 hours, during which it can be copied or taught to a familiar and prepared normally.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Blood Transcription (pf1-spells#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: blood grants temporary access to a dead caster’s known spell; a world can alter the blood quantity or access window because learning consumes the deceased’s remains.

rules.statement: Bloodbath makes targets bleed for 1d6 damage at the start of each turn only while the caster continues taking the 1d6 bleed damage caused by the spell. A target’s bleeding ends if it receives magical healing or the caster’s bleed ends; the spell fails if the caster can ignore or is immune to bleed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Bloodbath (pf1-spells#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the caster’s ongoing injury sustains the targets’ bleeding; a world can change the shared duration or damage because the effect depends on a conserved cost.

rules.statement: A bleeding target of Brow Gasher takes a cumulative −1 penalty to attacks each time it suffers the spell’s bleed damage. At −3 it treats all targets as having concealment, and at −5 it is blinded; stopping the bleed ends these effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Brow Gasher (pf1-spells#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: recurring bleeding worsens combat impairment in stages; a world can change the thresholds because the aftermath follows the injury.

rules.statement: Burning Arc deals 1d6 fire damage per caster level to its primary target, to a maximum of 10d6; each successive target takes half the previous number of dice, rounded down. Additional targets must be within 15 feet of the primary target, and no target can be struck twice.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Burning Arc (pf1-spells#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: fire jumps between nearby targets while losing power; a world can change the decay rate or permitted spacing because each jump dissipates energy.

rules.statement: A target’s charitable compulsion follows an ordered sequence: heal nearby injured creatures, give away its weapon, use beneficial magic, then give away possessions. It cannot attack or make opportunity attacks, and being attacked ends the effect; completing the sequence also ends it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Charitable Impulse (pf1-spells#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the target follows a fixed aid-and-give sequence; a world can change the priority list because the compulsion redirects behavior until completion or interruption.

rules.statement: Cleromancy grants a luck bonus based on one chosen group of matching results among 1d4 rolled per caster level. The bonus equals the group’s result and can be applied to as many rolls as there are dice in that group before the duration expires.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Cleromancy (pf1-spells#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: a selected omen provides a limited pool of matching bonuses; a world can change the dice or allocation window because unused luck fades.

rules.statement: Contact Entity sends an open invitation to up to 20 qualifying entities of a particular kind, beginning with the nearest. Its range and maximum recipient strength vary by version: I reaches 100 miles and 6 Hit Dice, II and III reach 200 miles and 12 or 18 Hit Dice, and IV reaches 500 miles and 24 Hit Dice; contacted creatures choose whether and how to respond.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Contact Entity (pf1-spells#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: a costly, creature-specific message invites a response but does not compel one; a world can alter range and eligible strength because rare components and recipient autonomy limit contact.

rules.statement: Corpse Lanterns can produce up to four lights, and multiple castings can coexist; only one set can be moved per round, and movement requires no concentration. Their dim glow fills a 20-foot radius, penalizes Stealth by 5 in dim or normal light, and grants a 2-point save bonus against pattern illusions; making them permanent costs 7,500 gp and requires caster level 11.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Corpse lanterns (opening passage) (pf1-spells#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to lights that impose local perception and illusion modifiers; a world can change their reach or permanence price, paid for with limited movement and costly magic.

rules.statement: The greed curse lasts 1 minute per level and makes a target of 7 Hit Dice or fewer try to steal a visible item worth at least 100 gp when it enters a new area, favoring the most valuable. In combat it subsides after an attempted theft or damage until the threat ends and the target enters a new area; a target that has done neither can try a save each round, and dispel magic cannot end the curse.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Covetous Urge (pf1-spells#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a compulsion keyed to valuable objects and room entry; a world can tune the value threshold or duration, at the cost of reckless behavior and susceptibility to specific curse-ending magic.

rules.statement: A pit is 10 feet square and 10 feet deep per two caster levels, to a maximum depth of 30 feet, and lasts 1 round plus 1 round per level. At the end, its occupants rise with the bottom to the surface over one round; the extradimensional hole does not displace or weigh on the underlying material.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Create Pit (pf1-spells#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary extradimensional hazard with a fixed footprint; a world can vary depth or duration, with falling and escape risks as its costs.

rules.statement: Lesser Curse Terrain creates three hazards in a 300-foot radius for one day, with their timing and locations unpredictable and outside the caster’s control. The stronger versions create four hazards in a 1-mile radius, or six or seven in a 5-mile radius; permanence costs range from 2,500 to 27,500 gp and requires caster level 9th to 19th, depending on the version.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Curse Terrain (pf1-spells#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a region-wide hazard curse whose events are not directed by its maker; a world can alter the footprint, hazard count, or permanence cost, with unpredictability as the drawback.

rules.statement: Detect Thoughts reveals information in stages: first whether thinking minds are present, then their count and Intelligence scores, then surface thoughts. Concentrating on an Intelligence score of at least 26 that exceeds the caster’s by 10 or more stuns the caster for one round and ends the spell; sufficiently thick stone, metal, lead, wood, or dirt blocks it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Detect Thoughts (pf1-spells#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to progressively deeper mental sensing that demands continued concentration; a world can change the information revealed or blocking materials, with mental overload as a risk.

rules.statement: Dispel Magic can end one ongoing spell on a target by checking against spells from highest caster level downward, or can attempt to counter a spell as it is cast. Suppressing a magic item’s properties lasts 1d4 rounds; Greater Dispel Magic can end one spell per four caster levels, or apply one check across a 20-foot-radius area.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dispel Magic (pf1-spells#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a contested method for ending or suppressing magic; a world can change the number of effects or area covered, balanced by caster strength and the check required.

rules.statement: Cushioning Bands reduce damage by 2 against attacks not piercing or slashing and halve damage from crushing, falls, and constriction. They discharge after preventing 12 points of damage per caster level, capped at 120 points.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Cushioning Bands (pf1-spells#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a protective effect with a finite damage budget; a world can change which damage types it mitigates or its capacity, with depletion ending the protection.

rules.statement: Discharge removes all remaining charges from one technological object, suppresses a non-charge electrical device for 1d4 rounds, or staggers a robot and disables its energy attacks for 1d4 rounds. Greater Discharge can affect a 20-foot-radius burst or discharge one possessed object per four caster levels when aimed at a creature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Discharge (pf1-spells#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a targeted shutdown of electrical technology and robot functions; a world can widen the target area or increase affected objects, with duration and target limits constraining it.

rules.statement: Defending Bone grants damage reduction 5 against attacks other than bludgeoning, but ends when it has prevented 5 points per caster level, capped at 50. It has no effect if the recipient already has damage reduction from another source.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Defending Bone (pf1-spells#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary defense with a damage cap that cannot stack with another such defense; a world can tune the cap or bypass type, with the bone destroyed when spent.

rules.statement: A spell that targets a construct can, on a failed Will save, remove its damage reduction and fast healing, halve its base speed, and lower its Strength by 4, with a further 2-point reduction per 3 caster levels above 3rd, to a maximum reduction of 14. A construct normally immune to magic gets a +4 bonus on the save.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): opening spell description (construct-weakening spell) (pf1-spells#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing temporary weakening of constructs; a world can tune the Strength reduction or duration, with stronger constructs resisting through their save.

rules.statement: A corpse can be reshaped to alter evidence of its death, but the spell cannot conceal a lost limb, turn flesh into bone or bone into flesh, or change the corpse’s apparent identity. Close inspection can reveal unnatural wounds at Perception DC 10 + caster level; a successful Heal check at DC 15 + caster level also reveals the originally obscured wounds.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dress Corpse (pf1-spells#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing limited alteration of a corpse’s clues; a world can make detection easier or harder, with skilled examination exposing the deception.

rules.statement: A fog spell creates an area that blocks sight beyond 5 feet, providing concealment nearby and total concealment farther away. Moderate wind disperses it in 4 rounds and strong wind in 1 round; the spell does not work underwater.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Fog Cloud (pf1-spells#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary obscuring field vulnerable to wind; a world can vary its scale or wind resistance, with powerful weather limiting its use.

rules.statement: A persistent rune on written material explodes when read, dealing 6d6 force damage; readers nearby take full damage and others within 10 feet may save for half. The caster and instructed readers can read safely or remove it, while failed attempts to dispel or erase it trigger the blast.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Explosive Runes (pf1-spells#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a reader-triggered trap that can be safely bypassed by authorized readers; a world can change its blast or bypass conditions, with failed tampering risking detonation.

rules.statement: A weapon rune can be discharged after a successful melee hit to deal 1d4+1 fire damage, increasing by 1d4+1 per 2 caster levels above 3rd, to 5d4+5 at 11th level. It lasts 1 minute per level or until discharged.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Fiery Runes (pf1-spells#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single consumable weapon charge; a world can alter its damage or number of charges, at the cost of expending the rune.

rules.statement: A creature caught in the intoxicating fog becomes fascinated while inside and for 1d4+1 rounds afterward. A creature that saves but stays in the cloud must save again each round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Euphoric Cloud (pf1-spells#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an area hazard that repeatedly tests exposed creatures; a world can change the lingering duration, with remaining in the cloud exposing creatures to further saves.

rules.statement: The recorded d20 result from this spell may replace one later ability check, attack roll, initiative check, saving throw, or skill check during its duration of 1 round per caster level. It ends after use or expiration, and only one instance can affect the caster at a time.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Embrace Destiny (pf1-spells#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one stored result usable once before expiry; a world can adjust its duration or eligible rolls, with the single-use limit preventing repeated certainty.

rules.statement: A spell can create up to three fire cones during its duration: the first deals 4d6 damage, the second 2d6, and the third 1d6; a successful Reflex save halves damage. Casting a cone takes a standard action, and the spell ends after the third.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Fire Breath (pf1-spells#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three progressively weaker discharges; a world can change the number or damage, with each use consuming part of the spell’s finite output.

rules.statement: A spell can create one poisonous mushroom per caster level, no more than 30 feet apart; once per round from the following round, the caster can command them to release spores. Adjacent creatures that fail a Fortitude save become sickened for 1d4 rounds, and repeat failures add 1d4 rounds without worsening the condition.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Garden of Peril (pf1-spells#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to persistent, breakable hazards that the caster activates; a world can change mushroom durability or spore effect, with placement and ongoing control limiting coverage.

rules.statement: The tentacles make dirty-trick checks using caster level + 5; each success randomly blinds, deafens, entangles, shakes, or sickens the victim, with each result having a 20% chance.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Opening passage (heading not shown) (pf1-spells#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed five equally likely conditions; a world can change their odds or effects to suit the tentacles’ nature, at the cost of less predictable outcomes.

rules.statement: A guardian-monument ward lasts 1 hour per caster level and grants humans inside its area DR 2/magic, or DR 4/magic with the greater version. Moving the touched object suppresses the ward, but returning it resumes the effect while its duration continues to elapse; a monument to human achievement expands the lesser version’s radius from 40 to 60 feet.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Guardian Monument, Lesser (pf1-spells#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary touchstone ward with the stated radius and protection; a world can make the anchor more or less portable, with displacement suppressing protection.

rules.statement: A guardian-wasp swarm needs its full 10-minute casting time to build a nest; disruption before completion makes it disappear and wastes the spell. Afterward, an intruder within 20 feet that lacks the password alerts the swarm, which attacks the nearest intruder and cannot then be directed by the caster.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Guardian Wasps (pf1-spells#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an unattended nest that attacks the nearest qualifying intruder; a world can allow more caster control, at the cost of weakening the autonomous ward.

rules.statement: A harrowing gives checks associated with its nine drawn cards lasting penalties or spendable, one-use bonuses: matching alignment grants +2, another alignment grants +1, and opposing alignment imposes –1. The effect ends when all bonuses are spent or its duration expires, and a creature cannot receive a second harrowing while one is active.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Harrowing (pf1-spells#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to card-determined bonuses and penalties that expire with the reading; a world can make fate more or less controllable, with the reading’s results limiting the subject.

rules.statement: Greater harrowing applies its card results separately to each participant and can affect one creature plus one more per 3 caster levels. A matching-alignment card can also grant its participant one suit-based ability, usable once before the spell ends; each participant remains limited to one harrowing or greater harrowing at a time.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Harrowing, Greater (pf1-spells#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to individual fate results and one optional suit ability per qualifying participant; a world can broaden or narrow that group, with caster power setting the limit.

rules.statement: Hidden Presence erases selected creatures’ awareness of the caster, defeating ordinary and extraordinary perception for 1 minute per caster level. Attacking a target ends the effect; a sustained obvious change instead grants the target a new save.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Hidden Presence (pf1-spells#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to complete unawareness until an attack ends the spell; a world can let disruptive actions break concealment sooner, at the cost of renewed saves.

rules.statement: A held humanoid is paralyzed and cannot act or speak, but can attempt a new saving throw each turn as a full-round action to end the effect. Hold Fey applies the same rule to fey, while the mass version can target multiple humanoids no more than 30 feet apart.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Hold Person (pf1-spells#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a target that can try once per turn to escape paralysis; a world can make the effect harder or easier to end, trading agency against reliability.

rules.statement: Hoodwinked targets perceive only vague shapes and muffled sound, automatically fail Perception checks above DC 5, and cannot reliably remember their route. Without a guide they move at half speed; moving faster requires a DC 10 Acrobatics check, and physical harm from a non-target ends the effect on that creature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Hoodwink (pf1-spells#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to impaired senses and navigation until the target is harmed by an outsider; a world can make the impairment less or more complete, with mobility and awareness as the cost.

rules.statement: Radiation strength is keyed to caster level: 6 or lower produces low radiation, 7–9 medium, 10–16 high, and 17 or higher severe. The affected area has a central 10-foot-radius spread, each creature is exposed only once, and the radiation does not persist; the spell sets the saving-throw difficulty.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Radiation spell description (opening passage) (pf1-spells#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one exposure in a fixed 10-foot-radius center, with strength rising by caster level; a world can change the tier thresholds or spread size to tune hazard severity.

rules.statement: A creature affected by Knell of the Depths takes a –10 penalty on Swim checks and sinks 15 feet each round while in liquid, unless it stands on a solid surface that supports its weight. The curse lasts permanently unless removed by other means.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Knell of the Depths (pf1-spells#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to permanent impairment that activates in liquid but not on supporting ground; a world can shorten the curse to reduce the long-term cost of a failed save.

rules.statement: Life Pact links willing living targets, up to one per caster level and no farther than 30 feet apart. Once per round, when a linked target falls below 0 hit points, it can drain 1 hit point from each other linked target with at least 1 hit point within 30 feet, healing itself up to 1 hit point; death effects and non-damage effects do not trigger this.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Life Pact (pf1-spells#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sharing one point from each nearby eligible ally once per round, capped at 1 hit point for the endangered target; a world can raise the cap or frequency, increasing the group’s shared risk.

rules.statement: An inward-facing Magic Circle against Evil can hold a non-good called creature for up to 24 hours per caster level if the calling spell was cast within 1 round. Breaking the powdered-silver circle ends the effect, and dimensional travel can escape unless an anchor or a successful 10-minute, DC 20 Spellcraft diagram strengthens the containment; disturbing that diagram releases the creature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Magic Circle against Evil (pf1-spells#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a breakable circle with a 24-hour-per-level maximum and possible dimensional escape; a world can make a carefully drawn diagram suppress those escape routes, at the cost of preparation and a fragile boundary.

rules.statement: Limp Lash gradually reduces Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution by 1d6 each round after a successful ranged touch attack, never lowering a score below 1. When any score reaches 1, the target’s body is paralyzed but its head and senses remain functional; the spell and all its penalties end if the caster releases or loses the 20-foot whip, it is destroyed (15 hit points, hardness 5), or the target moves out of range.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Limp Lash (pf1-spells#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to accumulating ability loss while the caster maintains a fragile tether; a world can increase the whip’s durability or range, at the cost of making escape harder.

rules.statement: Mindlocked Messenger stores a message of up to 10 words per caster level in a willing creature’s mind, along with the intended recipient’s identity. Attempts to reveal it to someone else, read it mentally, or force disclosure cause 1d6 minutes of forgetting; after delivery to someone the carrier believes is the recipient, the message is erased permanently.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mindlocked Messenger (pf1-spells#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a recipient-locked message that is erased on delivery and temporarily inaccessible under probing; a world can increase message length or remove the erasure, changing how much information can be carried and retained.

rules.statement: A Numerological Resistance caster rolls 5d8 and uses each die once: one selects the energy type, one sets the number of creatures affected, one sets duration in rounds, and the remaining two are added for the resistance amount. The Path of Numbers describes eight energy types and 64 pairings of those types.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Numerological Resistance; Mathematical Curse, “The Path of Numbers” (pf1-spells#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to unpredictable protection whose type, recipients, duration, and strength all depend on the five rolled dice; a world can allow rerolls or substitutions, improving reliability while reducing the spell’s uncertainty.

rules.statement: A target of Nauseating Trail lays down vapor-filled squares as it moves, up to 4 squares per caster level. Creatures entering or ending a turn in those squares must save or become nauseated while there and for 1d4+1 rounds afterward; the target is immune.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Nauseating Trail (pf1-spells#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a moving trail with a caster-level-based square limit and lingering nausea after exposure; a world can increase the limit or aftereffect to make pursuit more hazardous.

rules.statement: A creature in Light Prison can act normally inside its cage, but passing through its walls deals 1d6 damage and blinds it for 1 round, with no save against those consequences. The prison ends for that creature once it passes through the walls.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Light Prison (pf1-spells#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary cage that permits actions but punishes and then allows escape through its boundary; a world can change the boundary penalty or duration to tune restraint versus harm.

rules.statement: A conjured pellet blast deals 1d8 piercing damage per 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 5d8, and damage reduction normally applies. A cold-iron, silver, or adamantine component costing 50 gp, 20 gp, or 100 gp respectively lets the blast bypass the matching kind of reduction; the pellets vanish after impact.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Opening passage (spell name not shown) (pf1-spells#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary conjured ammunition that disappears on use; a world can let costly special materials overcome matching defenses, at the price of consuming the component.

rules.statement: A creature under shadow disguise gains a competence bonus equal to caster level on Disguise and Stealth checks in normal, dim, or dark light. In dim light or darkness, observers can infer only broad appearance and action; bright light reveals the creature’s normal appearance.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Penumbral Disguise (pf1-spells#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to concealment that blurs identity but not broad behavior; bright illumination is the countermeasure and limits the disguise.

rules.statement: A called outsider must be bargained with and paid before it works. For tasks up to 1 minute per caster level, payment is 100 gp per Hit Die; up to 1 hour costs 500 gp per Hit Die, and up to 1 day costs 1,000 gp per Hit Die; nonhazardous tasks cost half, while aligned service may reduce or waive payment.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Planar Ally, Lesser (pf1-spells#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a summoned helper governed by negotiated payment; worlds can alter the price for danger or aligned purpose, with service and resources as the cost.

rules.statement: Lesser, standard, and greater planar ally call outsiders with respective Hit Die ceilings of 6, 12, and 18; the higher forms allow up to two or three creatures of the same kind within that shared ceiling. The called creatures appear close together and return home when their agreed task or time ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Planar Ally, Lesser / Planar Ally / Planar Ally, Greater (pf1-spells#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to bounded calls with shared capacity ceilings; a world can raise the ceiling by granting stronger spell access, balanced by greater payment.

rules.statement: A phantom steed’s speed is 20 feet per 2 caster levels, capped at 100 feet, and its carrying capacity is its rider plus 10 pounds per caster level. At caster levels 8, 10, 12, and 14 it gains travel abilities in sequence, from traversing difficult ground to flight.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Phantom Steed (pf1-spells#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, noncombat mount whose capability scales with its maker; worlds can gate terrain and flight benefits by caster strength.

rules.statement: A creature affected by pugwampi’s grace rolls two d20s whenever a d20 check is called for and uses the lower result. A luck bonus suppresses this penalty while present, but does not shorten the spell; it has no effect on animals, gremlins, or gnolls.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Pugwampi’s Grace (pf1-spells#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent misfortune effect that luck can temporarily counter; the spell’s duration remains the cost and the listed creature types are exempt.

rules.statement: A poisoned creature affected by pernicious poison takes a –4 penalty on poison saves, its poisons last for 2 additional frequency increments, and attempts to cure it take a –4 penalty. The effect lasts 10 minutes per caster level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Pernicious Poison (pf1-spells#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to worsening an existing poison rather than creating one; the limited duration and requirement for a poisoned target constrain it.

rules.statement: A creature under puzzle box loses weapon and shield proficiencies and has difficulty using specified magic and mundane items for 1 round per caster level; it can spend a move action and succeed at an appropriate check to overcome the effect for one item. Cast on an unattended object of up to 5 pounds per caster level, the effect is permanent and applies to anyone trying to use it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Puzzle Box (pf1-spells#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to item-specific interference that can be overcome one object at a time; the permanent object version trades a stronger duration for a weight limit.

rules.statement: A replica-based healing effect can be cast only while each target has at least half its maximum hit points. If a target falls below half during the spell, that target can end the spell as an immediate action to regain 1d8 hit points plus 1 per caster level, to a maximum of +25.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Opening passage (before Greater Reversion) (pf1-spells#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-use healing reserve activated below half health; a world could raise or lower the threshold or healing cap, with the replica serving as the stored cost.

rules.statement: Greater Reversion takes 20 minutes to cast and lasts 24 hours; the caster must start at half maximum hit points or more. If the caster drops below half, they can end it as an immediate action to regain 3d8 hit points plus 1 per caster level, to a maximum of +15.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Greater Reversion (pf1-spells#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a once-per-casting emergency heal triggered below half health; a world could change the trigger or cap, balanced by the long casting time.

rules.statement: Ricochet Shot lasts 1 round per caster level or until discharged, and grants one ricochet per 3 caster levels, up to 6 at level 18. After hitting a primary target, the wielder can attack a second target within 20 feet using the same base attack bonus, but without the projectile’s enhancement bonuses or magic qualities; unused ricochets expire with the spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Ricochet Shot (pf1-spells#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a weapon-bound, limited-use attack effect; a world could change the shot count or secondary-target distance, paid for by expiring unused charges.

rules.statement: A River Whip lasts 1 minute per caster level or until discharged, creates fresh water, and ends after it hits creatures a number of times equal to caster level. Its hits deal whip damage and douse the target with 1 pint; fire-subtype creatures take an extra 1d6 damage, and a target already burning gets +2 on its next save to extinguish the flames.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): River Whip (pf1-spells#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited-use water weapon; a world could adjust the number of strikes or the fire interaction, with created water consumed by use.

rules.statement: A target of Scare with fewer than 6 Hit Dice becomes frightened; the spell targets one living creature per 3 caster levels, with targets no more than 30 feet apart. Its duration is 1 round per caster level, or 1 round under the referenced cause-fear rule.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Scare (pf1-spells#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to fear affecting only low-rank targets; a world could change the Hit Dice threshold or duration, with resistance handled by the spell’s save.

rules.statement: Selective Alarm can be set to trigger on observable conditions, such as a particular race, a group of at least four, or a metal object, but not subjective or hidden facts such as alignment, value, or an item’s classification as a weapon. It lasts 2 hours per caster level and covers an area up to a 20-foot radius.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Selective Alarm (pf1-spells#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to observable-condition detection within a fixed area; a world could widen the area or permit less objective triggers, at the cost of false or ambiguous alerts.

rules.statement: A Sepia Snake Sigil placed in a text of at least 25 words activates when someone deliberately reads the marked text. On a failed Reflex save, the reader is trapped, unaware and suspended, in a force field for 1d4 days plus 1 day per caster level or until released; the field does not protect against physical injury.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Sepia Snake Sigil (pf1-spells#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a reading-triggered trap that briefly suspends its victim; a world could alter the release time or trigger, while leaving the captive vulnerable to outside harm.

rules.statement: Shackle creates restraints lasting 1 hour per caster level; a touch attack and failed Reflex save can place them on or between creatures. At caster level 6 the restraints can be mithral or Tiny/Large, at 12 they can be Diminutive/Huge, and at 18 they gain hardness 30, 60 hit points, and cannot be broken by a Strength check; an emerald can also enable a 1-minute-per-level dimensional anchor effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shackle (pf1-spells#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to restraints whose strength and sizes scale with caster level; a world could tune those thresholds or add the costly anchor effect, paid for with an emerald.

rules.statement: Slipstream lasts 10 minutes per caster level and increases movement by 10 feet on level ground, 20 feet downhill, and nothing uphill; while swimming it adds 20 feet to a swim speed or grants a 20-foot swim speed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Slipstream (pf1-spells#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed terrain-dependent speed changes; a world can turn the duration dial, with longer travel aid costing longer-lasting magic.

rules.statement: Sonic Scream allows three cone attacks during its duration, dealing 4d4, then 2d4, then 1d4 sonic damage; until all are used, the caster can only speak at a shout and cannot use voice-dependent magic. The spell ends after the third cone or after 1 round per caster level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Sonic Scream (pf1-spells#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three progressively weaker blasts and impaired voice until spent; a world can alter the number of blasts, at the cost of changing the speech restriction.

rules.statement: Spectral Hand costs the caster 1d4 hit points, which return when the spell ends unless the hand is destroyed. For up to 1 minute per caster level it can deliver touch spells of level 4 or lower at range, with a +2 bonus to its melee touch attack; it returns after delivery or if it leaves range or sight.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spectral Hand (pf1-spells#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary projected hand paid for with hit points; a world can raise or lower the body cost, with destruction making the loss permanent.

rules.statement: A spectral scout lasts 10 minutes per caster level, follows simple instructions without animal-handling checks, and can relay witnessed sights, sounds, and smells clearly to its caster. It cannot attack or interpret what it observes, and has only 1 hit point.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spectral Scout (pf1-spells#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fragile, noncombatant scout with literal reporting; a world can widen its senses or autonomy, at the cost of making it more capable.

rules.statement: Spherescry requires a sphere containing at least a small portion of the caster’s body, such as a fingertip; it lets the caster see and hear within 20 feet of that sphere for 1 minute per caster level. It gives no warning detectable by ordinary magical detection, but other spells cannot operate through the sphere.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spherescry (pf1-spells#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to remote, covert observation anchored by bodily material; a world can expand the viewing radius, at the cost of stronger detection or additional bodily material.

rules.statement: Spirit Bonds can link up to one willing creature or object per 3 caster levels, prepared with each within 30 feet for the full hour of casting, and last 24 hours or until discharged. The caster can sense direction and distance on the same plane, and may send one telepathic message of up to 25 words to a linked creature; doing so ends that creature’s information link but not the others.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spirit Bonds (pf1-spells#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited number of temporary links with a one-message tradeoff; a world can raise link capacity, at the cost of longer preparation or weaker connection.

rules.statement: A storm step transports the caster up to close range along a visible path or a specified direction and distance, dealing 1d8 electricity damage per 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 5d8, to creatures and objects crossed. A solid obstruction stops the movement unless the damage breaks through it and range remains.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Storm Step (pf1-spells#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short, obstructible lightning transit that harms things in its path; a world can extend range, at the cost of greater exposure to barriers or damage.

rules.statement: Threefold Sight lasts 3 minutes and replaces each attack, save, or skill check roll with the middle of three d20 results, using the tied extreme when two or more dice match. If another ability would grant multiple rolls, selection of a higher or lower roll, or a reroll, that ability has no effect and Threefold Sight immediately ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Threefold Sight (pf1-spells#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a three-outcome middle result that suppresses competing roll-altering effects; a world can extend the duration, at the cost of heightened vulnerability to such conflicts.

rules.statement: A suggestion must describe a reasonable course of action in a sentence or two; an obviously harmful instruction automatically fails. The effect lasts up to 1 hour per caster level or until the requested activity is completed, and may instead await a stated triggering condition; the mass version applies the same instruction to one creature per caster level, no more than 30 feet apart.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Suggestion (pf1-spells#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a reasonable, limited instruction with a safety boundary; a world can permit more forceful commands, at the cost of weakening or removing that protection.

rules.statement: A ship-tracking effect requires a physical piece of the vessel and a nautical chart, lasts 1 hour per caster level, and fails if the ship is outside the chart’s mapped area. Its chart icon changes to a death marker if the ship reaches 0 or fewer hit points.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Track Ship (pf1-spells#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to chart-bounded tracking that requires a physical link; worlds can widen the map or remove the link requirement, at the cost of easier remote pursuit.

rules.statement: A single casting of animate dead creates no more than twice the caster’s level in undead Hit Dice; desecration doubles that limit. The caster can control 4 Hit Dice per caster level indefinitely, but newly created undead beyond that control capacity displace older controlled undead into uncontrolled status.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Animate Dead (pf1-spells#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed creation and control capacity; a world can increase capacity, with the danger of older minions becoming uncontrolled.

rules.statement: A web effect needs at least two solid anchor points facing one another or it collapses. It creates difficult terrain, can grapple creatures that fail its checks, and fire can consume a 5-foot square each round, dealing 2d4 fire damage to creatures in burning webs.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Web (pf1-spells#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to anchored, flammable restraint; a world can make the strands self-supporting or fireproof, reducing the environmental counterplay.

rules.statement: The denser form of a mist wall is limited to half the length of the thin form: 5 rather than 10 feet per caster level. Passing into or through the dense wall requires a DC 15 Strength check or the creature is entangled and unable to move until its next turn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wall of Mist (pf1-spells#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a trade-off between field length and strength; a world can change the density or check difficulty, reflecting how potent the barrier is.

rules.statement: A creature affected by Twisted Futures cannot benefit from effects that let it roll more than once and keep the better result, or select a die result instead of rolling. Effects that force the lower of two results still work.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Twisted Futures (pf1-spells#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to blocking favorable-result selection but not forced misfortune; a world can broaden the restriction, making fate magic more dominant.

rules.statement: Unravel Destiny imposes a cumulative –2 penalty to ability checks, attacks, saves, and skill checks per hero point the target holds. Spending a hero point can reduce the penalty, but costs the target 2d6 damage for each point spent.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Unravel Destiny (pf1-spells#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a penalty scaled by stored hero points, with damage as the escape cost; a world can increase the penalty or soften the cost, changing how risky hoarding points becomes.

rules.statement: Unseen Engineers take a number of rounds equal to a trap’s challenge rating to build it, then use Craft (traps) with a +5 bonus to determine success. They need the materials, must remain within spell range, and automatically fail if the spell expires before construction finishes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Unseen Engineers (pf1-spells#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to speedy but time-limited construction that consumes supplied materials; a world can shorten build time or remove the range tether, making remote trap construction easier.

rules.statement: Urban Step links two open, unobstructed portals in range and line of sight for 1 round; stepping through teleports the caster to the other portal, carrying objects only up to maximum load. Other creatures cannot be carried, and the spell ends after transit, leaving the caster unable to act until the next turn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Urban Step (pf1-spells#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-way personal transit with a load limit; a world can permit passengers or repeated crossings, at the cost of making portals more powerful.

rules.statement: Anywhere But Here moves you and up to four willing creatures who are away from their home plane to a randomly selected plane, appearing at a location judged nonhazardous by the GM. Afterward each transported creature is immune to this spell for 24 hours, though other planar travel still works.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Anywhere But Here (pf1-spells#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to random planar relocation for eligible travelers; a world can adjust destination odds or the immunity interval, with the cost being loss of control over where the group arrives.

rules.statement: Arcane Eye creates an invisible sensor for 1 minute per level that relays vision and moves at 30 feet per round when looking ahead or 10 feet per round when surveying floor, walls, and ceiling. It needs concentration to operate, cannot pass solid barriers except through gaps at least 1 inch wide, and cannot enter another plane.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Arcane Eye (pf1-spells#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a remotely directed visual sensor limited by movement, barriers, duration, and concentration; a world can change its speed or permeability, trading stronger surveillance for greater access.

rules.statement: Aura of Cannibalism affects creatures sharing your type and at least one of your subtypes: each must save at the start of its turn in the area or take 1d4 damage, which grants you matching temporary hit points up to 10 plus your caster level. While the spell lasts, 5 such hit points grant a +1 bonus to attacks, saves, and skills, rising to +2 at 15; the temporary hit points disappear when the spell ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Aura of Cannibalism (pf1-spells#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to drawing limited temporary vitality from similar nearby creatures; a world can widen eligibility or increase the cap, at the cost of harming those around the caster.

rules.statement: Aura of the Unremarkable alters non-allied observers’ perceptions so they treat strange behavior in its area as ordinary for 1 minute per level. Hostile acts against an observer or its allies end the effect for that observer; afterward observers see normally, but each later reminder of the events allows another save to restore ordinary memory.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Aura of the Unremarkable (pf1-spells#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to short-term perceptual normalization that leaves altered recollection behind; a world can make reminders more or less effective, with exposure and hostile behavior risking the cover.

rules.statement: A target of Bestow Curse receives one permanent curse: a –6 ability-score penalty, a –4 penalty to attacks, saves, ability checks, and skill checks, or a 50% chance each turn of taking no action. The effect cannot be dispelled, but specified powerful remedies including remove curse can remove it; Greater Bestow Curse offers stronger penalties, including –12 to one ability score, –8 to the listed checks, or only a 25% chance to act normally, and is harder to remove.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Bestow Curse / Greater Bestow Curse (pf1-spells#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a lasting, save-resisted affliction with a defined remedy; a world can strengthen its penalties or narrow removal options, balanced by the need for an appropriate curse-breaking intervention.

rules.statement: Bind Sage calls one caulborn into a prepared trap; a caster can compel the bound creature to provide information using its Knowledge skills or detect thoughts, but commands to fight, guard, or perform other tasks automatically fail. The spell otherwise follows planar binding, and unique books or thinking creatures are especially effective gifts for it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Bind Sage (pf1-spells#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a summoned, contained expert whose service is restricted to information; a world can broaden its permitted tasks, but must contend with the creature’s terms and preferred payment.

rules.statement: Break Enchantment can free up to one creature per level, grouped within 30 feet, from enchantments, transmutations, and curses, even if an effect was instantaneous. For each effect, success requires a check against 11 plus its caster level, capped at a +15 caster-level bonus; effects of 5th level or lower may be eligible even when ordinary dispelling cannot affect them.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Break Enchantment (pf1-spells#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a check-based way to end eligible conditions, with a level ceiling; a world can increase the ceiling or ease checks, making removal more reliable but less exceptional.

rules.statement: Channel the Gift lets an ally caster use their next spell of 3rd level or lower without spending a spell slot, provided casting begins before your next turn and takes no more than 1 full round. The donor spends the spell slot that powers it; when cast on yourself, it instead permits a prepared caster to cast a prepared spell of 3rd level or lower without spending that spell’s slot on the next turn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Channel the Gift (pf1-spells#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transferring the cost of one low-level spell to another caster; a world can raise the level ceiling or extend the timing window, at the risk of making shared reserves too efficient.

rules.statement: Calm Air lowers wind strength by one step for every 4 caster levels, down to light wind, and disperses or suppresses fog, dust, and other clouds in its area for 10 minutes per level. Magical wind or cloud suppression requires a caster-level check against 11 plus the effect’s caster level unless its origin is inside the area, in which case the whole effect is suppressed; the area can be moved by concentrating as a standard action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Calm Air (pf1-spells#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a movable zone that calms ordinary weather and contests magical effects; a world can alter its reach or suppression check, trading broader environmental control for stronger resistance from magic.

rules.statement: A poisonous cloud moves 10 feet away from its caster each round, sinks into low terrain, and cannot pass through liquid or be cast underwater. A living creature with at least 6 Hit Dice takes 1d4 Constitution damage each turn it remains in the cloud, halved by a successful Fortitude save; poison immunity prevents the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Cloudkill passage (opening fragment) (pf1-spells#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a ground-following cloud that advances 10 feet per round; a world can change its speed or terrain behavior, with terrain and poison immunity explaining its limits.

rules.statement: For the mythic version, add the caster’s tier to the spell level and Hit Dice categories used to determine its effects. At 6th tier, spending two uses of mythic power lets it affect living creatures normally immune to poison.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Cloudkill passage (Mythic) (pf1-spells#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to tier increasing the affected Hit Dice thresholds; a world can turn the tier bonus or immunity bypass, at the cost of mythic power.

rules.statement: One casting can enhance an ally’s spell that is at least 1 level below the highest-level spell the ally can cast, applying Enlarge, Extend, Silent, or Still without raising spell level or casting time. Two castings on the ally allow Empower if the spell is at least 2 levels below that limit; three allow Maximize or Widen if it is at least 3 levels below; the caster cannot target themself.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Collaborative Thaumaturgy – DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allies pooling castings to improve one spell without increasing its usual casting costs; a world can alter the number of cooperating casters or permitted enhancements.

rules.statement: The caster and one animal companion, familiar, or spirit animal exchange locations instantaneously, choosing arrival squares within the spaces each previously occupied. Afterward, the caster cannot act until their next turn and the companion is staggered until the end of its next turn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Companion Transposition – DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a location swap with a bonded companion and a short action penalty; a world can change eligible bonds or the delay, with disorientation providing a possible cost.

rules.statement: Contact with another plane yields one-word answers, at most one per round while concentrating, and permits one question per two caster levels. More remote contacts increase the chance of correct knowledge but also risk Intelligence and Charisma falling to 8 and arcane spellcasting becoming unavailable for the listed duration; the chance and duration vary by plane and power contacted.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Contact Other Plane – DESCRIPTION and table (pf1-spells#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to brief, uncertain answers traded against a risk of mental impairment; a world can tune the odds by the contacted plane and entity’s remoteness or rank.

rules.statement: A creature that fails against contagion immediately contracts one listed disease, using that disease’s frequency and save DC for later effects. Greater contagion prevents recovery through ordinary successful saves and raises the magical-removal DC by 5; mythic contagion can spread by contact at a save DC 4 below the spell’s DC, or at 7th-tier augmentation affect living creatures within 1 mile while excluding up to one creature per caster level in sight.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Contagion – DESCRIPTION; Contagion, Greater; Mythic (pf1-spells#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to immediate disease transmission with disease-specific ongoing rules; a world can change spread distance, exclusions, or recovery, with exposure and magical treatment as costs.

rules.statement: A contingency stores one personal spell of no higher than one-third the caster level, rounded down and capped at 6th level, and triggers it when a condition set at casting occurs. Both spells’ costs are paid at casting, the effect lasts 1 day per level or until triggered, and only one can be active; casting another dispels the first.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Contingency – DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one pre-paid personal spell triggered by a clearly specified condition; a world can change the spell limit or duration, with advance payment and a single active slot constraining use.

rules.statement: A willing target gains one extra readied standard, move, or swift action when a clear condition occurs, lasting up to 1 minute per level. The target may decline to act; once triggered, the spell ends whether the action is used or succeeds, and the action cannot cast a spell or use a supernatural ability.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Contingent Action – DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one conditional extra action with a short duration; a world can broaden the allowed actions or duration, while trigger failure and discharge limit its reliability.

rules.statement: A soul gem can capture the soul of a dying creature or one dead for no more than 1 round; a living target that fails its save dies. The gem lasts 1 day per caster level, then crumbles and releases the soul; resurrection requires a caster check against the spell’s save DC, increased by 2 if the gem is in an unholy place.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Create Soul Gem – DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary soul containment that obstructs resurrection until the gem is broken; a world can vary the duration or release conditions, with unholy locations making recovery harder.

rules.statement: A delayed self-centered blast erupts 1 round after casting; choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire, dealing 1d8 damage per caster level (maximum 10d8) within 15 feet and half damage from 15 to 30 feet. The caster takes half damage without a save, though resistance or immunity can reduce it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Opening spell description (pf1-spells#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-round fuse and a 30-foot blast; worlds can vary the delay or radius, with the caster accepting some of the blast as the cost.

rules.statement: Dimensional anchor blocks extradimensional travel by a struck creature or object for 1 minute per caster level, including teleportation and planar movement; it does not prevent travel already underway or extradimensional perception and attacks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dimensional Anchor (pf1-spells#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to suppressing travel but not perception; a world can broaden or narrow the blocked modes, at the cost of also limiting escape options.

rules.statement: Draconic reservoir absorbs one chosen energy type up to 6 points per caster level, maximum 60. The subject can spend a swift action each round to add 1d6 of stored energy to a melee hit; releasing it does not restore absorption capacity, and excess incoming damage applies normally.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Draconic Reservoir (pf1-spells#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed storage cap and limited release; worlds can adjust capacity or discharge rate, balancing protection against offensive use.

rules.statement: Elemental aura damages adjacent creatures for 2d6 of one chosen energy type when cast and at the start of each of the caster’s turns. Its type also inflicts a rider effect; saves halve the damage and negate the rider, and only one aura can be active at a time.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Elemental Aura (pf1-spells#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a repeating adjacent-area effect with one active aura; a world can change its radius or rider effects, with exposure to nearby creatures as the tradeoff.

rules.statement: A sleeping target under dream shield resists divination and gains spell resistance 10 + caster level against mind-affecting effects, plus another save against possession or direct mental control if one was initially allowed. Awake, it instead gains +4 against sleep effects, and each 10 minutes awake uses 1 hour of duration.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dream Shield (pf1-spells#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to stronger protection during sleep and a duration drain while awake; a world can change that tradeoff to favor either waking or sleeping protection.

rules.statement: Familiar melding transfers the caster’s soul into a familiar while the caster’s body appears dead. The caster uses their own mental traits and the familiar’s physical traits; returning requires a standard action and the body to be within range, while the caster dies if the familiar is killed out of range.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Familiar Melding (pf1-spells#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sharing a familiar’s body with a range-dependent return; a world can ease the range condition, but the exposed body and risk of death remain the cost.

rules.statement: Flesh puppet animates a corpse dead no more than 48 hours as a disguised, obedient zombie linked by a fragile string; severing the string ends the spell. Control is limited to 4 HD per caster level overall and 2 HD per caster level from one casting; the horde version permits one zombie command per round and makes all zombies visibly undead if ordered to attack.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Flesh Puppet; Flesh Puppet Horde (pf1-spells#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to remote command through a breakable link and a capped number of undead; worlds can alter the cap or link durability, with control and concealment limited by those vulnerabilities.

rules.statement: Geas/quest compels a living target of any Hit Dice without a saving throw; blocking obedience for 24 hours causes a −3 penalty to each ability score, accumulating daily to −12. Lesser geas can affect only a creature with 7 or fewer Hit Dice that understands the caster; preventing obedience for 24 hours instead causes −2 per ability score per day, to −8.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Geas/Quest; Geas, Lesser (pf1-spells#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to compelled service with escalating penalties for disobedience; worlds can change the penalty pace or cap, making enforcement harsher or easier to withstand.

rules.statement: A protective shell can cover up to one creature per caster level for a total of 2 hours per caster level; the caster may divide that time among those creatures in any proportions. It lets them breathe in water or vacuum and blocks harmful gases, vapors, inhaled diseases and poisons, and severe temperatures or pressure, but it does not grant visibility or normal movement in obstructive conditions.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Life Bubble (pf1-spells#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a movable personal protection shell with a shared duration budget; a world can broaden its coverage, but the limited hours per caster level are the cost.

rules.statement: An immobile sphere centered on its caster lasts 1 round per level and prevents effects of 3rd level or lower from affecting anything inside; the full version also excludes 4th-level effects. Higher-level effects and effects already active when the sphere appears are unaffected, and excluded effects are suppressed rather than destroyed if they enter it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Globe of Invulnerability, Lesser (pf1-spells#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary level-filtering ward that suppresses rather than erases excluded effects; a world can raise the cutoff, while dispelling or waiting out its duration ends the ward.

rules.statement: A water bubble with a 20-foot radius follows the caster for 1 minute per level. It blocks precipitation and pushes away fog or mist, but cannot stop lightning or change temperature; it also calms water and prevents water impacts from dealing damage, moving creatures, or performing attack-like actions.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Globe of Tranquil Water (pf1-spells#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a moving environmental ward with narrowly listed protections; a world can enlarge its radius, but lightning and temperature remain outside its protection.

rules.statement: A spell can preserve a corpse or severed body part so it does not decay, and days under the effect do not count against the time limit for raising the dead. Its duration is 1 day per level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spell description preceding Geyser (pf1-spells#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to preservation that pauses the resurrection deadline but does not restore life; a world can extend the duration, with the spell’s limited days defining the cost.

rules.statement: A healing-diversion effect splits each qualifying healing event: the target receives half, rounded down, and the caster receives the other half, rounded down. It ends if the caster moves beyond 25 feet plus 5 feet per two levels or after the caster has taken 5 hit points per level, capped at 50; the enhanced version takes all healing and raises that cap to 10 per level, capped at 100.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Healing Thief (pf1-spells#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a range-bound, finite siphon that divides incoming healing; a world can permit a greater fraction, but distance and a per-caster-level cap constrain the benefit.

rules.statement: A haunted fear effect makes creatures that fail a Will save acquire a phobia tied to a specifically named creature, object, or image in the area. The phobia lasts 1 day per level, manifests when triggered, and can be cured by ordinary treatment for insanity or suppressed by effects that prevent possession or mind control.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Horrifying Visage (pf1-spells#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, trigger-specific phobia that can be treated or suppressed; a world can make it harder to cure, at the cost of prolonging a severe mental effect.

rules.statement: A magical link lets the caster switch places with a targeted creature of the caster’s size or smaller as an immediate response to an attack or damaging spell directed at the caster, redirecting that event to the other creature. The link ends after one switch, if its 1-round-per-level duration expires, or if the destination would be invalid; an unconscious or dead target cannot be switched.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Hostile Juxtaposition (pf1-spells#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one reactive position swap with strict safety and target limits; a world can allow repeated swaps, but each use spends the short-lived link.

rules.statement: A target that fails its save against an imposed speaking curse must spend a move action to speak in combat, has a 50% chance to lose a spell with a verbal component, and takes at least 1 round to cast spells normally faster than that. Spells with casting times of 1 round or more take twice as long; specified powerful remedies can end the curse early.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Impede Speech (pf1-spells#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a speech impairment that directly taxes verbal magic and combat communication; a world can make it easier to remove, while the extended casting time and failure chance are the burden.

rules.statement: A creature affected by a healing-diversion spell receives only half of qualifying healing, rounded down, while the caster gains the other half, rounded down. The caster must remain within 25 feet plus 5 feet per two levels, and the spell ends after a total of 5 hit points per level is taken, to a maximum of 50.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Healing Thief (pf1-spells#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded split of healing that rewards staying close to the target; the range and total stolen-healing cap limit the gain.

rules.statement: A conjured watchdog remains fixed where created, alerts when a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet, and attacks creatures that approach within 5 feet for 2d6+3 damage once per round. Barking shortens its remaining duration to 1 round per caster level, and it vanishes if its caster gets more than 100 feet away.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mage’s Faithful Hound (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary, invisible alarm that can bite nearby intruders; a world can change its radius or damage, with the caster’s distance and the alarm triggering its shortened lifespan as costs.

rules.statement: A warded area can cover a 30-foot cube per level for 24 hours: outsiders see a dark fog, sound cannot escape, and scrying and thought detection fail, but creatures and objects can still cross its boundary.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mage’s Private Sanctum (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to blocking observation and sound without blocking entry; a world can enlarge or narrow the ward, trading privacy against the fixed area and duration.

rules.statement: A caster can put their soul in a gem worth at least 100 gp and attempt to take over a nearby body, displacing its soul into the gem; the possession lasts up to 1 hour per level, and the caster retains mental traits while the host body supplies physical traits. If a host dies or the spell ends, the souls return only if their respective bodies or the gem are in range; otherwise a soul may die.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Magic Jar (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to soul exchange through a costly receptacle and temporary body occupation; a world can alter range or duration, while the body’s death and the jar’s destruction make possession dangerous.

rules.statement: A creature marked by this curse is damned to an evil afterlife if it dies within 1 minute; ordinary resurrection then requires a caster-level check at DC 10 + the caster’s level, except for aligned worshipers or the use of miracle or wish. Removing the curse before death prevents the effect, and its caster can later release the soul to its proper afterlife but cannot thereby revive it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Malediction (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an alignment-directed afterlife consequence with a time limit; a world can change which powers can rescue a soul, with exceptional magic or a dangerous journey serving as the price.

rules.statement: The affected creature’s hostility toward a caster-designated person lasts up to 1 day per level and causes 2 points of Wisdom damage each day. The target can relieve that damage by acting on its spite, and remembers the conduct but not its magical motivation after the effect ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Malicious Spite (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sustained, covert hostility that exacts a daily mental cost; a world can adjust the damage or duration, while acting on the emotion temporarily relieves the cost.

rules.statement: A marked living target takes twice the damage the caster deals to themself, bypassing damage reduction, immunity, and resistance; the mark lasts 1 round per level, and each self-injury requires a standard action and deals 1d8 plus Strength modifier damage to the caster.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mark of Spite (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived damage link that doubles harm onto the marked target; a world can change the multiplier, with the caster paying the original injury each time.

rules.statement: A soul projected into a willing host shares its body with the host’s soul, which is helpless but can still perceive and communicate telepathically. The possessor keeps mental traits and the host supplies physical traits, but the possessor cannot activate the host’s special abilities; the spell lasts 10 minutes per level and ends if the possessor returns to their own body.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Marionette Possession (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to consensual possession with the host’s awareness retained but control surrendered; a world can change duration or the host’s degree of agency, while the possessor’s helpless body remains a vulnerability.

rules.statement: A fixed mask worn for 24 hours frustrates divination aimed at its wearer; specific scrying and certain detection attempts succeed only after a caster-level check. Checks to learn about or identify the wearer take a 4-point DC increase, but observers cannot be prevented from noticing the mask.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mask From Divination (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to making magical and social identification harder while leaving the disguise visibly obvious; a world can alter the check penalty, with the conspicuous mask as the cost.

rules.statement: A shadow attached to a failed-save target moves with them and deals 1d4 Strength damage initially; each following round the target saves or takes another 1d4, or 1 on a successful save. Reaching Strength 0 kills the target, while bright light grants a +2 save bonus and darkness imposes a –2 penalty.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Masochistic Shadow (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an escalating shadow affliction whose severity varies with light; a world can change damage or the save, with darkness making it more dangerous.

rules.statement: A caster and one controlled summoned creature can exchange places as a swift action during the spell’s 1-round-per-level duration. If the creature reaches 0 or fewer hit points first, the caster can instead move to a visible space within 30 feet as an immediate action; either use ends the spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Master’s Escape (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-use positional swap with a summoned ally; a world can change the fallback distance, while the limited duration and consumed effect constrain its use.

rules.statement: For 1 round per level, the caster is immune to gaze attacks and can reflect one gaze back at its source as an immediate action, making that creature save against its own gaze. Reflecting a gaze ends the spell and does not bypass other defenses.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Medusa’s Bane (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary gaze immunity with one retaliatory reflection; a world can change the duration, while using the reflection consumes the protection.

rules.statement: By comparing two objects, the caster can learn whether they are identical, belong to the same category, or have no match; alternatively, a comparison can reveal whether one could have caused or been related to the other. Duplicate objects or creatures can produce misleading identical matches.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Meticulous Match (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited relationship test that can be fooled by duplicates; a world can broaden what counts as a relationship, while ambiguous evidence remains a limitation.
