rules.statement: For up to 1 round per level, the caster can ask one question each round of a target’s memories. A failed Bluff check yields the desired answer; succeeding by 5 or more lets the target supply a false answer that the caster believes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mind Probe (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to question-by-question memory access that permits deliberate misinformation; a world can change the questioning window, with the target’s deception as the principal risk.

rules.statement: The spell erases part of a target’s mind, imposing 2 temporary negative levels for 1 day per caster level and corresponding losses of prepared spells or spontaneous spell slots and spell knowledge. If these levels bring the target’s total to at least its character level, it becomes catatonic rather than dying for as long as the threshold holds.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mindwipe (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary memory loss that disables some spellcasting and can cause catatonia; a world can change the number or duration of lost levels, with the severity bounded by the effect’s term.

rules.statement: A rune on an object can absorb up to 1 spell per 2 caster levels before discharging; when a holder casts a spell on the caster’s list, absorption has a 10% chance, and the stolen spell’s knowledge reaches the caster for 24 hours. The inscription lasts 1 day per level and makes the object appear magical.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mnemonic Siphon (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited-use spell trap that transfers spell knowledge to its maker; a world can change the chance or capacity, while the stolen spell fails for its original caster.

rules.statement: A failed save makes a humanoid dazed for 1 round, then gives it bite and claw attacks and forces rage-like, confused behavior for the rest of the spell; it is dazed again during the final round. The spell lasts 1 round per level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Moonstruck (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary bestial transformation with erratic aggression; a world can alter the duration or control limits, while the subject loses reliable agency.

rules.statement: The caster creates up to four light- or darkness-producing motes, each changing illumination by up to two categories in a 20-foot radius. They move without concentration at up to 100 feet per round, must stay within 10 feet of one another, and vanish if one exceeds spell range from the caster.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Motes of Dusk And Dawn (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a small mobile set of light sources or darkness zones; a world can alter their number, speed, or spacing, with separation and caster range limiting deployment.

rules.statement: For 1 round per level, a living target is nauseated and has pupils that randomly alternate between dilated and contracted each round; lighting can then blind or dazzle it. Other creatures can attempt Stealth against the target even without cover or concealment.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mydriatic Spontaneity (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to visual disruption that makes stealth easier while imposing nausea; a world can alter how often pupil states change, with lighting determining the added impairment.

rules.statement: Ammunition or a thrown weapon gains accuracy against a chosen creature type or a known named creature for up to 10 minutes per level, but discharges after one attack. Against that quarry it ignores concealment short of total concealment, can target touch AC within 30 feet, and adds 1 damage per level up to 20; the greater version adds 2 per level up to 40.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Named Bullet (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-use, quarry-specific weapon enchantment; a world can change its damage cap or targeting benefit, with the shot expending the effect whether it hits or misses.

rules.statement: For 1 hour per level, an undead target’s effective Hit Dice for control purposes are doubled, capped at twice the caster’s level. If this exceeds its controller’s control limit, the undead is immediately freed; another eligible controller may take control.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Necromantic Burden (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to raising an undead creature’s resistance to control while leaving it open to another eligible controller; a world can change the cap, with the former master losing control when its limit is exceeded.

rules.statement: An undead creature becomes staggered for 1 round per level; if it was already staggered, it is instead dazed for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Necrostasis (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to slowing undead and upgrading the effect against an already impaired target; a world can alter duration, with the stronger result limited to one round.

rules.statement: The caster creates an immobile blade wall up to 10 feet long per level and 10 feet high, lasting 1 minute per level. A creature entering it takes 1d4 damage per level, to a maximum of 10d4, with a Reflex save halving the damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Night of Blades (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary damaging barrier that can be crossed at a cost; a world can change its dimensions or damage, with its fixed location limiting use.

rules.statement: A song can lure up to 24 Hit Dice of creatures within a 300-foot radius toward the caster while the caster concentrates, then for 1 round per level. Lured creatures can only defend themselves; they get another save before entering an obvious peril, and stop moving to stand fascinated within 5 feet.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Nixie’s Lure (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a concentration-driven mass lure bounded by 24 Hit Dice; a world can change that cap or radius, while dangerous terrain offers a chance to resist.

rules.statement: A possessed Tiny or Small unattended object gains animated-object statistics and one construction point for up to 1 minute per level, but the possessing caster cannot use other spells or abilities. If the object moves beyond close range from the caster’s body, the tether breaks and consciousness returns.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Object Possession, Lesser (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to briefly animating a small object through the caster’s displaced consciousness; a world can change object size or construction points, with the tether range and lost abilities as constraints.

rules.statement: The ordinary and greater object-possession forms animate larger unattended objects for 10 minutes per level, granting construction points appropriate to size, up to 3 for Large and 5 for Gargantuan. The caster can return to their body and then try another object; the greater form extends the tether to medium range and can instead possess a construct as a control effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Object Possession (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to size-scaled object animation with a return-and-switch option; a world can change size limits and construction points, while distance and duration constrain control.

rules.statement: Diseased creatures in a 20-foot burst that fail their save become fatigued and spread their diseases to creatures within 10 feet; a successful save instead causes 1 round of fatigue without contagion.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Outbreak (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to turning existing disease into a short-range contagion; a world can alter the spread radius, while a successful save prevents transmission.

rules.statement: A target can take no actions, loses its Dexterity bonus to defense, and suffers a –2 defense penalty for up to 1 round per level; it can attempt a new save each round to end the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Overwhelming Grief (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an incapacitating emotional effect that can be resisted anew each round; a world can alter its duration or penalties, with repeated saves giving the victim an escape.

rules.statement: A living target takes 1d6 nonlethal damage each round for up to 10 rounds, is sickened for the duration, and gives the caster a +4 bonus on intimidation attempts against it. The mass version can affect one living creature per level, with targets no more than 30 feet apart.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Pain Strike (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to repeated nonlethal pain paired with a social advantage; a world can change damage or duration, while the mass form’s clustered targets limit its reach.

rules.statement: The caster creates a silent, quasi-real chariot and four-horse-like team for 1 hour per level, carrying up to six passengers including the driver. The vehicle has AC 19 and 10 hit points plus 2 per caster level, capped at 50; losing all hit points makes it disappear and may cause a crash.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Phantom Chariot (pf1-spells#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, silent transport with a fixed passenger and durability limit; a world can change its capacity or toughness, while its destruction risks a crash.

rules.statement: A calling effect can draw a creature into a prepared, inward-focused magic circle after a failed Will save. The creature remains trapped until it accepts one service for its freedom, but it may try once per day to escape through resistance, dimensional travel, or a Charisma check; a natural 1 on the caster’s bargaining check frees it, and an unfinished open-ended task lasts at most 1 day per caster level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Planar Binding, Lesser — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a prepared trap and negotiated single service; worlds can make escape or bargaining harder, at the cost of greater safeguards or a more compelling reward.

rules.statement: The stronger calling versions can call one creature up to 12 or 18 Hit Dice, or as many as three of the same kind whose Hit Dice total no more than that limit; no pair can appear more than 30 feet apart. Each called creature saves, tries to escape, and must be persuaded separately.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Planar Binding — DESCRIPTION; Planar Binding, Greater — EFFECT and DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to separate resistance and negotiation for every summoned creature; a world could permit group bargains, trading away individual agency and control.

rules.statement: Possession transfers the caster’s soul into a target for 1 hour per level, while the caster retains mental traits and the host body supplies physical traits; the host soul is imprisoned but cannot control the body. The caster can return with a standard action if both bodies remain on the same plane, while the host’s death returns the caster and kills the host; death of the caster’s original body ultimately kills the caster.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Possession — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary body takeover with the host’s physical capabilities; a world can make the soul transfer safer or riskier, changing the cost of leaving one’s body exposed.

rules.statement: A scouting-eye spell creates 1d4 plus caster level eyes, each with 120-foot vision, a 1-hit-point body, and a 1-mile operating limit; they follow instructions of at most 25 words and last no longer than 1 hour per caster level. An eye must return to its creator to relay what it saw, taking 1 round per recorded hour, after which it vanishes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Prying Eyes — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to fragile, visible scouts that return to report; a world could improve their durability or range, balanced by greater detection risk or cost.

rules.statement: A temporary pyrotechnic blaze deals 1d6 damage per caster level, up to 15d6, then deals half as many dice each successive round until it would deal none. It follows its target even through teleportation, damages anyone touching the target, and a creature pushed or grappled into the target’s place takes the current damage without a save.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Pyrotechnic Eruption — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent, fading effect that tracks its target; a world could shorten its persistence, reducing both damage potential and the danger to bystanders.

rules.statement: Recharging restores up to 1 charge per caster level to a battery, or half that amount to a battery-powered technological item; attempting to recharge a battery has a 20% chance of destroying it. Charges beyond an item’s capacity require a Fortitude save or cause 1d6 electricity damage per excess charge, and the amount to restore must be chosen before casting.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Recharge — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to restoring declared charges with a risk of battery loss or overload damage; a world could reduce that risk by requiring careful capacity knowledge or limiting the amount restored.

rules.statement: A hidden chest can hold up to 1 cubic foot per caster level on the Ethereal Plane for up to 60 days and can be recalled by concentrating while possessing its tiny replica. After 60 days, it has a cumulative 5% daily chance of being lost forever; losing the replica prevents recall, and living contents still need food, air, and water.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Secret Chest — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary remote storage keyed to a physical replica; a world could extend the storage period, risking greater chance of permanent loss.

rules.statement: An area of dim light or darkness can serve as an entrance to a shadow path that transports the caster to another dim or dark place within medium range. The transport is instantaneous and requires an appropriate shadow at both ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Shadow Step — DESCRIPTION (pf1-spells#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to instant travel between nearby shadowed locations; a world could allow brighter destinations, weakening the darkness restriction.

rules.statement: A successful magic siphon ends one ongoing spell on a touched creature and transfers its remaining duration to the caster; if the effect permits a save, the new recipient gets one without restarting the duration.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Siphon Magic (pf1-spells#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transferring an ended effect with its time left; a world can restrict this to touch or selected effects because magic resists being redirected.

rules.statement: Siphon Might reduces a target’s Strength by 1d6 + 1 per 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 1d6 + 5, but not below 1; a successful save halves the penalty. The caster grants an adjacent creature a matching Strength bonus, and the penalty does not stack with itself or ray of enfeeblement.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Siphon Might (pf1-spells#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to moving the drained amount from one creature to another; a world can cap or forbid the transfer because the source cannot be reduced below 1 Strength.

rules.statement: A spell that counters magic can absorb a countered spell of 3rd level or lower and restore one expended spell or slot of equal or lower level; the greater version raises the countered-spell limit to 6th level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spell Absorption (pf1-spells#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to converting a successful counter into a limited reserve recovery; a world can raise the level ceiling, with stronger magic required to absorb stronger spells.

rules.statement: Spotlight makes its target’s space brightly lit, suppresses mundane light and magical light of 3rd level or lower within 20 feet, and follows the target unless a Reflex save succeeds. The target takes a −20 penalty on Stealth checks and cannot use darkness for concealment while the spell lasts.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spotlight (pf1-spells#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a moving, bounded light-and-suppression field; a world can change its radius or which light sources it suppresses, since stronger lights may resist it.

rules.statement: Solid fog halves movement and imposes −2 on melee attacks and damage, prevents most ranged weapon attacks, and reduces falling damage by 1d6 per 10 feet passed through. Only winds of at least 31 mph disperse it, doing so in 1 round; overlapping instances do not compound their movement and attack penalties.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Solid Fog (pf1-spells#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent cloud that impedes movement and attacks; a world can set its dispersal threshold, with severe wind being the stated countermeasure.

rules.statement: Suppress Primal Magic prevents primal magic events from triggering inside its 10-foot-radius area and grants +4 on saves against outside primal effects that extend into it. When the spell ends or is dispelled, a primal event of CR equal to the caster level triggers at the center if primal magic remains active there; its caster can negate it with a DC 20 Will save.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Suppress Primal Magic (pf1-spells#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to suppressing local events while accumulating a release at the field’s center; a world can let the caster avert the aftermath by passing the stated save or ending the spell somewhere safe.

rules.statement: Teleport carries the caster and eligible willing companions as far as 100 miles per caster level, but not between planes; the chance of arriving on target depends on familiarity, while a mishap deals 1d10 damage and requires another destination roll. Greater teleport removes the range limit and off-target chance, but false or inadequate destination information returns travelers to their starting point.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Teleport (pf1-spells#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to familiarity-governed travel with mishap risk; a world can remove range and accuracy limits for a stronger version, while unreliable destination knowledge can still defeat the journey.

rules.statement: A telepathic bond links the caster and willing creatures with Intelligence 3 or higher, allowing language-independent communication over any distance but not across planes. The caster may exclude themself when casting.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Telepathic Bond (pf1-spells#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a communication-only group link; a world can expand membership or cross-plane reach, while consent and the Intelligence threshold limit who can join.

rules.statement: A created slime transfers to the first creature hit by a successful melee touch attack, deals 1d3 Constitution damage each round, and cannot spread to another creature; it dies if separated from its original target or after consuming a creature it kills. Scraping, freezing, burning, cutting, sunlight, or disease removal destroys it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Touch of Slime (pf1-spells#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one attached target and recurring harm; a world can vary the slime's damage or removal methods, with its inability to spread limiting contagion.

rules.statement: A spell that duplicates a poison already affecting its caster requires the caster to choose one poison if several apply; the target suffers that poison's effects using the spell's saving-throw difficulty. A related spell can force a poisonous creature to resist its own poison using the spell's difficulty, but later saves use the poison's usual difficulty.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Toxic Gift; Toxic Rupture (pf1-spells#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to copying an existing poison rather than inventing one; a world can allow other transferable afflictions, with the caster needing to bear the source effect.

rules.statement: A moving detection field reports teleport effects that start or end within 40 feet and can identify traces from as much as 1 hour earlier, including their time to the nearest minute. Studying a trace for 1 round allows one check against DC 11 plus the effect's caster level, with a –5 penalty if it is over 1 minute old; success gives only a brief view of the opposite endpoint, and the check cannot be retried.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Trace Teleport (pf1-spells#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sensing events inside a moving radius and a single limited investigation; a world can change the lookback window or check difficulty, trading reliable tracking for effort and uncertainty.

rules.statement: A swap spell exchanges a chosen object and a held focus object, each weighing at most 5 pounds per caster level. Similarity between them cumulatively adjusts resistance: same type, material, or weight each adds 1; being from the same set or mold adds 2; a more valuable target or one bound to its holder each subtracts 2.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Trade Items (pf1-spells#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to exchanging two bounded objects, with affinity making the exchange easier; a world can alter the weight cap or similarity adjustments, while possession or binding makes removal harder.

rules.statement: A conditional suggestion can prescribe only an activity that begins when a stated condition occurs, lasts up to 1 day per caster level or until completed, and leaves the subject unaware of the suggestion before its trigger.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Triggered Suggestion (pf1-spells#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one concealed, trigger-based instruction; a world can expand its duration or allowable instructions, at the cost of the target's resistance and the risk of a poorly chosen trigger.

rules.statement: A creature with a supernatural shape-changing ability that fails its initial save against a reversion effect may try again as a full-round action; success ends the effect and restores its ability to change shape. Failure locks it in its true form for the spell's duration, preventing other shape-changing effects from changing it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): True Form (pf1-spells#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to reverting a changed body and temporarily preventing further changes; a world can lengthen the lock or make reversion harder, limiting the target's access to alternate forms.

rules.statement: An undead-enhancement effect grants a mindless undead creature the advanced template for 1 minute per caster level, but gives destructive instincts control: attempts to command it have a 50% chance of failure, and an uncontrolled creature attacks living beings it sees. It cannot affect a creature that already has that template.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Umbral Infusion (pf1-spells#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary strength increase with a chance of command failure; a world can raise the bonus or failure chance, risking the enhanced creature's aggression.

rules.statement: An illumination wall lasts 1 minute per caster level, extends up to 5 feet per level, and sends bright light up to 60 feet from one face and darkness the same distance from the other, shifting illumination by at most two steps; it also blocks sight through it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wall of Split Illumination (pf1-spells#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary, two-sided light-and-dark barrier; a world could alter its reach or duration, with the caster’s power setting the limits.

rules.statement: A stone wall can cover up to one 5-foot square per caster level and is 1 inch thick per four caster levels; halving thickness doubles its area. It must join and be supported by existing stone, and a span over 20 feet must be arched and buttressed, halving the available area.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wall of Stone (pf1-spells#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a lasting stone structure constrained by support and area; a world could vary its strength or shaping, at the cost of reduced coverage.

rules.statement: A creature struck by Wandering Star Motes that fails its Will save is dazed for 1 round and must keep saving each round; on a successful save the motes jump to the nearest eligible enemy within 30 feet. Each creature can be affected only once, and the spell ends if no new target is available.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wandering Star Motes (pf1-spells#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a dazing effect that passes between enemies until each resists; a world could change its duration or target-selection range, with repeated saving throws limiting its hold.

rules.statement: A touched shield grants its wielder spell resistance of 10 plus the caster’s level for 1 minute per level when it can be interposed against a spell. Against area spells it grants no resistance, but gives a +5 bonus on Reflex saves.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Ward Shield (pf1-spells#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to protection tied to an interposed shield for a limited time; a world could strengthen or broaden it, at the cost of requiring the shield to block the effect.

rules.statement: A wind wall blocks Tiny and Small flying creatures, gases, and most gaseous breath, deflects arrows and bolts, and gives other ordinary ranged weapons passing through it a 30% miss chance. It lasts 1 round per caster level and can follow a continuous path, including a closed enclosure.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wind Wall (pf1-spells#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary barrier that selectively obstructs flight, gases, and projectiles; a world could vary its size or duration, with the wall’s shape defining its coverage.

rules.statement: Absorb Toxicity grants immunity to encountered poisons and diseases for 10 minutes per level or until discharged, but absorbing one affliction replaces immunity to all others. A successful melee touch transfers it and discharges the spell; if the spell expires first, the caster suffers it and gains +2 on saves against that instance.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Absorb Toxicity (pf1-spells#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to absorbing one affliction and transferring it by touch; a world could allow multiple stored afflictions, but the single-slot rule limits protection and creates exposure risk.

rules.statement: An antimagic field moves with its caster for 10 minutes per level and suppresses most magic within 10 feet without dispelling it; suppressed durations continue to run. Summoned creatures disappear inside and return when the field ends, while several named kinds of beings and certain effects are exempt.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Antimagic Field (pf1-spells#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a moving zone that suppresses most magic but does not erase it; a world could narrow its exemptions or radius, with active magic still expiring while suppressed.

rules.statement: Astral projection leaves the physical body suspended while the spirit travels as an astral body and can form a body on another plane. A broken silver cord kills the traveler; if the astral form or a formed body is slain, the traveler returns to the physical body but gains two permanent negative levels.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Astral Projection (pf1-spells#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to remote planar travel tethered to a vulnerable physical body; a world could make the tether safer or riskier, with death or lasting harm as the cost.

rules.statement: An enchanted curse can persist until its target meets a stated condition. The target intuitively understands a condition of at most 25 words that it can fulfill within a year and a day without ensuring its own death; magical removal checks are 5 harder.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Conditional Curse (pf1-spells#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a lasting curse with a reachable release condition; a world can make release harder or easier, reflecting the caster’s control and the victim’s chance to escape.

rules.statement: If a lethal spell kills its target, it can seal the victim’s organs and life essence in four jars; the victim revives as an undead 1d4 rounds later. A jar-bearer can communicate with and gain protection against that undead, while breaking or opening a jar lets its bearer issue a brief command; a 10-minute ritual by the caster can use all four jars to attempt longer control.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Canopic Conversion (pf1-spells#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to jars that grant limited influence over the revived undead; a world can strengthen or weaken their command and protection, with the caster exposed while performing the ritual.

rules.statement: A prepared duplicate can receive a slain person’s free, willing soul after 2d4 months of growth. The returned person has the original’s body, mind, personality, and memories, but suffers two permanent negative levels, or 2 Constitution drain if 1st level; a soul that has died of old age cannot return this way.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Clone (pf1-spells#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a prepared body as a costly return route for a willing soul; a world can alter the growth time or return penalty, with death by old age and unwillingness as hard limits.

rules.statement: A summoned black pudding attacks nearby creatures without obeying its summoner, and may attack the summoner if no clearer opponent exists. When the spell ends, the summoned pudding and any puddings it split into disappear.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Conjure Black Pudding (pf1-spells#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, uncontrolled summoned creature; a world can make it safer or more dangerous, with the danger of attacks on allies as the cost.

rules.statement: A demiplane can be expanded or modified through further castings; each casting can add or remove one available feature, such as a planar trait or physical structure. Permanent versions require separate permanency costs of 17,500 gp, 20,000 gp, or 22,500 gp for lesser, standard, or greater creation, respectively, and each expansion area requires its own payment.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Create Demiplane (pf1-spells#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a finite, configurable private plane; a world can broaden its features or persistence, with long casting times and substantial costs limiting the changes.

rules.statement: A creature that fails to resist a sleep-inducing aura falls asleep for 1 minute; it must resist again each time it starts a turn or finishes movement within 5 feet, even if it resisted earlier. A standard action or injury can wake a sleeper.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Cloak of Dreams (pf1-spells#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to repeated saves against a short-range sleep aura; a world can change its reach or sleep duration, with proximity to the source creating the risk.

rules.statement: Acid in a 30-foot-radius burst deals 1d6 damage per caster level, up to 20d6; creatures and objects that fail their save also take acid damage on each of the next 2 rounds. The lingering damage ends if the acid is neutralized, dispelled, or washed away.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Caustic Eruption (pf1-spells#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a burst followed by two rounds of lingering damage; a world can make the acid harder to remove, with cleansing or dispelling as counterplay.

rules.statement: A control spell can affect undead totaling up to 2 Hit Dice per caster level for 1 minute per level; they understand the caster’s commands regardless of language and do not attack the caster even when communication is impossible. When the spell ends, they return to their usual behavior and intelligent undead remember being controlled.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Control Undead (pf1-spells#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary command over a limited amount of undead; a world can change the duration or capacity, with intelligent subjects potentially seeking revenge afterward.

rules.statement: Cruel Jaunt lets the caster sense fear-afflicted creatures within medium range and, once per round as a standard action, teleport near one whose presence and rough location are known. The caster arrives in open space within 20 feet, can bring objects up to maximum load, and takes no further actions that round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Cruel Jaunt (pf1-spells#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sensing and short-range travel keyed to fear; a world can widen the range, with the cost that teleporting consumes the rest of the turn.

rules.statement: A permanent major curse is harder to remove: its removal DC is 5 higher than the save DC. A curse of disgust permanently sickens a target near an observed, designated trigger within 30 feet; a successful save negates its urge to leave, but not the sickness while the trigger remains present and noticed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Curse, Major; Curse of Disgust (pf1-spells#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to persistent curses removable with difficulty; a world can make removal harder or tie symptoms to a chosen trigger, at the cost of ongoing exposure.

rules.statement: Cursed Earth permanently affects a one-mile-radius area with one chosen effect: normal plant growth and food production are halved; qualifying dead creatures rise as uncontrolled zombies after 24 hours unless their corpses are burned or dismembered; or creatures risk contracting a chosen disease each day at sundown.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Cursed Earth (pf1-spells#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent, bounded land curse with one selected consequence; a world can broaden the area or add effects, paid for with rare costly components and lasting harm.

rules.statement: Daywalker physically reshapes a willing undead creature to resemble a living creature of its size for 24 hours, making an incorporeal target corporeal. It suppresses listed undead abilities and harmful touch effects; the target can end the spell as a standard action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Daywalker (pf1-spells#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary disguise and bodily alteration with suppressed powers; a world can lengthen the effect, while retaining the vulnerability that the target becomes physically embodied.

rules.statement: Decollate makes a willing humanoid’s head detachable for 24 hours. While it is off, the body has damage reduction 2 and immunity to decapitation and head-dependent effects, but is blind and has blindsense 15 feet; destroying the head or letting the spell expire before reattachment kills the target, while planar separation or dispelling returns and reattaches it safely.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Decollate (pf1-spells#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a reversible body-separation effect with a vulnerable anchor; a world can remove the time limit, but the detached body’s sensory limits and the head’s danger remain costs.

rules.statement: Dimensional Bounce links two designated locations within range for 1 round per caster level or until used up. As a swift action the caster can teleport to either location; the spell ends after a number of teleports equal to one-fourth caster level, to a maximum of 5.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dimensional Bounce (pf1-spells#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a two-endpoint travel link with a limited number of uses; a world can increase uses or duration, at the cost of requiring line of effect to both endpoints when made.

rules.statement: Dimensional Lock creates a 20-foot-radius area that blocks extradimensional travel into or out of it for 1 day per caster level. It does not block extradimensional perception or attacks, nor does it disrupt creatures already in astral or ethereal form.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dimensional Lock (pf1-spells#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded travel-blocking ward with specified exceptions; a world can expand its coverage, while leaving perception and existing planar states unaffected.

rules.statement: Dominate Person controls one humanoid for 1 day per caster level through a telepathic link; changing orders costs a move action, and the caster must concentrate for at least 1 round each day or the subject gets another save. The subject gets a new save with +2 against commands against its nature, and protection from evil can suspend the caster’s control and link without ending the spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Dominate Person (pf1-spells#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sustained remote control with periodic maintenance and resistance for unnatural orders; a world can relax those limits, at the cost of weaker subject autonomy.

rules.statement: A mind-altering effect can reduce Intelligence and Charisma to 1 and prevent language use, coherent communication, and abilities relying on those scores; it lasts until one of four specified restorative spells removes it. Arcane spellcasters take a −4 penalty on the saving throw.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Feeblemind (pf1-spells#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to lasting mental alteration removable only by exceptional cures; a world can shorten or broaden recovery options, with long-term disability as the cost.

rules.statement: A Fey Gate connects the Material Plane and Fey World for 1 round per caster level; travelers entering arrive together at a random point, while those leaving arrive where the gate was cast. A DC 30 Spellcraft check can keep it open for 1d4+1 days, but travel provides no protection from hazards or creatures.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Fey Gate (pf1-spells#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, one-way-randomized arrival route with a fixed return point; a world can make the extended opening easier, risking prolonged exposure to the Fey World.

rules.statement: A gate can connect different planes at a chosen point and remain open for at most 1 round per caster level while the caster concentrates. Calling creatures costs 10,000 gp in offerings; a group can total no more than twice the caster level in Hit Dice, and only a single creature at or below the caster’s level is controllable. Longer service requires fair payment, and breaking the promise can make the caller serve the creature or provoke retaliation.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Gate (pf1-spells#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to costly calling governed by a reciprocal service bargain and limited control; a world can waive payment or raise the control threshold, but risks uncontrolled beings or contract consequences.

rules.statement: A force prison lasts 1 round per caster level and can be a 20-foot barred cube or a solid 10-foot cube. Its force structure blocks ethereal escape, but not teleportation; it has hardness 30 and 20 hit points per caster level, and disintegrate destroys it automatically.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Forcecage (pf1-spells#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary prison with defined escape routes and break points; a world can make it harder to damage, at the cost of more reliable confinement.

rules.statement: A wall made from one corpse per 5-foot square can attack adjacent enemies and trap creatures that fail a Strength check against DC 15 plus caster level, dealing 3d6 crushing damage. The caster can detach one square as a standard action to create a verbally controlled zombie; when the spell ends, that zombie and the wall’s other corpses revert to corpses.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Flesh Wall (pf1-spells#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an animated corpse structure that can be split into a temporary servant; a world can allow longer-lasting servants, at the cost of requiring ongoing upkeep or control.

rules.statement: A prepared escape spell can teleport its caster and up to one willing creature per two caster levels to the casting location, provided they are within 30 feet when triggered. The trigger is a swift action; affected creatures farther away are left behind, and the route cannot cross planes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Getaway (pf1-spells#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a pre-established, short-range group extraction with a proximity limit; a world can allow separated allies to come too, weakening the need to stay together.

rules.statement: A foresight effect warns its subject immediately of impending danger for 10 minutes per caster level, prevents surprise and being caught flat-footed, and grants +2 to AC and Reflex saves while the subject retains its Dexterity bonus to AC. If cast on someone else, the caster must convey the warning for it to help that creature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Foresight (pf1-spells#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to immediate danger warnings with a limited defensive benefit; a world can make warnings actionable without communication, reducing the cost of separation.

rules.statement: A creature targeted by Ice Crystal Teleport is trapped in ice and paralyzed for 1d4 rounds before teleporting to a specified familiar location. Destroying the ice before the delay ends cancels the teleport.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Ice Crystal Teleport (pf1-spells#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a delayed relocation that can be interrupted by destroying its physical enclosure; a world can shorten the delay, reducing the opportunity to rescue the target.

rules.statement: A creature banished to the labyrinth can spend a full-round action each turn attempting a DC 20 Intelligence check to escape; if it remains inside, the maze ends after 10 minutes and returns it to its former location, or the nearest open space if that location is occupied. Ordinary movement between places on the same plane cannot escape it, but plane shifting can; minotaurs are unaffected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Maze (pf1-spells#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, escapable pocket prison; a world can turn the escape difficulty or duration, since stronger containment risks making removal depend on exceptional magic.

rules.statement: A permanent duration can be applied by casting the chosen spell first and then this spell, but only to spells on its eligible lists and only when the caster meets the listed minimum level and pays the listed diamond-dust cost. Some effects can be made permanent only on the caster, while other listed effects can affect other creatures, objects, or areas; a self-only application can be dispelled only by a higher-level caster.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Permanency (pf1-spells#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to permanence only for listed effects and after a level and material-cost gate; a world can broaden the eligible list, trading lasting convenience for expensive, hard-to-reverse magic.

rules.statement: A force hand follows one chosen opponent to provide its caster cover, even if the opponent hides or changes form, but it does not pursue that opponent. Creatures weighing at most 2,000 pounds that try to pass it move at half speed; changing its target takes a move action, and dispelling or disintegrating it ends it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Interposing Hand (pf1-spells#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a durable but bounded defensive barrier that tracks only one target; a world can alter its durability or weight limit, at the cost of making it less predictable in combat.

rules.statement: The dance compulsion lasts 1d4+1 rounds and prevents its target from taking other actions, while imposing –4 AC, –10 on Reflex saves, and removing shield AC; a successful Will save reduces the effect to 1 round. Affected creatures provoke attacks of opportunity on each of their turns.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Irresistible Dance (pf1-spells#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to short-lived forced behavior with a save that reduces rather than fully negates it; a world can turn the duration or resistance, at the cost of leaving targets exposed.

rules.statement: A permanent curse prevents its target from benefiting from teamwork feats or assistance, from accepting harmless magic willingly, and from improving others’ attitudes through social checks. While conscious, the target repeats a Will save hourly, or every round in combat or comparable stress, or acts as if affected by a crime-wave effect for 1 round; removal requires a higher-caster-level remove curse or limited wish, wish, or miracle.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Life of Crime (pf1-spells#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to persistent compulsive behavior with frequent checks under pressure and costly removal; a world can make the curse easier to clear, but thereby weaken the consequence of the initial magic.

rules.statement: A short transmitted message can reach creatures with Intelligence 3 or higher within up to 1 mile per caster level; the caster may restrict recipients using objective, observable criteria, but cannot select individuals or shape the area. The message carries no spell or speech-based ability, is not translated, and arrives in the caster’s voice.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mage’s Decree (pf1-spells#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to broad, one-way communication with objective audience filtering and no magical payload; a world can narrow the range or loosen recipient limits, trading reach for selectivity.

rules.statement: Within a 40-foot-radius burst, the spell unravels magical effects and suppresses permanent magic items for 1 minute per caster level unless the items resist; a natural 1 on an item’s save destroys it. A single targeted item instead faces a save at –5 against permanent destruction; successfully destroying an artifact also risks permanently losing the caster’s spellcasting and attracting a powerful interested being.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mage’s Disjunction (pf1-spells#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to broad magic-ending with item resistance and severe risks for artifact destruction; a world can reduce those risks, at the cost of making powerful magic less secure.

rules.statement: The enclosure suppresses magic in its area and blocks spells from being cast into, out of, or within it; its surrounding force shell has hardness 40 and 20 hit points per caster level. Destroying that shell ends the spell, and its antimagic also makes summoned creatures and incorporeal undead disappear temporarily unless spell resistance lets them remain.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Mage’s Magnificent Enclosure (pf1-spells#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary antimagic zone protected by a destructible shell; a world can raise the shell’s durability, but then the field becomes harder to breach or escape.

rules.statement: Effects cast on someone other than the caster can normally be ended by dispelling them. The game master may also permit other effects to be made permanent.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spell list, immediately before Pessimism (pf1-spells#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing dispelling of effects on other targets; a world can restrict dispelling or permanence, changing how long magic remains, because the passage leaves permanence to the game master.

rules.statement: A phase passage is a 5-by-8-foot opening extending 10 feet deep, plus 5 feet per three caster levels, and provides one use per two caster levels. Only its creator can use it unless a trigger based on observable qualities or actions is set; taking one Medium-or-smaller companion counts as two uses. It passes no light, sound, or spell effects, and dispelling it safely ejects anyone inside.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Phase Door (pf1-spells#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a creator-exclusive, finite-use passage; a world can allow conditional access at the price of uses and restrict qualifying triggers to observable facts.

rules.statement: An area of safe wilderness 50 feet in radius can suppress harmful planar conditions for one day per caster level, but it does not change gravity and needs solid matter at least as large as the area. Casting takes an hour and requires precious stones worth 500 gp; permanence requires a caster of at least 11th level and 7,500 gp.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Planar Refuge (pf1-spells#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary environmental shelter with costly, solid-ground requirements; a world can permit permanence, paid for with a further 7,500 gp and high-level magic.

rules.statement: A plane shift moves the caster or a touched creature, or up to eight willing creatures holding hands, instantly to another plane. From the Material Plane, arrival is imprecise: the group appears 5 to 500 miles from the intended destination, and return requires another means of travel.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Plane Shift (pf1-spells#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to cross-plane movement with substantial arrival error; a world can improve precision or restrict destinations, with the passage making reliable arrival the limitation.

rules.statement: The sacrifice spell traps a fragment of a creature’s spirit in a bloodstone for one day per caster level. A holder can use its highest-level eligible racial spell-like ability no more than once per day, or at that ability’s lower frequency; the stone loses power if the victim survives the casting or is revived before the duration ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Plundered Power (pf1-spells#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-use-per-day borrowed racial ability housed in a stone; a world can loosen the frequency or eligibility restrictions, at the cost of weakening the sacrifice-bound limit.

rules.statement: A phobia imposes a named fear trigger. When the target perceives it, or takes damage from a named energy type, it attempts a DC 20 Will save: failure causes panic, while success still causes shaking and discomfort; shaking prevents further saves until it ends. Panic can persist for one minute after exposure ceases, and specified magic can remove the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Phobia (pf1-spells#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed trigger and DC 20 with a lesser effect even on a successful save; a world can make the reaction stronger or easier to clear, balancing fear against duration and removal.

rules.statement: A protective sphere centered on its caster blocks attacks and other effects from passing through it. Its blindness lasts 2d4 times 10 minutes for creatures below 8 Hit Dice; the caster can pass through unharmed, and the sphere can be made permanent.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Prismatic Sphere (pf1-spells#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary barrier that protects its caster while blocking projected effects; a world can let effects pass or make it temporary, trading the breadth of protection against persistence.

rules.statement: A refuge stored in a prepared object lasts until discharged. The possessor can speak its command word and break the object to teleport themself and carried gear up to a heavy load to the caster’s home; alternatively, the caster can choose at casting to be transported to within 10 feet of the possessor, with no option to decline once triggered.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Refuge (pf1-spells#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a break-to-activate, one-use transport stored in an object; a world can let the caster choose to arrive instead, but that choice commits them to the transport.

rules.statement: Resurrection can restore a creature that has been dead no more than 10 years per caster level if any small part of its body remains, at a cost of a 10,000 gp diamond. The revived creature returns at full health but gains one permanent negative level, or, if 1st level, takes 2 points of Constitution drain; old-age deaths and several creature types are excluded.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Resurrection (pf1-spells#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to revival within a caster-level-based time limit, requiring remains and a costly diamond; a world can ease the limit or reduce the penalty, at the cost of making death less consequential.

rules.statement: A creature inside the rift takes 6d6 falling damage on entry, then takes another 6d6 damage each round from a randomly chosen damage type; a Reflex save halves that round’s environmental damage. When the rift closes, creatures still inside take double environmental damage for that round and are knocked prone as they are expelled.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Rift of Ruin description (opening passage) (pf1-spells#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent hazardous area with a save each round; a world can change the hazard types or damage, with the cost of making the rift’s interior dangerous to its occupants.

rules.statement: As a standard action during the rift’s duration, its caster can close it early and summon one listed group: one bebilith or vrock, 1d3 shadow demons or succubi, or 1d4+1 babaus or brimoraks. The summoned creatures remain for as many rounds as were left on the rift’s duration; anything still inside is expelled under the normal closing effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Rift of Ruin description (opening passage) (pf1-spells#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to exchanging the remaining duration of a hazardous rift for a temporary summoned force; a world can vary which beings answer, at the cost of immediately closing the rift.

rules.statement: A spellbane creates a 10-foot-radius emanation lasting 1 hour per caster level, and suppresses only the exact spells selected at casting, at one selected spell per five caster levels. Overlapping emanations combine their banned spell lists, but effects created by artifacts or deities are not suppressed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spellbane (pf1-spells#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a localized field that blocks named spells while leaving other magic functional; a world can broaden or narrow the list, with the cost of a fixed selection that cannot be changed after casting.

rules.statement: Spell turning redirects targeted spells back at the caster until it has consumed its randomly determined reserve of 7–10 spell levels, or until 10 minutes per caster level pass. A spell whose level exceeds the remaining reserve is divided proportionally between the protected creature and the attacker; if both have spell turning, a random resonance result applies, including a 3% chance of sending both into another plane.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spell Turning (pf1-spells#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a finite reserve that absorbs or reflects targeted spells; a world can change its reserve or resonance outcomes, with the cost that stronger spells can partly get through.

rules.statement: A symbol of death can kill creatures within 60 feet when its chosen trigger occurs, affecting the closest eligible targets first and no more than 150 total current hit points. It remains active for 10 minutes per caster level or until that limit is reached; chosen trigger conditions are fixed at casting, and a password or attunement can exempt creatures.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Symbol of Death (pf1-spells#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a visible, trigger-based area trap with a capped total effect; a world can alter its trigger or exemptions, with the cost of advance inscription and a powerful material component.

rules.statement: A symbol of sealing immediately creates a force barrier across a door or opening no larger than 20 square feet per caster level, lasting 10 minutes per caster level. A password or attunement prevents a creature from triggering the rune but does not let it pass through the barrier after activation.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Symbol of Sealing (pf1-spells#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary force barrier that blocks passage and line of effect; a world can allow different bypass conditions, with the cost that knowing the password alone does not overcome an active barrier.

rules.statement: In a spellscar area, every spell, spell-like ability, or magic-item activation triggers a primal magic event unless its user is a spellcaster who succeeds at a concentration check of DC 15 plus twice the spell’s level. The area’s creator gains +4 on checks to avoid these events there and rolls twice for any event they trigger, choosing the result.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Spellscar (pf1-spells#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to unstable magic within a bounded area, with a check to avoid triggering its consequences; a world can change the event frequency or check difficulty, at the cost of risking unpredictable magic.

rules.statement: A summoner conduit links a summoned creature or eidolon to its summoner for 1 minute per caster level: whenever the linked creature is targeted by a damaging spell, the summoner is also treated as a target and gets normal defenses. The link cannot affect the summoner across planes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Summoner Conduit (pf1-spells#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transmitting spell targeting through a summoning bond while retaining the summoner’s normal defenses; a world can extend or sever the link, with planar separation blocking it.

rules.statement: A triggered striking symbol threatens its 5-foot square and surrounding area as a Medium weapon-user, attacks provoking non-attuned creatures, and can make 1 plus its chosen ability modifier attacks of opportunity per round. It lasts 10 minutes per caster level or until it has made attacks equal to caster level; spell resistance can permanently prevent it harming a creature, while a successful Will save halves damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Symbol of striking (opening passage) (pf1-spells#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a triggered area hazard with a finite attack budget; a world can vary its weapon or ability modifier, at the cost of requiring an expensive masterwork weapon.

rules.statement: A triggered vulnerability symbol affects creatures within 60 feet, reducing spell resistance and saving throws by 4 and energy resistances and damage reduction by 10 (minimum 0). Its effects last while a creature remains within range and for 1 round per caster level afterward; the symbol itself lasts 10 minutes per level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Symbol of Vulnerability (pf1-spells#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent radius debuff with a brief lingering effect; a world can change the defenses affected, balanced by the symbol’s costly materials.

rules.statement: A triggered weakness symbol deals 3d6 Strength damage to each creature within 60 feet, and each creature can be affected only once. It remains active for 10 minutes per caster level and has no hit-point limit.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Symbol of Weakness (pf1-spells#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-application area effect; a world can change the damaged attribute, with the limited repeat exposure constraining the harm.

rules.statement: Sympathy makes a location or object attract a specifically named kind of intelligent creature or a specified alignment for 2 hours per caster level. A creature that succeeds at its save is freed, but must save again 1d6 × 10 minutes later; failure makes it try to return, and the spell counters and dispels antipathy.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Sympathy (pf1-spells#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a targeted attraction compulsion with a delayed repeat save; a world can broaden eligible targets, but must still identify them specifically.

rules.statement: A telekinetic sphere traps its contents in a resilient globe and reduces their weight to one-sixteenth. The caster can move up to 5,000 pounds within medium range by concentrating, at up to 30 feet per round; the sphere lasts 1 minute per caster level and falls at 60 feet per round if unsupported.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Telekinetic Sphere (pf1-spells#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a concentration-controlled containment sphere with fixed mass and speed limits; a world can raise those limits, at the cost of making transport easier.

rules.statement: Teleport trap redirects teleportation into or out of its area to a chosen open spot on solid ground for 1 day per caster level. A successful Will save prevents teleportation but still consumes its use; the caster can specify exclusions for travel out of the area, and linked castings can cover a larger area.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Teleport Trap (pf1-spells#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded redirection field with a save that cancels travel; a world can permit more exclusions or larger coverage, balanced by casting time and material cost.

rules.statement: Temporary resurrection restores a creature dead for less than 48 hours for 24 hours, but gives it one permanent negative level during that time. It dies again when the duration ends, and cannot receive this spell again until permanently raised.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Temporary Resurrection (pf1-spells#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived return with an explicit vitality cost and reuse restriction; a world can extend the reprieve, at the cost of making permanent restoration less urgent.

rules.statement: Torpid reanimation can animate corpses when a specified event occurs, or when the caster triggers it as a standard action; a time condition must occur within caster level days. The caster can gain control of a created undead as a free action within 60 feet and line of sight, subject to animate dead’s Hit Die limit, but cannot regain control after losing it once.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Torpid Reanimation (pf1-spells#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to delayed, condition-triggered animation with limited later control; a world can loosen the trigger deadline, while the control cap and irreversible loss remain costs.

rules.statement: Trap the soul confines a creature’s life force and body in a gem until it is broken; the gem costs 1,000 gp per Hit Die. A trigger-object version transfers the soul automatically when the creature accepts the object, bypassing saves and spell resistance, while the spoken-word version allows both defenses.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Trap the Soul (pf1-spells#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to indefinite gem imprisonment with release on destruction; a world can change the release condition, but the gem’s escalating cost limits powerful targets.

rules.statement: A magical barrier can suppress spells, effects, or magic items at or below its creator’s caster level for 1 round per level, while leaving higher-level magic, artifacts, and divine effects unaffected. Suppressed effects with longer durations resume afterward, but their durations continue to elapse while suppressed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wall of Suppression (pf1-spells#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to suppressing eligible magic that crosses the barrier; a world can raise or lower the caster-level threshold, because stronger magic can resist the field.

rules.statement: A broad reality-altering effect can duplicate specified spells, cure one kind of affliction for up to one creature per caster level, or transport up to one creature per caster level between any planes. Reviving someone whose body was destroyed takes two uses, and effects beyond the listed limits risk literal or partial fulfillment.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wish (pf1-spells#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed outcomes and limits; a world can permit stronger outcomes, but makes them dangerous through distortion or incomplete fulfillment.

rules.statement: Repeated use of a limb-weakening effect can disable multiple limbs: a leg injury halves leg-based movement, all legs disabled leaves only 5-foot crawling, and one withered wing prevents wing-based flight. The damage is permanent until restored by one of the listed powerful healing effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wither Limb (pf1-spells#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to lasting, stacking limb impairment; a world can make recovery easier or harder, with the listed restoration magic setting the baseline cost.

rules.statement: A sound barrier can deflect arrows, bolts, debris, and Small or smaller flying creatures; touching or crossing it deals 2d6 sonic damage plus 1 per caster level, to a maximum bonus of 20. A silence effect suppresses it in the area, and it returns when silence ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wall of Sound (pf1-spells#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to deflecting eligible projectiles and damaging contact; a world can change the barrier’s reach or damage, while silence remains a counter.

rules.statement: A wall of light blinds adjacent creatures while they remain near it and for another 1d4 rounds afterward; passing through blinds automatically. Shadow-plane creatures gain 1d4 negative levels per round within 5 feet, with a –4 save penalty for the round they cross; after 24 hours, each level is tested to determine whether it is removed or permanent.
locators: Pathfinder 1e spells (d20pfsrd): Wall of Light (pf1-spells#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated proximity and crossing effects; a world can change the wall’s duration or severity, with shadow-origin creatures bearing the special cost.

rules.statement: A weapon ability can be restricted to particular weapon types; an ability’s effects may also be limited by target type, wielder traits, or a specified triggering action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Individual ability descriptions (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to enforcing each stated eligibility and trigger; worlds can broaden them, at the cost of weakening the specializations that make abilities distinct.

rules.statement: Some weapon effects stay active after a command until another command ends them, while other effects expire after a stated duration, sleep, or being unattended for 8 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Individual ability descriptions (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the duration or ending condition stated for each effect; a world can make effects shorter or longer, trading convenience against persistent magical influence.

rules.statement: Several abilities have limited uses, including three activations per day, once per day, or once per round; some can instead consume two uses of another ability to channel its effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Individual ability descriptions (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the printed use limit and expenditure; a world can raise or remove those limits, at the cost of making magical resources less consequential.

rules.statement: Weapon bonuses can be lent to an ally until the wielder’s next turn, but do not stack with a bonus of the same type; abilities that add damage may likewise specify that their damage does not stack with similar effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Allying; Blood-Hunting; other ability descriptions (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated duration and non-stacking limits; a world can allow stacking or longer transfers, risking runaway bonuses.

rules.statement: An effect can impose a condition with a specified duration and a recurring chance to end it; for example, one weapon can cause confusion for 1d6 rounds, with a DC 17 Will save each round to end it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Bewildering (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated duration and repeated save; a world can change the save or duration, balancing reliability against how disruptive the condition is.

rules.statement: Some abilities impose a penalty on a creature for wielding the weapon, and that penalty lasts only while the creature holds it; the alignment-based examples impose one negative level that cannot be removed during that time.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Anarchic; Axiomatic (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the penalty persisting while the weapon is held; a world can make it milder or harder to escape, with the wielder bearing the corresponding risk.

rules.statement: A defending melee weapon’s enhancement bonus can be reassigned at the start of the wielder’s turn, before the weapon is used, to grant an equal AC bonus until the next turn; the wielder can shift some or all of it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Defending (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing a turn-by-turn allocation; a world could limit which defenses receive the bonus, reflecting the weapon’s finite enhancement.

rules.statement: A greater designating ranged weapon marks a creature it hits, giving allies +4 on melee attacks and +6 on melee damage against it for 1 round. Further hits do not increase either bonus or extend its duration.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Designating, Greater (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one marked target effect lasting 1 round; a world could change the bonuses or duration, with the mark representing coordinated targeting.

rules.statement: A dispelling weapon stores only dispel magic, and adds its enhancement bonus to checks made to dispel; that added bonus also applies to certain related class abilities and combat maneuvers.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Dispelling (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a weapon holding only the specified spell and improving dispelling checks; a world could broaden what it stores, balanced by access to the effect.

rules.statement: A disruption bludgeoning melee weapon forces any undead it hits to make a DC 14 Will save or be destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Disruption (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a DC 14 save against destruction on a hit; a world could restrict affected undead, with the weapon’s specialized construction as the cost.

rules.statement: A distracting weapon raises by 5 the concentration-check DC of a creature it hits for 1 minute; that creature then cannot be affected by this ability for 24 hours. The greater version raises the DC by 10 instead, replaces an ordinary distracting effect rather than stacking with it, and also has the 24-hour immunity.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Distracting (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-minute penalty and a 24-hour immunity; a world could vary the penalty or immunity, representing a target’s acclimation.

rules.statement: A dry-load cartridge protects its contents during loading in water or an airless environment and creates an air bubble around the firearm for 3 minutes or until it is fired, whichever comes first. Underwater attack penalties and firearm-explosion misfires still apply.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Dry Load (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one protected loading and a bubble that ends at firing or after 3 minutes; a world could change its duration, paid for by consuming specialized ammunition.

rules.statement: A wielder can use a fate-stealing melee weapon to take 1 grit or panache point from a struck foe as a swift action, regaining 1 of the wielder’s own points if applicable. An invalid target or a target with no points causes no effect and costs no action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Fate-Stealing (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transferring one available point on a successful target condition; a world could alter the eligible resource, with the cost limited by the foe’s supply.

rules.statement: A flamboyant weapon has a daily-refreshing reserve of 1 panache point, or 3 for its greater version; spending one lets the wielder reroll an attack with that weapon that missed on a natural 1, and the new roll must be kept. The two versions cannot be placed on the same weapon.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Flamboyant (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a small daily item-bound reserve and a mandatory reroll result; a world could adjust its capacity, balanced by the once-per-day refresh.

rules.statement: A glorious melee weapon sheds unsuppressible daylight when drawn, dazzles each creature it attacks in melee until the wielder’s next turn, and blinds a target on a confirmed critical hit unless it succeeds at DC 14 Will. Critical multipliers above x2 add 1 round of blindness per additional multiplier step.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Glorious (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated light and short-lived visual effects; a world could change the light’s suppressibility or blindness duration, with the weapon’s conspicuous glow as a drawback.

rules.statement: Some weapon abilities trigger only on a successful hit or critical hit; their effects can be limited to particular targets and durations, and some do not stack with themselves or similar effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Individual weapon ability descriptions (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to letting an enchanted weapon trigger its listed effect on its stated hit condition; a world can narrow eligible targets or stacking, justified by the enchantment’s specific design.

rules.statement: A weapon may carry a finite stored resource: one firearm ability has 1 grit point refreshed daily, while its stronger variant holds 3; spending a point can reroll a misfire, but the new result must be accepted.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Lucky / Lucky, Greater (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed capacity and daily refresh; a world can adjust the reserve or refresh rate, with the weapon’s magical reservoir as the in-world source.

rules.statement: Certain weapon effects are limited by weapon form or category, such as melee-only, ranged-only, ammunition-only, or particular damage types; the restriction prevents applying the effect to other forms.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Individual weapon ability descriptions (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to each ability’s specified weapon eligibility; a world can broaden compatible forms, at the cost of weakening its distinct construction requirements.
