rules.statement: A weapon can store up to 3 doses of injury poison; loading one dose takes a full-round action, and applying one from its reservoir takes a swift action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Injecting (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three stored doses and the stated action costs; a world can alter capacity or handling speed, with preparation time limiting repeated use.

rules.statement: A weapon strike can temporarily alter a target’s defenses: one ability reduces certain damage reduction by 5 for 1 round without stacking, while another reduces spell resistance by 1 for 1 minute per damaging hit, with critical hits reducing it by the critical multiplier; the latter stacks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Negating / Nullifying (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the specific defense reductions, durations, and stacking rules; a world can change which defenses are affected, with the effect framed as disruption by repeated strikes.

rules.statement: A strike may impose a condition or movement penalty with a fixed duration, and repeat hits can extend duration without increasing severity; some such effects allow a listed check to remove them.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Legbreaker / Ominous / Peaceful (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the printed condition and duration rules; a world can change duration, removal, or reapplication, with the effect representing a lingering consequence of the hit.

rules.statement: Some weapon powers can be activated or suppressed by command, but the weapon may lose a benefit while that power is suppressed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Merciful (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a command switching the property off and back on; a world can require an action or impose a delay, justified by deliberate control of the enchantment.

rules.statement: An ability that releases a creature from a movement-inhibiting effect requires a standard action and a combat maneuver check against DC 15 plus the effect’s caster level or the creature’s Hit Dice; only one attempt is allowed per effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Liberating (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one check per effect at the stated DC; a world can permit repeat attempts or broaden eligible effects, with the check representing forceful disruption.

rules.statement: Some weapon effects activate only on a specified event, such as a hit, critical hit, command, or kill; a few require spending a resource or forgoing the normal critical-hit benefit instead.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Magic Weapon Special Abilities (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to tying an effect to its weapon and listed trigger; worlds can broaden or narrow eligible weapon types because the enchantment is built for particular forms of use.

rules.statement: Several effects have a limited duration or use rate: returning weapons arrive just before the thrower’s next turn, silencing effects last until the next turn or a number of rounds, and some abilities can be used once per round or day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Magic Weapon Special Abilities (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated trigger and duration; a world can change the window or frequency to tune how often an enchanted weapon can shape a fight.

rules.statement: An effect that transfers or copies a spell removes it from its original target and gives it to the wielder, with the stolen benefit lasting no longer than its remaining duration or 1 minute; stored spells instead discharge on a damaging hit and can then be replaced.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Spell Siphon; Spell Stealing; Spell Storing (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transferring rather than duplicating active magic; a world can allow copying, at the cost of making the effect more powerful.

rules.statement: Some weapon properties are mutually exclusive, do not stack with similar effects, or apply after other modifiers; greater reliable reduces misfire by 4 after increases, cannot coexist with reliable, and repositioning cannot coexist with anchoring.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Reliable; Reliable, Greater; Repositioning; Speed (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated order and exclusions; a world can permit combinations, accepting stronger or more reliable weapon effects.

rules.statement: A toxic weapon raises the save DC of poison delivered by its strike by 2; each hit also has a 25% chance to preserve the dose for one more attack, but a dose can be preserved only once.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Toxic (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a +2 poison DC and one 25% reuse chance; worlds can tune the odds or bonus, balancing poison reliability against the limited preservation of each dose.

rules.statement: A transformative melee weapon can change on its wielder’s command into another melee weapon of the same general shape and handedness. Its enchantments remain unless incompatible with the new shape, and it returns to its true form when unattended.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Transformative (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to shape-matched melee forms with incompatible traits disabled; worlds can broaden the permitted forms, with the weapon’s original structure limiting change.

rules.statement: A greater transformative weapon can become any desired weapon when its command word is spoken, but not ammunition; incompatible abilities stop functioning, and it reverts to its original form after being unattended for 1 day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Transformative Greater (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to any weapon form but no ammunition, retaining only compatible abilities; worlds can alter the reversion delay, with unattended time anchoring the weapon to its true shape.

rules.statement: An unseen melee weapon can be made invisible by command. While it is invisible, its wielder takes a –1 attack penalty, but the first attack in a combat denies the target its Dexterity bonus to AC unless the target has a listed countermeasure or knows about the weapon.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Unseen (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to concealment with a modest handling penalty and a one-time opening advantage; worlds can change how long surprise lasts, with awareness and special senses countering it.

rules.statement: An umbral weapon grants its holder darkvision to 30 feet and can, while drawn and held, reduce light by one step in a 20-foot radius on command. The darkness ends if the weapon is dropped, disarmed, sheathed, or stowed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Umbral (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a held-weapon light field that ends immediately when put away; worlds can change its radius or light reduction, with maintaining the effect requiring possession and readiness.

rules.statement: Arrow-collecting medium armor gives its wearer a 20% miss chance against projectile attacks and can hold up to 5 projectiles that miss for this reason. The wearer may fire all held projectiles at one target within 30 feet as a standard action; unused or disturbed projectiles break after 5 minutes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Arrow-Collecting (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 20% deflection chance and a five-projectile capacity; worlds can vary capacity or expiry, with collected ammunition becoming fragile and short-lived.

rules.statement: An animated shield can be released as a move action to accompany its wielder and provide its shield bonus for 4 rounds, then drops. Once retrieved, it cannot be animated again for at least 4 rounds; grasping it can end the animation early.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Animated (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to four rounds of independent shielding followed by a four-round cooldown; worlds can change the duration, with the shield needing time before it can animate again.

rules.statement: A bastion shield suppresses a mind-affecting effect after its wielder fails a Will save, for a number of rounds equal to the shield’s enhancement bonus. The shield loses its enhancement bonus while doing so, and the suppressed effect resumes immediately if the shield is dropped or lost.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Bastion (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to suppression lasting one round per enhancement point, paid for by losing the shield’s enhancement while active; worlds can adjust the duration or payment, with losing the shield ending protection.

rules.statement: Buoyant armor or a shield removes its armor check penalty from the wearer’s Swim checks, but leaves the penalty in place for other checks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Buoyant armor and shields (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: waive only the Swim penalty; a setting can broaden the benefit, balanced by the item’s cost.

rules.statement: Burdenless armor increases the wearer’s carrying capacity by 50% for each of the light, medium, and heavy load categories.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Burdenless (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: increase each load threshold by half; a world can change the percentage to reflect how much magical load redistribution is available.

rules.statement: Calming armor can create a 5-foot aura as a swift action for up to 10 rounds per day, split among uses, and can be ended with another swift action. An agitated opponent threatening the wearer who is raging or affected by an emotion effect must pass a DC 15 Will save or have that effect suppressed, not removed, while the aura lasts.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Calming (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: require a save and spend up to 10 daily rounds; a world can widen the aura or increase its duration at the cost of stronger enchantment.

rules.statement: A qualifying good wearer with a challenge or smite-evil ability gains a +2 sacred AC bonus against the opponent chosen for that ability while wearing champion armor.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Champion (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: limit the bonus to the chosen foe and an eligible wearer; a setting can broaden eligibility, weakening the alignment-and-ability restriction.

rules.statement: A keyed shield lets a bearer who can channel the matching energy add one die to a channeling use three times per day, and reduces damage from the opposing energy by 10 points.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Channeling (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: tie the extra die to three daily uses and the bearer’s own channeling; a world can raise the use limit at the cost of making the shield rarer.

rules.statement: When its wearer is hit, clangorous armor can be triggered as an immediate action to make a thunderstone-like deafening bang; on a critical hit it can instead produce a sound burst with a DC 13 partial Fortitude save. The chosen area must include the attacker, and neither effect harms the wearer.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Clangorous (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: trigger only on a hit and spare the wearer; a world can remove the hit trigger or expand the area at the cost of collateral risk.

rules.statement: If the wearer becomes unconscious away from its native plane, cocooning armor prevents harmful local environmental effects, including toxins, extreme temperatures, negative energy, and lack of air, until the wearer wakes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Cocooning (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: protection applies only while unconscious off-world; a world can extend it to conscious wearers at the cost of broader magical protection.

rules.statement: Cotraveling armor can attune up to five willing creatures by touch. Once per day, when its wearer is sent to another plane, it can bring attuned creatures within 30 feet that are willing; all five attunement marks deactivate, and new creatures cannot be attuned for 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Cotraveling (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: transport only nearby willing companions and consume all marks; a world can allow more passengers at the cost of exhausting the attunements longer.

rules.statement: Hosteling armor or a shield stores one bonded animal as a sleeping image and releases it beside the wearer on command, or automatically after 24 hours. The animal continues to age and get hungry, gains no benefits while stored, and the permitted size depends on the armor or shield; the ability does not work on outsiders, oozes, or other exotic companions.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Hosteling (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: store one qualifying bonded animal with size limits and normal needs; a world can remove the size cap at the cost of greater storage magic.

rules.statement: A power attached to worn armor or a shield operates only while it is worn when the description says so; several abilities instead require a command, and limited-use effects specify their own daily uses or duration.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Individual ability descriptions (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated wear, command, use limit, and duration; a setting can loosen these limits, at the cost of making powerful gear more available.

rules.statement: Some abilities absorb or redirect a magical effect only when it targets the wearer alone; area effects and effects aimed at multiple targets are excluded. Other abilities absorb a spell that beats spell resistance and can later discharge its energy through a shield bash.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Spellsink; Spellrending (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed target restrictions and daily limit; a world can broaden absorption, but doing so weakens the reliability of offensive magic.

rules.statement: A poison-loaded suit exposes a grappler or a creature that bites its wearer, depending on the poison type, then empties its stored dose whether or not the victim resists. Venom-eating armor instead catches a dose when its wearer resists a poison, stores only as many same-type doses as its enhancement bonus, and can apply one to a held weapon.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Poisoning; Venom-Eating (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to single-dose discharge or the enhancement-bonus storage cap; a world can allow more stored poison, with the cost of stronger and more persistent poisoning.

rules.statement: Putrid armor affects living creatures within 10 feet with a DC 14 Fortitude save; failure sickens them for 5 rounds, and a successful save prevents another exposure from that armor for 24 hours. The wearer is immune to its own stench, while poison immunity and a natural stench also prevent the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Putrid (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated radius, save, and immunity limits; a world can enlarge the aura, but its odor also risks affecting more bystanders.

rules.statement: A phantasmal armor wearer can, three times per day, leave a stationary illusory double in a square she occupied during movement; it can distract and count as an ally for flanking but cannot attack, and any successful attack or area damage dismisses it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Phantasmal (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three stationary, fragile doubles daily; a world can make projections more durable, but they become harder to distinguish from real allies.

rules.statement: Phase-lurching armor lets its wearer pass through one material obstacle up to 5 feet thick once per day, as a move action; the effect does not pass through creatures or force effects, and leaves a trace for 1 minute.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Phase Lurching (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one thin-obstacle passage each day; a world can increase thickness, but doing so undermines physical barriers.

rules.statement: Unbowed armor can negate an attack that would reduce its wearer to 0 hit points or fewer, but doing so destroys the armor and blasts nearby creatures within 10 feet for 1d6 piercing damage per point of its armor bonus; a DC 20 Reflex save halves the blast.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Unbowed (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single destructive rescue with the listed blast; a world can make the armor reusable, but removes the sacrifice that balances survival.

rules.statement: Righteous, unrighteous, and unbound armor can grant a 10-round transformation once per day, but inflicts a negative level on a wearer of an opposed alignment for as long as it remains worn; removing the armor ends that penalty.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Righteous; Unbound; Unrighteous (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one use daily and an alignment-based penalty while worn; a world can remove the penalty, but loses the armor's built-in opposition cost.

rules.statement: Vigilant armor can be commanded once per day to give its wearer the effects of righteous might for 10 rounds, except its damage reduction is 5 against chaotic creatures. A chaotic wearer instead suffers one negative level for as long as the armor is worn; it cannot be removed by any means while the armor remains on.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Vigilant (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one 10-round activation per day and the alignment penalty; a setting could change the frequency or who is penalized, at the cost of weakening the armor’s lawful restriction.

rules.statement: Once per day, heavy volcanic armor can erupt in a 5-foot-radius area around its wearer, creating concealing smoke and molten liquid that deals 1d6 fire damage and ignites flammable material. After 1 round the smoke clears and the liquid hardens into difficult terrain; the wearer is unaffected by all of these effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Volcanic (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a once-daily eruption with a 5-foot radius, brief smoke, fire damage, and lingering terrain; a world could tune radius or frequency, balancing greater coverage against greater collateral hazard.

rules.statement: Vouchsafing armor grants its wearer damage reduction 5/— while unconscious, nauseated, stunned, or pinned, stacking with other damage reduction. It grants no protection from this ability if the wearer can act or attack despite the relevant condition.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Vouchsafing (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to protection only during the listed incapacitating states; a world could broaden the protected states, at the cost of making the armor more reliably defensive.

rules.statement: Once per day as an immediate action, warding armor ends all active challenge, judgment, and smite effects on its wearer, but does not prevent future targeting. The wearer can spend one of their own such abilities as a swift action to restore the armor’s use.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Warding (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one use per day, renewable by sacrificing a matching ability; a world could relax the sacrifice or broaden the ended effects, at the cost of reducing the value of hostile powers.

rules.statement: A shield with the weeping quality can be made to wail for up to 10 minutes, imposing –1 on attack rolls, saves, ability and skill checks, and weapon damage rolls for good-aligned creatures within 10 feet. The wielder can end the effect as a move action; nongood creatures and creatures immune to mind-affecting effects are unaffected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Weeping (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 10-foot effect lasting up to 10 minutes and limited to good-aligned, susceptible targets; a world could alter range or duration, with greater reach increasing the burden on allies.

rules.statement: Wild armor or a wild shield keeps its armor and enhancement bonuses while its wearer is in wild shape, and is not visible in that form.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Wild (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to preserving the item’s defensive bonuses while concealing it only during wild shape; a world could extend this to other transformations, at the cost of making transformed wearers harder to identify or disarm.

rules.statement: Withstanding medium armor is tailored to one creature type: it gives a +2 bonus on related Knowledge checks, and has a 50% chance to negate a sneak attack or confirmed critical hit from that type, making the damage normal instead. This chance does not stack with other critical-hit negation.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Withstanding (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one selected creature type and a 50% defensive chance that does not stack; a world could allow multiple types or stacking, at the cost of stronger protection.

rules.statement: A wyrmsbreath shield stores one charge per 5 points of keyed energy damage its wearer takes, up to 5 charges; charges vanish after 24 hours. On command, it can spend 1–5 charges to create a 15-foot cone dealing 1d4 damage of that energy type per charge, with a Reflex save at DC 11 for half damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e weapon and armor abilities (d20pfsrd): Wyrmsbreath (pf1-weapon-armor-abilities#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to energy damage charging the shield, a five-charge cap, and 24-hour expiry; a world could change the cap or expiry, balancing flexibility against the power of stored bursts.

rules.statement: A bag of holding keeps a fixed carried weight while storing contents in an interior space larger than its exterior. Types I–IV weigh 15, 25, 35, and 60 lb. and hold up to 250, 500, 1,000, and 1,500 lb., with volume limits of 30, 70, 150, and 250 cubic feet; the minor version holds 50 lb. or 6 cubic feet.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag of Holding (pf1-wondrous-items#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to weight- and volume-limited storage with fixed carried weight; worlds can vary the limits or storage physics, at the cost of changing what can be transported.

rules.statement: Overloading a bag of holding or piercing it with a sharp object ruptures and ruins it immediately, permanently losing everything inside. Turning it inside out instead spills out its contents unharmed, but it cannot be used again until restored.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag of Holding (pf1-wondrous-items#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a catastrophic failure threshold and a recoverable opening method; a world can make failures safer or more destructive, trading tension against risk to stored goods.

rules.statement: A living creature in a bag of holding can survive for up to 10 minutes before suffocating. A portable hole has only the air admitted when opened, enough for one Medium or two Small creatures for 10 minutes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag of Holding; Portable Hole (pf1-wondrous-items#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limited air and a 10-minute survival window; a world can supply breathable air indefinitely or shorten the limit, at the cost of changing the danger of enclosed storage.

rules.statement: Putting a bag of holding inside a portable hole tears open a rift that consumes both objects and loses them forever. Putting a portable hole inside a bag instead opens an Astral gate that draws the objects and creatures within 10 feet there, destroying both objects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag of Holding; Portable Hole (pf1-wondrous-items#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to destructive incompatibility between these two storage spaces; a world can allow or alter their interaction, with the catastrophic loss serving as the cost of combining them.

rules.statement: When a wondrous-power figurine is thrown down and its command word spoken, it becomes a creature that obeys its owner. Destroying it as a statuette permanently removes its magic; killing it in creature form returns it to statuette form for later use.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Figurines of Wondrous Power (pf1-wondrous-items#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a reusable creature form but a vulnerable, permanently breakable token; a world can make the creature or token more durable, changing the cost of deploying it.

rules.statement: A creature retrieved from a bag of holding takes a move action if the contents fit in an ordinary backpack, or a full-round action if they do not. Magic items stored inside give no benefits to the person carrying the bag.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag of Holding (pf1-wondrous-items#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to retrieval time based on storage bulk and suppress stored-item benefits; a world can make access faster or permit passive item effects, at the cost of convenience and power.

rules.statement: The merform belt can transform its wearer once per day for up to 12 hours, and a command can end the transformation early. The form breathes underwater and swims at 30 feet, but moves on land at only 5 feet.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Merform (pf1-wondrous-items#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited daily transformation with a strong land-mobility drawback; a world can change duration or the drawback, trading versatility against specialization.

rules.statement: A stoneskin belt grants damage reduction 10 against attacks other than adamantine until it absorbs 100 points of damage. It refreshes every 24 hours, but first requires 24 consecutive hours worn, and removing it restarts that requirement.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt of Stoneskin (pf1-wondrous-items#000)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily damage-absorption pool with a long reattunement interval; a world can alter the pool or wear requirement, balancing protection against downtime.

rules.statement: Some worn items grant an enhancement bonus to an ability score; treat that bonus as temporary for the first 24 hours the item is worn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Plague Rat (pf1-wondrous-items#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to granting the listed bonus while worn; a world can change the 24-hour transition, with the cost of altering how long-term ability increases work.

rules.statement: A limited-use item power can be activated only a stated number of times per day or rounds per day; where stated, uses need not be consecutive.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Shadowform (pf1-wondrous-items#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to tracking each item’s daily allotment separately; a world can make uses consecutive or share a reserve, at the cost of flexibility or item independence.

rules.statement: An item can store a shrunken object of up to 10 cubic feet; once per day it can be stowed by command, then restored with a move action when drawn from a pocket.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Security (pf1-wondrous-items#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to permitting one daily storage activation and move-action retrieval; a world can alter capacity or retrieval speed, with the cost of changing the item’s utility and balance.

rules.statement: An animated belt becomes a snake that obeys the animator’s spoken commands for up to 1 hour; it returns to belt form if slain or more than 100 feet from its animator.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Serpent (pf1-wondrous-items#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-hour obedient animated form with death and distance ending it; a world can extend control or range, at the cost of reducing its leash and failure limits.

rules.statement: The security belt makes it harder to steal from or search its wearer: the relevant check DCs rise by 5, and the wearer gains +5 CMD against steal attempts.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Security (pf1-wondrous-items#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to applying the stated +5 defenses; a world can raise or lower them, with the cost of making concealment more or less reliable.

rules.statement: The shadowform belt lets its wearer become incorporeal as a swift action for up to 10 rounds per day, not necessarily consecutively; while incorporeal, natural armor becomes a deflection bonus, and no Charisma-based deflection bonus is gained.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Shadowform (pf1-wondrous-items#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 10-round daily transformation with the listed defensive conversion; a world can change duration or defenses, at the cost of altering access to incorporeality.

rules.statement: The security belt’s concealed magic and pocketed objects appear nonmagical under a constant aura-masking effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Security (pf1-wondrous-items#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to continuous masking of the belt and stored items; a world can restrict the masking’s targets or duration, at the cost of making detection easier.

rules.statement: The body wrap can enhance one unarmed or natural-weapon attack and damage roll at a time, with a bonus from +1 to +5; it gains one additional use per round at base attack bonuses +6, +11, and +16. Its added weapon abilities are fixed at creation, require at least a +1 enhancement bonus, and the combined value cannot exceed +7.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Body Wrap of Mighty Strikes (pf1-wondrous-items#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a per-round limited enhancement chosen before each attack roll; a world can change the bonus cap or use progression, at the cost of changing attack specialization.

rules.statement: The cackling hag’s blouse grants a witch the cackle hex if she lacks it; if she already has it, she can use cackle as a swift action twice per day instead of a move action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Blouse, Cackling Hag’s (pf1-wondrous-items#001)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to granting the ability only to a witch and accelerating its use twice daily for an existing user; a world can remove the class restriction, at the cost of broader access.

rules.statement: A magic item may grant a limited-use effect, with the passage specifying daily use limits or a total number of rounds; for example, some effects are usable once per day, while the Vishkanya corset allows up to 10 rounds per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Individual item descriptions (pf1-wondrous-items#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to item-powered abilities with the stated daily limits; a setting can change the recharge period or usage allowance, balanced by how often such magic is available.

rules.statement: Some item effects last only while the item is worn, and removing the item ends the effect; other effects last for a stated duration or until a specified event ends them.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Individual item descriptions (pf1-wondrous-items#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to effects ending on removal when explicitly stated and otherwise following their listed duration; a world can make magic persist after removal at the cost of weaker or rarer items.

rules.statement: An item can store a single held object weighing no more than 20 pounds, make it weightless while stored, and return it as a free action; the item occupies the wearer’s entire hands slot, and stored spell durations continue to expire.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Glove of Storing (pf1-wondrous-items#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated one-item, 20-pound capacity and hands-slot restriction; a world can expand capacity, with the cost of more powerful or bulkier storage magic.

rules.statement: A weapon stored in the Gauntlets of the Weaponmaster can be retrieved as a swift action, up to 10 weapons can be stored, and a retrieved weapon swaps with one held; if storage is full, weapons displaced from the wearer’s hands are dropped.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gauntlets of the Weaponmaster (pf1-wondrous-items#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 10-weapon limit and the stated drop risk when there is no room; a world can raise capacity, at the cost of more demanding magic.

rules.statement: The Iron Cobra gauntlet can animate up to three times per day, but its cobra form can remain active for only 1 hour per day; if slain, it cannot be used again for 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gauntlet, Iron Cobra (pf1-wondrous-items#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the daily activation and duration limits, with destruction imposing a 24-hour lockout; a world can remove the lockout but require costly repairs or upkeep.

rules.statement: A glove-created hand can assist with one task, using the wearer’s base attack bonus or skill ranks but not their ability scores or other bonuses; it disappears after that attempt or after 1 minute, and the gloves then become nonmagical.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves, Assisting (pf1-wondrous-items#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one brief assisted action before the gloves lose their magic; a world can allow repeated use by imposing a recharge or maintenance cost.

rules.statement: An item can add a magical effect to another ability: the Corset of Dire Witchcraft lets a witch raise one known hex’s caster level by 2 for 24 hours, but removing the corset or enhancing a different hex ends the boost.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Corset of Dire Witchcraft (pf1-wondrous-items#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one selected ability at a time for 24 hours; a world can allow multiple enhanced abilities by increasing the item’s cost or requiring a stronger bond.

rules.statement: The Crown of Heaven’s linked regalia gains stronger benefits when its crown, orb, and scepter are used together; an evil creature carrying the crown takes a negative level, and intentionally wearing it also brings a curse that recurs every 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Crown of Heaven (pf1-wondrous-items#002)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed escalating benefits and alignment-based penalties; a world can loosen the alignment restriction, but should preserve a meaningful consequence for misuse.

rules.statement: A replacement ability counts as the standard ability for rules that improve it only if its description says it works like the standard ability or requires a choice specified for that standard ability; a similar name or progression alone is insufficient. Thus the dragoon’s spear training qualifies as weapon training, while the archer’s expert archer does not.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Archetype ability replacement clarification (pf1-wondrous-items#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring an explicit rules link or standard-ability choice; a setting can broaden equivalence, at the cost of making improvements apply more widely.

rules.statement: The Gloves of the Shortened Path create a connection to a visible, nonadjacent square for 10 rounds once per day. The wearer can change the square as a swift action and reach, attack, or manipulate things there, but cannot transfer objects, grapple, make ranged attacks, or use movement-dependent attacks through the connection; the wearer’s arms appear there and can be targeted, and threats in the wearer’s actual square automatically flank her.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves of the Shortened Path (pf1-wondrous-items#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary remote-reach link with exposed limbs and no item transfer; a world can loosen those limits, at the cost of reducing the danger and tactical tradeoffs.

rules.statement: The Gloves of the Commanding Conjurer let the wearer’s summoned creatures understand the wearer while worn, but do not let the wearer understand them. Three times per day, the wearer can try to control a summoned creature within 50 feet against Will DC 16.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves of the Commanding Conjurer (pf1-wondrous-items#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one-way comprehension plus three control attempts daily at DC 16; a world can allow two-way speech or more attempts, at the cost of weakening the summoning’s autonomy.

rules.statement: Each Poisoner’s Glove can hold one dose of a suitable liquid and deliver it by melee touch or a hand-based unarmed or natural attack; each glove works once per day. Loading one takes a full-round action and provokes attacks of opportunity, and harmful liquids such as acid or alchemist’s fire are unsuitable.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves, Poisoner’s (pf1-wondrous-items#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-dose, once-daily delivery channel that takes time to load; a world can allow more charges or faster loading, at the cost of making concealed delivery easier.

rules.statement: Gloves of Spellstrike can alter a ranged magus spell into a touch-range spell for spellstrike three times per day, but only if it normally targets creatures and is not a ray or other created effect. The altered spell affects only the creature attacked, and other targets are lost.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves, Spellstrike (pf1-wondrous-items#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three restricted spell-range conversions daily that collapse multi-target effects to one target; a world can permit broader conversion, at the cost of letting spellstrike bypass more targeting limits.

rules.statement: The Hat of Magician’s can move a metamagic feat between prepared spells three times per day as a free action when a spell is cast. The receiving spell cannot exceed the slot level of the spell that originally carried the feat; the effect does not help spontaneous casting or spell-like abilities.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Hat, Magician’s (pf1-wondrous-items#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three prepared-spell metamagic swaps daily with the original slot as a ceiling; a world can remove the ceiling, at the cost of allowing stronger spell modification.

rules.statement: A Halo of Menace continuously affects hostile creatures within 20 feet that fail a DC 20 Will save, giving them –2 to attacks, saves, and AC for 24 hours or until they harm the wearer. Chaotic creatures take –2 on the save, and a creature that resists or breaks the effect cannot be affected by that wearer again for 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Halo of Menace (pf1-wondrous-items#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent 20-foot hostile aura with a save, a behavioral way to end it, and a per-target immunity interval; a world can change the duration or immunity, at the cost of making the aura more or less controlling.

rules.statement: An Eidolon Anchoring Harness can let an eidolon avoid forced return to its home plane for 1 round by spending one use of its summoner’s summon monster ability; the summoner must be within 100 feet and, if conscious, can refuse the expenditure. If the return-triggering condition remains after that round, another use is required or the eidolon returns.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Harness, Eidolon Anchoring (pf1-wondrous-items#003)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to delaying dismissal one round per expended summon use, subject to the summoner’s veto; a world can make anchoring permanent or independent, at the cost of weakening the plane’s return safeguard.

rules.statement: An item can add a temporary mental-ability bonus; for the first 24 hours it is worn, treat the bonus as temporary. After 24 hours, an intelligence-granting headband also supplies ranks in its chosen skills equal to the wearer’s Hit Dice, without stacking with existing ranks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Headband of Vast Intelligence (pf1-wondrous-items#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to item-granted abilities that require wearing the item; a world can change the 24-hour activation delay or the number of granted ranks, with the cost of making the bonus less immediate or less useful.

rules.statement: A fear effect can be reduced by one severity step as an immediate response, up to three times per day; reducing shaken negates the effect. The wearer must spend the item’s limited daily uses to do so.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Headband of Unshakeable Resolve (pf1-wondrous-items#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three fear reductions daily; a world can raise or lower that cap, reflecting how reliably its enchanted gear counters fear.

rules.statement: A helm can pull a visible target within 20 feet, or pull its wearer toward that target. It can be used three times daily; it pulls objects of at most 250 pounds and creatures no larger than the wearer toward the wearer, while larger targets and immobile structures draw the wearer instead.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Helm, Batrachian (pf1-wondrous-items#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 20-foot pull with a 250-pound object limit and three daily uses; a world can tune range, strength, or uses, with stronger effects making the item more versatile.

rules.statement: A commanded howl can demoralize audible opponents within 30 feet with one Intimidate check, then summons 1d3 wolves at the start of the wearer’s next turn. They follow instructions for 5 rounds, and the howl can be used three times daily.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Helm, Howling (pf1-wondrous-items#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three uses per day and a short-lived wolf group; a world can change the summoned number or duration, trading reliability for a more costly or fleeting aid.

rules.statement: A charged gem can trigger its assigned magical effect once, and the helm can activate at most one gem each round. If magical fire harms the wearer and an additional DC 15 Will save fails, remaining gems detonate with effects determined by gem type, and the helm and opals are destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Helm of Brilliance (pf1-wondrous-items#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to finite gem charges and a destruction risk on failed resistance; a world can change charge counts or the overload trigger, making stored magic either safer or more volatile.

rules.statement: A creature within 60 feet can be captured once per day without a save and held in an extradimensional maze. It can try a DC 20 Intelligence check each turn to escape; otherwise it is released after 10 minutes, and the wearer’s defensive bonuses rise by 2 while it is held.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Kimono, Otherwordly (pf1-wondrous-items#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily capture that permits escape attempts and ends after 10 minutes; a world can alter escape difficulty or duration, increasing the risk and power of containment.

rules.statement: A mount’s rider can grant it a smoke ability for a total of 10 rounds per day, divided into uses of at least 1 round. While active, the mount’s hooves deal an additional 1d4 fire damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horseshoes, Nightmare (pf1-wondrous-items#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a shared 10-round daily budget with one-round minimum activations; a world can change the budget or minimum, balancing flexible use against limited duration.

rules.statement: The wearer is protected from effects that target souls and from divination effects blocked by nondetection, without a caster check to overcome the latter protection. If the wearer dies, magic cannot restore them until the circlet is removed, except through miracle, wish, or divine intervention.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Iron Circlet of Guarded Souls (pf1-wondrous-items#004)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to strong soul and identity shielding that also obstructs resurrection; a world can weaken the shield or ease removal, balancing privacy against the cost of being unable to return to life.

rules.statement: A worn artifact can grant a persistent benefit while imposing a drawback; one knowledge mask adds +10 to Knowledge checks only after 10 minutes of wear, but blinds its wearer for as long as it is worn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mask of Giants page (preceding entry) (pf1-wondrous-items#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: an equipped artifact grants its benefit and drawback together; a world can change the activation delay or penalty to reflect the artifact’s cost.

rules.statement: A form-changing item can grant a new body and selected traits of that form. The giant mask works only for a wearer with wild shape, and its lesser and greater versions grant different listed traits and physical bonuses while in giant form.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mask of Giants (pf1-wondrous-items#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: form changes require the stated qualification and grant only specified traits; a world can broaden eligible forms, with the mask’s power and balance as the cost.

rules.statement: The krenshar mask can be activated three times per day to frighten or shake onlookers within 100 feet for 1d4 rounds; a DC 13 Will save resists, and creatures able to see through illusions are unaffected. Targets with 6 or fewer Hit Dice become frightened, while those with more become shaken.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mask of the Krenshar (pf1-wondrous-items#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: limit the fear display to three uses daily and allow a save; a world can adjust frequency or reach at the cost of greater or lesser influence.

rules.statement: Once per day, after being worn for at least 1 hour, the skull mask flies up to 50 feet to attack a designated target. A successful touch attack forces a DC 20 Fortitude save against a death effect; success still deals 3d6+13 damage, and the mask returns after attacking.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mask of the Skull (pf1-wondrous-items#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the autonomous attack is limited to once daily and returns after its strike; a world can vary its range or damage, balanced by the item’s exposure and recovery.

rules.statement: An appearance-changing mask can copy the observed look of a creature of the wearer’s basic size and shape within 60 feet once per day for 1 hour. It adds +10 to disguise checks against that appearance and +1 to attacks and weapon damage against the imitated creature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mask, Stalker’s (pf1-wondrous-items#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: require observation and restrict the copied form and duration; a world can allow more forms or longer imitation at the cost of easier detection or fewer uses.

rules.statement: A robe can conceal its wearer in an extradimensional space with carried nonliving objects up to the wearer’s maximum load. The occupant can breathe for at most 24 hours, can take no action there except to exit by thought, and is forced out if the robe is destroyed or suppressed; lack of room can prevent voluntary exit.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe, Smuggler’s Collapsible (pf1-wondrous-items#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: permit refuge in a bounded storage space for up to 24 hours, with escape constrained by available room; a world can turn the capacity or duration dial, risking forced ejection.

rules.statement: The robe of scintillating colors uses at most 10 rounds per day: after a 1-round startup, viewers within 30 feet who look at it may be dazed for 1d4+1 rounds (DC 16 Will negates), while the wearer’s concealment improves by 10% per round to 50%; it also sheds light in a 30-foot radius.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe of Scintillating Colors (pf1-wondrous-items#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: one activation combines a gaze-like effect, increasing concealment, and light, but spends from a 10-round daily pool; a world can adjust the pool or escalation rate.

rules.statement: A robe can supply spell components and focuses, including costly ones up to 50 gp total per day. Supplied materials work only for spellcasting and disappear if separated from the wearer or once the relevant spell is cast.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe of Components (pf1-wondrous-items#005)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: supply temporary spell materials within a daily value cap; a world can raise the cap at the cost of making spellcasting resources less scarce.

rules.statement: A wearer who has already moved at least 10 feet over a surface can activate air-walking sandals as a swift action, but only through the end of that round; they can be used 5 times per day, with at least 1 minute between uses, and the wearer falls if not back on a solid surface by then.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Sandals of the Lightest Step (pf1-wondrous-items#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a brief, movement-gated item power; a world can turn the daily uses or duration, with falling as the cost of failing to land.

rules.statement: A belt wearer with a free hand can try to negate a successful melee attack by making an unarmed attack roll that exceeds the attacker’s roll; the attempt deals no damage, and whether it works or not the wearer takes a –4 attack penalty until the end of their next turn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Sash of Flowing Water (pf1-wondrous-items#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a reactive defense that competes with the incoming attack; a world can turn the roll requirement or penalty, with impaired attacks as the price.

rules.statement: A shirt can grant one extra move action once per day, after which the wearer’s turn immediately ends and any unused actions are lost; it must have been worn continuously for 24 hours first.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shirt, Quick Runner’s (pf1-wondrous-items#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited action boost with a lost-turn remainder; a world can turn the frequency or prerequisite, with the sacrificed actions balancing the benefit.

rules.statement: While its wearer is grappling, a shirt burns its grapplers for 1d6+10 fire damage each round, without harming the wearer; the effect consumes at most 10 rounds per day, which need not be consecutive.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shirt of Immolation (pf1-wondrous-items#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an automatic, condition-triggered effect with a daily fuel limit; a world can turn its damage or capacity, with grappling exposing attackers to the burn.

rules.statement: Shoes can summon 1d4 invisible, mindless servants twice daily; they last 3 hours, unless dismissed sooner. Once per day the wearer can instead gain 20% concealment for 3 minutes, but cannot do so while servants are active; true seeing ignores the concealment.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shoes, Haunted (pf1-wondrous-items#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to two non-overlapping item modes with separate limits; a world can turn their duration or availability, with active servants barring the defensive mode.

rules.statement: Once per day, lightning shoes transform their wearer into a bolt that travels up to 50 feet in a straight line; creatures in its path take 6d6 electricity damage. If a barrier stops the bolt, the wearer reappears beside it and is staggered for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shoes of Lightning Leaping (pf1-wondrous-items#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-use linear transformation that can be stopped by barriers; a world can turn distance or damage, with a failed passage causing a penalty.

rules.statement: Wearing the blood ampoule for at least a day replaces a sorcerer’s bloodline powers with those of the ampoule while worn, but not the original bonus spells, arcana, or feats; taking it off blocks all bloodline powers for 1 hour. Drinking its contents destroys it, sickens the drinker for 1d4 hours, and permanently changes a sorcerer’s bloodline powers and associated features.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Ampoule of False Blood (pf1-wondrous-items#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary, worn provenance swap or a permanent change through consumption; a world can turn the transition cost, with sickness and loss of access marking the irreversible route.

rules.statement: An unbroken salt line, made as a full-round action, blocks evil summoned or called creatures from crossing or physically interfering; it can be a 5-foot-diameter circle or a line up to 15 feet long. It lasts until disturbed, does not stop ranged or magical attacks, and cannot be recovered once poured.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Abjurant Salt (pf1-wondrous-items#006)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fragile boundary with a narrow target class; a world can turn its dimensions or protected beings, with disturbance ending the protection.

rules.statement: A commanded amulet transforms the wearer’s hands into rigid, superheated metal; hand attacks gain flaming and adamantine properties, but the hands cannot handle objects except as a fire-safe club could. The wearer is heat-protected and can end the change as a swift action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Opening description (heading not shown) (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to item-triggered, wearer-only transformation; a world can vary the metal or damage type, with rigid hands as the balancing cost.

rules.statement: The elemental amulet detects elemental outsiders within 60 feet with torch-like light and identifies their element by color. It grants resistance 5 to the energy type associated with the nearest elemental, only against elemental attacks, and allows the wearer’s attacks to bypass those creatures’ damage reduction.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet of Elemental Strife (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 60-foot elemental alert and narrowly applicable resistance; a world can widen detection or protection, at the cost of broader magical power.

rules.statement: The once-daily hidden-strength amulet either lets its wearer make one attack at their highest attack bonus as a swift action, or, if they have a ki pool, restores 2 ki points with a full-round action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet of Hidden Strength (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one use per day and one of two mutually exclusive benefits; a world can increase uses by charging a greater reserve or requiring a longer recovery.

rules.statement: A universalist wizard bonded to the amulet selects one spell school when preparing spells each day. Until the next preparation, they may replace a prepared spell from that school with a known wizard spell from the same school of equal or lower level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet of Magecraft (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to daily school selection and same-or-lower-level replacement; a world can loosen these limits by requiring a stronger bond or greater resource expenditure.

rules.statement: When used as a wizard’s bonded object, the spell-cunning locket adds 3 levels of spells to the wizard’s daily preparation capacity; the spell-mastery locket adds 6 levels instead.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet of Spell Cunning; Amulet of Spell Mastery (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bond-gated increase of 3 or 6 spell levels per day; a world can grant more capacity while requiring a more restrictive bond.

rules.statement: The plane-travel amulet attempts to transport its user and companions to a chosen plane and location. A DC 15 Intelligence check is required to choose accurately; on failure, travel goes to a random place on that plane on 01–60 on d%, or a random plane on 61–100.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet of the Planes (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to difficult destination control with the stated random failure outcomes; a world can make travel more precise by imposing a higher skill or resource cost.

rules.statement: The portrait can deliver up to 10 prepared verbal responses, each no longer than 25 words, when questions seem to match them. It has no actual intelligence.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Animated Portrait (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed, non-intelligent response set; a world can allow a larger repertoire, but would need to add upkeep or a means of updating it.

rules.statement: Biting the apple, even just tasting it, forces a DC 19 Will save; failure causes eternal sleep. It can be ended by specified powerful magic or a kiss from someone of royal blood.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Apple of Eternal Sleep (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single bite-triggered save and rare release conditions; a world can make the sleep easier to end, or make the trigger harder to avoid.

rules.statement: The arrow magnet hovers for 5 rounds after being thrown to a square within 50 feet. Small projectiles and thrown weapons passing through adjacent squares automatically turn toward it; touching it or reducing its 5 hit points to 0 destroys it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Arrow Magnet (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived, local projectile-diversion field; a world can enlarge or extend the field but should increase the device’s vulnerability or cost.

rules.statement: A handy haversack stores up to 2 cubic feet or 20 pounds in each side pouch and 8 cubic feet or 80 pounds in the center, while weighing 5 pounds when full. A requested item is on top and takes a move action to retrieve without provoking an attack of opportunity.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag, Handy Haversack (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to fixed extradimensional capacity and convenient retrieval; a world can increase capacity, with weight, retrieval time, or dimensional risk as a cost.

rules.statement: A bag of tricks produces random animals that serve the drawer for 10 minutes or until slain or sent back. Only one animal can exist at once; up to 10 may be drawn per week and no more than 2 per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag of Tricks (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a random temporary animal with one active at a time and daily and weekly limits; a world can provide more control or duration at the cost of fewer uses.

rules.statement: A band of the stalwart warrior reduces any fear effect to shaken and grants +2 on Will saves against fear. A wearer with bravery counts as four levels higher for that feature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Band of the Stalwart Warrior (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limiting fear severity and improving resistance; a world can strengthen the protection, perhaps by narrowing which fear sources it counters.

rules.statement: Once per day, a boro bead restores one previously consumed extract of its designated level, from 1st through 6th. It works on an infusion, but not on potions, elixirs, bombs, mutagens, or mundane alchemical substances.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bead, Boro (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one daily restoration of a specific-level extract; a world can allow broader restoration by requiring a rarer or consumable bead.

rules.statement: Speaking the bead’s command word turns it into a small burning-log pile for 8 hours or until extinguished, then it returns to bead form. It cannot be activated again until a period twice as long as its previous burn has passed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bead, Campfire (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an 8-hour transformation followed by twice that duration of cooldown; a world can shorten the wait by consuming fuel or another resource.

rules.statement: When thrown up to 60 feet, the bead explodes for 5d6 force damage in a 10-foot radius and creates a 10-foot-radius sphere for 10 minutes. A creature inside is sealed in; nothing passes through, it cannot be moved, and the one-use bead is consumed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bead of Force (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one-use damage and a fixed 10-minute enclosure; a world can make the barrier easier to break or shorten its duration to reduce the containment strength.

rules.statement: If its bearer fails a save against a hostile polymorph effect, the bead is destroyed and prevents that effect from affecting the bearer.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bead of Newt Prevention (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-use safeguard that triggers only after a failed save; a world can make it reusable by limiting which transformations it blocks.

rules.statement: A beast-bond brand gives a master’s eligible personal- or touch-range spells a 30-foot range to one marked companion, if line of effect exists. A new brand has 10 charges and spends one per spell level; it also lets the master treat the companion as an object or creature for teleportation, subject to weight limits.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Beast-Bond Brand (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one companion and 10 level-based charges, with line of effect; a world can increase reach or charges while requiring a stronger bond or more costly mark.

rules.statement: Filling the blood reservoir takes a minute, deals 4 Constitution damage, and grants 4 charges. Charges can heal physical ability damage at 1 point per charge, or all be spent for a one-turn inherent bonus to one physical ability score equal to twice the charges spent; only one charged reservoir can be safely carried.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Blood Reservoir of Physical Prowess (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to blood-paid charges with a choice between healing and a brief stat surge; a world can increase capacity by imposing greater bodily harm.

rules.statement: A book of extended summoning applies the Extend Spell effect to an eligible summon without increasing its spell slot, but it works only for creatures matching the book’s keyed alignment and is destroyed after use. The lesser, standard, and greater versions work up to spell levels 3, 6, and 9 respectively.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Book of Extended Summoning (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-use, alignment-limited extension with tiered level ceilings; a world can make it reusable by requiring a charge or other ongoing cost.

rules.statement: A bookplate lets its named individual summon the book by speaking its title, once per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bookplate of Recall (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one named book and one daily recall; a world can allow more targets or uses by limiting distance or requiring a costly link.

rules.statement: The bottle stores up to 25 spoken words during the round in which its cork becomes substantial. Removing the cork or breaking the bottle releases the message as if spoken then, and the bottle shatters after release.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bottle of Messages (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one stored short message released by opening or destruction; a world can allow longer messages by extending the sealing time or increasing the container’s cost.

rules.statement: A witch can move a known single-target hex, excluding greater and grand hexes, into the syrup as a full-round action. A weapon hit with it forces a DC 15 save against the hex; the syrup remains potent for 24 hours and follows the hex’s once-per-target limits.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bottled Misfortune (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transferring one eligible hex into a 24-hour poison-like dose; a world can extend potency or broaden eligible effects by requiring more preparation or risk.

rules.statement: The fur flask coats its user, granting cold resistance 5, +2 natural armor, and +4 Stealth in icy or snowy areas. The coat lasts 24 hours or until removed with alcohol, and the flask is spent after one use.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bottled Yeti Fur (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-use, 24-hour protective coating; a world can increase duration by making removal harder or adding a bodily cost.

rules.statement: When a handshake seals a deal or promise, the wearer can sense whether deceit is involved unless the other creature succeeds on a DC 16 Will save; the wearer cannot learn the deception’s specifics.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet of Bargaining (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a handshake-triggered, resisted yes-or-no deception sense; a world can reveal details by requiring a stronger save or more intimate contact.

rules.statement: The owner may key each of four charms to a known person. Speaking that person’s name while grasping the charm calls them, with their gear, to the owner’s location if they are on the same plane and willing; the used charm disappears.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet of Friends (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to four keyed people, same-plane travel, and willing targets, with one charm consumed per call; a world can add range or involuntary travel at substantial relational or item cost.

rules.statement: A wearer with lay on hands gains one additional daily use and the diseased mercy; if they already have that mercy, their effective caster level for removing diseases increases by 4.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet of Mercy (pf1-wondrous-items#007)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a feature-gated extra use and disease-cleansing benefit; a world can grant broader healing by requiring a more restrictive user or limited charges.

rules.statement: The unnamed bracelet can turn a confirmed critical hit or sneak attack against its wearer into a normal hit if the wearer uses an immediate action before damage is rolled. Each use destroys one of its seven beads; after the seventh, the bracelet crumbles.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Opening passage, before Bracers, Arrowmaster’s (pf1-wondrous-items#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: allow up to seven prevented critical hits or sneak attacks; a world can change the bead count, with each prevention consuming one bead.

rules.statement: When an item grants an effect a limited number of times, the use is spent when activated; some items are permanently depleted after a fixed number of activations. The passage also gives effects with stated durations, or that end when a specific event occurs.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Various item descriptions (pf1-wondrous-items#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: enforce each stated use limit and duration; a world can adjust recharge or duration, at the cost of changing the item’s power.

rules.statement: The bracers of armor grant an armor bonus from +1 to +8, but their armor bonus and special abilities do not stack with ordinary armor or another armor source; the source with the larger armor bonus functions instead. Their combined armor and special-ability bonus equivalent cannot exceed +8.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracers of Armor (pf1-wondrous-items#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: use only the larger armor source and enforce the +8 ceiling; a world can permit stacking, but that raises protection beyond the stated limit.

rules.statement: The charm bracelet’s magical charms each work once and then disappear; after the last is used, the bracelet is nonmagical. Its listed effects can create equipment for 1 hour, heal 2d8 hit points, charm a person, improve nearby allies’ rolls for 1 round, or calm nearby creatures.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet, Charm (pf1-wondrous-items#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: each charm is a single-use stored effect and disappears on activation; a world can allow replenishment, at the cost of weakening the item’s depletion limit.

rules.statement: Some items create an area effect with a stated radius and duration; the effect may allow a saving throw, recur at the start of a target’s turn, or end through a specified action. For example, the verdant-vine effect covers a 20-foot radius and can be ended by a DC 20 Strength check as a standard action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet, Verdant Vine (pf1-wondrous-items#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: apply the effect within its stated radius and duration, using its listed escape method; a world can alter the radius or escape difficulty, with stronger control as the cost.

rules.statement: A wearer who has an enchantment spell resisted by the seducer’s-bane bracelet knows the source and that the attempt occurred, while the caster senses that the spell worked. If the wearer acts against the spell’s intended effect, the caster immediately learns it failed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet, Seducer’s Bane (pf1-wondrous-items#008)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: conceal the failed resistance from the caster until the wearer contradicts the spell; a world can remove that false signal, at the cost of losing the deception.

rules.statement: Some worn items grant always-on bonuses or protections, while others activate on command or a specified action. Limited powers specify daily uses or durations; for example, one cloak’s distortion lasts 15 rounds per day, which its wearer may divide as desired.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cloak of Displacement (pf1-wondrous-items#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to item-bound effects that are continuous or activated by command; worlds can change their daily uses or duration, with scarcity represented by limited charges or recovery time.

rules.statement: A wearer can use certain cloaks to take a restricted creature or object form; the form may be limited to one creature type and may prevent use of another ability while transformed. One lion-form cloak permits up to one use per day, plus one use per available smite, but the wearer cannot smite while in lion form.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lion Cloak (pf1-wondrous-items#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default transformations to the stated form and duration; a world can broaden forms or relax blocked actions, balanced by limited uses or the loss of other powers.

rules.statement: Some effects require particular circumstances: one cloak enables flight only in darkness, for up to 7 minutes, and then prevents further flight for an equal period. Another can be triggered once per day when fire damage obscures its wearer, producing invisibility and false remains for 5 rounds or until the wearer attacks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cloak of the Bat; Cloak of Fiery Vanishing (pf1-wondrous-items#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to explicit triggers, restrictions, and cooldowns; a world can ease the trigger or shorten the cooldown, at the cost of making the power easier to exploit.

rules.statement: A magical cloak can store one use of a benefactor’s healing ability and later release it onto the wearer; the released effect retains the healer’s applicable secondary benefits. Other storage effects in the passage impose limits, such as one object of at most 100 pounds for no more than 1 hour, or up to three stored disguises.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Crystal of Healing Hands; Cloak, Prestidigitator’s; Cloak, Quick Change (pf1-wondrous-items#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default stored effects to fixed capacity and an explicit release action; a world can raise capacity or storage time, with cost paid through rarer items or risk of loss.

rules.statement: A creature can be linked to a blood-marked doll, which lets its bearer inflict a brief sickened state and negative-energy harm from a distance, subject to line of effect and a target’s resistance. Each time the doll affects the target, the target can attempt a DC 14 Will save to break the link; a doll cannot link to a different creature once assigned.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Doll, Anatomy (pf1-wondrous-items#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default links to a single marked target and allow repeated chances to break them; a world can make links harder to resist, with the blood mark and unique assignment as the cost.

rules.statement: Items can conceal or reveal magical and visual phenomena. For example, appearance dust reveals invisible creatures and images for 5 minutes, while disappearance dust makes a creature or object invisible for 2d6 rounds and resists magical detection, but appearance dust can still reveal it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Dust of Appearance; Dust of Disappearance (pf1-wondrous-items#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
