rules.default_dial_reason: Default opposing detection and concealment effects to their stated interaction; a world can make concealment harder to pierce, at the cost of rarer counters or shorter duration.

rules.statement: Certain consumable dusts absorb a defined substance into a pellet that can later release the same volume; one dust handles up to 100 gallons of water, and another up to 10 gallons of acid. Some also harm or potentially destroy particular creatures, with a saving throw and damage even if the creature resists destruction.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Dust of Dryness; Dust of Acid Consumption (pf1-wondrous-items#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default consumables to fixed substance and volume limits, with release tied to breaking the pellet; a world can increase capacity, balanced by higher cost or reduced availability.

rules.statement: The shackles prevent a bound creature from traveling between dimensions without a save, but creatures of Small through Large size can attempt to break free or slip out against DC 30. Other items’ effects can be ended by specific actions or conditions, such as attacking to end invisibility or scrubbing away weight-increasing dust.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Dimensional Shackles; Cloak of Fiery Vanishing; Dust of Weighty Burdens (pf1-wondrous-items#009)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default restraints block the stated escape capability while preserving the listed physical escape test; a world can make restraints more absolute, with stronger materials or greater cost.

rules.statement: The efficient quiver stores up to 60 arrow-sized objects, 18 javelin-sized objects, and 6 bow-sized objects in separate nondimensional compartments; its weight does not change with its contents, and its owner can quickly retrieve any stored item.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Efficient Quiver description (opening passage) (pf1-wondrous-items#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to fixed compartment capacities and weight; worlds can change the limits, with the reason being how much extra space the magic provides.

rules.statement: A dragon-breath elixir lets its drinker use one standard action to breathe a dragon-matched blast for 7d6 energy damage; targets in the area can save at DC 16 for half damage. The effect ends after one blast or 1 hour, whichever comes first.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elixir of Dragon Breath (pf1-wondrous-items#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one use within an hour; a world can adjust duration or damage, with the elixir’s single-use nature limiting repeated attacks.

rules.statement: The escape ladder extends or retracts by command and supports up to 300 pounds while suspended, or 600 pounds when attached to a sturdy surface. Its once-daily third command creates a space for one Medium creature that collapses at the end of that creature’s turn, sending it 1d6 × 100 feet in a random direction to a safe ground-level place; the ladder then falls.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Escape Ladder (pf1-wondrous-items#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated load limits and one safe but random relocation daily; worlds can change distance or frequency, trading safety and predictability against escape utility.

rules.statement: An implanted soulbound eye shares the wearer’s senses and permits telepathic communication with its master, but neither works across planar boundaries. The master can also target the wearer through it with specified spells, subject to the wearer’s normal saves and spell resistance; removal requires lifting its curse, after which the eye crumbles.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Eye, Soulbound (pf1-wondrous-items#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to remote sensing and communication without forced obedience; a world can broaden the master’s control, with planar separation and curse removal as limits.

rules.statement: The hybridization funnel can combine two different alchemical splash liquids after 10 minutes and a DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check; mixing with holy or unholy water raises the DC to 30. Failure destroys both ingredients, and a successful mixture has both effects but becomes inert after 24 hours; mixtures, potions, elixirs, and extracts cannot be combined.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Hybridization Funnel (pf1-wondrous-items#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to combining two eligible liquids at a risk of losing both; worlds can vary the check or eligible ingredients, with instability limiting the result to a day.

rules.statement: The goblin skull bomb ignites its last toucher when it breaks, dealing 5d6 fire damage and potentially setting that creature alight on a failed DC 13 Reflex save. If the victim dies, its body burns away in one round and leaves a new bomb only if the required skull conditions are met.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Goblin Skull Bomb (pf1-wondrous-items#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a dangerous last-touch trigger and conditional replacement; worlds can change the damage or reproduction conditions, with the risk of self-ignition enforcing caution.

rules.statement: The goblin fire drum adds 1 fire damage to fires within 30 feet, or 2 for the greater version, while its bearer spends a move action each round playing. Nearby unattended flammable alchemical objects start with a 10% ignition or explosion chance, increasing by 5% per round; the greater drum also produces pyrotechnics once daily.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Goblin Fire Drum (pf1-wondrous-items#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an ongoing 30-foot field that requires continued playing; worlds can change its reach or escalation, with the action cost and fire hazard limiting use.

rules.statement: Grave salt can consecrate a circle of 5-foot radius per dose for 1 hour per dose, taking 1 round to apply each dose; a corporeal creature can end the effect with a standard action. A dose can instead be thrown up to 15 feet to make an incorporeal undead target save at DC 14 or take 1d4 Charisma damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Grave Salt (pf1-wondrous-items#010)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a consumable area effect that can be deliberately broken, or a ranged spirit attack; worlds can alter the radius or duration, with each use costing a dose.

rules.statement: Iron cuffs placed on a helpless humanoid make the captive docile: the captive will not try to escape voluntarily and complies with reasonable requests unless a DC 11 Will save succeeds.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Passage 12 opening, before Mantle of Spores (pf1-wondrous-items#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to compliance while the cuffs are on a helpless target; a world can change the save difficulty or the requests allowed, with resistance determined by the captive’s will.

rules.statement: Some worn items grant a constant defense or immunity, while others add a limited-use effect; the effect may have a stated duration, end condition, or penalty alongside its benefit.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mantle of Spores – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the item’s stated use count and duration; a world can make such effects more or less sustainable, at the cost of access to the item’s other protections.

rules.statement: The necklace of fireballs lets its wearer detach and throw a bead up to 70 feet; it explodes as a fireball, and a failed save by the necklace against magical fire detonates all remaining beads.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Necklace of Fireballs – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to expendable beads with the listed damage and range; a world can vary bead strength or sensitivity to fire, risking all remaining charges at once.

rules.statement: A necklace of netted stars has seven jewels that can each recall one previously cast 0- or 1st-level spell. Its once-daily counterspell attempt is limited by unused jewels; whether it succeeds or fails, it exhausts all the jewels for that day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Necklace of Netted Stars – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to seven daily jewel uses and the stated counterspell limits; a world can increase capacity or countering strength, balanced by exhausting the entire stored reserve.

rules.statement: Nightdrops affect one willing creature per dose, granting low-light vision for 1 hour while imposing a −2 penalty on saves against light effects and light sensitivity.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Nightdrops – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the one-hour vision change and its light-related drawbacks; a world can lengthen the adaptation, at the cost of greater vulnerability to light.

rules.statement: An origami swarm fills a 10-foot space and behaves as a rat swarm except that it is a fire-vulnerable construct without disease. It attacks nearby creatures other than its creator, lasts 5 rounds, then becomes inert and loses its magic.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Origami Swarm – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived, largely uncontrolled swarm; a world can grant more control or duration, likely at a higher activation cost.

rules.statement: A philter makes its drinker helpful toward, and fall in love with, the first creature perceived after drinking; the effect is permanent unless removed by one of the listed powerful effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Philter of Love – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to permanent attachment until explicitly removed; a world can shorten or weaken the effect, with the cost of making the drinker’s altered attitude less reliable.

rules.statement: The salve protects an anointed creature from webs and similar obstructions, and improves escape from grapples; it lasts 8 hours unless wiped off with alcohol. Applied to a floor or steps, it instead makes the area function like a long-lasting grease effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Salve of Slipperiness – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#011)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an eight-hour personal effect or a long-lasting slippery area; a world can extend either duration, while alcohol remains a simple way to remove the substance.

rules.statement: A power fixed in an item can grant detection or bypass a target’s defense: the golem-detecting pin senses golems within 60 feet when its wearer concentrates for a standard action, and its attacks ignore golems’ damage reduction.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Scarab, Golembane (pf1-wondrous-items#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to item-bound detection and a narrow defense bypass; a world could widen targets or range, at the cost of making the item rarer or more powerful.

rules.statement: The protective medallion grants spell resistance 20 and absorbs energy-draining attacks, death effects, and negative-energy effects; after absorbing 12 such attacks, it is destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Scarab of Protection (pf1-wondrous-items#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed resistance and a 12-hit reserve; a world could raise the reserve, with the cost of making the item more durable or expensive.

rules.statement: The bindings fit Small through Large creatures and lock automatically; their key-holder can impose a command effect three times daily, while intimidation against the wearer receives a +4 bonus.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shackles of Compliance (pf1-wondrous-items#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a keyed, limited-use command effect; a world could increase uses or remove the key requirement, at the cost of stronger coercion.

rules.statement: Once daily, the stronger shackles can impose domination on a helpless, restrained, or willing humanoid; a failed save leaves the effect in place while the shackles remain attached, and removing or destroying them ends it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shackles of Durance Vile (pf1-wondrous-items#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to domination that lasts only while the physical restraint remains; a world could allow activation against resisting targets, at the cost of easier coercive capture.

rules.statement: Once daily, the wearer can store up to 10 hit points of life energy in a shawl; if reduced to −1 hit points or lower, it restores the stored amount but cannot prevent death. The reserve expires after 24 hours, and while stored it makes its owner more vulnerable to the shawl’s current holder.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shawl of Life-Keeping (pf1-wondrous-items#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a small, short-lived reserve with a bearer-linked vulnerability; a world could extend storage, at the cost of leaving the owner’s life energy exposed longer.

rules.statement: One daily activation turns a potion into a 10-foot-radius mist that gives its full effect to creatures in it that can breathe and do not hold their breath; use consumes both pill and potion. The pill works only on potions of its designated spell level, and not on oils, extracts, or mutagens.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Volatile Vaporizer (pf1-wondrous-items#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sharing one consumable effect in a limited cloud; a world could increase the cloud or remove the level restriction, at the cost of multiplying the potion’s recipients.

rules.statement: A stored targeted language-dependent spell of 3rd level or lower can be released by throwing and breaking its bottle; the spell’s variables are fixed when stored. The target struck is affected normally, while creatures within 5 feet can also be affected but receive +5 on saves, including a Will save if the spell normally permits none.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Word Bottle (pf1-wondrous-items#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one prepaid spell released on impact with a weaker splash; a world could permit higher-level or longer-cast spells, at the cost of greater stored power.

rules.statement: Sovereign glue covers 1 square foot per ounce and sets in 1 round; separating the surfaces before then ruins that application, but after setting only universal solvent dissolves the bond. Its flask needs slipperiness salve, reapplied within 1 round after pouring, to keep the remaining glue from sticking inside.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Sovereign Glue (pf1-wondrous-items#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a permanent bond that can be foiled during setting or removed with a specific solvent; a world could shorten setting time, at the cost of making accidental bonding more likely.

rules.statement: Wings of the Gargoyle grant flight and damage reduction 10 against adamantine while unfurled, but can be used for only 5 minutes per day in 1-minute increments; furling or unfurling them is a swift action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wings of the Gargoyle (pf1-wondrous-items#012)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short daily transformation with combined mobility and protection; a world could lengthen the duration, at the cost of reducing the power’s scarcity.

rules.statement: Some powers operate only while a particular item is worn or held; taking it off can end the benefit or impose a delayed penalty. One item, for example, causes four hours of exhaustion for each night of sleep skipped if removed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet, Everwake (pf1-wondrous-items#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to powers requiring the item to stay equipped; a world can relax that requirement, but the item’s magical focus must remain close to its bearer.

rules.statement: An item may trigger an effect on a specific event rather than by choice: one neck item heals its wearer for 2d8+3 when the wearer falls below 0 hit points, then crumbles. Its greater version heals 5d8+7 and also crumbles.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Aegis of Recovery (pf1-wondrous-items#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-use emergency trigger; a world can make it reusable, at the cost of weakening the rescue or requiring recharging.

rules.statement: Some item powers have limited daily uses, while others impose a fixed recovery or exhaustion period after extended use. An amulet that prevents sleep stops working for one day after seven nights of use and exhausts its wearer during that day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet, Everwake (pf1-wondrous-items#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a use limit followed by enforced downtime; a world can change the limit, with longer use causing a harsher recovery cost.

rules.statement: An item can transform a user’s abilities while it is worn, and consuming or breaking it can make the change permanent. Drinking the blood from an ampoule destroys it, sickens the drinker for 1d4 hours, and permanently changes a sorcerer’s bloodline.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Ampoule of False Blood (pf1-wondrous-items#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary borrowed powers while the item is worn; a world can permit permanent transfer, but requires consuming and losing the item.

rules.statement: A magical object can sustain created undead only within explicit capacity and range limits. The blackmarrow altar supports at most 20 Hit Dice, creates no more than 20 Hit Dice per week, and undead separated from it by over 100 feet must return within 4 hours or are destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Altar, Blackmarrow (pf1-wondrous-items#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed capacity, production ceiling, and tethered upkeep; a world can extend the tether, but must provide another source of sustaining energy.

rules.statement: A magic item can enhance creatures summoned through it but make their obedience uncertain: there is a 25% chance they turn on their summoner. The summoner then cannot dismiss them early, though they still leave when the spell expires.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Altar, Dark Lens (pf1-wondrous-items#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a chance of loss of control in exchange for enhanced summons; a world can eliminate the risk, but should reduce the mutation benefit or impose another cost.

rules.statement: A bounded area can impose a continuing effect on anyone meeting its trigger, regardless of who caused the trigger. Within 40 feet of the crimson altar, piercing or slashing damage causes 1d4 bleed damage, which does not stack with itself or existing bleed damage from the attack.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Altar, Crimson (pf1-wondrous-items#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an area effect with a fixed radius and nonstacking damage; a world can widen the area, at the cost of increasing the risk to allies and bystanders.

rules.statement: A stored healing substance can be produced only up to a daily limit and spoils quickly once removed from its source. The crimson altar produces at most 3 full cups per day, each requiring 30 points of nearby bleed damage, and the nectar loses potency one round after removal.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Altar, Crimson (pf1-wondrous-items#013)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a resource generated by nearby harm with a short use window; a world can lengthen its shelf life, but should reduce production or require preservation.

rules.statement: The Abyss amulet grants a worshiper a faith-checking function and lets its wearer use each of the associated demon lord’s three first-boon spell-like abilities once daily. A lawful or good wearer suffers 2 negative levels for as long as it is worn; they cannot be suppressed while worn and never cause actual level loss.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet of the Abyss (pf1-wondrous-items#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to item-granted daily abilities with a persistent alignment-based penalty; a setting can change which alignments trigger it, with the cost being lost levels of capability while wearing it.

rules.statement: Bloodline and spirit amulets grant abilities tied to a particular lineage or spirit, but also make the wearer vulnerable to effects aimed at that lineage or bond. If the wearer already has the matching bloodline, mystery, or spirit, the amulet instead raises the effective level of those powers by 2; this increase does not stack with similar increases.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet of the Blooded; Amulet of the Spirits (pf1-wondrous-items#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to borrowing a source’s benefits while inheriting its targeted vulnerabilities; a world can vary which source grants the powers, and matching the source converts the benefit into +2 effective levels.

rules.statement: The amulet of the planes transports its wearer and companions to another plane, but a DC 15 Intelligence check is needed to select the destination plane and location. On failure, the travelers go to a random location on that plane on 01–60 on d%, or to a random plane on 61–100.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet of the Planes (pf1-wondrous-items#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to planar travel with destination control gated by a check; a world can tune the accuracy threshold, with failure risking an unintended location or plane.

rules.statement: The anointed holy symbol must be filled with a dose of holy water on its deity’s home plane, using a full-round action, to charge it. For 3 days, each channeling use may apply either the standard effect or one portfolio-based variant chosen at that use; after 3 days the holy water is consumed, and only one variant may apply at once.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Anointed Holy Symbol (pf1-wondrous-items#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a consumable charge that enables one selected mode per use; a world can alter the charging location or duration, with holy water consumed when the 3-day charge expires.

rules.statement: The amulet of the storm provides cold and electricity resistance 5, increased to 10 for a worshiper of its associated deity, and automatically identifies nearby spells with air, electricity, or water descriptors. Once daily as an immediate action, it can counter one such spell as dispel magic; success redirects lightning damage to its caster for 1d6 per spell level, with a DC 18 Reflex save for half.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Amulet of the Storm (pf1-wondrous-items#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sensing a defined category of spell and permitting one reactive counter per day; a world can change the favored descriptors or deity link, while the counter is limited by its daily use and save.

rules.statement: An arcane battery attached to a staff raises its maximum capacity from 10 to 11 charges and permits its wielder to add up to 2 charges daily by expending two qualifying prepared spells or slots. It must remain attached for 24 hours to attune, only one may be attached, and removing it requires another 24 hours of attachment before it works again.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Arcane Battery (pf1-wondrous-items#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a staff-specific capacity increase and spell-funded recharge; a world can vary the cap or recharge rate, with the resource cost paid in prepared magic and 24-hour attunement.

rules.statement: The Apparatus of the Crab and Apparatus of the Octopus are controlled from inside by levers; each lever action takes a full-round action and each lever can be used no more than once per round. Two occupants can operate different levers in one round; the crab survives to 900 feet underwater with air for 1d4+1 hours for two, while the octopus reaches 5,000 feet and holds air for 2d4+2 hours for two.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Apparatus of the Crab; Apparatus of the Octopus (pf1-wondrous-items#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a crew-operated vehicle whose action rate is limited by lever use; a world can tune depth and air endurance, with operation requiring occupants and consuming finite stored air.

rules.statement: The apparatus of the Octopus’s tentacles can manipulate objects about as well as hands but cannot perform fine-motor tasks or attack; the vehicle can carry no more than 600 pounds including occupants and grasped objects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Apparatus of the Octopus (pf1-wondrous-items#014)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to broad object handling with explicit task and payload limits; a world can broaden manipulation, while exceeding the 600-pound capacity or requiring precision remains disallowed.

rules.statement: A bag of holding opens into an extradimensional interior with capacity determined by its type: types I–IV hold 250, 500, 1,000, or 1,500 pounds and 30, 70, 150, or 250 cubic feet, while the bag itself weighs 15, 25, 35, or 60 pounds. Overloading or piercing it destroys the bag and its contents; a living creature inside suffocates after 10 minutes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag of Holding — DESCRIPTION/EFFECT (pf1-wondrous-items#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to type-based capacity and destructive overload; worlds can alter the limits, with lost contents as the cost of exceeding them.

rules.statement: A bag of concealment has the capacity of a matching bag of holding, but only its keyed owner can access its contents. If the owner dies, the next creature to open it becomes keyed; another creature placing an item inside blocks access to the stored contents until that item is removed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag of Concealment — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single keyed user and hidden contents; a world can change how ownership transfers, with access controlled by the keying rule.

rules.statement: A black soul shard attunes after being carried against a creature for 1 continuous week, and loses attunement if separated from it for at least 1 day. It can absorb one negative level from its attuned bearer, destroying its stored soul fragment and requiring another week of attunement before reuse; as a resurrection focus used within 24 hours of death, it reduces the normal negative-level cost by 1, to a minimum of 1.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Black Soul Shard — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one negative level absorbed per attunement; a world can change the cost or recovery interval, with the shard’s soul fragment consumed.

rules.statement: A prayer-bead strand’s special beads each work once per day, except its summons bead, which works once and then becomes nonmagical. Removing a special bead from the strand removes its power; the summons can aid its user for 1 day, and frivolously calling a deity’s emissary can bring confiscation of the user’s items and a geas.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Beads, Prayer (Strand) — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limited daily uses and a one-use summons bead; a world can change the frequency or divine response, with punishment for frivolous requests.

rules.statement: A golem manual supplies its listed construction magic and grants the Craft Construct feat for making the matching golem, a +5 bonus on the relevant crafting check, and a specified caster-level increase. The maker must still provide the body and normal construction time, but not the remaining ordinary construction cost; when construction is finished, the manual burns and its ashes animate the golem.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Book, Golem Manual — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one manual consumed per finished construct while body materials and construction time remain necessary; a world can alter those requirements, with the manual lost on completion.

rules.statement: The astrologer’s telescope can store the result of a successful DC 20 Knowledge (geography) check made during 1 hour of stargazing, then substitute it for one later check in a selected Knowledge skill within 24 hours. Each extra 24 hours of storage imposes a cumulative –5 penalty on the viewing check; a new viewing replaces the old result even if it fails, and a user can benefit from only one stored result at a time.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Astrologer’s Telescope — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one stored check result lasting 24 hours; a world can extend the duration, with a cumulative penalty for holding the insight longer.

rules.statement: An autonomous cartographer draws what its user can see onto a scroll sized to fit its 1-by-4-foot space. A second command erases the drawing for reuse; inserting or removing a scroll takes a full-round action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Autonomous Cartographer — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a map limited to visible surroundings on a reusable scroll; a world can expand what is recorded, at the cost of needing a suitable surface.

rules.statement: An apparatus of the crab holds two Small or Medium occupants and operates underwater to 900 feet deep, with air for two occupants lasting 1d4+1 hours or twice as long for one. Each lever takes a full-round action and can be used only once per round, though two occupants can operate separate levers in the same round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Apparatus of the Crab — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one lever operation per occupant per round and a finite air supply; a world can change operating limits, with crew capacity and air imposing constraints.

rules.statement: An azata’s whimsy lets its wearer choose to enter confusion for up to 7 rounds per day, which need not be consecutive. While confused, babbling instead inspires allies as a 7th-level bard’s performance, self-inflicted damage is nonlethal, and attacks against enemies gain +1 while attacks against allies take –4.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Azata’s Whimsy — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#015)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to up to 7 selectable rounds of confusion and altered outcomes; a world can change the daily allowance, with confusion remaining the price of the benefits.

rules.statement: Reading an empowered attribute book takes 48 hours spread over at least 6 days; the reader gains an inherent +1 to +5 bonus to the named ability score, and the book’s magic is consumed. The Loremaster’s book instead grants a bard consulting it up to three times daily a +5 competence bonus on a Knowledge check when using lore master and taking 10 or 20.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Book, Manual of Bodily Health; Book of the Loremaster (pf1-wondrous-items#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Make each book a single-use, reader-bound improvement; worlds can vary the bonus, with the cost being the consumed book and time spent studying.

rules.statement: An efreeti bottle opens once per day and produces one of three outcomes: a 10% chance of immediate attack, a 10% chance of granting three wishes, or an 80% chance of service for up to 10 minutes that day or until the efreeti dies. After the attack or wishes outcome, the efreeti vanishes permanently and the bottle loses its magic.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bottle, Efreeti (pf1-wondrous-items#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the stated daily random outcome; a world can alter the odds, while the rare wish outcome consumes the bottle and ends the relationship.

rules.statement: An opened eversmoking bottle fills a 50-foot spread in 1 round, then expands by 10 feet per round to a 100-foot radius if left open; stoppering it ends further production and the smoke disperses normally. Moderate wind clears it in 4 rounds and strong wind in 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bottle, Eversmoking (pf1-wondrous-items#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Treat the smoke as an expanding obscuring field; the world can change its growth or wind sensitivity, with sealing or wind providing counterplay.

rules.statement: A chaos emerald starts with 1d6+2 charges, holds at most 10, and regains 1d3−1 charges daily; its listed powers cost one charge each except chaos hammer, which costs two. A non-chaotic bearer suffers one negative level while holding or carrying it, which cannot be removed until the gem is dropped.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Chaos Emerald (pf1-wondrous-items#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use a capped, slowly replenishing charge pool and an alignment-linked penalty; a world can adjust recovery or penalty, with access to the gem carrying a personal cost.

rules.statement: A crystal ball can scry across almost any distance or into another plane, with Will DC 16 negating; each additional use in a day lowers the resistance DC by 1. Some versions add listed vision or communication abilities, and its telepathy version can attempt to implant a suggestion once per day (Will DC 14 negates).
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Crystal Ball (pf1-wondrous-items#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Allow remote viewing with resistance that weakens through repeated use; a world can set access and added functions, while frequent viewing makes targets less able to resist.

rules.statement: A stone guardian’s associated book lists spells and lets its reader count as 3 caster levels higher when crafting a stone golem guardian. More generally, the listed material golem books grant a crafting-level increase of 1 to 4 levels, as specified for each material.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Golem books; Stone Guardian (pf1-wondrous-items#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Let the book improve crafting capability for its matching construct; worlds can alter the bonus, with access to the specific text as the limiting cost.

rules.statement: A summoned elemental bowl, brazier, or censer cannot summon another elemental while its current one remains, until it is dismissed, killed, or its summoning ends. The required contents and, for some vessels, their type or quality determine the elemental’s size and strength; summoning consumes or empties those contents.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bowl of Conjuring Water Elementals; Brazier of Conjuring Fire Elementals; Censer of Conjuring Air Elementals (pf1-wondrous-items#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Permit one active elemental per vessel and make its fuel determine its potency; a world can vary capacity or fuel, with contents consumed and the active summon occupying the slot.

rules.statement: Boundary chalk creates a force wall along a drawn line, extending 10 feet out from the surface; each 5 feet of line takes a standard action and the wall lasts 10 minutes. One stick makes 100 feet of wall in 5-foot increments, and its bearer can dismiss a section by touching it as a swift action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Boundary Chalk (pf1-wondrous-items#016)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use a finite supply to draw short-lived force barriers; a world can change length or duration, with each segment consuming chalk and time.

rules.statement: A charge-using device can spend a specified number of charges to maintain or produce an effect; some devices restore spent charges daily, while others become unusable when depleted. The cube of force starts with 36 charges and renews them daily, whereas the gem of brightness starts with 50 and becomes nonmagical when empty.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cube of Force; Gem of Brightness (pf1-wondrous-items#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a finite, item-held reserve; worlds can adjust its size or renewal rate, with depletion limiting repeated use.

rules.statement: The cube of force creates a 10-foot-per-side barrier around its possessor, with a selected face determining what it excludes. Maintaining the barrier costs 1–6 charges per minute depending on the selected effect, limits movement to 10–30 feet, and attacks exceeding 30 damage drain further charges; certain spells also drain charges.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cube of Force (pf1-wondrous-items#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a mobile barrier with graduated protections; turn its charge drain or speed restriction to change how costly safety is.

rules.statement: The cube of frost resistance creates a 10-foot-per-side zone that keeps its temperature at least 65°F and absorbs cold attacks. More than 50 cold damage in one round collapses it for an hour, while more than 100 damage over 10 rounds destroys the device.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cube of Frost Resistance (pf1-wondrous-items#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a protective field with a damage threshold; raise or lower the thresholds to set how readily protection fails or is destroyed.

rules.statement: A cubic gate opens a route to a random point on the plane assigned to the pressed face; a second press closes it, and only one gate can be open at a time. Pressing twice rapidly transports the user and adjacent creatures to a random point there, though other creatures can resist with a DC 23 Will save; an outsider may emerge each minute with a 10% chance.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cubic Gate (pf1-wondrous-items#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one open route at a time and uncertain arrivals; change the destination certainty or visitor chance to tune the risk of passage.

rules.statement: A drum can grant nearby allies increased running speed while its bearer plays; the effect ends when playing stops. It can be used for up to one hour each day in blocks of at least 10 minutes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Drum of Advance and Retreat (pf1-wondrous-items#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an effect sustained by ongoing performance; alter the daily limit or required activity to set the user's upkeep burden.

rules.statement: Fortune-telling may be a deceptive performance rather than supernatural knowledge: use a Bluff check for the effectiveness of a con, and do not test whether the audience detects it unless they question the seer’s legitimacy.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mundane and Magical Fortune-Telling (pf1-wondrous-items#017)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to uncertain, potentially false predictions; a world can make readings genuinely prophetic or leave them dependent on performance and belief.

rules.statement: An effect may grant an ally a user’s full favored-enemy bonus against one target within 30 feet if the ally can see and hear the user; it lasts 1 minute and can be used once per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horn of the Hunt (opening passage) (pf1-wondrous-items#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: a visible, audible ally gains the bonus briefly; a world can change the range or duration, with limited daily uses as the cost.

rules.statement: A horn used once per day (three times by a triton) can choose one of three functions: calm rough waters within 1 mile, dismiss a targeted water elemental, summon sharks, or frighten qualifying aquatic creatures within 500 feet. Any triton within 3 miles can hear a sounding.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horn of the Tritons (pf1-wondrous-items#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: each daily activation selects one function; a world can alter its range or uses, while the strong effects are limited by that daily choice.

rules.statement: A command-word horn summons humanlike construct barbarians once every 7 days; their number and level depend on its type. They fight as directed for up to 1 hour, but attack the user if the user lacks the required qualification.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horn of Valhalla (pf1-wondrous-items#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: summoned constructs obey combat orders for at most an hour; a world can vary the type or frequency, while qualification failures turn the summons hostile.

rules.statement: For up to 5 rounds total, a target within 30 feet gains freedom of movement and has specified conditions suspended, not removed; suspended conditions resume when the effect ends, and their duration does not run while suspended. The user can end the effect as a swift action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Hourglass of Last Chances (pf1-wondrous-items#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: suspended conditions return when protection ends; a world can change the list or total rounds, with the finite five-round reserve as the cost.

rules.statement: A doorknocker placed against a wall, floor, or ceiling once per day fuses to it and creates a usable passage through up to 1 foot of material. Speaking its command again ends the passage and releases the item, restoring the surface.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Insistent Doorknocker (pf1-wondrous-items#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: one daily use makes and then closes a shallow passage; a world can alter depth or frequency, with the item fixed to the surface while active.

rules.statement: An hourglass can be activated for as many as 5 rounds total, which need not be consecutive; its effect ends with a swift action, and its magic is consumed when those rounds are spent.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Hourglass of Last Chances (pf1-wondrous-items#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: track a finite pool of active rounds; a world can change the pool, with depletion consuming the item’s magic.

rules.statement: The Iron Flask can hold only one creature from another plane at a time. Capturing one requires it to fail a DC 19 Will save within 60 feet; a second attempt against that same creature gives it a +2 save bonus and makes it hostile. Releasing it with the command word compels service for 1 hour.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Iron Flask (pf1-wondrous-items#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the flask holds one extraplanar creature, and commanded release buys an hour of service; a world can change capacity or terms, with resistance improving after a repeat attempt.

rules.statement: The lyre can protect inanimate construction within 300 feet from attacks for 30 minutes once per day. Once per week it can also build structures in 30 minutes at a rate equal to 100 people working for 3 days, but the player must pass a DC 18 performance check for each hour after the first or stop.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lyre of Building (pf1-wondrous-items#018)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the lyre blocks construction damage or accelerates building; a world can adjust range, output, or frequency, with continued construction requiring successful performance.

rules.statement: The life-trapping mirror can hold 15 living creatures. A creature within 30 feet that sees its reflection must make a DC 23 Will save or be taken bodily inside, leaving its equipment behind; constructs, undead, and nonliving matter are excluded. A creature aware of the danger and trying not to look has only a 50% chance of seeing its reflection, while an unaware creature always sees it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mirror of Life Trapping (opening description) (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 15-cell reflection-triggered prison with a DC 23 resistance check; a world can change its capacity or detection odds, with escape limited to specific commands or destruction.

rules.statement: When all 15 cells are occupied, trapping a new victim randomly releases one existing prisoner. Destroying the mirror (hardness 1, 5 hit points) releases everyone inside. The owner can call one prisoner's reflection to the surface to talk, and a separate command word frees that prisoner.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mirror of Life Trapping (opening description) (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to forced release on overcapacity and mass release on destruction; a world can make stored captives harder to recover, at the cost of risking accidental escape.

rules.statement: A mental-prowess mirror can read the thoughts of a reflected creature when its controller is within 25 feet, including thoughts in an unknown language. It can also view familiar locations, including on other planes, and once each week answer one short question about a creature pictured on its surface.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mirror of Mental Prowess (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to nearby reflected minds and a weekly creature-specific answer; a world can widen the target or frequency, making knowledge and planar familiarity the limiting costs.

rules.statement: A mental-prowess mirror can serve as a passage to a place first viewed through its remote-viewing function. The passage remains at both ends until the user returns, speaks a closing command, or 24 hours pass; if time expires while the user is away, the user is stranded there.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mirror of Mental Prowess (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a two-way route lasting at most 24 hours; a world can shorten or lengthen that window, with the danger of being stranded when it closes.

rules.statement: The opposition mirror creates an exact, immediately hostile duplicate when a creature sees its reflection. The copy has the original's possessions and powers, and both it and its possessions disappear when either copy or original is defeated; the mirror works at most four times per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mirror of Opposition (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary hostile duplicate with matching capabilities and a four-use daily limit; a world can alter fidelity or use count, risking an opponent with the target's own strengths.

rules.statement: A naga-scale bindi transforms its wearer for 11 minutes, or until the wearer uses a standard action to revert, and can be used twice before becoming nonmagical. It grants scaly features, +4 natural armor, 60-foot darkvision, and a poisonous bite; the chosen naga type also determines a distinct extra ability and poison.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Naga-Scale Bindi (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a type-specific transformation with two uses and an 11-minute duration; a world can vary the granted traits, with finite activations and a forced reversion boundary.

rules.statement: The needles can turn an object into a tattoo on a willing creature once per day, taking 10 minutes; the object may resist with a DC 17 Fortitude save. The bearer can peel the tattoo off with a standard action, and it also reverts after 7 days, dispelling, or the bearer's death.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Needles of Fleshgraving (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one object-sized tattoo transformation per day, removable by its bearer and ending within 7 days; a world can change storage limits, with the object unavailable in its normal form meanwhile.

rules.statement: A good creature carrying the Orb of Foul Abaddon suffers one negative level for as long as it carries the orb, and that penalty cannot be removed while the creature still has it. The Orb of Golden Heaven and Orb of Pure Law similarly impose an unremovable carrying penalty on, respectively, evil and chaotic creatures; the Orb of Utter Chaos imposes it on lawful creatures.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Orb of Foul Abaddon; Orb of Golden Heaven; Orb of Pure Law; Orb of Utter Chaos (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an alignment-triggered negative level that ends immediately when the item is put down; a world can broaden eligible bearers, making possession itself the cost.

rules.statement: Ring gates function only when paired on the same plane and within 100 miles of each other, and transfer at most 100 pounds of material per day. Anything put through one emerges from the other; creatures pass only if Tiny or smaller, or Small and successful on a DC 13 Escape Artist check.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Ring Gates (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to paired same-plane gates with a 100-mile range and 100-pound daily throughput; a world can turn distance or throughput, while size and escape skill limit passage.

rules.statement: The stone of alliance lets a master monitor a bonded companion's distance, direction, and general condition. Once per day, within 30 feet, the master can take the full effect of one successful attack meant for the companion or transfer certain conditions to himself; the stone is destroyed if either dies or the bond ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Stone of Alliance (pf1-wondrous-items#019)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one bonded companion, ongoing status awareness, and a daily condition transfer or attack interception; a world can change the range or frequency, with the master taking the companion's harm.

rules.statement: A summoned creature shackled by the silver focus cannot move more than 30 feet from its caster, including by teleportation; the caster can exceed that distance, immediately ending the restraint. The focus extends a summoning spell of 3rd level or lower as Extend Spell would, without increasing casting time, and can be used five times per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Silver shackle description (opening passage) (pf1-wondrous-items#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 30-foot tether and five uses daily; a world could change the distance or uses, with longer range and more frequent use making summons easier to control.

rules.statement: A seal can maintain effects on at most three items; activating it on a fourth removes the oldest effect. Its bearer can suspend effects made by that seal for 1 minute, at will.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Treasurer’s Seal (pf1-wondrous-items#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three concurrent targets and a 1-minute suspension; a world could raise or lower the capacity, with greater capacity increasing the reach of its security magic.

rules.statement: A planted pennant creates a 30-foot zone in which teleporting into or out of the area causes nausea for 1 round, reduced to sickened by a successful DC 18 Fortitude save. It functions for 10 rounds per day, which need not be consecutive, and uprooting it ends the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Void Pennant (pf1-wondrous-items#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 30-foot radius and 10 rounds daily; a world could expand the zone or duration, at the cost of making travel through the area more hazardous.

rules.statement: The fluids in Waters of Transfiguration permanently turn touched solid objects into glass, iron, paper, stone, or wood. Objects of 1 cubic foot or less change instantly; larger ones change at 1 hour per cubic foot, up to 10 cubic feet, and magical or attended objects can resist with a successful DC 17 Fortitude save.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Waters of Transfiguration (pf1-wondrous-items#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to permanent material conversion with the stated size and save limits; a world could allow larger or faster conversions, at the cost of making durable materials and magic less secure.

rules.statement: The Well of Many Worlds sends anything put inside to a randomly selected other world, planet, or plane. Moving the well opens it to a new random destination, and passage works in both directions.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Well of Many Worlds (pf1-wondrous-items#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to random destinations and two-way passage; a world could make destinations selectable, at the cost of making interworld travel far more reliable.

rules.statement: A banner planted in the ground creates an 8-hour, 20-foot-radius refuge that provides protection from environmental extremes and sounds an alarm when its ward is triggered. Its refuge can resist magical weather only when that weather’s caster level is lower than the banner’s.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Banner of Restful Nights (pf1-wondrous-items#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an 8-hour, 20-foot refuge and a caster-level limit; a world could expand the duration or let it resist stronger weather, at the cost of weakening hazards as obstacles.

rules.statement: Void dust affects one force effect per pinch: at a range of up to 10 feet, it dispels that effect, or disintegrates it if it cannot be dispelled. A found container holds three pinches.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Void Dust (pf1-wondrous-items#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one targeted force effect per pinch and three pinches per container; a world could let a pinch affect more than one effect, making force defenses less dependable.

rules.statement: A Bag of Tricks produces a random animal that serves for 10 minutes, until slain, or until ordered back into the bag; only one animal may exist at once. Up to 10 can be drawn weekly, with no more than two drawn per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bag of Tricks (pf1-wondrous-items#020)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to random animals, one present at a time, and the stated weekly and daily limits; a world could permit more or longer-lived companions, at the cost of greater access to creature allies.

rules.statement: A worn or carried banner can grant bonuses to its bearer and allies in a stated radius, but some effects require a particular grip, mount, or bearer; for example, the Ancient Kings banner requires a two-handed firm hold and affects allies within 30 feet.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Banner of the Ancient Kings (pf1-wondrous-items#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to granting the listed bonuses only while the banner is properly held; a world can change the radius or required grip to suit its battle customs.

rules.statement: Some banners grant allies feats while nearby; the Rushing Horde banner affects allies within 60 feet, but if planted it stops working when toppled or touched by an enemy until friendly hands reclaim and replant it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Banner of the Rushing Horde (pf1-wondrous-items#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 60-foot ally-only benefit that is interrupted by enemy interference; a world can adjust its range or vulnerability to make standards more or less decisive.

rules.statement: A one-use bead can explode on impact for 5d6 force damage in a 10-foot radius and enclose a suitably small creature for 10 minutes; the enclosure blocks passage and most damage, and the bead is consumed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bead of Force (pf1-wondrous-items#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the stated blast and 10-minute containment, with destruction of the bead as the cost; a world can alter what breaks the enclosure.

rules.statement: The bead that prevents hostile polymorph is destroyed when its bearer fails the saving throw, negating that effect; the bone-bead bracelet can control up to 8 HD of mindless undead, and taking control over the limit releases previously controlled excess creatures.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bead of Newt Prevention; Beads, Bone (pf1-wondrous-items#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to single-use protection and an 8-HD control ceiling; a world can raise or lower the ceiling, with excess control displacing older commands.

rules.statement: The prayer strand’s special beads each work once per day, except its summoning bead, which works once and becomes nonmagical; removing a special bead from the strand also removes its power.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Beads, Prayer (Strand) (pf1-wondrous-items#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to daily-use powers attached to the intact strand and a one-shot summon; a world can change recharge frequency or make bead removal preserve power.

rules.statement: A bead that becomes a campfire burns for up to 8 hours, then returns to bead form; it cannot be activated again until a wait twice as long as its actual burn time has passed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bead, Campfire (pf1-wondrous-items#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an 8-hour maximum and twice-the-burn-time recovery; a world can lengthen or shorten the cooldown to regulate portable fire.

rules.statement: A marked companion can receive its master’s personal- or touch-range spells from up to 30 feet away if the master has line of effect; each spell consumes charges equal to its level, from a brand holding 10 charges, and a master can mark only one creature at a time.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Beast-Bond Brand (pf1-wondrous-items#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one companion and 10 spell-level charges; a world can change capacity or marking duration, with new marks replacing old ones.

rules.statement: The Returning Spirits bell can summon a living familiar from within 100 feet once per day; if used to raise a dead familiar, it restores that familiar but becomes inert clay, while recovery of lost levels and Constitution takes one per day each.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bell of Returning Spirits (pf1-wondrous-items#021)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 100-foot call and one-use revival that consumes the bell; a world can alter the range or recovery rate, with the bell’s destruction limiting repeated returns.

rules.statement: The lesser belt of mighty hurling grants +2 Strength; for thrown weapons, the wearer can use Strength instead of Dexterity on attack rolls and gains 10 feet of range increment. The Strength increase counts as temporary for the first 24 hours worn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt of Mighty Hurling (pf1-wondrous-items#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a worn item with a fixed bonus; a world can change the bonus or duration, reflecting how long its magic takes to settle into the wearer.

rules.statement: The greater version grants +4 Strength and makes eligible thrown weapons return after being thrown. This returning effect excludes improvised weapons, splash weapons, and weapons the wearer is not proficient with; its Strength increase is temporary for the first 24 hours worn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt of Mighty Hurling, Greater (pf1-wondrous-items#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to returning proficient thrown weapons; a world can broaden or narrow eligibility, reflecting the item’s capacity to guide only suitable weapons.

rules.statement: The belt of spirit vines connects its wearer to a willing creature within 30 feet. When the wearer casts a druid, ranger, shaman, or witch touch spell on herself, the connected creature also receives its benefit for half the spell’s duration, rounded down; instantaneous and permanent spells are excluded, and the effect ends if the vine’s range is exceeded.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt of Spirit Vines (pf1-wondrous-items#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a willing target within 30 feet; a world can change the distance or spell traditions, reflecting the vine’s limited reach and magical affinity.

rules.statement: The belt of stoneskin grants damage reduction 10 against all attacks except those made with adamantine, until it has absorbed 100 damage in a 24-hour period. After removal, or when first put on, it requires 24 consecutive hours of wear before functioning again.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt of Stoneskin (pf1-wondrous-items#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 100-damage daily reserve with a full-day reattunement; a world can raise or lower either threshold, reflecting the belt’s protective capacity.

rules.statement: The security belt can shrink one touched object of up to 10 cubic feet once per day; the wearer can restore it from a belt pocket with a move action. The belt and pocketed objects also appear nonmagical to detection.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Security (pf1-wondrous-items#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one stored object per daily activation; a world can alter the volume or recharge, reflecting the belt’s storage enchantment.

rules.statement: The serpent belt can become a venomous or constrictor snake once per day, obeying spoken commands for up to 1 hour. It returns to belt form if slain or more than 100 feet from its animator; the greater version can additionally give it one of several specified simple templates.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Serpent; Serpent Belt, Greater (pf1-wondrous-items#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a commanded snake limited to an hour and 100 feet; a world can change its range or duration, reflecting the tether between tool and animator.

rules.statement: The shadowform belt lets its wearer become incorporeal for up to 10 rounds per day, divided as desired. While incorporeal, the wearer’s natural armor becomes a deflection bonus, and the wearer does not receive the usual Charisma-based deflection bonus.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Shadowform (pf1-wondrous-items#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to ten spendable rounds daily; a world can increase or reduce that pool, reflecting the strain of sustaining an incorporeal body.

rules.statement: The bivouac ward requires three banners planted no more than 40 feet apart. It lasts up to 8 hours, then cannot be reactivated for 12 hours; creatures already inside when the third banner is planted can cross freely, while later entrants trigger barking and a summoned dog that attacks the nearest intruder.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bivouac Banners (pf1-wondrous-items#022)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a three-point ward with an 8-hour active period and 12-hour downtime; a world can alter spacing or schedule, reflecting the formation’s setup and recovery.

rules.statement: Each Founder bone grants 1 temporary hit point; multiple such grants stack with one another but not with temporary hit points from other sources, and they return at dawn. A bearer senses other Founder bones within 50 feet; acquiring a bone calls for a Will save at DC 10 plus the number already possessed, and failure causes a nonbinding dream encouraging collection.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bones of the Founder (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to daily renewable, source-limited hit points and short-range sensing; a world can change the range or save difficulty because the bones’ collecting impulse reflects the Founder’s influence.

rules.statement: If all 32 Founder bones are gathered together, they immediately crumble and release the Founder’s soul, ending the bones’ powers.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bones of the Founder (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to destruction and soul release when the complete set is assembled; a world can change the required count or release outcome to alter the cost of reunification.

rules.statement: A golem manual supplies the construction knowledge, prerequisite spells, a +5 bonus on crafting checks, and a caster-level increase specific to its golem type. The maker still provides the golem’s body and spends the normal construction time, but avoids the rest of the ordinary cost; once construction finishes, the manual is consumed and its ashes animate the golem.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Book, Golem Manual — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-use construction aid that substitutes for much of the cost but not body or time; a world can change the bonus, subsidy, or consumption because the manual embodies stored craft magic.

rules.statement: Reading a standard inherent-bonus tome for 48 hours spread across at least 6 days grants its reader an inherent +1 to +5 bonus to the listed ability score, then consumes the tome’s magic.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Book, Manual of Bodily Health; Book, Manual of Gainful Exercise; Book, Manual of Quickness of Action; Book, Tome of Clear Thought; Book, Tome of Leadership and Influence; Book, Tome of Understanding (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-reader permanent bonus purchased through six or more days of study; a world can alter the score, bonus, or study time because the book’s magic is expended in teaching.

rules.statement: The Dream Journal causes fatigue the day after an hour of reading; after 24 total hours, it gives one prophetic dream of the reader’s death. When that reader is about to die, they may reroll a failed save from the prior round or force a reroll of the killing attack, must accept the second result, and receive no further aid after that chance.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Book, Dream Journal of the Pallid Seer (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one costly death-warning and one last-chance reroll; a world can change the reading threshold or reroll target because the journal’s prediction is an exhausted, one-use intervention.

rules.statement: A Book of Whispers can send a message of up to 25 words, a drawing, or a map from a source page to its linked secret letter when the owner writes the activation word. The pages disguise their contents, the recipient can reveal or restore the disguise, and the book has 25 nonreusable pages; tearing out a source page destroys its linked letter.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Book of Whispers (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to secret, linked-page messages with a 25-use lifetime; a world can change the capacity or reveal method because each message consumes a page pair.

rules.statement: A Book of Extended Summoning applies Extend Spell to a summoned-monster spell without raising its slot, but only for a creature matching the book’s alignment. Lesser, standard, and greater versions work through spell levels 3, 6, and 9 respectively, and using one destroys it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Book of Extended Summoning (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one-use, alignment-matched duration extension within the stated level cap; a world can change its level ceiling or whether it is consumed because the book contains finite stored magic.

rules.statement: Once per day, the Book of Marvelous Recipes enhances a meal being cooked so that it has the effect of heroes’ feast at caster level 11. Its recipes also let an untrained reader cook or grant a trained cook +4 on Profession (cook) checks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Book of Marvelous Recipes (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one enhanced meal per day and a cooking-skill aid; a world can adjust the meal’s frequency or potency because the effect is tied to preparation.

rules.statement: A Bookplate of Recall lets its named individual summon the book bearing it by speaking that book’s title, once per day. Boots of Getaway can likewise return their wearer and carried possessions to a chosen attunement point once per day, but do not transport allies.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bookplate of Recall; Boots, Getaway (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limited, keyed return travel that excludes companions; a world can change daily frequency or what travels because the effect is bound to a named book or attuned location.

rules.statement: Boots of Bogstrider remove movement penalties in shallow and deep bog and keep shallow-bog Acrobatics DCs unchanged; three times daily, a charge or withdrawal can grant +60 feet of speed for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Boots, Bogstrider (pf1-wondrous-items#023)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to terrain-specific mobility and three short bursts of speed; a world can change terrain coverage or burst distance because the boots adapt to marsh travel.

rules.statement: A worn item can move its wearer to a point within 30 feet once per day when the wearer is grappled, pinned, or entangled; a gnome wearer can choose a point up to 400 feet away.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Boots of Escape (pf1-wondrous-items#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a once-daily escape with a short range; a world could increase range for gnomes, reflecting a lineage-linked item effect.

rules.statement: A wearer can designate one creature within 30 feet up to three times per day, gaining +2 AC against its attacks and +4 CMD against its maneuvers for up to 7 rounds. The effect ends if the wearer or target moves as specified, the target dies, or the wearer selects another target; selecting a replacement uses another daily use.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Boots of Flawless Resolve (pf1-wondrous-items#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one marked opponent and a 7-round limit; a world could loosen the movement break, at the cost of longer-lasting focus.

rules.statement: A wearer can activate one of two wards as a swift action: one adds 30 feet to all movement speeds, while the other permits standing without provoking and prevents an opportunity attack from the first square left. The wearer can dismiss the ward freely or switch wards as a swift action, for at most 10 rounds per day spent in 1-round increments.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Boots of Refuge (pf1-wondrous-items#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a shared pool of 10 rounds for two selectable modes; a world could grant each mode its own pool, increasing the item's daily output.

rules.statement: A wearer can gain a haste-like effect for up to 10 rounds per day, with the rounds usable separately; activation is a free action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Boots of Speed (pf1-wondrous-items#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to 10 nonconsecutive rounds; a world could require one continuous activation, making the resource easier to track but less flexible.

rules.statement: While standing on the ground, a wearer can activate roots that grant tremorsense to 30 feet only while she stays in the same space. While active, the roots also add +4 CMD against bull rush and trip attempts and +4 to checks to escape grapples or bonds.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Boots, Rootsense (pf1-wondrous-items#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sensing only while grounded and stationary; a world could permit movement, increasing the power's scope.

rules.statement: A wearer can create an ice-covered area within 30 feet once per day, lasting 10 rounds. Creatures moving through it travel at half speed with a successful DC 10 Acrobatics check; failure prevents movement that round, and failure by 5 or more causes a fall.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Boots, Rime-Stride (pf1-wondrous-items#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 30-foot area for 10 rounds with a movement check; a world could extend its duration, making the hazard persist longer.

rules.statement: A summoned efreeti has a daily 10% chance to attack and a separate 10% chance to grant three wishes; otherwise it serves for up to 10 minutes per day or until killed. In either exceptional outcome it vanishes permanently and the bottle becomes nonmagical; the result is rolled each day the bottle is opened.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bottle, Efreeti (pf1-wondrous-items#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily roll with a limited service period; a world could remove the risk of hostility, but make the bottle's service more costly or constrained.

rules.statement: Drawing a line creates a force wall extending 10 feet from the surface; each 5-foot segment takes a standard action and provokes opportunity attacks. Each segment lasts 10 minutes, can be dismissed by touching it with the chalk as a swift action, and the stick draws at most 100 feet in 5-foot increments.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Boundary Chalk (pf1-wondrous-items#024)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary wall with finite chalk supply; a world could increase wall duration, making the consumable material more valuable.

rules.statement: A handshake made to seal a deal lets the bracelet wearer sense whether deceit is involved, unless the other creature succeeds at a DC 16 Will save; the wearer learns nothing about the deception’s specific nature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet of Bargaining (pf1-wondrous-items#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to detecting deceit on a deal-sealing handshake; a world can change the save threshold or remove the limit on detail, with stronger detection carrying greater risk of exposure.

rules.statement: A bracelet starts with four charms, each assignable to a known person with a standard action; speaking that person’s name while grasping the charm calls them and their gear to the wearer, but only if both are on the same plane and the traveler is willing. Each use consumes the charm.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet of Friends (pf1-wondrous-items#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one willing, same-plane traveler per consumable charm; a world can allow unwilling or cross-plane travel, at the cost of greater power or danger.

rules.statement: Once per day, the wearer can negate a confirmed critical hit or sneak attack before damage is rolled; each negation destroys one of seven beads, and the bracelet crumbles when none remain.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet of Second Chances (pf1-wondrous-items#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to seven item-bound negations, each consuming a bead; a world can adjust the charges, with more uses requiring a scarcer or costlier item.

rules.statement: Once per day, the wearer can create a stone wall up to 2 inches thick and 45 feet long, or 1 inch thick and 90 feet long. While sustaining it, the wearer cannot move and is flat-footed; removing either bracelet or breaching the wall ends the effect and causes the wall to crumble.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelets of Stone (pf1-wondrous-items#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed-size wall that requires an adjacent connection point and immobilizes its creator; a world can loosen the support requirement, at the cost of stability.

rules.statement: The electro-temporal bracer’s nimbus lasts up to 3 minutes per day in 1-minute increments. While active, each electricity spell can dazzle all its targets, stagger one target, or haste one target for 1 round; taking at least 50 electricity damage from one source grants time stop, then disables the bracer for 1 month.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracer, Electro-Temporal (pf1-wondrous-items#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
