rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short daily enhancement and a one-month shutdown after a major electrical hit; a world can remove the shutdown, risking uncontrolled time effects.

rules.statement: The wearer can spend one or more daily smite uses to summon eligible good outsiders; the summon’s spell level equals the number of uses spent. A brazier can summon a Large fire elemental, or a Huge one if 1 pound of sulfur burns in it; it cannot summon another until the first departs, dies, or its duration ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracers of Celestial Intervention; Brazier of Conjuring Fire Elementals (pf1-wondrous-items#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to summoning constrained by expended power, fuel, and the existing summon; a world can permit multiple summons, with greater upkeep or control costs.

rules.statement: Once per day, a thrown briar bomb creates a 20-foot-radius field of thorny growth. Crossing it deals 1d4 piercing damage per 5 feet, and movement through it risks entanglement on a DC 20 Reflex save; the bomb is consumed when thrown.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Briar Bomb (pf1-wondrous-items#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a temporary obstacle that harms and can trap movers; a world can make the growth longer-lasting or more selective, with greater environmental consequences.

rules.statement: Once per day, a mount can become incorporeal during movement and must stop in an unoccupied space. Objects it passes through lose half their hit points, ignoring hardness, while living creatures in its path must pass a DC 20 Fortitude save or take a –4 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution for 1 minute.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bridle of Charon (pf1-wondrous-items#025)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-use incorporeal passage with a brief physical penalty; a world can increase the duration or severity, with greater harm to those encountered.

rules.statement: A charged copper-and-amber clasp absorbs up to 20 electricity damage from each hit, to a daily maximum of 50 points. Its stored charge can be released on command for 1d6 electricity damage per 5 points held, or it dissipates harmlessly after 10 minutes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Passage opening, before Brooch of Blending (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stored-charge item with a 50-point daily limit and a 10-minute decay; a world can adjust the capacity or decay time because accumulated electricity is finite and unstable.

rules.statement: The brooch’s physical appearance change lasts until it is activated again or removed; it grants +20 to Disguise checks for appearing to be the selected race, but does not fool people who already know the wearer. Its alteration is concealed from detect magic but exposed by true seeing.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Brooch of Blending (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent physical disguise with limited social effectiveness and specific detection counters; a world can make it more or less detectable because the change is genuinely physical but not a replacement identity.

rules.statement: A shielding brooch absorbs magic-missile damage until it has taken 101 points, then melts and becomes useless.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Brooch of Shielding (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-use item with a 101-point damage capacity; a world can change that threshold because the brooch is consumed by the accumulated force.

rules.statement: The racing broom can use increased speed for up to 9 minutes each day. Each minute of that speed consumes 1 hour of ordinary flight time; spending 5 hours instead grants a one-round burst at a still higher speed, with a 50% chance the broom becomes broken afterward.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Broom of Flying, Racing (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily flight reserve, an accelerated mode that drains it rapidly, and a risky one-round overdrive; a world can tune speed, load, or failure chance because the vehicle is spending and stressing its stored magic.

rules.statement: The ordinary flying broom can fly for up to 9 hours per day, split as its owner chooses, carrying up to 200 pounds at 40 feet per round or 400 pounds at 30 feet. It can travel alone to a destination the owner can describe adequately and return when called from as far as 300 yards.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Broom of Flying (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited daily flight reserve with load-dependent speed and a defined recall range; a world can alter those limits because flight capacity is constrained by the broom’s magic and payload.

rules.statement: A bubble vault holds up to 5 cubic feet of goods underwater. Three spoken commands within 30 feet bring it to the surface; opening it returns it to pearl form for 24 hours, and the container otherwise only keeps water out.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bubble Vault (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a small, watertight underwater cache with a 24-hour reset after opening; a world can change its capacity or retrieval trigger because the bubble is only a temporary storage vessel.

rules.statement: A burdenstone sticks to a target wearing metal armor for 2d6 rounds, raising its carrying burden one step and preventing flight. If the target was already heavily loaded, it falls prone, moves no faster than 10 feet, and cannot run; a DC 20 Strength check as a full-round action removes the stone early.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Burdenstone (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-target, short-duration load penalty with a strength-based escape; a world can change the duration or severity because attachment and physical burden constrain the victim.

rules.statement: A creature can wear the Meridian Belt to place rings on its feet as well as its hands, but only two rings function at once. The wearer can switch which two are active as a swift action; this does not change the action required to activate a ring.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Belt, Meridian (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to extra ring-wearing capacity but only two active effects at once; a world can change the number of active rings because attunement capacity remains limited.

rules.statement: The charm bracelet’s five specified magical charms are each single-use; after activation each disappears. Its remaining charms can produce weapons for 1 hour, healing and renewed saves against poison or disease, a brief charm effect, a one-round +2 luck bonus in a 20-foot burst, or a calming 20-foot burst; the final used charm leaves only an ordinary bracelet.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Bracelet, Charm (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bracelet with discrete consumable effects that vanish after use; a world can change its charm mix or strength because each effect is an expendable stored charge.

rules.statement: A cage can capture one subdued, non-summoned outsider per day after a minute of concentration and insertion of gems worth at least 100 gp per Hit Die. A captured outsider is reduced to 1 inch and cannot use supernatural or spell-like abilities; opening the cage requires a DC 22 Will save, and the captor can demand a service in exchange for release under the stated name-dependent compulsion.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cage of Captivity (pf1-wondrous-items#026)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to costly capture of a helpless present outsider, with magic suppression and a release bargain; a world can alter the gem cost, save difficulty, or bargain strength because imprisonment requires leverage and a price.

rules.statement: A worn cap takes over its wearer’s body when a daze or stun would occur: daze becomes confusion, while stun becomes confusion plus staggering. It can do this for at most 5 rounds per day; those rounds count toward the original effect, and control ends when that effect or the cap’s duration ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cap, Steel-Mind (pf1-wondrous-items#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to automatic intervention for up to 5 rounds daily; a setting can change the reserve or trigger, because the cap’s intervention spends time from a limited daily allowance.

rules.statement: A one-use cape creates a force sphere that gives 20% concealment against ranged attacks for up to 1 minute, ending earlier if it causes an attack to miss. Using it consumes the cape’s magic.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cape, Catching (pf1-wondrous-items#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-use defensive field; a setting can make the protection reusable or longer-lasting, at the cost of reducing the cape’s consumable nature.

rules.statement: A light-emitting cape can be triggered twice per day to blind creatures other than its wearer within 20 feet for 1d4 rounds (Reflex DC 14 negates); the wearer then becomes invisible for 1 minute, and the cape’s light is off during that invisibility.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cape of Effulgent Escape (pf1-wondrous-items#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a coupled escape effect with two daily uses; a setting can separate or alter its stages, since the burst’s light and the wearer’s concealment interact.

rules.statement: A time-bewitching candle produces deeper darkness by day and daylight by night, each in a 15-foot radius; its daylight counts as sunlight against vulnerable creatures. It burns for 10 minutes total, in 1-minute increments, and uses the sun position of its home world if taken somewhere without a sun.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Candle, Time-Bewitching (pf1-wondrous-items#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 15-foot light rule keyed to the home world’s sun, with a 10-minute fuel limit; a setting can change the celestial reference or duration because the effect consumes candle burn time.

rules.statement: A creature that fails to speak a command within 1 round of approaching a caravan guardian triggers an eagle attack and a mental warning to up to five designated allies. The guardian can summon only one eagle per day, and an obstructed summoning space prevents the eagle but not the warning.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Caravan Guardian Statuette (pf1-wondrous-items#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one daily summoned defender plus an alert for up to five chosen recipients; a setting can change the summon’s frequency or recipients, with limited daily use constraining defense.

rules.statement: A carcanet can try once per day to entangle and immobilize one Medium-or-smaller creature within 15 feet (Reflex DC 15 negates). The target can attempt a new save as a full-round action; otherwise the restraint lasts 10 minutes, and the wearer can end it as a swift action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Carcanet of Detention (pf1-wondrous-items#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one daily, resistible restraint with a 10-minute ceiling; a setting can change its range or escape options because the target gets a chance to break free.

rules.statement: A captain’s locker holds up to 2,500 pounds or 250 cubic feet without changing its own weight, and expands a vehicle cargo hold’s capacity by 50% while inside it. Removing it while the hold is over its ordinary capacity expels excess cargo, dealing 3d6 damage to anyone within 5 feet of an exit.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Captain’s Locker (pf1-wondrous-items#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to fixed storage limits and a 50% hold expansion; a setting can change the capacity or expulsion consequence, since removing the locker while overloaded creates a hazardous release.

rules.statement: A cathedral pit stone creates a 10-foot-wide, 20-foot-deep pit when thrown or dropped, lasting 6 rounds; affected bystanders can jump clear with a Reflex save (DC 13). The stone is consumed when used.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cathedral Pit Stone (pf1-wondrous-items#027)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-use pit with a 6-round duration; a setting can change its size or duration, with consumption limiting repeated terrain alteration.

rules.statement: A poison-removing vessel can be used once per day. If it removes a poison that normally exists as a solid or liquid, it gathers one dose in the vessel; that dose works normally except its save DC is 4 lower.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Passage opening (item heading not included) (pf1-wondrous-items#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one use each day and a recoverable dose with a 4-point lower DC; a setting could change the rate or potency because the poison is a costly resource.

rules.statement: A chaos emerald begins with 1d6+2 charges, can store at most 10, and regains 1d3−1 charges each day. A non-chaotic bearer or carrier gains a negative level that lasts until the gem is dropped and cannot be removed while carrying it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Chaos Emerald (pf1-wondrous-items#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a capped, randomly replenishing charge pool and an alignment-based carrying penalty; a world could vary the recharge or penalty to reflect the gem’s chaotic nature.

rules.statement: Once per day, a wearer can trigger a robe’s distracting display as a move action; creatures within 30 feet that can see it must pass a DC 13 Will save or be blinded for 1d4+1 rounds. The robe also makes its wearer’s spellcasting harder to identify, increasing the relevant check DC by 10.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Charlatan’s Cope (pf1-wondrous-items#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a visible 30-foot burst with a daily limit and short blindness; a world could change its reach or duration because the display is overt and magical.

rules.statement: A once-used charm can add 3 to a wearer’s saving throw against a curse. If the curse takes hold, for up to 1 week the wearer gains 2 on later saves against it and 3 on checks to remove it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Charm, Hexbiter (pf1-wondrous-items#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one activation and a week of follow-up aid; a world could increase the duration or number of uses at the cost of making charms rarer.

rules.statement: A command from an attuned pendant controls generic aluum within 100 feet as though they were under a person-dominating effect, though it cannot use their senses and they will not attack protected groups. If different controllers issue orders, they make opposed Will saves; only pactmasters can re-attune the pendant.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Charm of Aluum Control (pf1-wondrous-items#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to range-limited control with explicit protected targets and contested orders; a world could widen the range or permit broader commands by weakening the safeguards.

rules.statement: A locked defensive chest changes into a Medium wooden golem when its alarm is triggered, attacks the intruder unless given other instructions through its command word, then returns to chest form when the intruder is defeated. Its stored contents count toward the golem’s carrying limit but survive the change.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Chest, Chest of Defending (pf1-wondrous-items#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an alarm-triggered guardian that reverts after the threat is defeated; a world could extend its patrol or add upkeep, at the cost of greater risk to its contents.

rules.statement: A coffer can bury itself once per day, moving 10–30 feet downward through loose earth over 1 minute per 10 feet, and can later dig back up when called from nearby. Its interior holds up to 3,000 pounds or 500 cubic feet, but living creatures have only 20 minutes of air.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Chest, Corsair’s Coffer (pf1-wondrous-items#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to bounded extradimensional storage and a daily, slow burial; a world could raise capacity or air supply, with the cost of making the coffer harder to conceal or retrieve.

rules.statement: A resonating chime blocks verbal-component spells within 30 feet for 3 minutes, unless the caster succeeds at a concentration check with DC 15 plus the spell’s level. It can be sounded once every 10 minutes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Chime of Interruption (pf1-wondrous-items#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a timed area that disrupts speech-dependent magic but permits a check; a world could change its radius or interval because the effect relies on sustained resonance.

rules.statement: A chest opens into an interior space that holds up to 3,000 pounds or 500 cubic feet; overloading it fails, contents must be deliberately retrieved, and creatures inside begin to suffocate after 20 minutes. Its contents do not affect its weight.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Chest, Corsair’s Coffer (pf1-wondrous-items#028)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to fixed capacity and a 20-minute air limit; a world could raise either limit, balanced by greater expense or risk of entrapment.

rules.statement: Some cloak powers have a fixed daily use or time budget: examples include 3 uses per day no more than once per minute, 15 rounds per day usable in chosen portions, and 10 minutes per day spent in 1-minute increments. A few powers recharge one charge each dawn, up to a maximum of 3.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Individual cloak entries (pf1-wondrous-items#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the printed daily limits and increments; a world may alter recharge or capacity, trading rarity and power balance for more frequent use.

rules.statement: Certain cloak effects trigger only when a specific event occurs, such as falling asleep, falling more than 5 feet, being touched, or being exposed to fire; some then end on waking, movement, an attack, or after a stated duration.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Individual cloak entries (pf1-wondrous-items#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to explicit triggers and endings; a world may broaden triggers, but should charge for the greater reliability and duration.

rules.statement: Some effects require a particular wearer or circumstance, including worship of an associated deity, having a class feature, being in darkness, or wearing the cloak in salt water or favored terrain.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Individual cloak entries (pf1-wondrous-items#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to each stated prerequisite; a world can remove one to make the power broadly accessible, at the cost of its contextual restriction.

rules.statement: A cloak with 3 charges can spend 1 charge to dispel an alignment-marked spell, 2 to automatically counter one when readied, or 3 to counter an outsider’s alignment-marked spell and possibly banish that outsider; spent charges return at dawn at 1 per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cloak of Moral Refraction (pf1-wondrous-items#029)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the charge prices, automatic countering, and daily recharge; a world may change those prices, with stronger counters consuming more stored power.

rules.statement: A cloak can hold one object no larger than a 5-foot square or heavier than 100 lb. for at most 1 hour; its wearer can release it sooner into an adjacent square, and otherwise it falls out beside the cloak or wearer when time expires.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cloak, Prestidigitator’s (pf1-wondrous-items#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single stored object and a one-hour limit; a world can alter capacity or duration, with the cloak’s extradimensional space providing the in-world constraint.

rules.statement: A protean cloak grants a +1 to +5 resistance bonus to one chosen saving-throw type. Once per day its wearer can switch the type; if unattended for more than 24 hours, the bonus reverts to Will saves.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cloak, Protean (pf1-wondrous-items#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one save type at a time, changed daily; a world can change the reset period, with its magic settling back to Will when uncarried.

rules.statement: A quick-change cloak can store up to three mundane disguises and later restore one to the person who stored it, using the original Disguise check result. Any wearer can discard any number of stored disguises as a free action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cloak, Quick Change (pf1-wondrous-items#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three stored disguises and preserve their original quality; a world can vary capacity, with the cloak retaining only what it has recorded.

rules.statement: A quicksand cloak can contain only one creature at a time. A creature of the wearer’s size or smaller that tries to grapple the wearer must pass a DC 15 Reflex save or be trapped; each round it needs a DC 15 Swim check to escape, and failing by 5 or more makes it begin to drown.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cloak, Quicksand (pf1-wondrous-items#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one trapped creature and the stated escape checks; a world can adjust capacity or checks, with the cloak’s extradimensional sand imposing the limit.

rules.statement: A cloak of mist grants total concealment for up to 5 rounds per day in misty conditions, but the wearer must remain in or adjacent to the mist to keep it. Once per day, it can also turn its wearer into mist for up to 5 rounds.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Coat of Mist (pf1-wondrous-items#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to five concealment rounds and one brief mist transformation daily; a world can adjust those budgets, with mist remaining necessary for concealment.

rules.statement: Cockatrice grit makes a struck target take 1d4 Dexterity damage and be slowed for 1 round. Each following round, a DC 17 Fortitude save ends the effect; otherwise the target takes another 1d4 Dexterity damage and is slowed for another round, up to 11 rounds, and is permanently petrified if the damage reaches its Dexterity score.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cockatrice Grit (pf1-wondrous-items#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the 11-round buildup and a Dexterity threshold for petrification; a world can alter accumulation or duration, with progressive bodily calcification as the cause.

rules.statement: A closed death’s head coffer preserves contents against aging and damage and keeps infectious material intact. Disease can pass from a contaminated item to other stored items, which can then spread it for 1 week after removal; opening the coffer after closing it ends its magic.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Coffer, Death’s Head (pf1-wondrous-items#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to sealed preservation and one week of contagiousness after removal; a world can change persistence, with contact inside the box transferring infection.

rules.statement: A collar of the unliving servant links its wearer to one chosen undead creature within 100 feet. It transfers positive-energy damage to the wearer as healing and negative-energy damage to the wearer to the undead as healing, up to 70 points per day; command words dismiss or remake the link.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Collar of Unliving Servitude (pf1-wondrous-items#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one linked undead and 70 points transferred daily; a world can tune the distance or quota, with the linked pair sharing opposed energy effects.

rules.statement: A collar of sacrifice revives its bonded master at 1 hit point when the master is slain, but kills the wearer familiar in the process. The familiar becomes despondent and paranoid while wearing it, and the master needs a DC 15 Charisma check to compel it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Collar of Sacrifice (pf1-wondrous-items#030)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-for-one familiar sacrifice and immediate return at 1 hit point; a world can alter the revived state, with the familiar’s life paying the cost.

rules.statement: A charged coven charm stores up to 3 charges, each created by putting a coven member’s finger-, toe-, or tongue-sized piece of flesh into it. Taking the piece costs that member 1d6 damage and a permanent negative level until the charge is spent; spending 1, 2, or 3 charges lets the wearer cast an eligible coven spell of up to 4th, 6th, or 8th level, respectively.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Coven Charm (pf1-wondrous-items#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to storing a charge at the cost of bodily harm and a lasting negative level; worlds can change the charge limit or spell ceiling, with the coven’s flesh serving as the price.

rules.statement: A wearer who dies in an alternate form keeps that form as a corpse instead of reverting. The puppet is consumed when this happens, and observers who suspect something unnatural can recognize it with a successful DC 12 Will save.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Corpse Puppet (pf1-wondrous-items#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to preserving the final body shape once, consuming the puppet; a world can alter recognition difficulty or what forms qualify, at the cost of the item.

rules.statement: A witch can use the corset when preparing spells with her familiar to strengthen one known hex by 2 caster levels for 24 hours. Removing the corset or choosing a different hex ends the enhancement.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Corset of Dire Witchcraft (pf1-wondrous-items#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one enhanced hex per day, ending on removal or replacement; a world can widen the choice or duration, making the garment’s continued use the constraint.

rules.statement: The Vishkanya corset lets its wearer compress through tight spaces for up to 10 rounds per day and grants +5 on Escape Artist checks while active.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Corset of the Vishkanya (pf1-wondrous-items#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited daily duration with an escape skill benefit; a world can change the time budget or squeezing benefit, with daily use as the cost.

rules.statement: Clothing produced by the bureau grants +2 Charisma while worn, but fades into worthless scraps after 24 hours. Separated pieces also fade, so they cannot be kept as useful material.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Costume Bureau (pf1-wondrous-items#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one-day clothing whose bonus ends with its material; a world can change the bonus or duration, with impermanence preventing stockpiling.

rules.statement: A crackling tassel works only when attached to a weapon. After its wielder fights defensively, an attacker whose next attack misses takes 3d6 electricity damage; the tassel then cannot discharge again for 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Crackling Tassel (pf1-wondrous-items#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a triggered defensive discharge with a one-day recharge; worlds can tune the damage or recharge time, with the weapon attachment and trigger condition limiting use.

rules.statement: A Devil’s Crux holds up to 200 pounds in an extradimensional space. Opening it properly requires tracing its markings in order; a wrong trace causes fire damage that starts at 2 and increases by 2 per prior failure, while eight consecutive failures reset the order.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Crux, Devil’s (pf1-wondrous-items#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 200-pound storage limit and a hazardous puzzle whose accumulated failures raise the cost; worlds can change capacity or reset threshold, with wrong attempts risking injury.

rules.statement: A marionette crux can dominate one humanoid at a time, for up to a day after a successful hit and failed DC 17 Will save. It can be used twice per day; passing the crux transfers control, giving it to the victim ends the effect, and dominating another target releases the previous one.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Crux, Marionette (pf1-wondrous-items#031)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one controlled target and a day-long effect, limited to two activations daily; worlds can change duration or capacity, with control requiring possession of the crux for new commands.

rules.statement: A portable defense can create a 10-foot cube of six force walls, with 36 charges that renew daily. Maintaining a selected face costs 1–6 charges per minute and limits movement speed to 30, 20, 15, or 10 feet depending on the face; severe attacks and certain spells drain extra charges, and spells cannot pass through the screen.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cube of Force (pf1-wondrous-items#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to charge-paid protection that moves with its bearer; a world can vary its blocked threats and movement cap, with daily charge recovery as the operating limit.

rules.statement: A cold-protective cube produces a 10-foot area that keeps its temperature at least 65°F and absorbs cold attacks. More than 50 cold damage in a round disables it for 1 hour, while absorbing over 100 cold damage in 10 rounds destroys it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cube of Frost Resistance (pf1-wondrous-items#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent protective field with a damage threshold; a world can change the threshold or recovery period, while excess exposure risks destruction.

rules.statement: The varied-wall version can activate each face independently, including combinations of different barriers; its total per-minute charge cost is the sum of the selected effects, such as 7 charges for blocking magic and living matter.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cube of Varied Force Walls (pf1-wondrous-items#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to separately selectable barriers whose costs add together; a world can allow different combinations, with charges limiting simultaneous coverage.

rules.statement: A gate cube opens a passage to one of five chosen planes or dimensions, one face per destination; one gate at most can be open. An open gate has a 10% chance each minute of attracting an outsider, while pressing a face twice quickly transports the user and nearby creatures unless they resist with DC 23 Will saves.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cubic Gate (pf1-wondrous-items#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to keyed destinations and a single open passage; a world can alter the outsider risk or resistance, with involuntary travel as the cost of rapid activation.

rules.statement: A paired master and mark cup grant the master-cup drinker +5 on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Sense Motive checks against the other drinker after 5 minutes sharing a drink and conversation. The benefit ends after 1 hour or if they separate by more than 15 feet, and the mark-cup user cannot be affected by that pair again for 1 day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cups of Rapport (pf1-wondrous-items#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a brief social advantage requiring shared activity and proximity; a world can adjust the trust bonus or duration, with a daily per-target limit.

rules.statement: A construct-mounted crystal can dominate a construct that fails a DC 23 Will save; its wearer can take direct control as a full-round action and release control as a free action. Removing the crystal restores the construct’s original control, but if the construct is destroyed while carrying it, the crystal has a 10% chance of being destroyed too.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Diadem of Control (pf1-wondrous-items#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to resisted control through an attached device; a world can adjust control depth or resistance, with attachment and possible crystal loss as costs.

rules.statement: A creature bound in these shackles is prevented from dimensional travel without a saving throw. They fit creatures from Small to Large size, and breaking or slipping free has DC 30.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Dimensional Shackles (pf1-wondrous-items#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to travel-blocking restraints that apply automatically; a world can change which movement powers they stop, with escape requiring a difficult physical effort.

rules.statement: A witching doll lets its owner see and hear through it for up to 1 hour at a time while concentrating, but leaves the owner blind and deaf to nearby events. Once daily, the owner can cast a spell of touch range or greater from the doll.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Doll, Witching (pf1-wondrous-items#032)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to remote perception that occupies the user’s attention and senses; a world can broaden the link or remote casting, with local awareness sacrificed.

rules.statement: A user can unstopper a jar as a standard action while picturing a person or object seen within 30 feet; when poured onto the ground, the syrup travels at 15 feet per round by the most direct route to that target, if it is on the same plane. It can climb and pass through gaps as narrow as 1/16 inch, but cannot pass through other liquids or porous or absorbent surfaces, and leaves a sticky trail.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Passage opening (heading not shown) (pf1-wondrous-items#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to tracking a visualized target across the same plane; a world can alter the speed or permitted barriers, with liquids and absorbent terrain stopping it.

rules.statement: Dragon Herald Vestments grant the wearer energy resistance 5 of a type determined by their color: black or green for acid, blue for electricity, red for fire, or white for cold. A kobold with matching scales can change the vestments’ color with a Draconic command word as a standard action that provokes opportunity attacks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Dragon Herald Vestments (pf1-wondrous-items#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to fixed resistance tied to the item’s color; a world can allow a qualifying wearer to switch that resistance, at the cost of time and exposure to attacks.

rules.statement: Dragonbane Divination Sticks improve the chance of successfully casting augury and divination by 5%. Each day, the bearer randomly gains a +3 luck bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, or Will saves; carrying multiple sets does not change which save receives the bonus.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Dragonbane Divination Sticks (pf1-wondrous-items#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily random saving-throw benefit and a small divination reliability boost; a world can change the random selection method, while duplicate sets do not broaden the benefit.

rules.statement: A charged Drinking Horn of Bottomless Valor has 3 charges, renewed each day, and can fill with an alcoholic drink while it has a charge. Drinking for 1, 2, or 3 charges grants respectively 1d8 temporary hit points for 1 minute; 1d8+5 temporary hit points and enlargement for 5 minutes; or 1d8+10 temporary hit points, enlargement for 10 minutes, and heroism while enlarged. Using the tiers takes a standard action, a full-round action, or two full-round actions, respectively, and provokes opportunity attacks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Drinking Horn of Bottomless Valor (pf1-wondrous-items#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily rechargeable, three-charge consumable effect; a world can raise or lower the benefits, balanced by charge expenditure and increasingly long, dangerous drinking.

rules.statement: Once per day, a creature holding the Drinking Horn of the Panacea can command it to produce a drink with one of four effects: cure serious wounds, neutralize poison, remove disease, or lesser restoration. Drinking takes a standard action and provokes opportunity attacks; the magic is wasted if the liquid is spilled or not consumed within 1 minute.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Drinking Horn of the Panacea (pf1-wondrous-items#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one selected remedy each day; a world can change the remedy list or daily limit, with the drink’s short shelf life making delay costly.

rules.statement: Playing the Drum of Advance and Retreat as a standard action requires a DC 20 percussion performance check and improves allied creatures’ running speed within 120 feet as if they had the Run feat. Playing can be maintained as a free action while running; the effect ends if the player stops, and the drum works for up to 1 hour daily in 10-minute increments.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Drum of Advance and Retreat (pf1-wondrous-items#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a maintained ally-only field with a daily duration cap; a world can expand its reach or duration, with performance and continued movement sustaining it.

rules.statement: Drums of Haste affect up to 5 creatures when played after a DC 20 percussion performance check; they can affect no more than 25 creatures in a day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Drums of Haste (pf1-wondrous-items#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited group haste effect; a world can change the group or daily cap, with the performance check and target allowance limiting use.

rules.statement: Sounding both Drums of Panic affects creatures within 120 feet with fear (Will DC 16 partial), except those within a 20-foot-radius safe zone around the drums. The pair can be used once per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Drums of Panic (pf1-wondrous-items#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a once-daily fear field with a protected central zone; a world can adjust its radius or safe area, while the saving throw limits its effect.

rules.statement: One application of Dust of Desiccating wards two 5-foot squares for 24 hours or until it affects a creature. A creature entering must succeed at DC 19 Fortitude or take 5d6 nonlethal damage and become fatigued; that damage cannot be healed until it drinks water, and creatures already affected suffer no additional effect from crossing the dust.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Dust, Desiccating (pf1-wondrous-items#033)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-use ward that imposes thirst, pain, and fatigue; a world can change its footprint or duration, with water required to heal its nonlethal harm.

rules.statement: Applying an elemental augmentation takes 1 hour and requires a willing recipient with the appropriate body part. The recipient makes a DC 18 Fortitude save to integrate it, but takes 2 Constitution damage whether the save succeeds or fails.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elemental augmentations (introductory paragraph) (pf1-wondrous-items#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring a compatible body and a DC 18 save; a setting can change the integration difficulty, with bodily damage as the cost of attempting the change.

rules.statement: A Vaporous Lungs user can inhale nonmagical clouds and fog within 20 feet once per day, removing them; magical cloud or fog effects wholly within that radius require a dispel check of 1d20+7 against DC 11 plus caster level. The user can hold inhaled vapors and later expel them, but the contained effects continue counting down and damaging or penalizing vapors do not harm the user while inhaled.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Vaporous Lungs — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a once-daily 20-foot clearing with a caster-level check for magic; a world can change its range or frequency, while stored vapors remain a risk because they can be released and their durations continue.

rules.statement: A Whirlpool Maw can swallow one adjacent unattended object of up to 10 cubic feet as a full-round action, store it without weight or harm in extradimensional space, and retrieve it with another full-round action. If its effect is suppressed or dispelled, the stored object appears immediately.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Whirlpool Maw — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one object at a time and full-round access; a world can raise capacity or speed, with the risk that suppressing the effect releases the stored object.

rules.statement: An elemental storing stone activates at the start of each day; taking at least 10 points of one energy type charges it with that type. It can then fire one 60-foot ranged-touch ray for 2d6 damage once that day, and any unused charge expires at the next day’s start.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elemental Storing Stone — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring 10 damage of one type to charge and permitting one ray per day; a world can alter the threshold or uses, with a charge lost if not spent before daybreak.

rules.statement: A creature drinking an Elixir of Two Worlds underwater changes between land legs and a merfolk-like tail: the land-dweller gets 5-foot land speed, 40-foot swim speed, and the aquatic subtype, while the sea-dweller gets 30-foot land speed, no swim speed, and loses that subtype. The change is instantaneous and only miracle, wish, similar magic, or another dose reverses it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elixir of Two Worlds — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring willing consumption underwater and making reversal exceptional; a world can make the change easier to undo, while the resulting body and movement limits are the cost.

rules.statement: An Elixir of Emulation requires bodily material from one living, corporeal Small or Medium creature; after the material is added, it remains potent for 24 hours. Drinking it grants that creature’s shape and a +20 bonus to impersonate it, lasts 2d6+12 hours, and permits one attempt to learn knowledge the donor had when sampled.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elixir of Emulation — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a specific donor sample that spoils after a day and a finite disguise duration; a world can widen eligible donors or extend potency, with the need to obtain their bodily material as the cost.

rules.statement: An Elixir of Amnesia lets the drinker choose one event or specific piece of information to forget, unless a DC 14 Will save negates the effect. The lost memory can be restored only by modify memory or a similar effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elixir of Amnesia — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one selected memory and a resistance save; a world can let the draught erase more or less, with specialized magic required to restore what was lost.

rules.statement: An Elixir of Truth compels its drinker to speak truthfully for 10 minutes unless a DC 13 Will save negates it. At most one question can be asked each round, and the drinker gets a separate DC 13 save for each question to avoid answering without ending the truth effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elixir of Truth — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to compelled truthful speech with a separate chance to refuse each question; a world can alter the duration or resistance, with the drinker’s ability to withhold answers limited but not eliminated.

rules.statement: An Elixir of Vicious Magic makes the imbiber’s damaging spells deal extra damage equal to the spell’s level for 1 minute, but the imbiber also takes that same extra damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elixir of Vicious Magic — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#034)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to matching the added damage to spell level and inflicting it on both target and caster; a world can change the scaling, with self-injury paying for the increased output.

rules.statement: A temporary body transformation replaces physical statistics while preserving mental statistics and equipment drops; only movement-control or purely mental actions are allowed. It lasts 1 hour, but reaching 0 hit points ends it immediately and restores the original body.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Opening passage (heading not shown) (pf1-wondrous-items#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-hour transformation with an immediate 0-hit-point exit; a world can change its duration or exit threshold to tune how risky bodily alteration is.

rules.statement: The webbed-appendage effect lasts 1 hour, grants a 20-foot swim speed, and imposes –2 on attacks with held weapons while making items difficult to hold.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elixir, Webbed Appendages — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-hour bodily adaptation with a handling penalty; a world can turn duration or penalty to make aquatic movement more or less costly.

rules.statement: The wraith-sight drink grants lifesense out to 30 feet for 30 minutes but also blinds the drinker; removing or healing blindness ends the effect immediately.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elixir, Wraith’s Sight — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to paired perception and blindness for 30 minutes; a world can adjust the range or duration, with blindness serving as the price of unusual sensing.

rules.statement: A wearer can use an entangling aiguillette once per day when struck in melee to entangle the attacker (Reflex DC 13 negates); repeated failed saves raise the DC by 1 per round to 16. The wearer cannot move while holding the target, but can release it freely; the target can also try to escape with a move action and DC 13 Strength or Escape Artist check.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Entangling Aiguillette — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-target restraint with escalating resistance difficulty and a stationary user; a world can tune uses or escape difficulty, trading control for the wearer’s mobility.

rules.statement: An expedition pavilion provides a hidden 30-by-30-foot interior behind a 10-by-10-foot exterior, with protection from weather and a 70°F interior when outside temperatures are 0–100°F. It can be erected or dismantled once per day in 10 minutes, fails in hurricane-force winds of 75 mph or more, and cannot be dismantled while foreign objects remain inside.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Expedition Pavilion — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded shelter with one daily setup and explicit destruction and ejection conditions; a world can change its capacity or weather limit to define how secure magical refuge is.

rules.statement: The escape ladder can create an extradimensional refuge once per day; when an occupant’s turn ends, the refuge collapses and transports that creature 1d6 × 100 feet in a random direction to safe ground. Using this power leaves the ladder behind, where it falls to the ground.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Escape Ladder — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one daily, involuntary relocation to safe ground after a brief refuge; a world can change the distance or destination control to make escape more or less predictable.

rules.statement: An entangling aiguillette’s target can attempt a new save at the start of each turn, with the save DC increasing by 1 for every failed attempt up to DC 16 after 3 rounds.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Entangling Aiguillette — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to accumulating escape difficulty capped after three failures; a world can alter the cap or progression to determine whether restraint becomes harder or easier to break.

rules.statement: An implanted soulbound eye links its wearer and master for shared sensory observation and telepathic communication, but the link does not function across planar boundaries. The master can direct certain spells through it at any distance, subject to the target’s normal saves and spell resistance; removal requires lifting its curse, and removal destroys the item.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Eye, Soulbound — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#035)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to remote observation and spell delivery without forced obedience, with planar separation blocking the link; a world can change the link’s reach or removal cost to set the danger of implantation.

rules.statement: A single creature chosen as a standard action from within 30 feet may pass through the familiar bubble; other living creatures cannot. The choice persists until changed or the bubble is removed, which makes it vanish.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Familiar Bubble (opening passage) (pf1-wondrous-items#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one changeable permitted creature and a barrier to all other living creatures; a world can widen the passage or loosen selection limits, with the bubble’s disappearance as the cost of removal.

rules.statement: A feather token is a one-use item with a power suited to a specific need; its appearance does not reliably reveal its power unless its magic aura is detected.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Feather Token (pf1-wondrous-items#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a concealed, single-use power stored in a token; a world can make tokens reusable or visibly identifiable, at the cost of reducing their scarcity and uncertainty.

rules.statement: Figurines of wondrous power become obedient living creatures when thrown down and activated by command word. If destroyed while miniature, they lose their magic permanently; if slain while animated, they revert to miniature form and may be used again later, unless a specific figurine says otherwise.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Figurines of Wondrous Power (pf1-wondrous-items#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a command-activated creature form that returns on death, while destruction of the stored form ruins it; a world can make animated forms mortal or permanently renewable, trading durability or risk.

rules.statement: Several activated effects have fixed daily or weekly use limits and durations; for example, the Black Feather Fan grants up to three wind effects per day, while figurines specify individual weekly limits and maximum active hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Fan, Black Feather; Figurines of Wondrous Power (pf1-wondrous-items#036)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to explicit use pools and time caps; a world can raise or lower either limit, with greater access balanced by reduced scarcity or shorter active periods.

rules.statement: The wearer can cast one listed healing spell as a standard action by permanently consuming sapphires equal to its spell level; each hand’s gems must be spent as a single group, so spells costing five gems require all five from one hand. Both gloves must be worn, and after all 10 sapphires are used the pair loses its magic.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): First aid gloves — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to items spending a fixed count of stored charges per use; worlds can vary the charge price or whether charge pools can be combined, with limited gems as the cost.

rules.statement: A metamagic gem is consumed as an extra material component to add its specific metamagic effect without changing the spell’s slot; only one gem can modify a spell, and a gem-modified spell cannot also receive a rod’s effect. The gem grants only that use, not the feat, and spontaneous casters retain the usual full-round casting time except when using a quickening diamond.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gem, Metamagic — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to consumables applying one defined modifier without granting a lasting ability; a world can turn how many modifiers stack, at the cost of the gem and any normal casting-time burden.

rules.statement: A spell-capturing gem can hold a spell its owner successfully counterspells, using dispel magic or another method. It holds the spell for a number of days equal to the owner’s caster level minus the spell’s level, minimum 1; releasing it lets any wielder cast it at the minimum caster level, after which the gem is spent, and it is also spent when its storage time expires.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gem, Spell-Capturing — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-use container that captures a successfully blocked effect and releases it later; worlds can change storage duration or who can release it, with expiration or use destroying the container.

rules.statement: A floating sail unfolds on command as a rigid weight-bearing sheet and folds on a second command only into a space it touches. It collapses if overloaded or commanded to fold while bearing weight, and must then be manually refolded before reuse; capacities range from 800 to 2,000 pounds across the listed sizes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Floating Sail — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a deployable structure with a fixed capacity and dangerous failure under load; worlds can change its capacity or collapse consequences, with weight support as the limiting factor.

rules.statement: A flask of ebon flame creates a 20-foot-radius burst that extinguishes ordinary fires, attempts to dispel magical fire at +5, and heals each creature for 5d6 damage caused by fire. Fire-subtype creatures instead take 5d6 damage and are stunned for 1 round, with a DC 15 Fortitude save halving damage and negating the stun; the single-use substance dissipates if combined in larger doses or kept outside its prepared flask, and overlapping bursts do not stack.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Flask of Ebon Flame — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one prepared dose producing a nonstacking area effect with different outcomes by target type; a world can adjust area or potency, while unstable storage limits bulk use.

rules.statement: Once per day, the Foresight Quill requires 1 uninterrupted minute of writing, then lets the user choose an attack roll, save, or skill check type to roll twice and keep the better result on its next use that day. The next roll of either of the other types that day instead rolls twice and keeps the worse result.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Foresight Quill — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a foreseen favorable result balanced by a later unfavorable one; worlds can change which roll types are affected, with the drawback and daily limit pricing the benefit.

rules.statement: A gauntlet of rust can use rusting grasp on an object once per day and protects its wearer and carried gear from rust, including rust-monster attacks; the greater version allows three uses per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gauntlet of Rust — DESCRIPTION; Gauntlet of Rust, Greater — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limited corrosion effects paired with continuous rust immunity; a world can tune daily uses or what counts as rust, with the use limit constraining offense.

rules.statement: A wearer who pins a shape-changing creature can, with a successful grapple check, force it into a natural form it can take without magic, without spending the target’s action. While grappled or pinned, such a creature must also pass a concentration check to use shape-changing magic or abilities.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gauntlets, Form-Fixing — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#037)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to control over a target’s available natural forms only while physically restrained; worlds can broaden the forms or raise resistance, with the grapple and check as the cost.

rules.statement: Elemental gem crafting takes 8 hours and an uncut gem worth 1,000 gp; a failed DC 21 Craft (jewelry) check ruins the materials. The crafter must speak the language of the chosen element, but need not meet other prerequisites.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elementalist’s tools — crafting passage (pf1-wondrous-items#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Require the stated time, language, check, and gem; a world can ease these limits for trained crafters, with rare materials as the in-world cost.

rules.statement: A shattered globe creates dim moonlight in a 30-foot-radius burst for 1 minute; it replaces existing illumination and interacts with light and darkness as a 4th-level light spell. Moonlight-sensitive creatures and moonlight-dependent effects respond to it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Globe of Moonlight — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the fixed radius and duration; a world can alter coverage or persistence, at the cost of stronger interactions with illumination-dependent effects.

rules.statement: The Glove of Storing holds one hand-held item weighing at most 20 pounds, making it unseen and negligible in weight; storing or retrieving it takes a free action. Its spells keep expiring, and suppressing or dispelling the glove’s effect releases the item immediately.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Glove of Storing — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Allow one qualifying item and keep time running while stored; a world can expand capacity, risking loss or sudden release when the effect ends.

rules.statement: The Glove of Familiar’s Touch lets its wearer use a familiar touching the glove’s attuned gem as the source of a touch spell, even when the wearer and familiar are apart. The glove occupies the entire hands slot, preventing use of another hands-slot item.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Glove of Familiar’s Touch — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Permit delivery only through the attuned familiar; a world can loosen the contact requirement, at the cost of a stronger companion bond or item-slot commitment.

rules.statement: Once per day, the Shadow Falconer’s glove creates a magical bird silhouette that attempts a disarm or steal against a creature within 30 feet, using CMB +16, without provoking attacks of opportunity. It delivers the item to the wearer’s free hand or, if occupied, to an adjacent unoccupied space.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Glove, Shadow Falconer’s — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use one attempt per day at the stated range and maneuver bonus; a world can allow more attempts, with magical theft drawing notice or resistance.

rules.statement: The Aristocrat’s gloves can twice per day repel a creature for 1 minute, ending early if the wearer touches someone; an attacker or toucher must pass a DC 11 Will save. Once daily, they can also attempt a no-opportunity bull rush against one target within 40 feet, with a +5 bonus.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves, Aristocrat’s — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Keep the protection brief and limited by daily uses and a touch-based end condition; a world can strengthen it, making social contact harder.

rules.statement: The Gloves of First Aid cast one of six listed healing spells as a standard action, spending a number of sapphires equal to the spell’s level. The wearer cannot combine gems from both hands for one spell; once all ten sapphires are spent, the gloves become nonmagical.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves, First Aid — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Spend one gem per spell level, with each hand’s supply separate; a world can provide replenishment, but must pay the cost in gems or a similar consumable.

rules.statement: The Gloves of Reconnaissance let the wearer see and hear through solid material up to 5 feet thick for up to 1 minute, once per day. The wearer must have worn them continuously for 24 hours before activating them.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves of Reconnaissance — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#038)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the stated thickness, daily limit, and wear-in period; a world can extend sensing, with greater exposure to detection or interruption.

rules.statement: Some worn items provide a limited number of activations each day; each use spends one activation, and some effects also end after a stated duration or when the item is removed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves, Perilous; Gloves, Spellstrike; Gloves, Vampiric (pf1-wondrous-items#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily-use pool that refreshes each day; worlds can vary the pool or refresh schedule, with scarcity limiting repeated use.

rules.statement: A godstar has five deity-keyed points, each usable once: breaking one spends it and ends its use as that deity’s holy symbol.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Godstar (pf1-wondrous-items#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one-use stored effects attached to breakable points; a world can change the number or effects, with each activation permanently consuming a point.

rules.statement: An effect that creates or strengthens a bounded area can specify its radius, what it affects, and how long it persists; the gourd’s effect covers 40 feet and fixes a fear-removal effect there.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Glowing Gourd (pf1-wondrous-items#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed radius and duration from the effect; a world can widen or extend the field, at the cost of greater power or rarer components.

rules.statement: A spell altered to use touch range can be delivered through a designated attack, but this conversion can restrict the spell to the struck creature and exclude effects that create rays or other separate effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gloves, Spellstrike (pf1-wondrous-items#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing only eligible creature-targeting spells and only the attacked target; a world can relax either limit, risking broader or less controlled effects.

rules.statement: A creature made by an item can carry a predetermined mental effect in its attack; the living whisper lasts up to 1 minute or until killed, and each bitten target can resist with a Will save.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Gorget of Living Whispers (pf1-wondrous-items#039)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived summoned creature with an effect fixed at creation; a world can increase its duration or autonomy, with greater control and upkeep costs.

rules.statement: An item can grant several distinct effects while imposing a persistent bodily limitation: the stone hand cannot be used for ordinary tasks, imposes –4 on checks that normally need two hands, and cannot be removed without a suitable curse-breaking spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Grasp of Granite (pf1-wondrous-items#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to letting a bound item provide several powers with an ongoing physical drawback; a world can make removal easier or harder, with the curse-binding explaining the cost.

rules.statement: An area effect can be built by spending doses: each salt dose takes 1 round to apply, covers a 5-foot-radius circle, and extends consecration by 1 hour; a corporeal creature can end it with a standard action. One dose can also be thrown 15 feet, forcing a struck incorporeal undead creature to save against DC 14 or take 1d4 Charisma damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Grave Salt (pf1-wondrous-items#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to dose-scaled area and duration that can be broken by a creature; a world can increase the doses or make the boundary harder to disrupt, because salt supplies the sanctifying force.

rules.statement: A struck bonded companion temporarily loses bond-derived abilities for 1d4 minutes, unless magical washing ends the effect sooner; the bond’s normal benefits resume afterward.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Grease, Mundanity (pf1-wondrous-items#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporarily suspending the bond rather than destroying it; a world can lengthen the interruption or remove magical washing, with the risk of separating companions from their master’s support.

rules.statement: A consumable reserve can store up to five captured deaths indefinitely. The wearer can spend stored deaths for a 10-minute benefit per death; multiple expenditures add durations and temporary hit points, but Strength and caster-level bonuses do not stack.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Hand of Hoarded Deaths (pf1-wondrous-items#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a five-unit reserve with nonstacking bonuses; a world can raise capacity or permit stacking, with the stored life-force making the resource finite and dangerous.

rules.statement: A temporary protective aura can last 1 minute, with a 20% miss chance against ranged attacks; the same activation can produce further effects during that minute. The item limits this activation to three times per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Harp of Storms (pf1-wondrous-items#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived defensive field with a small daily activation budget; a world can increase its duration or uses, at the cost of stronger or more frequent wind magic.

rules.statement: An effect that changes a creature’s state can be conditional on a threshold: after drinking, the imbiber has 1 hour of protection that triggers when damage would reduce them to 0 or fewer hit points, healing them and briefly moving them through barriers if a safe destination exists.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Elixir, Spirit Rush (pf1-wondrous-items#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-hour trigger with healing and escape only when a free destination is available; a world can alter the trigger window or escape distance, with failure to find space preventing the displacement.

rules.statement: A creature in a bounded aura can be made to lose a category of benefits after failing a save; successful targets, and targets that later resist or break the effect, are protected from that same source for 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Helm, Grim; Halo of Menace (pf1-wondrous-items#040)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an area effect with a 24-hour immunity interval; a world can change the saving threshold or immunity duration, because repeated exposure otherwise makes the aura oppressive.

rules.statement: A haunt siphon activated in a haunt’s area deals 3d6 positive-energy damage to one haunt. It is expended even if the damage fails to reduce the haunt to 0 hit points; if it does, the mist changes color and the haunt takes a –5 penalty on its caster-level check to manifest after its reset.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Haunt Siphon (pf1-wondrous-items#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-use, item-bound attack with a lasting suppression penalty on a successful takedown; a setting can change the penalty or number of uses to tune haunt-hunting scarcity.

rules.statement: A siphon that neutralizes a haunt can no longer harm haunts, but can be thrown as a splash weapon for 1d6 negative-energy damage on a direct hit and 1 damage to creatures within 5 feet. A failed attempt leaves it nonmagical and unusable.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Haunt Siphon (pf1-wondrous-items#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an exhausted tool changing into a lesser-purpose weapon; a world can allow recovery or forbid the fallback, trading utility against conservation of rare items.

rules.statement: An arcane-energy headband can be used three times per day by sacrificing an arcane spell: the blast deals 1d6 damage of a chosen cold, electricity, or fire type per spell level at up to 30 feet, or a shield gives AC deflection of 2 plus the spell level for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Headband of Arcane Energy (pf1-wondrous-items#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to converting a limited daily item use plus a spell into offense or brief defense; a setting can vary the daily cap or damage types to shift the value of spell sacrifice.

rules.statement: The Headband of Intuition grants an augury-like answer about a proposed action three times per day, using a standard action, and always provides a meaningful reply.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Headband of Intuition (pf1-wondrous-items#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to capped, actionable foresight that cannot return an empty answer; a world can make answers less certain or change the daily limit to control how much uncertainty remains.

rules.statement: A wearer suffering a poison’s effects can make a melee touch attack to expose one other creature to a duplicate of that poison, which gets a Fortitude save against the original DC; failure applies the poison for its full duration. Only one additional target can be affected at a time.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Headband of the Tainted Ouroboros (pf1-wondrous-items#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to letting an afflicted wearer pass the same danger onward to one target; a world can broaden the target limit or require a different trigger, changing the contagion risk.

rules.statement: A twisted-intellect headband lets two inserted ioun stones manifest their resonant powers at once without suppressing the headband. If the wearer also uses a wayfinder or similar stone-holding item, the two devices suppress each other until one is set aside.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Headband of Twisted Intellect (pf1-wondrous-items#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing the headband’s paired stones but making competing interfaces mutually incompatible; a world can remove or expand this conflict to regulate combined magical equipment.

rules.statement: An heirloom seal prevents mundane or magical alteration of stamped ordinary writing. A spell that changes, ruins, or obscures it must beat a caster-level check DC of 15 plus the owner’s Hit Dice; mundane forgery fades back to the original in 2d4 rounds, and magical writing cannot be sealed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Heirloom Seal (pf1-wondrous-items#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to protected documents resisting edits, with a level-scaled magical bypass and temporary mundane fraud; a world can alter the check or allow magical writing to be sealed to set the strength of documentary trust.

rules.statement: A helm of brilliance provides fire resistance 30 and damages undead within 30 feet for 1d6 each round while its gems retain magic. If magical fire harms its wearer and the wearer fails a DC 15 Will save, remaining gems detonate into their associated spell effects, while the opals and helm are destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Helm of Brilliance (pf1-wondrous-items#041)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a powerful consumable artifact that can catastrophically discharge under a failed save; a world can tune the trigger or resistance while accepting the cost of losing the helm.

rules.statement: A carried banner’s effects work only while it is properly mounted; planting it removes the need for a bearer, but an enemy touching or toppling it suppresses its effects until allies reclaim and replant it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Hobgoblin Battle Standard (pf1-wondrous-items#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: mounted banners project their stated effects; a world can change the area or disruption condition, with the cost that enemies can disable the field.

rules.statement: A magical-use ability with a daily limit cannot be used more often than specified; the ordinary and greater blasting horns each risk a cumulative 20% chance of exploding for each use beyond the first in a day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horn of Blasting (pf1-wondrous-items#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: daily charges limit repeated activations; a world can raise the limit, with escalating risk of the device exploding.

rules.statement: The aligned Valhalla horn summons creatures that may turn on the user if the user’s alignment is more than one step from the horn’s, or if the user orders them to act strongly against their ethos.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horn of Valhalla, Aligned (pf1-wondrous-items#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: summoned helpers follow an ethos; a world can loosen that constraint, at the cost of losing aligned service or provoking their hostility.

rules.statement: A horn of Valhalla summons constructed barbarians who fight as directed until they or their opponents are slain or 1 hour passes; a user lacking the horn’s prerequisite is attacked by the summoned group.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horn of Valhalla (pf1-wondrous-items#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: summoned fighters are temporary and require qualification; a world can extend their service, at the cost of control or reliability.

rules.statement: A wand hidden with a holdout wrap changes appearance and ceases to radiate magic, but activating the disguised wand suppresses the disguise for 1 minute; true seeing reveals it regardless.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Holdout Wand Wrap (pf1-wondrous-items#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: concealment lasts until the concealed item is used; a world can make it harder to detect, with the cost of more limited access or upkeep.

rules.statement: A spectral wolf summoned by the Valkyrie helm lasts up to 24 hours only while its summoner keeps wearing the helm, and it cannot attack.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Helm of the Valkyrie (pf1-wondrous-items#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the mount is maintained by continued use of its source item; a world can remove that dependency, at the cost of a shorter duration or reduced capability.

rules.statement: The homunculus made from the clay reverts when its mutagen ends or it dies, and the clay is reusable; destroying it while inactive ruins it permanently.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Homunculus Clay (pf1-wondrous-items#042)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the created form lasts only while its triggering effect persists; a world can make it permanent, at the cost of losing reusable material or requiring ongoing upkeep.

rules.statement: The horn of blasting deals sonic damage and can impose deafness; each use after the first in a day adds a cumulative 20% explosion chance, which damages the user.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horn of Blasting (pf1-wondrous-items#042)
