rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: repeated use increases danger rather than power; a world can reduce the risk, at the cost of a weaker blast or a scarce-use limit.

rules.statement: A complete set of four Glory horseshoes can be commanded once per day to either increase the mount’s size by one category, to a maximum of Huge, or change it into a magical beast as beast shape IV. While either augmentation lasts, the rider selects one alignment category and the mount gains damage reduction 5 against it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horseshoes of Glory (pf1-wondrous-items#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one daily transformation with selectable protection; a world can vary the protected alignment, with the restriction reflecting the set’s limited stored magic.

rules.statement: All four Great Burden horseshoes must be worn by the same animal; together they double its carrying capacity. All four Speed horseshoes must likewise be worn by one animal, increasing its base land speed by 30 feet and proportionally increasing its jumping distance.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horseshoes of Great Burden; Horseshoes of Speed (pf1-wondrous-items#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a complete-set requirement and fixed bonuses; a world can change the bonus or required number of shoes, with the set acting as the power’s limiting focus.

rules.statement: Mist horseshoes grant the rider and mount a gaseous form on command, using a shared daily allowance of 10 minutes in one-minute increments. If rider and mount separate while transformed, the effect ends for both.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Horseshoes of Mist (pf1-wondrous-items#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a shared, segmented time budget and forced termination on separation; a world can change the budget, with the paired travelers’ connection setting the limit.

rules.statement: The Hourglass of Last Chances affects one creature within 30 feet: it grants freedom of movement and suspends a listed set of harmful conditions without removing them. Its effects can be ended as a swift action and last for up to 5 rounds total; suspended conditions resume afterward, and their duration does not run while suspended.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Hourglass of Last Chances (pf1-wondrous-items#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a five-round consumable pause that preserves the original conditions; a world can alter the allowed conditions or rounds, with the hourglass’s finite sand paying the cost.

rules.statement: A Hunter’s Tree Fort unfolds beneath a tree with a trunk at least 2 feet across into one of two forms, stays open for up to 12 hours in a 24-hour period, and then folds back into its box. If it takes 50 damage, it also folds, leaving occupants unharmed; damage-forced folding prevents reuse for 24 hours. Its exterior resembles its tree and takes a DC 25 Perception check to notice, or DC 15 for a dead or leafless tree.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Hunter’s Tree Fort (pf1-wondrous-items#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a tree-dependent shelter with a daily operating limit and damage-triggered shutdown; a world can adjust its forms or endurance, with the tree and recovery period constraining deployment.

rules.statement: The Hybridization Funnel takes 10 minutes and a DC 25 Craft (alchemy) check to combine two liquid splash weapons; combining one with holy or unholy water raises the DC to 30. Failure destroys both inputs; success makes one vial with both effects, usable for 24 hours, but mixtures cannot be recombined and identical substances, potions, elixirs, and extracts are excluded.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Hybridization Funnel (pf1-wondrous-items#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to combining two eligible liquids into a short-lived dual-effect item, with failure consuming the inputs; a world can vary eligible ingredients or check difficulty, with incompatible substances and risk limiting experimentation.

rules.statement: Incense of Dulled Senses fills ten 10-foot cubes with stationary smoke unless wind moves it. A creature with blindsense, scent, or tremorsense that inhales it and fails a DC 20 Fortitude save loses the benefit of those senses for 10 minutes; the smoke then dissipates.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Incense of Dulled Senses (pf1-wondrous-items#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded smoke field that suppresses special senses after a failed save; a world can tune its volume or duration, with wind and exposure limiting its reach.

rules.statement: An Instant Muzzle can be thrown three times per day and attaches to a struck creature of Large size or smaller, or to one such creature in the targeted 5-foot space. For 4 rounds it impairs speech, causes a 20% failure chance for verbal spells and command words, and prevents biting and proper eating or drinking; it then returns to its thrower.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Instant Muzzle (pf1-wondrous-items#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-lived, size-limited restraint with a daily use cap; a world can change the targets or penalties, with the device’s brief attachment bounding the disruption.

rules.statement: Ioun stones orbit their owner 1d3 feet away and only function within 3 feet; grasping or netting separates them, and voluntarily stowing one suspends its benefits. Each has AC 24, 10 hit points, and hardness 5, while its power depends on its type.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Ioun Stones (pf1-wondrous-items#043)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.mechanism: law: proximity and handling govern ioun stone benefits
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to orbiting stones with a three-foot operating radius and removable benefits; a world can vary their durability or range, with exposure and loss of proximity limiting their use.

rules.statement: An ioun stone functions only while freely orbiting the head of an intelligent creature (Intelligence 3 or higher), or while fitted into a suitable device. It provides no benefit to animals, mindless creatures, comatose users, or creatures whose Intelligence is significantly damaged or drained.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Facts About Ioun Stones (pf1-wondrous-items#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Require an intelligent bearer and free orbit by default; a world can permit alternate holders or mounts, but doing so changes how the stone’s power is assigned.

rules.statement: An orbiting stone avoids accidental collisions, counts as an attended object, and receives the owner’s magical protections. It cannot bear loads or support creatures, and it must be able to orbit freely or occupy a specialized mount for its power to work.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Facts About Ioun Stones (pf1-wondrous-items#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Keep orbiting stones protected but unable to carry weight; a world can make them easier to obstruct or target, making active use riskier.

rules.statement: A stone can be bonded through a ritual requiring at least 3 days of uninterrupted fasting and a DC 20 Charisma check; each full extra fasting day grants +1, to a maximum +5. After bonding, implantation takes 1 hour and requires both a DC 25 Heal check and DC 25 Knowledge (arcana) check; failure causes 1d6 Constitution damage and requires restarting, while success causes 1d2 Constitution damage and makes the stone part of the skin, protected from sundering or removal without consent while the owner lives.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Implanted Ioun Stones (pf1-wondrous-items#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the full ritual, checks, and Constitution damage; a world can ease the checks or make implantation reversible, trading away the procedure’s bodily risk and security.

rules.statement: An absorbed spell is limited by the stone’s stated maximum spell level and consumes its finite capacity in spell levels. At capacity the stone burns out permanently; some stones require a readied action, and the flawed versions may also injure the wearer.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lavender and Green Ellipsoid; Pale Lavender Ellipsoid (pf1-wondrous-items#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Treat absorbed spell levels as a finite consumable reserve; a world can raise capacity or permit the stored energy to be reused, changing the stone’s cost and defensive value.

rules.statement: Cracked stones generally provide weaker versions of their normal effect. Flawed stones are usually weaker or altered and can impose penalties; scorched constant-effect stones typically work only 50% of the time each day, while use-activated ones have a 50% chance to function per use.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Inferior Ioun Stones (pf1-wondrous-items#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Apply the listed defects and unreliable operation by default; a world can make inferior stones more or less erratic, changing their affordability against their drawbacks.

rules.statement: A wayfinder can trigger a secondary resonant effect from an inserted stone while suppressing the wayfinder’s usual magic. Two such wayfinders held by one character suppress each other until one is set aside; 75% of ordinary stones, 25% of cracked or flawed stones, and 10% of scorched stones have resonant powers.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Resonant Powers (pf1-wondrous-items#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the stated chance and mutual suppression; a world can alter resonance frequency or allow multiple effects, changing the benefit of carrying several devices.

rules.statement: A failed creation check by 5–14 has a 50% chance to produce a cracked stone and a 50% chance to produce a flawed one; failure by 15 or more instead produces a cursed stone whose curse is determined randomly.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cursed Stones (pf1-wondrous-items#044)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Use the stated failure bands and outcomes; a world can soften or worsen crafting failures, changing the danger of creating magical items.

rules.statement: The Nacreous Gray Sphere prevents aging-related ability penalties and magical aging, but does not remove penalties already present or stop old-age death. If it is lost or suppressed, aging and its penalties apply immediately.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Nacreous Gray Sphere (Ioun Stone) (pf1-wondrous-items#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to delaying age penalties, not age or death; a world could extend the protection, at the cost of making loss or suppression trigger the accumulated effects.

rules.statement: The Pale Lavender Ellipsoid absorbs spells up to 4th level, but requires a readied action and cannot empower spells; it becomes permanently useless after absorbing 20 spell levels. Its flawed form absorbs spells up to 3rd level and deals its user 2 hit points of damage per absorbed spell level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Pale Lavender Ellipsoid (Ioun Stone) (pf1-wondrous-items#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a finite item that blocks incoming spells; a world could raise the capacity or remove the readiness requirement, at the cost of greater power or reduced risk.

rules.statement: The Pale Orange Rhomboid transfers its owner's soul into the stone immediately before death. Within 12 hours, the soul can return to its body if both are within 120 feet; the owner returns unconscious and dying at negative hit points equal to Constitution minus 1, and the effect can happen only once per 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Pale Orange Rhomboid (Ioun Stone) (pf1-wondrous-items#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one nearby, brief return opportunity with the owner still dying; a world could lengthen the window, at the cost of weakening the death boundary.

rules.statement: The Sepia Ellipsoid grants the effects of an Iridescent Spindle, Pearly White Spindle, and Orange Prism. Once released to orbit, it escapes containment in 1d4+1 hours and drains one other Ioun Stone's power every 24 hours; removing its curse can stop its return to orbit.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Sepia Ellipsoid (Ioun Stone) (pf1-wondrous-items#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a useful item whose power harms nearby stored stones; a world could make containment reliable, at the cost of removing its distinctive hazard.

rules.statement: An Ioun Tower transmits the effect of its embedded stone to creatures throughout a 7-mile radius. Replacing the embedded stone requires a successful DC 40 Use Magic Device check, and some stones may not function in a tower.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Ioun Tower (pf1-wondrous-items#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to broadcasting one embedded stone's benefit across a fixed area; a world could enlarge the area or allow more stones, at the cost of wider access to the effect.

rules.statement: Iron Bands of Binding can capture one Large or smaller creature on a successful ranged touch attack and hold it immobile until the command word releases it. The target can break them with a DC 30 Strength check or escape with a DC 30 combat maneuver or Escape Artist check; the bands work once per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Iron Bands of Binding (pf1-wondrous-items#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one target held until release or escape; a world could make the restraint stronger, at the cost of making rescue harder.

rules.statement: An Iron Flask can contain one creature from another plane within 60 feet if it fails a DC 19 Will save; it can be used once per day. Speaking the command word when freeing the captive compels it to serve for 1 hour, while freeing it without the word leaves it to its natural inclinations.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Iron Flask (pf1-wondrous-items#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single captive and a one-hour service period; a world could demand longer service, at the cost of stronger resistance or greater danger from the captive.

rules.statement: The Spirit Jars allow souls to move among the jars and bodies while the caster's magic jar spell remains active, but do not let the caster move other souls between bodies. If the spell ends with souls in the jars, opening a jar lets its spirit attempt a soul swap against DC 17 Will resistance or return to its body if in range; a bodiless spirit without a jar available dies when the spell ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Jars, Spirit (pf1-wondrous-items#045)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to soul movement constrained by an active spell and available jars; a world could permit movement after the spell ends, at the cost of weakening the danger of entrapment.

rules.statement: An item can create a hardened-metal dome that grants tower-shield protection, but the wearer becomes immobile and can take no other actions except changing the shield’s facing. It can be maintained indefinitely, makes rest equivalent to resting in heavy armor, ends as a swift action, and ends automatically if the cloak is removed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cloak description (opening passage; item heading not included) (pf1-wondrous-items#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an indefinite, wearer-bound defensive form with immobility and restricted actions; a setting can shorten its duration because the protection is powerful.

rules.statement: Once per day, a cloak can make a key that lasts 1 hour and can be used on only one lock. It uses a Disable Device bonus of +15, cannot be used to take 10, and a failed attempt permanently prevents it from opening or closing that lock.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Cloak description (opening passage; item heading not included) (pf1-wondrous-items#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one consumable-like attempt per day with a fixed +15 bonus; a setting can make it more reliable at the cost of rarity or time.

rules.statement: A clockwork key makes constructs avoid attacking its bearer when they have other possible targets, except when the bearer threatens them or their creator orders them to attack. If the bearer’s patron is a good god, the key can instead be used to damage and possibly paralyze a construct; a successful paralysis destroys the key.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Key, Clockwork — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to conditional target redirection and a patron-gated, single successful paralysis; a setting can change the patron requirement or the key’s expendability.

rules.statement: A key of lock jamming merges into a standard-sized keyhole and makes the lock impossible to operate, even by magic; it increases the lock’s hardness by 2, hit points by 8, and Break DC by 5. Touching it and speaking its command word destroys the key and restores the lock’s operation.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Key of Lock Jamming — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a durable, magically sealed lock that can be restored by sacrificing the key; a setting can let force remove it but weaken the lock’s added durability.

rules.statement: The otherworldly kimono can trap one creature within 60 feet once per day without a save; the prisoner gets a DC 20 Intelligence check each turn to escape and is otherwise released after 10 minutes. While someone is trapped, the wearer’s saving-throw and caster-level bonuses rise from +4 to +6, and the prisoner returns to its former location or the nearest open space.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Kimono, Otherwordly — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one daily capture with an escape check and a 10-minute limit, temporarily strengthening the wearer; a setting can make escape harder in exchange for a shorter capture.

rules.statement: Once per day, the moonlight lantern can force a creature in its light to take another of its forms. A shapechanger must pass a DC 20 Fortitude save or shift immediately and remain in the chosen form for at least 1 minute; a polymorph spell effect can instead be targeted with a dispel check using the lantern’s caster level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lantern, Moonlight — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily, light-limited forced form change with a DC 20 resistance check and 1-minute minimum; a setting can allow resistance at a lower cost or make the change last longer.

rules.statement: A salt lamp shines like a torch for 1d4+1 hours, then becomes ordinary salt. While it is lit, the bearer can throw it to create a 10-foot-radius glowing cloud that outlines invisible things and imposes a –40 penalty on Stealth checks; the particles last for the lamp’s remaining duration unless dispelled.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lamp, Salt — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a finite-duration lamp that can be expended for a strong revealing cloud; a setting can reduce the penalty or radius to make the item less decisive.

rules.statement: A lantern of concealment creates a hidden-campsite effect in a 20-foot cube for 10 hours, once per day, but only while stationary. After it moves, it needs 10 minutes in the new position before the effect resumes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lantern of Concealment — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a once-daily, stationary 20-foot-cube concealment field; a setting can allow movement without interruption at the cost of a shorter duration.

rules.statement: The lambent window shows creatures and terrain at the corresponding Material–Shadow Plane location after 1 minute of viewing, for up to 10 minutes per day. A bearer can also use it as a focus to reach the location shown when traveling by plane shift.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lambent Window — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#046)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limited visual access and precise destination-setting, but no sound or other sensory access; a setting can widen the sensing at the cost of daily viewing time.

rules.statement: A telescope can hold only one magical lens at a time. The starsight lens works only when attached to a telescope aimed at the night sky, and grants starsight plus a +2 competence bonus on relevant star-geography checks.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lenses, Fogcutting (preceding entry) (pf1-wondrous-items#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one lens per telescope and require a night-sky view; a world can relax either limit, at the cost of making powerful lens combinations easier.

rules.statement: The situational spectacles let the wearer switch one, two, or all three filters with a standard action. Each filter set works for 10 minutes total, spent in 1-minute increments; they grant magic detection, invisibility sight, or darkvision to 60 feet (or extend existing darkvision by 60 feet).
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lenses of Situational Sight (pf1-wondrous-items#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to separate 10-minute reserves for the three filters; a world can make them share one reserve, with versatile sight consuming a scarce charge.

rules.statement: A triggered levitating mine gives a creature in its square a DC 14 Will save or raises it 5 inches so it cannot move. The target can save again each round; the effect ends after 5 rounds, a successful save, or a DC 25 Disable Device check, and the mine is destroyed when the effect ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Levitating Land Mine (pf1-wondrous-items#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single-target, square-triggered trap with recurring saves and a five-round cap; a world can change its escape window, at the cost of making the trap more or less reliable.

rules.statement: The lintel stone can be activated once per day at a portal, using a rod attuned to a plane; for 1 minute, a creature passing through must make a DC 17 Will save or be sent to that plane. Arrival location is uncontrolled, and after 1 minute the stone returns to its activator even across planes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lintel Stone (pf1-wondrous-items#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-minute, save-gated transit effect with uncontrolled arrival; a world can let the activator choose the destination point, at the cost of safer and more precise travel.

rules.statement: The necromancer’s beacon attracts undead within 1,000 feet, compelling them toward it unless blocked by 1 foot of wood, 1 inch of stone, or a thin layer of lead. Sentient undead can resist with a DC 20 Will save; undead in its light take 1 positive-energy damage each round, and destroying the lantern ends the compulsion immediately.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lantern, Necromancer’s Beacon (pf1-wondrous-items#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an attraction field with specified barriers and an immediate destruction-based release; a world can make the signal penetrate barriers, at the cost of weaker counterplay.

rules.statement: The formbinding lock suppresses magical polymorph and supernatural shapechanging, restoring the wearer’s true form without ending the underlying effect. A new polymorph lasts only 1 round; a wearer’s own shapechange requires a DC 16 Will save each round to persist, and attaching the lock takes a provoking full-round action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lock of Formbinding (pf1-wondrous-items#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to suppressing, rather than dispelling, shape effects and allow only one round for outside transformations; a world can make the lock dispel those effects, at the cost of turning temporary restraint into permanent removal.

rules.statement: The lyre can once per day protect inanimate construction within 300 feet from attacks for 30 minutes. Once per week, 30 minutes of playing can perform work equal to 100 people laboring for 3 days; each later hour requires a DC 18 Perform check, and failure ends that use and bars another attempt for a week.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Lyre of Building (pf1-wondrous-items#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a broad construction ward and a capped weekly burst of labor; a world can remove the weekly limit, at the cost of making building and siege defense far less constrained.

rules.statement: A creature holding the eye-stealing locket can target one creature within 30 feet with a command word; a failed DC 13 Fortitude save seals its eyes inside the locket and permanently blinds it until the wielder returns them or a miracle or wish restores sight. The locket holds only one set of eyes at a time, and its possessor counts as bearing a body part of their owner for certain spells.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Locket, Eye-Stealing (pf1-wondrous-items#047)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one stored set of eyes and a severe but reversible-by-owner result; a world can allow multiple sets or ordinary restoration, at the cost of reducing the locket’s scarcity and permanence.

rules.statement: An item can create ordinary objects through a surface image; one pot makes up to 1,000 cubic feet of objects, the depiction takes 10 minutes and a DC 15 painting check, and each object must be worth no more than 2,000 gp. It cannot create creatures or magic items, and depicted valuables are made from inexpensive materials.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Marvelous Pigments — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to permanent mundane objects created from a drawn plan; worlds can change the volume, time, or value limits, with scarce pigment and skilled work as costs.

rules.statement: The mallet creates one nail, spike, piton, or fence post with a full-round action, up to 100 creations per day. A created item lasts like an ordinary object unless removed from the surface it penetrates, which destroys it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mallet of Building — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to durable created objects that vanish when detached from their placement; a world can change the daily limit or allowed materials, making repeated construction consume time and uses.

rules.statement: The holy symbol’s bearer may change a channeled-energy area as a free action, choosing a 10-foot burst centered within 30 feet, a 60-foot line, or a 30-foot cone. The lump can be made into the worshipper’s deity’s masterwork holy symbol by concentrating for 1 minute, and reverts to lump form after 24 hours away from its bearer.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Undistinguished metal lump — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three selectable channel shapes while the symbol remains with its bearer; a world can change the available shapes or separation duration, with deity devotion and carrying the object as limits.

rules.statement: A wearer can lend an ally an armor-and-shield benefit for 10 minutes after attuning the mantle for 10 minutes at the start of the day. Activation makes the owner lose those benefits for 1 minute.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mantle of the Protector — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to transferring the owner’s defenses temporarily, with a one-minute vulnerability in exchange; worlds can adjust duration or attunement, while the owner’s lost protection is the cost.

rules.statement: The martyr’s gemstone accepts 3d6 hit points from its bearer once per day, up to an 18-hit-point capacity. A standard action transfers all stored hit points to a touched creature as healing, emptying the gem.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Martyr’s Tear — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#048)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to storing life at a personal cost and releasing it as healing; a world can alter the capacity or rate, with the donor taking the damage and the daily limit restraining use.

rules.statement: A worn skin mask heightens fear detection, granting +2 to Perception checks against creatures that can experience fear; seeing living circulatory systems also grants +1 damage with slashing weapons against living targets. Putting it on causes 1 point of Charisma damage.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Opening passage (Skin Mask) (pf1-wondrous-items#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to continuous senses and a small combat benefit while worn; a world can increase or remove the mental cost, with the wearer’s Charisma damage representing the toll.

rules.statement: A Stalker’s Mask can copy the appearance of an observed creature within 60 feet once per day, taking a full-round action; the disguise lasts 1 hour. The wearer gains +10 on checks to pass as that creature and +1 on attack and weapon damage rolls against it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mask, Stalker’s — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one observed appearance per day for an hour; a world can widen access or duration, balancing stronger imitation against limited uses.

rules.statement: A matching Vermin Mask lets its wearer speak normally while using a corresponding vermin form and extends wild shape by 3 hours or a vermin-shape spell by 7 minutes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mask, Vermin — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a form-specific exception and modest duration extension; a world can make these benefits broader, but should preserve the mask-to-form match.

rules.statement: The Master’s Perfect Golden Bell weakens extraplanar creatures within 30 feet by 5 points of damage reduction and spell resistance. It rings for 1d6 rounds when struck, can be silenced early with a standard action, and has a 10-round daily limit.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Master’s Perfect Golden Bell — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a short-range, short-lived field with a fixed daily budget; a world can turn up its reach or potency at the cost of fewer activations.

rules.statement: The Mirror of Life Trapping can hold 15 creatures in separate extradimensional cells. A reflected creature within 30 feet must make a DC 23 Will save or be taken into the mirror; when full, the mirror releases a random captive to admit the new one, and destroying it frees all captives.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mirror of Life Trapping — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bounded capacity, a resistance check, and mass release if the container is destroyed; a world can increase capacity while making escape or release harder.

rules.statement: The Mirror of Mental Prowess can open a route to a viewed location, including a sufficiently familiar place on another plane. The route closes when the user returns, by command, or after 24 hours; anyone still beyond it when it expires is trapped there.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mirror of Mental Prowess — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-way-at-a-time portal with a return route and a 24-hour limit; a world can extend or shorten the window, with the risk of being stranded as the cost.

rules.statement: The Memory Musk Gourd affects creatures within 10 feet of impact: on a failed DC 20 Will save they are dazed, blinded, and forget the previous round for 1d4 rounds; a successful save instead dazzles them for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Memory Musk Gourd — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a small blast that imposes brief impairment and erases only recent events; a world can broaden the memory loss, at the cost of stronger resistance or rarer use.

rules.statement: The Drowning Medallion delays Constitution checks for up to 10 minutes after its wearer becomes unconscious from drowning. One round after the wearer leaves the drowning substance, the wearer returns to consciousness at 0 hit points and the medallion is consumed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Medallion, Drowning — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#049)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single emergency recovery that consumes the item and leaves the wearer at 0 hit points; a world can increase the delay, while retaining the one-use cost.

rules.statement: A mummified guardian must be enclosed with a corpse to function. Opening its container triggers a one-use ward: creatures with 5 Hit Dice or fewer within 20 feet save at DC 13 or become frightened for 3 rounds, or shaken for 1 round on a success; after triggering, only corpse preservation remains.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mummified guardian (pf1-wondrous-items#050)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one trigger and a corpse-bound ward; a setting can change the fear or range, with the cost of weakening its grave protection.

rules.statement: A music box can hold one targeted mind-affecting spell of up to 4th level. After it is opened and plays for 1 round, it targets the opener; if the target is invalid or moves beyond the spell’s range during the delay, the stored spell is lost without effect. Closing it before delivery preserves the spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Music Box Trap (pf1-wondrous-items#050)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one stored spell and a one-round delay; a world can alter the capacity or trigger, at the cost of making the trap easier to evade or harder to detect.

rules.statement: A mute marionette can affect its attuned creature type within 30 feet once per creature per 24 hours: a failed DC 11 Will save gives a 10% chance to fail spellcasting for 1 hour while nearby. Once per day it can also cast confusion, DC 16, in a 15-foot burst within 170 feet against that type.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Mute Marionette (pf1-wondrous-items#050)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed type, limits, and durations; a world can widen its target category, but risks making spell disruption too pervasive.

rules.statement: A naga-scale bindi transforms its wearer for 11 minutes, granting +4 natural armor, darkvision 60 feet, and a poisonous bite; the chosen naga variety adds its listed special ability. The wearer can end the change with a standard action, and the bindi works twice before becoming nonmagical.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Naga-Scale Bindi (pf1-wondrous-items#050)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited-use, temporary transformation; a world can vary the chosen form’s gifts, with the cost of finite activations.

rules.statement: A nail of blood lets its user cast in a magic-dead zone up to one spell of each known or prepared spell level. Further spells can be cast only up to the user’s normal limit, each causing fatigue and requiring a concentration check at DC 15 plus spell level or failing; casting while fatigued causes exhaustion, and exhaustion bars further extra casting.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Nail of Blood (pf1-wondrous-items#050)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limited casting without the usual zone restriction, with fatigue as the escalating cost; a world can raise the limit by making bodily strain more dangerous.

rules.statement: A null spike driven into stone weighing at least 1,000 pounds creates a 60-foot radius in which each spell has a 30% chance to fail; this chance does not stack with other spell-failure chances. The effect lasts until the spike is removed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Null Spike (pf1-wondrous-items#050)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stationary, removable spell-disruption field; a world can adjust its radius or failure rate, risking either negligible interference or a magic dead zone.

rules.statement: Installing a necrograft takes 1 hour, requires a humanoid to replace a body part, and deals 2 Constitution damage; the recipient must pass a DC 18 Fortitude save or it fails to integrate. A host’s necrosis score is half the number of implants, minimum 1, and applies equal benefits to some defenses and penalties to disease, negative-energy saves, morale bonuses, and magical healing.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Necrograft — Necrosis Score (pf1-wondrous-items#050)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a lasting bodily alteration with benefits and linked penalties; a world can change the integration risk, but surgical damage and necrosis keep the augmentation costly.

rules.statement: When two people willingly agree by handshake while holding the oath-breaker’s brand, breaking the agreement marks the offender for 1 year, imposing a –8 penalty on Diplomacy and Bluff checks wherever the mark is visible in the River Kingdoms. Listed powerful magic can remove the mark sooner.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Oath breaker’s Brand (pf1-wondrous-items#050)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a voluntary agreement enforced by a visible regional stigma; a world can broaden enforcement, at the cost of making ordinary broken promises magically consequential.

rules.statement: A voluntarily signed blood agreement can bind its signers to the specified service or actions. A breaker takes –4 on attack rolls, saves, ability checks, and skill checks until complying, if possible, or until the parchment is destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Pact Parchment (pf1-wondrous-items#051)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: voluntary signatures bind and breaking brings penalties; a world can change what counts as fulfillment or how the contract is ended, reflecting its enforcement customs.

rules.statement: An ofuda attached to a prominent structure after a 24-hour ritual creates dimensional locking in a 240-foot radius until removed. Moving the structure ends the effect, which must be restored by repeating the ritual.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Ofuda of Dimensional Warding (pf1-wondrous-items#051)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the ward lasts while its anchored talisman stays put; a world can alter its radius or ritual time, reflecting the effort needed to secure a place.

rules.statement: The oculus can be used once per hour to target one robot within 60 feet, dealing 10d6 electricity damage and making it helpless for 1 minute. A DC 18 Will save halves the damage and prevents helplessness; a helpless robot retries the save at the end of each turn.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Oculus of Magnetic Fury (pf1-wondrous-items#051)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: a held device emits a robot-targeting pulse once hourly; a world can change its recharge interval or affectable machines, reflecting power supply and design.

rules.statement: An orb of consumption compels creatures with Intelligence 3 or higher within 10 feet to approach and touch it, requiring a DC 15 Will save each round; its holder is immune while holding it. The first creature to touch it takes 1d2 Constitution and 1d2 Wisdom damage unless it succeeds at a DC 15 Will save, and the user gains +4 Charisma for 1 hour per point of ability damage dealt; use lasts up to 6 rounds per day while concentrating.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Orb of Consumption (pf1-wondrous-items#051)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the orb spends a limited daily activation to lure victims and harvest their vitality; a world can change the daily limit or the resulting benefit, reflecting the danger of feeding it.

rules.statement: The orb of foul Abaddon gives a good creature carrying it one permanent negative level, which vanishes immediately when the creature stops carrying it and cannot be remedied while it is carried. It also improves the bearer’s caster level by 1 for evil spells when used as an additional focus, and releases a dread bolt once per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Orb of Foul Abaddon (pf1-wondrous-items#051)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the artifact empowers evil magic but burdens good bearers; a world can change the alignment restriction or penalty, reflecting its moral nature.

rules.statement: A paradox box opens only when its command or combination is correctly supplied; before then it has no accessible opening or interior. Opened, it holds up to 1 cubic foot in extradimensional storage regardless of weight, but destroying it sends its contents randomly into the Ethereal Plane.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Paradox Box (pf1-wondrous-items#051)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: access depends on the correct key and stored objects remain outside ordinary space; a world can alter capacity or the consequences of destruction, reflecting security and dimensional instability.

rules.statement: A paralyzing snare is set as a 5-foot loop; a creature entering it must succeed at a DC 26 Will save or be paralyzed. The effect ends if its command is spoken, a DC 30 Disable Device check succeeds, or the target succeeds at the save; the snare is then destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Paralyzing Snare (pf1-wondrous-items#051)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: the trap binds one intruder until a defined release condition, then is spent; a world can alter the escape methods or save difficulty, reflecting trap construction.

rules.statement: The white tribal war paint gives +4 on saves against level drain and negative energy; when it absorbs a negative level from energy drain, it fades and its effects end. Only one paint color can benefit a creature at once, and an application lasts 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Paint, Tribal War Paint (pf1-wondrous-items#051)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default: one applied paint grants its color’s benefit for 24 hours, with white paint consumed by an absorbed level; a world can alter duration or protection, reflecting the paint’s potency.

rules.statement: A power can be tied to a worn item: it may grant a steady benefit, or activate only under a stated trigger, action, or daily-use limit. Some benefits last for a set duration, and some require continued use or performance.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Various item descriptions (pf1-wondrous-items#052)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed trigger, duration, and uses; a world can loosen these limits, but doing so makes item power less scarce.

rules.statement: An item can turn a failed save against paralysis into fatigue for 1d4 rounds; if the wearer is already fatigued, another such failure causes exhaustion. Effects that paralyze without a save cause fatigue until the wearer removes the condition.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Periapt of Proof Against Paralysis (pf1-wondrous-items#052)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to exchanging paralysis for fatigue or exhaustion; a world can make the protection stronger, at the cost of more persistent impairment.

rules.statement: A pearl of power can restore one spell of its assigned level that its owner prepared and cast that day, once per day. A version can instead restore two spells per day, each of a different level no higher than 6th.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Pearl of Power (pf1-wondrous-items#052)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the pearl’s level and daily limit; a world can allow more recovered spells, making prepared magic more readily renewable.

rules.statement: A puzzle box can hold one touch spell of 4th level or lower. If it has been set as a trap, failure to solve it before the 1-minute timer expires—or pausing for 1 round while solving—discharges the spell against the holder; a failed attempt locks it for 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Perilous Puzzle Box (pf1-wondrous-items#052)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the DC 20 puzzle and its timer, discharge, and lockout; a world can shorten the timer, making stored magic more dangerous to handle.

rules.statement: The philter permanently makes its drinker helpful toward the first creature seen afterward and creates romantic love when possible, otherwise platonic adoration. The effect ends only through one of the listed powerful removal effects.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Philter of Love (pf1-wondrous-items#052)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a permanent attachment removable only by specified magic; a world can shorten the duration, reducing the cost to the drinker’s autonomy.

rules.statement: Pipes of pain fascinate creatures within 30 feet while the performer continues playing, unless they succeed at a DC 14 Will save. For 2d4 rounds after the music stops, affected creatures take 1d4 damage per round from noise unless in total silence, then become shaken unless they remain in silence.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Pipes of Pain (pf1-wondrous-items#052)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to continuous performance and the listed aftereffect; a world can extend the pain, making the benefit of silence more consequential.

rules.statement: Pipes of dissolution grant creatures within 30 feet a +2 bonus on checks to dispel magic or overcome spell resistance while played. The performer must spend a move action and succeed at a Perform check each round, with its DC rising by 1 each round; stopping or failing ends the effect and prevents reuse for 1 hour.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Pipes of Dissolution (pf1-wondrous-items#052)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the escalating check and one-hour lockout; a world can reduce the upkeep, letting magical interference persist more easily.

rules.statement: Pipes of the Sewers can attract 1d3 rat swarms from within 400 feet. A successful DC 10 Perform check lets the player command them only while playing; failure makes them attack the player, and the check becomes 5 harder each time rats were successfully called in the preceding 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Pipes of the Sewers (pf1-wondrous-items#052)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring continuous music and an escalating check; a world can make the rats easier to command, reducing the danger of calling them.

rules.statement: A planar carriage travels under magical propulsion at up to 90 feet per round, accelerating by 30 feet, and requires its driver to use Spellcraft or Use Magic Device for driving checks. Once per day, while moving at maximum speed, the driver can make a DC 20 check with one of those skills to open a gate to another plane and drive through it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Planar Carriage (pf1-wondrous-items#053)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a once-daily interplanar crossing at full speed with a DC 20 driving check; a world can change the frequency or reliability, with the reason grounded in the carriage’s unstable planar transit.

rules.statement: After arriving on another plane, the carriage and its occupants gain that plane’s adaptation benefits while inside; those benefits change when it moves to a different plane, and natives of the current plane gain none.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Planar Carriage (pf1-wondrous-items#053)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to adapting only the carriage and its occupants, and only to the current plane; a world can broaden or narrow protection, with the in-world constraint that adaptation follows the carriage’s destination.

rules.statement: A planar keystone can be used once per day by up to eight intelligent creatures within 20 feet: they must concentrate for 1 minute without being attacked or taking other actions, or the attempt is lost for that day. On completion, the group and keystone travel to the fixed site it is attuned to, arriving precisely on target.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Planar Keystone (pf1-wondrous-items#053)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one daily, fragile group transit for up to eight creatures; a world can alter the capacity or concentration requirement, with the reason or cost expressed as vulnerability during the minute-long attunement.

rules.statement: A planar guide points toward a plane’s ruler’s stronghold, or the closest equivalent, and can instead locate a portal within 3 miles. Each consultation has a 5% chance of misleading the user toward a hazard; this chance accumulates on later consultations and resets to 5% when a hazard is encountered.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Planar Guide (pf1-wondrous-items#053)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to accurate direction-finding with a growing 5% misdirection risk per use until a hazard is found; a world can change the risk or reset condition, with the cost being exposure to dangerous destinations.

rules.statement: A planar strap tied to a weapon makes it immune to harmful environmental effects of a plane, but not to non-environmental energy attacks. It takes a full-round action to tie or untie, only one strap can be attached to a weapon, and the strap is destroyed if the weapon is destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Planar Strap (pf1-wondrous-items#053)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to protecting one weapon from ambient planar harm but not targeted attacks; a world can expand or narrow the protection, with the in-world limit enforced by the strap’s attachment to that weapon.

rules.statement: A poison popcushion struck by a melee or ranged attack bursts in a 10-foot-radius area, dealing 1d4+1 piercing damage each round for 1d3 rounds; a DC 13 Reflex save halves the damage. Loading it requires 3 doses of injury poison, which affects struck creatures at a save DC 4 lower than the poison’s usual DC.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Poison Popcushion (pf1-wondrous-items#053)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an attack-triggered burst with persistent area damage and weaker-than-normal poison; a world can turn the radius, duration, or poison penalty, with the cost being consumed poison doses and risk to nearby creatures.

rules.statement: A portable hole creates a 10-foot-deep extradimensional space when spread on a surface; folding the cloth closes the entrance while contents remain stored with it. It contains air for one Medium or two Small creatures for 10 minutes, and placing it in or inside a bag of holding causes a catastrophic rift that draws in the items and nearby creatures as specified by their arrangement.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Portable Hole (pf1-wondrous-items#053)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to portable storage with a limited air supply and a dangerous interaction with bags of holding; a world can change capacity or interaction severity, with the in-world cost being entrapment or loss through the rift.

rules.statement: A poison vial of distance can deliver a supplied contact or ingested poison to a creature or object up to 30 feet away with a ranged touch attack, granting a +4 circumstance bonus to that attack.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Poison Vial of Distance (pf1-wondrous-items#053)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to ranged delivery within 30 feet with an accuracy bonus; a world can change the range or bonus, with the cost that the user must supply a suitable poison and land the attack.

rules.statement: A quill of passage can create up to three doorways per day in a wall no more than 6 inches thick; each lasts 10 minutes, and any number of creatures can pass through using a move action. No use is spent if the far side is blocked and the ink fails to flow.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Quill of Passage (pf1-wondrous-items#053)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary pass-through openings only where the far side is clear; a world can change wall thickness, duration, or uses, with the cost limited by three daily activations.

rules.statement: An armed regression mine must be deployed within 3 rounds or be armed again. Once deployed, it triggers when a creature enters its space and creates a field with a 20-foot radius that lasts 1 minute.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Regression Mine — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#054)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a timed, single-use trigger; a world can change the arming window or field radius to tune setup difficulty and danger.

rules.statement: Creatures in the mine’s field when it activates, or entering while it remains active, are confused and take –4 Intelligence while in the field and for 1 minute after leaving. Affected creatures reroll any determined action other than attacking the nearest creature and use the reroll; a DC 15 save avoids the effects, but must be tried again each round in the field.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Regression Mine — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#054)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to recurring saves against an area condition; a world can adjust the penalty, duration, or save frequency, with harsher settings making exposure more costly.

rules.statement: A mine is single-use and becomes inert and nonmagical after triggering. An armed mine in another mine’s active field triggers automatically; a DC 30 Disable Device check disables an armed or active mine, and missing an armed mine’s check by more than 5 triggers it immediately. Disabling an active mine collapses its field.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Regression Mine — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#054)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to consuming the device on activation and allowing a high-risk disable attempt; a world can change the check difficulty or chain-trigger behavior to alter the hazard’s cost.

rules.statement: A creature carrying an armed regression mine that takes damage must make a DC 15 Reflex save or trigger it immediately.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Regression Mine — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#054)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to damage destabilizing armed devices; a world can remove or increase this chance, trading reliability against the risk of carrying the mine.

rules.statement: Ring gates function only as a pair on the same plane and no more than 100 miles apart. They instantly pass objects, creatures small enough to fit, attacks, and spells between their marked entry and exit sides, subject to a daily limit of 100 pounds of material transferred.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Ring Gates (pf1-wondrous-items#054)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to paired, directional passage with a distance and throughput limit; a world can change these bounds, with greater capacity making transport more useful.

rules.statement: A robe of scintillating colors takes 1 full round to begin its display. For up to 10 rounds per day, it can daze those looking toward its wearer within 30 feet for 1d4+1 rounds unless they succeed at a DC 16 Will save; its concealment rises by 10% each continuous round to a maximum 50%, and it lights a 30-foot radius.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe of Scintillating Colors (pf1-wondrous-items#054)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a ramping defense and gaze-like mental effect with a shared daily limit; a world can tune activation delay, range, or duration to trade protection for exposure.

rules.statement: A robe of the archmagi grants its powers only to an arcane spellcaster. Wearing one whose alignment conflicts with the wearer’s imposes two or three permanent negative levels, depending on the mismatch; these levels remain while worn and vanish when it is removed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe of the Archmagi (pf1-wondrous-items#054)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to alignment mismatch imposing a removable while-worn penalty; a world can change the penalty or eligibility rule, making powerful equipment more or less restrictive.

rules.statement: A robe of useful items yields one patch each round, turning it into its listed item; its standard patches include two each of six specified items, and it also has 4d4 additional patches determined by the listed table. Removed patches cannot be replaced.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe of Useful Items (pf1-wondrous-items#054)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limited, permanent-use stored items; a world can alter the patch count or contents, balancing flexibility against depletion.

rules.statement: A smuggler’s collapsible robe can draw its wearer and nonliving carried objects up to the wearer’s maximum load into an extradimensional space. Inside, the wearer can breathe for up to 24 hours, see the area around the robe, and leave as a free action, but cannot take other actions; leaving is impossible if there is insufficient room to reappear.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe, Smuggler’s Collapsible (pf1-wondrous-items#054)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a limited-action refuge with a capacity and exit-space constraint; a world can change its duration or what can be carried, with greater safety inviting greater reliance.

rules.statement: If the robe is destroyed or its magic suppressed while its wearer is inside the extradimensional space, or the wearer remains there for 24 hours, the wearer and everything inside return instantly to the robe’s location; the wearer is dazed for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Opening fragment (pf1-wondrous-items#055)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to forced return at the stated triggers; a world could change the 24-hour limit, with the risk of being stranded or dazed as the cost.

rules.statement: A sorcerer’s robe lets its wearer spend a use of her 1st-level bloodline power as a swift action before casting a spell, applying it to one target of that spell; it can do this up to 3 times per day. A successful save against the spell halves hit-point damage from the bloodline effect or negates a non-damaging effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe, Sorcerer’s (pf1-wondrous-items#055)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three daily activations that consume the wearer’s own bloodline use; a world could loosen either limit, at the cost of greater magical output.

rules.statement: Once per day while casting a summon monster or summon nature’s ally spell, the summoner’s robe can absorb one creature instead of placing it in the spell’s range. The wearer gains specified defenses and powers based on the creature type, but does not gain its appearance, movement, attacks, size, or ability-score changes; the aura ends when dispelled, barred from an area the creature could not enter, when the summoning spell ends, or when the wearer takes damage equal to at least 5 hit points per spell level.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe, Summoner’s (pf1-wondrous-items#055)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one absorbed summon per day and the listed termination conditions; a world could extend the duration or damage threshold, risking a stronger or longer-lasting defense.

rules.statement: A wearer of a robe of Xorn can travel through up to 20 feet of natural or worked stone per day in 5-foot increments, and can live on gems, precious metals, and metallic ore, with 100 gp worth sustaining a day. After such a meal, removing the robe causes sickness until 24 hours have passed since that meal; putting it back on ends the sickness immediately.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Robe, Xorn (pf1-wondrous-items#055)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the 20-foot daily travel allowance and 100-gp food requirement; a world could change either limit, with the robe’s removal imposing sickness after a metal meal.

rules.statement: A rope of climbing moves at 10 feet per round when commanded and can attach or return; it can also knot itself, shortening from 60 to 50 feet while lowering climbing-check difficulty by 10. A creature must hold an end when the rope’s magic is invoked.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Rope of Climbing (pf1-wondrous-items#055)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to commanded movement with an owner holding the rope; a world could change its speed or knotting limits, risking less control over the animated tool.

rules.statement: A rope of entanglement lashes up to 20 feet forward or 10 feet upward to entangle a victim; escape requires a DC 20 Strength or Escape Artist check. It has AC 22, 12 hit points, hardness 10, and damage reduction 5 against slashing, repairs 1 hit point per 5 minutes, and is destroyed if severed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Rope of Entanglement (pf1-wondrous-items#055)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed reach, escape checks, and self-repair; a world could alter durability or repair speed, making the living rope easier or harder to disable.

rules.statement: Once per day, a spontaneous caster can use a runestone of power to cast one spell of the stone’s level without expending a personal spell slot; the stone recharges after 24 hours. The stone only works for spontaneous spellcasters, not casters who merely have an option to cast some spells spontaneously.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Runestone of Power (pf1-wondrous-items#055)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one stored spell use per day at the marked level; a world could change recharge or eligible users, increasing the supply of castings.

rules.statement: A book thief’s satchel can once per day erase the ordinary text in a placed book or scroll and copy it into a hidden blank book, taking 1 full round. The blank book must be large enough; interruption loses the text being copied, and magical writing cannot be copied or erased this way.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Satchel, Book Thief’s (pf1-wondrous-items#055)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one daily transfer with size, time, and magical-writing limits; a world could change those limits, risking loss or unauthorized copying of texts.

rules.statement: A power attached to an item may activate on a command, a use action, or a qualifying event, with its frequency and duration fixed by the item; some effects also spend a limited number of charges or destroy the item when exhausted.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wondrous Items > R-Z (pf1-wondrous-items#056)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to item powers with stated triggers and limits; a world can change recharge or exhaustion rates, balancing magical convenience against scarcity.

rules.statement: An effect can be restricted to a particular target or situation, and may fail against targets with a specified defense or above a stated difficulty threshold.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Scabbard of Stanching (pf1-wondrous-items#056)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to hard eligibility limits and defenses; a world can widen eligible targets, at the cost of making specialized protections less meaningful.

rules.statement: A magical effect can persist while a condition holds, then end when that condition is broken; removing or destroying the item can immediately end an ongoing effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shackles of Durance Vile (pf1-wondrous-items#056)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to effects that last while their stated condition remains; a world can allow effects to persist after removal, at the cost of harder-to-break control.

rules.statement: A stored or conjured effect can be constrained by a capacity, duration, range, or use count, and may impose a cost or vulnerability while active.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Scabbard of Many Blades (pf1-wondrous-items#056)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to explicit capacity, duration, and use ceilings; a world can raise them, making the item more powerful but more costly or risky.

rules.statement: An item can conceal a compatible slashing weapon by making both it and its sheath invisible until the weapon is drawn; touch still detects it, and other invisibility-detection effects work normally. This grants +5 on checks to hide the weapon.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Sheath of Bladestealth (pf1-wondrous-items#057)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to hiding the weapon until drawn, with touch and special detection as counters; a world can make the concealment more or less reliable because the item is a paid, limited tool.

rules.statement: A wrist sheath stores one eligible item weighing at most 5 pounds in weightless extradimensional space; retrieval takes a swift action and fails if the wearer’s hand is occupied, while storage takes a move action. Paired sheaths can release both stored items with one swift action.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Sheath, Vanishing (pf1-wondrous-items#057)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a single stored item and action costs; a world can vary capacity or retrieval speed because the magic trades convenience for a bounded storage space.

rules.statement: A paired set of shells sends up to 25 whispered words once per day to the holder of its attuned partner on the same plane; reattuning a replacement takes 24 hours. Eavesdroppers who fail a DC 14 Will save hear apparent nonsense, and those failing by 5 or more are deafened for 1d4 minutes.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shell of Sending (pf1-wondrous-items#057)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a paired, same-plane, once-daily channel with a short message limit; a world can alter range or frequency because the shells require attunement and offer imperfect privacy.

rules.statement: A wearer can activate the shirt once per day for 10 minutes to gain freedom of movement. Another shirt grants one extra move action once per day, but the wearer must have worn it continuously for 24 hours and immediately ends their turn after using that action, losing unused actions.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shirt, Unfettered; Shirt, Quick Runner’s (pf1-wondrous-items#057)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to brief or once-daily movement benefits with activation constraints; a world can turn duration or action cost because these effects bypass ordinary movement limits.

rules.statement: The shoes of lightning leaping can be used once per day to transform the wearer into lightning and move up to 50 feet in a straight line; creatures in the path take 6d6 electricity damage. If a barrier stops the movement, the wearer appears beside it and is staggered for 1 round.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shoes of Lightning Leaping (pf1-wondrous-items#057)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a once-daily straight-line transformation with a collision penalty; a world can vary distance or damage because the wearer risks being stopped by barriers.

rules.statement: A single use of the snapleaf while falling destroys it and grants both feather fall and invisibility; the two effects end independently, but cannot be activated separately.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Snapleaf (pf1-wondrous-items#057)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a consumed item that supplies both effects together; a world can change the paired effects because the leaf is destroyed on activation.

rules.statement: The silver nail can be used once against a helpless or pinned evil outsider to prevent dimensional escape, or against an incorporeal undead creature to prevent it entering solid objects. The effect lasts 1 minute, then the nail falls out and is powerless; an invalid target still expends it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Silver Nail (pf1-wondrous-items#057)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a one-minute, target-restricted containment effect; a world can widen targets or duration because a failed choice still consumes the nail.

rules.statement: A creature that eats a shrinking berry transforms into a smaller, less dangerous animal for 24 hours unless it succeeds at Fortitude DC 14; the effect can be hidden in food typical for that animal.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Shrinking Berries (pf1-wondrous-items#057)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a consumable transformation with a Fortitude resistance check and fixed duration; a world can vary the duration or resistance because the effect is delivered through food.

rules.statement: A halfling can spend a full-round action puffing on solidsmoke pipeweed to form a smoky object up to 5 pounds and 1 cubic foot; each further full-round action adds 2 pounds and 1 cubic foot. Making a complex object requires an appropriate Craft check, and stopping early collapses it and extinguishes the pipe; one pinch lasts 3 rounds, so one object cannot exceed 9 pounds or 3 cubic feet, and it cannot be made to precisely duplicate a particular object.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Solidsmoke pipeweed passage (pf1-wondrous-items#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary, size-limited fabrication; a world could raise the size or persistence dial, with more fuel or time as the cost.

rules.statement: Objects made with solidsmoke pipeweed last 24 hours before fading. They otherwise have the ordinary hardness, hit points, and qualities of their manufactured type, but non-halflings gain no benefit from smoking the pipeweed and become sickened for 1 round each time they spend a standard action smoking it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Solidsmoke pipeweed passage (pf1-wondrous-items#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a 24-hour duration and a halfling-only benefit; a world could make the smoke usable by all, at the cost of removing its racial restriction.

rules.statement: A spirit planchette takes 2d6 rounds to attune while its users concentrate, and can then be used once per day to ask 1 question with brass, 3 with cold iron, or 5 with silver. Answers are brief; each use risks possession, with Will save DCs 11, 15, and 19 respectively, and a failed save causes 1, 2, or 3 rounds of confusion and no answer.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Spirit Planchette (pf1-wondrous-items#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to limited, potentially unreliable spirit answers; a world could make contact safer or more truthful, with reduced danger or fewer questions as the balancing cost.

rules.statement: Sovereign glue covers 1 square foot per ounce and permanently bonds almost any two substances after 1 round. Pulling the joined objects apart before it sets ruins that application; after setting, separation fails unless universal solvent is applied, and fresh slipperiness salve must be put in the flask within 1 round of each pour to keep the remaining glue from adhering to its container.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Sovereign Glue (pf1-wondrous-items#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a nearly permanent bond with a brief setting window and solvent as the release; a world could allow other release methods, at the cost of weakening the bond.

rules.statement: A spell lattice holds one chosen spell. A spontaneous caster or arcanist with that spell on her class list can spend a spell slot to cast it as though known or prepared, while a spellbook user can copy it as from a scroll, which expends the contained spell.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Spell Lattice (pf1-wondrous-items#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to storing one spell for qualifying users; a world could allow repeated copying, at the cost of making the spell lattice nonconsumable.

rules.statement: A spell totem can hold up to 3 spell levels but cannot cast them by itself. When its bearer becomes the matching animal, the bearer can use a stored spell on themself as a swift action if it can target them in that form; the effect immediately ends when the bearer changes shape again.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Spell Totem (pf1-wondrous-items#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to matching-form access and an effect tied to that form; a world could let the effect persist after transformation, at the cost of more powerful storage.

rules.statement: A canopic stone permanently binds a spectral vilkacis to the Material Plane and lets its bearer summon it once per day, but does not control it. The summoned creature avoids the bearer and attacks the nearest other creature, attempting possession; using the stone this way is evil.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Stone, Canopic (pf1-wondrous-items#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a persistent anchor that summons a hostile, uncontrolled spirit; a world could grant control, with a binding contract or other price.

rules.statement: A steadfast gut-stone stays inside its bearer for up to a week and can absorb precision damage, but only one can be inside a creature at a time. Swallowing a second destroys both and requires a DC 15 Fortitude save or causes 1 round of sickness; a damaged stone may instead be sacrificed to harm an attacking melee weapon.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Steadfast Gut-Stone (pf1-wondrous-items#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one short-lived internal defense that can be sacrificed; a world could permit multiple stones, with the risk of internal harm as the cost.

rules.statement: A lesser protective amulet activates automatically when its specific trigger occurs, but can protect its wearer only once before crumbling. Up to three may be worn on one cord, but only one effect can operate at a time; a second amulet whose trigger occurs during an active effect remains available.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Talisman, Lesser — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one automatic, single-use protection at a time; a world can change the number worn or their recharge, trading broader coverage against scarcity and competing triggers.

rules.statement: The greater version retains its matching lesser version’s effect but can provide it once per day rather than only once before destruction.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Talisman, Greater — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one use each day; a world can make the effect more or less renewable, balancing reliable protection against the value of the item.

rules.statement: A wearable item can create a portal to one of two destinations fixed when it is made; it can be used once per day, and the portal lasts at most 10 minutes unless dismissed sooner. If the user remains beyond the destination after it closes, the user is stranded there.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Talisman, Melancholic – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to fixed endpoints and one daily use; a world can change the destinations or duration, with stranding as the risk of lingering.

rules.statement: Some items hold a bound creature that can provide a benefit without being under the wearer’s control; a daily attempt to call it can fail, and success makes it serve for rounds equal to its challenge rating.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Talisman, Sanguine – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an independent bound being and a contested daily call; a world can make the being more cooperative or harder to summon.

rules.statement: A stored single-target spell of up to 3rd level can be suppressed along with its remaining duration, then restored to its original target; the stored spell is lost when the bearer next prepares spells.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Tattoo, Reservoir – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#060)
