rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one spell stored and suspended until restored; a world can raise the level limit, risking longer-term spell retention.

rules.statement: A persistent item effect can have a limited number of uses or a fixed daily duration, and may cease to function after its final use or after its duration ends.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Talisman of Beast Training – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to finite item charges; a world can make such effects renewable, but must decide how the renewal is paid for.

rules.statement: An item can change a creature’s form or create a temporary creature, with duration, use limits, and possible early termination specified by the effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Talisman of the Summoned Steed – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary, item-driven manifestations; a world can make them permanent, at the cost of ongoing upkeep or greater risk.

rules.statement: Some magic imposes a continuing mental cost on its user while also granting protection against that same kind of mental effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Talons of Leng – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a lasting drawback paired with a matching immunity; a world can make the drawback worsen with use or remove the immunity.

rules.statement: A placed ward can block a chosen creature category from crossing an entrance; a creature’s first saving throw sets whether it can pass while the ward remains undisturbed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Threshold Guardian – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed ward with a one-time resistance test; a world can broaden the blocked categories or make the ward easier to destroy.

rules.statement: An effect that grants a temporary benefit may end early when its recipient attacks, and ending it early does not restore the expended daily use.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Thundering Collar – DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an attack ending the protection without refunding its use; a world can let the protection persist through aggression, making it stronger.

rules.statement: A tome can record 50 creatures’ names, each with a distinguishing description. Speaking its command word protects all named creatures as mind blank for 24 hours and seals the tome; when that period ends, the eye reopens and the pages containing names disappear.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Tome of Forgotten Epithets — Effects (pf1-wondrous-items#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one 24-hour activation affecting everyone listed; a world could change the duration or number protected, with the cost being erased entries when the effect expires.

rules.statement: A toxin sponge removes poison gas from one 10-foot cube and holds one poison at a time, pausing its remaining duration. The poison dissipates harmlessly after 24 hours, or a creature can squeeze the filled sponge to release it with its remaining duration and original area.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Toxin Sponge — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one stored poison in a 10-foot cube for up to 24 hours; a world could expand capacity or storage time, at the risk of keeping a dangerous substance available for release.

rules.statement: A treasurer’s seal can maintain effects on three items at once; applying it to a fourth ends the oldest effect. Its bearer can suspend effects made by that seal for one minute, at will.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Treasurer’s Seal — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to three maintained targets and a one-minute suspension; a world could raise the target limit, but stronger effects would occupy more of the seal’s capacity.

rules.statement: A trophy box can capture one Medium-or-larger animal per day when it approaches within 20 feet; the animal can resist with a DC 17 Will save. A captured animal remains suspended for up to 24 hours, and release can be immediate or triggered by another creature approaching; nearby users can control it for one minute, otherwise it attacks the nearest creature for that long.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Trophy Box — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one animal, a 20-foot trigger, and 24-hour containment; a world could alter the capacity or duration, with the captured creature’s freedom and safety at stake.

rules.statement: A traveler’s translator listens to speech within 30 feet and learns one language after one minute of exposure, but can retain only one learned language and learn at most one per day. After at least 24 hours, the command word can erase the learned language to make room for another; it does not teach reading or writing.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Traveler’s Translator — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one learned language and one day between replacements; a world could permit several stored languages, but would need to relax the device’s memory limit.

rules.statement: A shadowbond tunic links its wearer to one ally after a one-minute attunement and lasts 24 hours. While adjacent, the wearer may take up to 10 damage to prevent the same amount to that ally; removing the tunic ends the link and prevents another attunement for 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Tunic, Shadowbond — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one ally, adjacency, and a maximum 10 damage transferred per event; a world could increase the protection, but the wearer pays the prevented damage directly.

rules.statement: The traveler’s grandiose carrying case grants a stored harrow deck a +2 bonus on saves against effects that specifically target it. During a harrowing, it dims light within 15 feet and creates small illusions of the cards being interpreted.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Traveler’s Grandiose Carrying Case — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to protection for only the stored deck and a 15-foot dimming area during a harrowing; a world could extend either benefit, making the case’s influence more conspicuous.

rules.statement: Unctuous waders provide underwater breathing and swimming, and can propel their wearer with a slipstream effect three times per day. If the wearer spends more than a week without entering the ocean, the boots may withdraw underwater breathing to pressure the wearer.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Unctuous Waders — Effects (pf1-wondrous-items#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to reliable underwater use while the wearer regularly submerges in the ocean, with three daily bursts of propulsion; a world could make the boots’ demands more forceful, at the cost of their breathing benefit.

rules.statement: Some worn items grant an ability only to a specified kind of wearer or when a condition is met; for example, the tactician vambraces require a cavalier, while the merciful vambraces require a paladin and a mercy the wearer is high enough level to use.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Vambraces, Merciful; Vambraces of the Tactician (pf1-wondrous-items#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to enforcing wearer and ability prerequisites; a world can loosen them, at the cost of weakening the items’ ties to their intended traditions.

rules.statement: An item’s activated abilities may be limited by a daily use allotment, a fixed number of charges, or a pool of usable time; the void pennant, for example, works for 10 rounds per day, which need not be consecutive.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Vambraces of Defense; Void Pennant (pf1-wondrous-items#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to tracking each stated use, charge, or round limit and restoring it only as described; a world can increase the reserve, making rare magic more common.

rules.statement: A placed or played item can affect a bounded area and continue to affect creatures only while they meet its range or participation conditions. The war drums affect audible allies within 60 feet while playing; the effect ends when playing stops and cannot restart for 1 day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): War Drums of Savagery (pf1-wondrous-items#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to applying the effect only within the stated area and while its trigger continues; a world can broaden the area or ease the restart delay, making group magic less costly to coordinate.

rules.statement: Some item effects have a limited duration or end when a particular event occurs: venombane lozenges last 5 minutes, while the warlord’s scabbard’s rage effect lasts 1 minute or until its wielder kills a creature.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Venombane Lozenges; Warlord’s Scabbard (pf1-wondrous-items#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to ending effects at their stated duration or event; a world can let them persist longer, increasing the time a character can benefit.

rules.statement: Certain effects can be ended early by removing or uprooting their source: taking off the visage of the bound immediately releases its outsider, and uprooting the void pennant ends its field.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Visage of the Bound; Void Pennant (pf1-wondrous-items#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to treating removal of the source as an immediate end condition; a world can require a separate action or contest, making ongoing magic harder to stop.

rules.statement: An item can transform a supplied object or effect rather than creating an independent effect: a volatile vaporizer pill converts a compatible potion into a 10-foot-radius cloud that affects creatures in it, but consumes both pill and potion.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Volatile Vaporizer (pf1-wondrous-items#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to consuming both ingredients on a successful conversion and applying the potion’s effect to eligible creatures in range; a world can allow reuse or wider clouds, at the cost of scarce consumables.

rules.statement: Some items create creatures or place them in a container-like state with restrictions. The visage holds an outsider summoned by its wearer, grants access to that outsider’s spell-like abilities for the summon’s duration, and cannot house an outsider opposed to the wearer’s alignment.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Visage of the Bound (pf1-wondrous-items#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing only the wearer’s qualifying summon and to releasing it when the mask is removed; a world can relax alignment restrictions, risking the use of hostile outsiders.

rules.statement: A voidstick can turn a corpse into a zombie through an hour-long ritual, a successful DC 25 Knowledge (religion) check, and one stick per Hit Die; the creature rises in 12 rounds and is not controlled by its creator. Using the ritual on a living helpless target instead calls for a DC 18 Fortitude save, with success leaving the target dying and wasting the ritual and stick, and failure killing and transforming it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Voidstick (pf1-wondrous-items#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring the ritual, materials, and stated checks and to leaving the resulting undead uncontrolled; a world can make creation more reliable or grant control, at the cost of greater ritual power.

rules.statement: A watchful tankard placed on a solid surface after its command word is spoken sticks with the equivalent of Strength 18. Its last drinker can make Perception checks from the tankard while within 60 feet, and can use permanent vision-based abilities through it to 30 feet; repeating the word while holding the handle releases it.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Watchful tankard description (pf1-wondrous-items#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a surface-anchored remote viewpoint; a world could change its range or adhesive strength because the object is a fixed, vulnerable observer.

rules.statement: Each fluid in Waters of Transfiguration permanently changes a touched solid object into its labeled material. Objects of at most 1 cubic foot change instantly; larger targets change at 1 cubic foot per hour, up to 10 cubic feet, and magical or attended objects can resist with a successful DC 17 Fortitude save; each vial provides five applications.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Waters of Transfiguration — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to permanent material conversion within a strict volume cap; a world could vary the speed or resistance because changing matter is consequential and difficult to reverse.

rules.statement: A wave harp can conjure sonic hands three times per day that assist its player for 1 minute, granting +2 on instrument Perform checks and sonic resistance 10. Alternatively, on a successful DC 15 Perform check it imposes a –2 penalty on nearby creatures’ saves against sonic effects for 1 round, plus 1 round per 5 points the check exceeds the DC; the musician is excluded and the range is 30 feet.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wave Harp — Effects (pf1-wondrous-items#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to two limited-use sonic effects; a world could change the uses or duration because one bolsters performance while the other makes targets vulnerable to sonic magic.

rules.statement: A wavecutter’s figurine fitted at the helm of a Large or smaller water vehicle reduces its friction with water and grants +20 feet to its maximum speeds.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wavecutter’s Figurine — Effects (pf1-wondrous-items#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a helm-mounted speed enhancement; a world could restrict eligible vessels because the item works through a vehicle’s contact with water.

rules.statement: Wax of Defiance lasts 1 hour and gives its wearer –2 on Perception checks but +4 on saves against charm and language-dependent compulsion. If applied to a willing or helpless creature already affected by one of those effects, it allows an immediate new save without the +4 bonus.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wax of Defiance — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to temporary resistance with a perception tradeoff and a one-time escape attempt; a world could change the duration or penalties because stopping influence dulls hearing and awareness.

rules.statement: A wayfinder can channel an inserted ioun stone’s normal benefits and often grants it an additional resonant power. While the stone is being augmented, the wayfinder’s own magical properties are suppressed; two nearby augmenting wayfinders interfere and usually stop working within seconds, then function again when separated.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wayfinder — Wayfinders and Ioun Stones (pf1-wondrous-items#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to amplification that temporarily consumes the device’s own magic; a world could vary amplification and interference because the device redirects finite magical energy.

rules.statement: A wayfinder of many paths can open a 5- to 20-foot gateway once per day for up to 18 rounds, with its destination set by the inserted ioun stone. Draining that stone extends the opening by up to 18 rounds; while in the stone’s attuned location, the device can open a return route to its last-used location after 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wayfinder of Many Paths — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a stone-keyed, short-lived gateway with a consumable extension; a world could alter its reach or duration because each route is tied to a particular stone and uses its power.

rules.statement: A wayfinder of the sleeping eye projects a mobile, partly real image of its sleeping or meditating user for up to 8 hours. The image has 40% of the user’s current hit points, can perceive through its senses, and is destroyed at 0 hit points, dealing the user 2d4 Charisma damage; ending it voluntarily or when the user awakens, is attacked, or reaches the time limit causes no such damage, but using the projection drains the ioun stone for 24 hours.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wayfinder of the Sleeping Eye — Description (pf1-wondrous-items#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fragile remote body with a costly destruction backlash; a world could change its toughness or duration because projection draws on both the bearer and the stone.

rules.statement: The truthseeker wayfinder provides up to 7 minutes per day of a truth-compelling area effect, spent in 1-minute increments. A creature that resists it is immune for 24 hours; one that fails gets another save whenever the wielder starts the effect again.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Truthseeker wayfinder — DESCRIPTION (opening item) (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily pool of seven one-minute uses; a world could change the pool or immunity period, with truth compelled only when a target fails to resist.

rules.statement: Once per day, the truthseeker wayfinder lets its wielder scrutinize a creature for up to 7 rounds; a target can resist with a DC 16 Will save. When the target knowingly lies, the item vibrates perceptibly to its wielder alone.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Truthseeker wayfinder — DESCRIPTION (opening item) (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one daily, seven-round truth-sensing use; a world could widen duration or make the signal public, while a successful save blocks scrutiny.

rules.statement: A vanishing wayfinder lets its bearer become invisible while concentrating, for up to 5 minutes total per day. Each activation spends a full minute even if an attack or other event ends invisibility sooner.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wayfinder, Vanishing — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a five-minute daily reserve spent by the minute; a world could alter the reserve or interruption rule, with concentration required to sustain concealment.

rules.statement: Activating any piece of a weirding watch grants haste and resistance to aging for 3 rounds to its bearer and to other bearers of that same watch within 30 feet. Each of the watch’s five pieces can be activated once per day.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Weirding Watch — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to five once-daily activators sharing a 30-foot benefit; a world could change the range or number of pieces, and the effect ends after three rounds.

rules.statement: A well of many worlds opens a two-way passage to a randomly selected other world; moving the device causes it to select a new random destination. Objects can pass through in either direction.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Well of Many Worlds — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a random, bidirectional world portal that rerolls on relocation; a world could constrain destinations, with unpredictability the cost of access.

rules.statement: A shadow well usually connects to a random location on the Shadow Plane, or to a random Material Plane location when used from the Shadow Plane. Each opening has a 15% chance of diverting the user to the Ethereal Plane.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Well, Shadow — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to plane-dependent random destinations and a 15% diversion; a world could change the chance or destination set, with misrouting as the travel risk.

rules.statement: The wine links creatures that each finish a glass within 10 feet of one another: for 3 hours they sense one another’s direction, distance, and condition, and while within 100 feet they divide wounds equally. The shared-wound effect pauses beyond that distance and resumes when they return within range.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Wine of Concordance — EFFECTS (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a three-hour drinker bond with sensing and equal wound sharing within 100 feet; a world could adjust range or duration, while separation suspends protection.

rules.statement: A word bottle stores a targeted language-dependent spell of up to 3rd level if its casting time is no longer than one full round; throwing and breaking the bottle releases it. The direct target is affected normally, while creatures within 5 feet are also affected but get +5 on saves, including a Will save if the spell normally allows none.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Word Bottle — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one stored eligible spell released by breaking the flask; a world could change level or splash limits, with the container destroyed on release.

rules.statement: The whistle of calling can once per day teleport its specifically attuned mount or animal companion from within 1 mile to a safe space within 30 feet of its user. A 10-minute ritual sets the attunement, which can be changed freely; barriers to teleportation also block this effect.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Whistle of Calling — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a daily rescue teleport for one bonded creature within a mile; a world could alter range or attunement procedure, while teleport-blocking effects remain a hard limit.

rules.statement: A devastating dog whistle affects canines in a 30-foot-radius area: each must resist DC 11 Fortitude or take 1d6 sonic damage and lose the ability to speak or vocalize for 1 minute. It can be used once daily without risk; each extra daily activation adds a cumulative 25% chance that it is destroyed.
locators: Pathfinder 1e wondrous items (d20pfsrd): Whistle, Devastating Dog — DESCRIPTION (pf1-wondrous-items#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to one safe daily use and cumulative 25% destruction risk per extra use; a world could alter the target area or risk, trading reliability for additional activations.
